words.enDefinition: all day and all night without stopping

examples.en: The engineering building has a printer room open twenty-four seven with student card access.
examples.zh: 工学院楼里有一间「全天候」开放的打印室，可以刷学生卡进入。

examples.en: My host family's shop used to stay open twenty-four seven during the busy summer months.
examples.zh: 夏天生意忙的时候，我寄宿家庭的小店以前是「全天候」营业。

words.enDefinition: a small amount of something

examples.en: Can I give you a bit of advice about professor office hours?
examples.zh: 关于教授答疑时间，我能给你「一点」建议吗？

examples.en: There's still a bit of milk left in the mini fridge.
examples.zh: 小冰箱里还剩「一点」牛奶。

words.enDefinition: the amount a bottle holds

examples.en: Bring a bottle of water to the gym, it gets hot in there.
examples.zh: 去健身房带「一瓶」水吧，里面很热。

examples.en: I left a bottle of soda in the freezer by mistake.
examples.zh: 我不小心把「一瓶」汽水忘在了冷冻室。

words.enDefinition: a collection or group of people or things

examples.en: My roommate left a bunch of dirty dishes in the sink again.
examples.zh: 室友又在水槽里留了「一大堆」脏盘子。

examples.en: A bunch of us are going to the movies tonight, want to come?
examples.zh: 今晚我们「一堆」人要去看电影，你要一起吗？

words.enDefinition: two, or a small number of things

examples.en: I'll be there in a couple of minutes, order me a latte.
examples.zh: 我「两三分钟」就到，帮我点一杯拿铁。

examples.en: We watched a couple of episodes after dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚饭后我们看了「两三集」剧。

words.enDefinition: the amount a cup holds

examples.en: Let's grab a cup of coffee before our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 早课之前我们去喝「一杯」咖啡吧。

examples.en: He made me a cup of hot chocolate when I was stressed.
examples.zh: 我压力大的时候，他给我泡了「一杯」热巧克力。

words.enDefinition: a very small part of a whole

examples.en: Rent here costs a fraction of what you'd pay downtown.
examples.zh: 这里的房租只是市中心价格的「一小部分」。

examples.en: Only a fraction of applicants get into that summer program.
examples.zh: 只有「一小部分」申请者能进那个暑期项目。

words.enDefinition: A folding sign with two panels forming an A shape

examples.en: The volunteer put an A-frame sign outside to point people toward the side entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者在外面放了一个「A字形立式标牌」，给人们指明侧门的方向。

examples.en: The A-frame sign was moved indoors when the wind began picking up outside.
examples.zh: 外面的风大起来时，那个「A字形立式标牌」被挪进了室内。

collocations: an A-frame sign on the path

words.enDefinition: a large amount of something abstract

examples.en: Writing the thesis took a great deal of time and patience.
examples.zh: 写论文花了「大量」的时间和耐心。

examples.en: She showed a great deal of patience with the new exchange students.
examples.zh: 她对新来的交换生表现出「极大的」耐心。

words.enDefinition: several people or things considered together

examples.en: A group of us studies together in the library every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 每周二我们「一群」人在图书馆一起学习。

examples.en: A group of tourists asked me for directions to the museum.
examples.zh: 「一群」游客向我打听去博物馆的路。

words.enDefinition: a very small number or amount

examples.en: Only a handful of students showed up to the early review session.
examples.zh: 只有「寥寥几个」学生来参加早上的复习课。

examples.en: She grabbed a handful of popcorn before the movie started.
examples.zh: 电影开始前她抓了「一把」爆米花。

words.enDefinition: one machine full of clothes to be washed

examples.en: Throw in a load of laundry before we head to the library.
examples.zh: 出发去图书馆之前，先「洗一机衣服」。

examples.en: One load of laundry costs two dollars in the dorm basement.
examples.zh: 在宿舍地下室，「洗一机衣服」要两美元。

collocations: throw in a load of laundry
a load of whites and a load of colors

words.enDefinition: a large number or amount of something

examples.en: There are a lot of international students in my dorm this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期我宿舍里住着「很多」国际学生。

examples.en: I spent a lot of money on textbooks at the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学时我花了「很多」钱买课本。

words.enDefinition: several; more than a few

examples.en: A number of students complained about the broken printers in the library.
examples.zh: 「若干」学生抱怨图书馆的打印机坏了。

examples.en: We faced a number of problems when setting up the club.
examples.zh: 创办社团的过程中我们遇到了「若干」问题。

words.enDefinition: two things used or seen together

examples.en: I need a pair of comfortable shoes for walking around campus.
examples.zh: 我需要「一双」舒服的鞋在校园里走动。

examples.en: She bought a pair of gloves before the first snowfall.
examples.zh: 初雪来临前她买了「一双」手套。

words.enDefinition: a single amount of something larger

examples.en: Can I have a piece of that banana bread you baked?
examples.zh: 你烤的香蕉面包能给我「一块」吗？

examples.en: He tore a piece of paper to write down the Wi-Fi password.
examples.zh: 他撕了「一张」纸记下无线网密码。

words.enDefinition: several similar things happening one after another

examples.en: The career center is hosting a series of resume workshops this month.
examples.zh: 就业指导中心本月举办「一系列」简历工作坊。

examples.en: A series of delays made me miss my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 「一系列」延误害我错过了转机航班。

words.enDefinition: a group of similar things belonging together

examples.en: My mom mailed me a set of sheets for my dorm bed.
examples.zh: 妈妈给我寄来了「一套」宿舍床单。

examples.en: The TA handed each group a set of practice questions.
examples.zh: 助教给每组发了「一套」练习题。

words.enDefinition: a sudden feeling of dread that something bad has happened or will happen

examples.en: I got a sinking feeling when the train stopped far from the station.
examples.zh: 列车在离车站很远的地方停下时，我「心里一沉」。

examples.en: She had a sinking feeling after realizing her bag was still on the bus.
examples.zh: 她意识到包还在公交车上时，「心里一沉」。

words.enDefinition: a thin flat piece cut from something

examples.en: Would you like a slice of pizza before your next class?
examples.zh: 下一节课前要不要来「一片」披萨？

examples.en: She added a slice of lemon to her iced tea.
examples.zh: 她在冰茶里加了「一片」柠檬。

words.enDefinition: a very small amount, informal

examples.en: The dorm room feels a tad small with three desks in it.
examples.zh: 放进三张书桌后，宿舍房间显得「稍微」小了点。

examples.en: Your coffee is a tad too sweet for me, honestly.
examples.zh: 说实话，你的咖啡对我来说「稍微」甜了点。

words.enDefinition: several different kinds of the same thing

examples.en: The dining hall serves a variety of dishes every week.
examples.zh: 食堂每周供应「各种各样的」菜品。

examples.en: We discussed a variety of topics during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 迎新会上我们讨论了「各种各样的」话题。

words.enDefinition: many different kinds of something

examples.en: The gym offers a wide range of classes, from yoga to boxing.
examples.zh: 健身房开设瑜伽、拳击等「种类广泛」的课程。

examples.en: You can borrow a wide range of equipment from the media lab.
examples.zh: 你可以从媒体实验室借到「各种各样」的设备。

words.enDefinition: forgetful because your mind is on something else

examples.en: My absent-minded professor once taught the whole class with slippers on.
examples.zh: 我那位「心不在焉的」教授有一次穿着拖鞋上完了整节课。

examples.en: Absorbed in his novel, my absent-minded uncle missed his highway exit.
examples.zh: 我「心不在焉的」叔叔看小说入了迷，错过了高速出口。

words.enDefinition: so unreasonable that it seems silly

examples.en: Charging each roommate a full utility share is absurd when only one of us stays home.
examples.zh: 只有一人在住，却让每个室友全额分摊水电，简直「荒唐」。

examples.en: It felt absurd to write ten pages about a two-page poem, but everyone survived.
examples.zh: 为两页的诗写十页评论听着「荒唐」，但大家还是熬过来了。

words.enDefinition: possible to reach with reasonable effort

examples.en: Saving fifty dollars a month is an achievable goal even on my part-time wage.
examples.zh: 就算靠兼职工资，每月存五十美元也是个「能实现」的目标。

examples.en: The coach set achievable weekly targets so the beginner swimmers stayed motivated.
examples.zh: 教练给新手定「够得着」的周目标，让大家保持干劲。

words.enDefinition: a person you know slightly, but not a close friend

examples.en: He's more of an acquaintance than a friend; we only nod in lectures.
examples.zh: 他算是「熟人」，算不上朋友——我们只在课堂上点个头。

examples.en: I ran into an acquaintance from my chemistry lab at the mall.
examples.zh: 我在商场碰到了一位实验课认识的「熟人」。

words.enDefinition: in or travelling to another part of the same town or city

examples.en: I took a bus across town for the evening class at another campus.
examples.zh: 我坐公交去了「城里另一头」的校区上晚课。

examples.en: We found a repair shop across town that stayed open on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我们在「城里另一头」找到了一家周六也营业的修理店。

words.enDefinition: full of exciting, fast-moving events

examples.en: We spent Friday night watching an action-packed superhero movie at the discount theater.
examples.zh: 周五晚上我们在廉价影院看了部「紧张刺激」的超级英雄片。

examples.en: Our orientation weekend was action-packed, from the morning campus run to the late bonfire.
examples.zh: 迎新周末行程「满满当当」，从清晨环校跑到深夜篝火。

words.enDefinition: able to be changed to fit different needs

examples.en: Get an adjustable desk lamp so late readings don't wake your roommate.
examples.zh: 买盏「可调节」的台灯，夜里赶阅读就不吵到室友。

examples.en: The chair's adjustable arms saved my shoulders during thesis season.
examples.zh: 写论文那阵子，椅子「可调」的扶手救了我的肩膀。

words.enDefinition: a strap whose length can be changed

examples.en: My sandal has an adjustable strap that I loosened after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了很远后，我把凉鞋那根「长度可调的带子」松了松。

examples.en: The adjustable strap on my top kept slipping down during the rehearsal.
examples.zh: 排练时，我上衣那根「长度可调的带子」老是滑下来。

collocations: an adjustable strap on a sandal

words.enDefinition: legally take another person's child into your family

examples.en: My parents decided to adopt after volunteering at the orphanage.
examples.zh: 在孤儿院做志愿者之后，我父母决定「收养」孩子。

examples.en: They adopted a two-year-old girl from a city near my hometown.
examples.zh: 他们从我家乡附近的城市「领养」了一个两岁的女孩。

words.enDefinition: cute in a way that makes you feel affection

examples.en: The neighbor's golden retriever puppy is adorable, so I volunteer to walk it.
examples.zh: 邻居家的金毛幼犬「可爱」极了，我主动帮忙遛狗。

examples.en: Her adorable hand-knitted mittens became the most requested gift that whole winter.
examples.zh: 她那双「可爱」的手织手套成了那年冬天最受欢迎的礼物。

words.enDefinition: priced low enough for you to pay

examples.en: We finally found an affordable flat twenty minutes from campus.
examples.zh: 我们终于找到一套离校园二十分钟、租金「能负担」的房子。

examples.en: Shopping secondhand keeps a professional wardrobe affordable on a student budget.
examples.zh: 买二手衣服，学生预算也「负担」得起职业装。

words.enDefinition: repeatedly, many times over

examples.en: I read my application essay again and again before submitting it.
examples.zh: 提交之前，我把申请文书「反复」读了好几遍。

examples.en: My laptop froze again and again during the online exam.
examples.zh: 在线考试时，我的笔记本「反复」死机。

words.enDefinition: earlier than the planned or expected time

examples.en: We finished the group poster two days ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 我们的小组海报「提前」两天完成了。

examples.en: The train arrived ahead of schedule, so I caught the earlier ferry.
examples.zh: 火车「提前」到站，我赶上了更早一班渡轮。

words.enDefinition: cooled and kept fresh by air conditioning

examples.en: The library is air-conditioned, so everyone camps there during heat waves.
examples.zh: 图书馆「有空调」，热浪一来大家都去那儿待着。

examples.en: Only the computer labs are air-conditioned; our dorm room just has a fan.
examples.zh: 只有机房「有空调」，我们宿舍只有一台风扇。

words.enDefinition: let wet clothes dry naturally on a rack or line

examples.en: I air dry my sweaters on the rack instead of using the dryer.
examples.zh: 毛衣我都放架子上「晾干」，不用烘干机。

examples.en: Air dry your jeans overnight and they will keep their shape.
examples.zh: 牛仔裤「晾」一晚上，版型就不会变。

collocations: air dry sweaters on a rack
air dry instead of tumble drying

words.enDefinition: a counter appliance that crisps food with hot air

examples.en: The air fryer reheats leftover pizza better than the microwave does.
examples.zh: 用「空气炸锅」热剩披萨比微波炉效果好。

examples.en: Our whole floor shares one air fryer in the common room.
examples.zh: 我们整层楼共用公共休息室里的一台「空气炸锅」。

collocations: crisp up fries in the air fryer

words.enDefinition: open windows to let fresh air move through

examples.en: Air out the dorm room every morning—it always smells like instant noodles.
examples.zh: 每天早上给宿舍「通通风」，总有一股泡面味。

examples.en: He aired out the stuffy kitchen after frying fish last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚煎完鱼，他把满是味道的厨房「通」了会儿风。

words.enDefinition: how clean or polluted the outdoor air is

examples.en: The air quality was so poor that outdoor practice got canceled.
examples.zh: 「空气质量」太差，室外训练被取消了。

examples.en: Wildfire smoke pushed the air quality index into the red zone.
examples.zh: 山火烟雾让「空气质量指数」进入了红色区间。

words.enDefinition: a setting that turns off all wireless connections at once

examples.en: Switch on airplane mode during the flight and download movies beforehand.
examples.zh: 飞行途中开启「飞行模式」，记得提前把电影下载好。

examples.en: I leave airplane mode on at night, so my alarm still works but nothing else pings.
examples.zh: 晚上我一直开着「飞行模式」，闹钟照常响，其他消息一律不打扰。

words.enDefinition: a clock that wakes you with a loud sound

examples.en: I set three alarm clocks because one never wakes me up.
examples.zh: 我定了三个「闹钟」，因为一个根本叫不醒我。

examples.en: Her alarm clock rang for ten minutes before she heard it.
examples.zh: 她的「闹钟」响了十分钟她才听见。

words.enDefinition: A restroom available to people of any gender

examples.en: The map showed an all-gender restroom next to the drinking water station.
examples.zh: 地图标出饮水补给点旁有一个「不限性别的洗手间」。

examples.en: I asked the volunteer where the all-gender restroom was before the screening began.
examples.zh: 放映开始前，我问志愿者「不限性别的洗手间」在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: many different types of people or things

examples.en: You'll meet all kinds of people at an international students' mixer.
examples.zh: 在国际学生联谊会上你会遇到「各式各样的」人。

examples.en: My roommate collects all kinds of snacks from different countries.
examples.zh: 我室友收集了「各式各样的」各国零食。

words.enDefinition: a night spent studying or working without sleeping

examples.en: I pulled an all-nighter to finish the essay due at nine.
examples.zh: 为了赶九点截止的论文，我「熬了个通宵」。

examples.en: Two all-nighters in one week left me sick with a cold.
examples.zh: 一周两次「通宵」让我感冒病倒了。

words.enDefinition: continuously or very often

examples.en: My phone dies all the time because the battery is old.
examples.zh: 电池老化，我的手机「动不动」就没电。

examples.en: We used to hang out in the lounge all the time.
examples.zh: 我们以前「一直」泡在休息室里。

words.enDefinition: a plant-based milk substitute made from almonds

examples.en: Almond milk froths surprisingly well for homemade lattes on weekends.
examples.zh: 「杏仁奶」打奶泡的效果出奇地好，适合周末自制拿铁。

examples.en: I stock almond milk in the dorm fridge just for my cereal.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍小冰箱里囤了「杏仁奶」，专门泡麦片用。

words.enDefinition: nearly every time

examples.en: I almost always take the stairs to my third-floor room.
examples.zh: 去三楼的房间，我「几乎总是」走楼梯。

examples.en: Our weekly quiz almost always covers the newest lecture chapter.
examples.zh: 我们的每周小测「几乎总是」考最新讲的章节。

words.enDefinition: very nearly but not completely

examples.en: I almost missed the shuttle because I overslept this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我睡过头，「差点儿」错过班车。

examples.en: The line at the bookstore was almost out the door.
examples.zh: 书店的队伍「几乎」排到了门外。

words.enDefinition: every time; all the time

examples.en: My roommate always leaves a note when she borrows my pan.
examples.zh: 室友借我的锅时「总是」会留张字条。

examples.en: The main library is always packed the week before finals start.
examples.zh: 期末开始前一周，主图书馆「总是」爆满。

words.enDefinition: open to more than one meaning or reading

examples.en: One ambiguous clause in our lease caused a two-week argument over the deposit.
examples.zh: 租约里一条「模棱两可」的条款引发了两周的押金争执。

examples.en: His ambiguous reply—'maybe, we'll see'—left everyone unsure about the road trip.
examples.zh: 他那句"再说吧"的回复「含糊其辞」，大家都不确定自驾游还去不去。

words.enDefinition: strongly wanting to achieve success or goals

examples.en: My ambitious brother is already planning his startup before graduation.
examples.zh: 我那「有上进心的」弟弟还没毕业就开始筹划创业了。

examples.en: Ambitious students often pack their schedules with internships and certificates.
examples.zh: 「上进心强的」学生通常把日程排满了实习和考证。

words.enDefinition: a family member who lived long before you

examples.en: My ancestors moved to this coastal town over two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 两百多年前，我的「祖先」搬到了这座海滨小镇。

examples.en: During Qingming, our family honors ancestors with a simple home ritual.
examples.zh: 清明时节，我们全家会用简单的仪式祭拜「祖先」。

words.enDefinition: boots that rise as high as the ankle

examples.en: I wore ankle boots on the walk home when the paths were covered in leaves.
examples.zh: 小路上铺满落叶，我穿着「及踝短靴」走回家。

examples.en: She changed out of her ankle boots after the student theatre rehearsal ended.
examples.zh: 学生剧团排练结束后，她换下了「及踝短靴」。

words.enDefinition: socks that end around the ankle

examples.en: I packed ankle socks for the gym because they sit just above my shoes.
examples.zh: 我去健身房带了「踝袜」，袜口刚好比鞋口高一点。

examples.en: My ankle socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle outside the hall.
examples.zh: 我在大厅外踩进水坑，「踝袜」湿了。

words.enDefinition: the feeling of being slightly angry about something

examples.en: To my annoyance, the printer broke right before my deadline.
examples.zh: 让我「恼火」的是，打印机偏偏在截止日前坏了。

examples.en: He couldn't hide his annoyance at the constant construction noise.
examples.zh: 施工噪音不断，他掩不住一脸「烦躁」。

words.enDefinition: a strong worried feeling that something bad may happen

examples.en: During exam season, quiet anxiety fills every corner of the library.
examples.zh: 考试季，图书馆的每个角落都弥漫着「焦虑」。

examples.en: She manages her anxiety before presentations with slow, deep breathing.
examples.zh: 她用缓慢的深呼吸来缓解上台演讲前的「焦虑」。

words.enDefinition: a program installed on a phone to do a particular task

examples.en: There is an app for everything here, even for booking laundry machines.
examples.zh: 这儿什么都有对应的「应用程序」，连洗衣服都能预约。

examples.en: I deleted the shopping app to stop myself from impulse buying online.
examples.zh: 我删掉了那个购物「应用」，免得网购时冲动消费。

words.enDefinition: the small picture you tap to open an app

examples.en: I accidentally deleted the app icon while rearranging my home screen.
examples.zh: 整理桌面时，我不小心删掉了一个「应用图标」。

examples.en: Long-press any app icon to see shortcuts like scanning a document.
examples.zh: 长按任意「应用图标」，就能看到扫描文档这类快捷操作。

words.enDefinition: the official shop on a phone for downloading apps

examples.en: The campus map is free, just grab it from the app store.
examples.zh: 校园地图是免费的，直接去「应用商店」下载就行。

examples.en: My app store will not update anything until I agree to new terms.
examples.zh: 不同意新条款，我的「应用商店」就什么都不给更新。

words.enDefinition: the natural desire to eat food

examples.en: Stress during finals week has completely killed my appetite lately.
examples.zh: 期末周的压力最近让我的「食欲」全没了。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread gave me a huge appetite.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味让我「胃口」大开。

words.enDefinition: worried that something that is about to happen may go badly

examples.en: I felt apprehensive about speaking first at the welcome session for new students.
examples.zh: 要在新生欢迎会上第一个发言，我「心里有些忐忑」。

examples.en: My roommate looked apprehensive as we waited outside the unfamiliar lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我们在陌生的讲堂外等候时，室友看起来「心里有些忐忑」。

words.enDefinition: friendly and easy to talk to

examples.en: Our advisor is approachable, so students drop by without appointments.
examples.zh: 我们的导师很「平易近人」，学生不预约也会来找他。

examples.en: The new librarian seems strict, but she's actually very approachable.
examples.zh: 新来的图书管理员看着严肃，其实非常「平易近人」。

words.enDefinition: move old messages or files into long-term storage without deleting

examples.en: Archive old club emails instead of deleting them in case you need receipts.
examples.zh: 把社团的旧邮件「归档」而不是删除，留着以后对账用。

examples.en: I archive every assignment confirmation email the moment I get it.
examples.zh: 每收到一封作业确认邮件，我就立刻「归档」。

words.enDefinition: approximately, close to an exact number

examples.en: The party starts around eight, so don't stress about being exact.
examples.zh: 派对「大约」八点开始，不用太掐点。

examples.en: Each of the big lecture halls seats around two hundred students.
examples.zh: 每间大梯教室「大约」能坐两百名学生。

words.enDefinition: behaving as if you are better than everyone else

examples.en: The arrogant senior refused to explain anything to the freshmen.
examples.zh: 那位「自大的」学长什么都不肯教给新生。

examples.en: He sounded arrogant when he called everyone else's ideas basic.
examples.zh: 他说别人的想法都很普通时，听起来特别「傲慢」。

words.enDefinition: made by people rather than occurring naturally

examples.en: Our dorm's artificial Christmas tree saves us from vacuuming needles every single day.
examples.zh: 宿舍的「人造」圣诞树让我们免于每天吸松针。

examples.en: She avoids artificial sweeteners and just uses half a spoon of real sugar.
examples.zh: 她不碰「人工」甜味剂，宁可放半勺真糖。

words.enDefinition: of the same quality as something else

examples.en: The campus clinic's service is as good as any hospital's downtown.
examples.zh: 校医院的服务「不比市中心的医院差」。

examples.en: My repaired phone screen looks as good as new now.
examples.zh: 修好的手机屏幕现在看起来「跟新的一样」。

words.enDefinition: an equal amount compared with something

examples.en: I don't earn as much as my roommate at the same job.
examples.zh: 同样的工作，我挣得「没有室友多」。

examples.en: I don't snack as much as my desk-mate does during finals.
examples.zh: 期末周我吃零食「没有同桌那么多」。

words.enDefinition: the greatest amount you can manage

examples.en: Practice speaking English as much as possible before the oral exam.
examples.zh: 口语考试前要「尽可能多」地练习英语口语。

examples.en: We walked as much as possible to save money on the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行时我们「尽量多」走路来省钱。

words.enDefinition: as early as you can manage

examples.en: Please reply to the advisor's email as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请「尽快」回复导师的邮件。

examples.en: Book the moving truck as soon as possible; September fills up.
examples.zh: 搬家货车要「尽早」预订，九月的档期很快订满。

words.enDefinition: ask several people in order to find something out

examples.en: I'll ask around and see if anyone is subletting a room this summer.
examples.zh: 我会去「四处打听」，看看今年夏天有没有人转租房间。

examples.en: Ask around the department—someone probably has a spare bike pump.
examples.zh: 在系里「到处问问」，多半有人有多余的打气筒。

words.enDefinition: invite someone on a romantic date

examples.en: He finally asked her out to the autumn festival on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五他终于「约她出去」逛秋日集市了。

examples.en: Nervously, I asked my classmate out for coffee after lecture.
examples.zh: 我紧张地「约」同学下课后出去喝咖啡。

collocations: ask someone out on a date

words.enDefinition: Holding as many people as can be accommodated

examples.en: The volunteer said the hall was at capacity, so we waited for the next session.
examples.zh: 志愿者说大厅「已满员」，我们就等下一场。

examples.en: The reading room was already at capacity when I checked after my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我下午下课过去看时，阅览室已经「满员」了。

words.enDefinition: no less than; not fewer than

examples.en: You should arrive at least fifteen minutes before the exam starts.
examples.zh: 考试开始前你「至少」要提前十五分钟到。

examples.en: Call your parents at least once a week while you're abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外也要「至少」每周给父母打一次电话。

words.enDefinition: no more than a stated amount

examples.en: The taxi ride takes twenty minutes at most without traffic.
examples.zh: 不堵车的话，打车「顶多」二十分钟。

examples.en: There are at most four spots left in that workshop.
examples.zh: 那个工作坊「最多」还剩四个名额。

words.enDefinition: very early in the morning, just after sunrise

examples.en: The campus shuttle leaves at the crack of dawn, so set two alarms.
examples.zh: 校园班车「天一亮」就发车，所以记得定两个闹钟。

examples.en: We had to get up at the crack of dawn to catch the airport bus.
examples.zh: 为了赶机场大巴，我们只好「天一亮」就起床。

collocations: get up at the crack of dawn
leave at the crack of dawn
start at the crack of dawn

words.enDefinition: At the end farthest from the current position

examples.en: There were two spare chairs at the far end of the shared table.
examples.zh: 共用桌子的「另一头」还有两把空椅子。

examples.en: The smaller entrance is at the far end of the courtyard beside the trees.
examples.zh: 较小的入口「在院子的另一头」，挨着几棵树。

collocations: at the far end of the hall

words.enDefinition: at the latest possible moment before a deadline

examples.en: He signed up for the campus marathon at the last minute.
examples.zh: 他在「最后一刻」才报名校园马拉松。

examples.en: Never start writing your personal statement at the last minute.
examples.zh: 千万别「拖到最后一刻」才动笔写个人陈述。

words.enDefinition: no later than the stated time

examples.en: Please submit the housing form by Friday at the latest.
examples.zh: 住宿申请表请尽快提交，「最迟」周五。

examples.en: I will text you by ten at the latest tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚「最迟」十点前会给你发短信。

words.enDefinition: on some occasions; occasionally

examples.en: At times I miss my mom's home-cooked food more than anything.
examples.zh: 「有时候」我格外想念妈妈做的家常菜。

examples.en: Group work can be stressful at times, but it teaches teamwork.
examples.zh: 小组作业「有时」让人头疼，但能锻炼协作能力。

words.enDefinition: true to its origin and not copied

examples.en: That family-run dumpling house two blocks away serves the most authentic food near campus.
examples.zh: 离校园两个街区的那家家庭饺子馆最「正宗」。

examples.en: Her authentic tamales came from her grandmother's handwritten recipe notebook, not any website.
examples.zh: 她的「地道」玉米粽配方来自祖母的手写笔记，不是网上抄的。

words.enDefinition: save your document automatically at regular intervals

examples.en: This editor will auto-save your notes every thirty seconds or so.
examples.zh: 这个编辑器每隔三十秒左右就会「自动保存」一次笔记。

examples.en: Turn on auto-save in settings or you will lose work like I did.
examples.zh: 在设置里开启「自动保存」，不然会像我一样白白丢掉成果。

words.enDefinition: a typing feature that silently fixes misspelled words

examples.en: Autocorrect keeps changing my roommate's name into a random word.
examples.zh: 「自动更正」总把室友的名字改成一个莫名其妙的词。

examples.en: I turned off autocorrect because it kept fixing words I typed on purpose.
examples.zh: 「自动更正」老改我故意打的词，所以我把它关了。

words.enDefinition: A door that opens by a sensor or control

examples.en: The automatic door opened as I approached with a stack of books.
examples.zh: 我抱着一摞书走近时，「自动门」打开了。

examples.en: The automatic door was on the left, beside a set of ordinary glass doors.
examples.zh: 「自动门」在左边，挨着一组普通玻璃门。

collocations: an automatic door at the entrance

words.enDefinition: the times when a person or room is free

examples.en: Send me your availability for the group project this week.
examples.zh: 把你这周「有空的时间」发给我，安排小组项目。

examples.en: The advisor's booking page lists her availability for each day.
examples.zh: 导师的预约页面列出了她每天「可预约的时段」。

words.enDefinition: able to be prevented with care or planning

examples.en: Most freshman mistakes, like skipping orientation week, are completely avoidable with planning.
examples.zh: 像翘掉迎新周这种新生失误，稍微规划一下就「完全可避免」。

examples.en: Her library late fee was avoidable because renewing books online takes thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 她那笔图书馆滞纳金本「可以避免」，网上续借只要三十秒。

words.enDefinition: extremely good or impressive in an exciting way

examples.en: The advisor was awesome about rescheduling my placement test around my work shift.
examples.zh: 顾问「极棒」，把我的分级考试安排在了下班之后。

examples.en: Your slides look awesome—did you really make that animated chart yourself?
examples.zh: 你的幻灯片「超棒」——那个动态图表真是你自己做的？

words.enDefinition: uncomfortable and unsure how to behave in a social situation

examples.en: It was awkward running into my ex at the dining hall.
examples.zh: 在食堂撞见前任，场面特别「尴尬」。

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after someone mentioned the failed exam.
examples.zh: 有人提到挂科的事后，出现了一阵「尴尬的」沉默。

words.enDefinition: A surface for changing a baby's diaper

examples.en: The community hall had a baby changing station in the larger washroom near reception.
examples.zh: 社区活动大厅靠近前台的那个大洗手间里有「婴儿换尿布台」。

examples.en: My classmate checked the map for a baby changing station before bringing her nephew.
examples.zh: 同学带侄子来之前，看地图确认哪里有「婴儿换尿布台」。

words.enDefinition: look after children while their parents are away

examples.en: She babysits for our neighbor every Friday to cover her phone bill.
examples.zh: 她每周五帮邻居「照看小孩」，赚点手机话费。

examples.en: I can't come to movie night—I'm babysitting my cousin's twins tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚电影之夜去不了了，我要帮表哥「带」双胞胎。

words.enDefinition: Available again after an interruption

examples.en: The lift was back in service when I came to the hall after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午饭后来到大厅时，电梯已经「恢复使用」。

examples.en: The volunteer said the bottle filler would be back in service by the next event.
examples.zh: 志愿者说，自助饮水补给机到下次活动时会「恢复使用」。

collocations: put a lift back in service

words.enDefinition: The end of a queue where new people join

examples.en: I went to the back of the line after finding out where it started.
examples.zh: 我弄清从哪儿排队后，就去了「队尾」。

examples.en: My classmate waved from the back of the line near the courtyard gate.
examples.zh: 同学站在院门附近的「队尾」，朝我挥了挥手。

collocations: go to the back of the line
join the back of the line
wait at the back of the line

words.enDefinition: reverse a vehicle out of a space or driveway

examples.en: Back out of the parking spot slowly; bikes pass behind you.
examples.zh: 「倒车」出车位时慢一点，身后有自行车经过。

examples.en: She backed out of the narrow driveway with her friend guiding.
examples.zh: 朋友在旁边指挥，她把车从窄车道里「倒了出来」。

collocations: back out of the parking spot

words.enDefinition: with the back of a garment facing forward

examples.en: I rushed to rehearsal and put my costume on back to front by mistake.
examples.zh: 我赶去排练，不小心把戏服「前后穿反了」。

examples.en: My scarf hid the fact that I'd put the sweater on back to front.
examples.zh: 围巾遮住了，所以看不出来我的毛衣「前后穿反了」。

collocations: wear a top back to front
put a shirt on back to front

words.enDefinition: save a second copy of files in case of loss

examples.en: Back up your thesis to the cloud before you update your laptop.
examples.zh: 升级笔记本系统之前，先把论文「备份」到云端。

examples.en: She lost two essays because she never backed up her files.
examples.zh: 她因为从不「备份」文件，弄丢了两篇论文。

words.enDefinition: impossible to understand or explain

examples.en: The dorm's mail sorting system is baffling—my packages keep ending up three doors away.
examples.zh: 宿舍的分拣系统「让人摸不着头脑」，我的包裹总跑到三间房外。

examples.en: His baffling absence from the final turned out to be a family emergency.
examples.zh: 他期末考试的「神秘」缺席原来是家里出了急事。

words.enDefinition: loose-fitting and hanging away from the body

examples.en: I wear baggy sweatshirts to my 8 a.m. labs when I don't want to think about outfits.
examples.zh: 早上八点有实验课又不想搭配衣服时，我就套件「宽松」的卫衣出门。

examples.en: These jeans were baggy a month ago, so my gym plan is clearly working.
examples.zh: 这条牛仔裤一个月前还「松垮」的，看来健身计划见效了。

words.enDefinition: eating a healthy mix of different foods

examples.en: It's hard to keep a balanced diet when the dorm has no kitchen.
examples.zh: 宿舍没有厨房，很难坚持「均衡饮食」。

examples.en: My professor said a balanced diet really helps your concentration.
examples.zh: 教授说「均衡饮食」有助于集中注意力。

words.enDefinition: hair cut so that it falls over the forehead

examples.en: I clipped my bangs back before leaning over the desk to finish the poster.
examples.zh: 我把「刘海」夹到后面，才俯身在桌上把海报画完。

examples.en: Her bangs slipped out from under her hat on the walk to class.
examples.zh: 去上课的路上，她的「刘海」从帽子下面露了出来。

collocations: wear your bangs to one side

words.enDefinition: soap made in a solid block rather than liquid form

examples.en: I put the bar soap on a plate while the bathroom shelf was being fixed.
examples.zh: 浴室架子还在修，我先把「块状肥皂」放在盘子上。

examples.en: We took bar soap on the trip because the cabin only had a small sink.
examples.zh: 小木屋只有一个小洗手池，所以我们出门带了「块状肥皂」。

words.enDefinition: almost none at all

examples.en: There was barely any hot water left after eight a.m.
examples.zh: 早上八点过后，热水就「几乎没有」了。

examples.en: I made barely any progress on my essay this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我的论文「几乎没」什么进展。

words.enDefinition: enter a room suddenly without knocking or asking

examples.en: My flatmate barged in while I was on a video interview.
examples.zh: 我正在视频面试，室友直接「闯了进来」。

examples.en: Knock before you barge in; the study room isn't always free.
examples.zh: 「闯」进研讨间之前先敲门，那里不一定空着。

words.enDefinition: Tape stretched across a space to restrict entry

examples.en: The volunteers put barrier tape across one side of the courtyard during the setup.
examples.zh: 布置场地时，志愿者在院子的一侧拉起了「警戒隔离带」。

examples.en: The barrier tape was gone when we came back after the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 我们下午场结束后回来时，「警戒隔离带」已经拆掉了。

collocations: an area marked off with barrier tape

words.enDefinition: the layer of clothing worn closest to the skin

examples.en: I wore a base layer under my sweater for the early morning field trip.
examples.zh: 一大早去实地考察，我在毛衣下面穿了件「贴身打底层」。

examples.en: The base layer was useful when I had to wait outside for the first bus.
examples.zh: 要在外面等头班公交时，「贴身打底层」派上了用场。

words.enDefinition: a soft hat with a stiff bill at the front

examples.en: I wore a baseball cap to the rowing event because there was no shade.
examples.zh: 赛艇活动那里没遮阳的地方，我戴着「棒球帽」去了。

examples.en: The baseball cap from the student club had a small logo on the side.
examples.zh: 学生社团发的「棒球帽」侧面有个小标志。

words.enDefinition: a loose robe worn after bathing or while getting dressed

examples.en: I keep a bathrobe by the door for walking back from the shared shower.
examples.zh: 我在门边放了件「浴袍」，方便洗完澡从共用淋浴间走回来。

examples.en: My bathrobe was still over the chair when my flatmate knocked to borrow a towel.
examples.zh: 室友敲门来借毛巾时，我的「浴袍」还搭在椅子上。

words.enDefinition: how long a device runs before needing another charge

examples.en: The update actually improved my battery life, which surprised me.
examples.zh: 这次更新居然改善了「电池续航」，挺意外的。

examples.en: Close background apps if you want better battery life during lectures.
examples.zh: 想上课时有更好的「电池续航」，就把后台应用关掉。

collocations: the battery life on this phone

words.enDefinition: stay available to support someone in hard times

examples.en: My best friend was there for me through every homesick night.
examples.zh: 每个想家的夜晚，我的挚友都「在我身边」支持我。

examples.en: Promise you'll be there for each other during exam season.
examples.zh: 答应我，考试季你们要「互相支持」。

words.enDefinition: go early to avoid the busiest travel time

examples.en: I leave at seven to beat the rush and get a seat on the bus.
examples.zh: 我七点就出门「避开高峰」，还能在公交上抢到座位。

examples.en: Grab lunch at eleven thirty to beat the rush at the dining hall.
examples.zh: 十一点半就去食堂吃饭，「避开排队高峰」。

collocations: leave early to beat the rush

words.enDefinition: signal someone to come closer with your hand or finger

examples.en: The barista beckoned me over when my mobile order was ready.
examples.zh: 我的手机点单做好了，咖啡师「招手示意」我过去。

examples.en: She beckoned from across the hall to show where our seats were.
examples.zh: 她在大厅另一头「招手」，告诉我们座位在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: the usual time when someone goes to sleep

examples.en: My bedtime is eleven on weekdays because morning classes start early.
examples.zh: 工作日我的「就寝时间」是十一点，因为早课很早。

examples.en: Reading a novel before bedtime helps me fall asleep much faster.
examples.zh: 「就寝时间」前读一会儿小说，能让我更快睡着。

words.enDefinition: the calming habits you repeat before sleeping

examples.en: My bedtime routine is a shower, some light reading, then lights out.
examples.zh: 我的「睡前流程」是洗澡、看点轻松的书，然后熄灯。

examples.en: A steady bedtime routine helps me fall asleep without scrolling.
examples.zh: 固定的「睡前流程」让我不刷手机也能睡着。

words.enDefinition: earlier than an event, so you are prepared

examples.en: Check the bus schedule beforehand so you are not stranded.
examples.zh: 「事先」查好班车时刻表，免得被困在半路。

examples.en: Our professor emails the reading list beforehand every single week.
examples.zh: 教授每周都「事先」把阅读书单发邮件给我们。

words.enDefinition: later than the planned or expected time

examples.en: The renovation is behind schedule, so the gym stays shut.
examples.zh: 装修「进度落后」，健身房还得继续关着。

examples.en: Heavy snow left every train on the line behind schedule.
examples.zh: 大雪让整条线路的火车都「晚点」了。

words.enDefinition: colder than the freezing point of water

examples.en: The wind pushed the temperature well below zero last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚大风把气温吹到了「零下」好几度。

examples.en: My water bottle froze because it stayed below zero all weekend.
examples.zh: 气温整个周末都在「零下」，我的水瓶都冻住了。

words.enDefinition: the fastener that joins the ends of a belt

examples.en: My belt buckle caught the light when we walked back from the student theatre.
examples.zh: 我们从学生剧院走回来时，我的「皮带扣」在灯光下一闪。

examples.en: I checked that the belt buckle was centered before we took our group photo.
examples.zh: 拍合影前，我确认「皮带扣」对在正中间。

words.enDefinition: a small loop on trousers that holds a belt in place

examples.en: I clipped my keys to a belt loop before walking over to the workshop.
examples.zh: 我出发去工坊前，把钥匙扣在一个「裤袢」上。

examples.en: The last belt loop had a loose thread that caught on the door handle.
examples.zh: 最后一个「裤袢」有根松线，勾到了门把手上。

collocations: thread a belt through a belt loop

words.enDefinition: Seating arranged on long benches instead of individual chairs

examples.en: The hall uses bench seating along the wall and chairs in the middle.
examples.zh: 大厅沿墙摆的是「长椅式座位」，中间另外摆了椅子。

examples.en: The bench seating near the entrance gave us somewhere to sit during the break.
examples.zh: 入口旁的「长椅式座位」让我们休息时有地方坐。

words.enDefinition: lower your upper body toward the ground

examples.en: Bend down slowly to grab the phone you dropped under the seat.
examples.zh: 手机掉到座位底下，慢慢「弯腰」去捡。

examples.en: I had to bend down to tie my shoelace halfway through the race.
examples.zh: 跑到一半，我不得不「弯下腰」系鞋带。

words.enDefinition: the friend you are closest to of all

examples.en: My best friend from high school videos with me every Sunday night.
examples.zh: 高中时的「挚友」每周日晚都和我视频。

examples.en: My roommate became my best friend within one stressful semester.
examples.zh: 一个紧张忙碌的学期下来，我的室友变成了我的「挚友」。

words.enDefinition: any drink, especially one served at an event

examples.en: The club meeting provides free beverages and pizza every Thursday.
examples.zh: 社团会议每周四提供免费「饮品」和披萨。

examples.en: Please bring your own beverage to the evening study hall.
examples.zh: 晚间自习室请自带「饮品」。

words.enDefinition: unfairly favoring one side or group

examples.en: He worried the peer evaluation was biased because his partner disliked group debates.
examples.zh: 他担心同伴互评「不客观」，因为搭档本来就讨厌小组辩论。

examples.en: A biased sample ruined our first survey, so we collected responses outside that one dorm.
examples.zh: 第一份问卷因样本「有偏」而废掉，后来我们走出那栋楼去收数据。

words.enDefinition: travel to campus by bicycle

examples.en: I bike to campus when the weather is nice and lock up by the gym.
examples.zh: 天气好的时候我就「骑车去学校」，把车锁在健身房旁边。

examples.en: It takes me fifteen minutes to bike to school along the river path.
examples.zh: 沿着河边小路「骑车上学」，我只要十五分钟。

words.enDefinition: the parents someone was born to, by blood

examples.en: He finally met his biological parents at twenty-two through a DNA website.
examples.zh: 二十二岁那年，他通过 DNA 网站见到了自己的「亲生父母」。

examples.en: My adoptive parents always answered my questions about my biological parents honestly.
examples.zh: 关于「亲生父母」的问题，我的养父母总是坦诚作答。

words.enDefinition: press your teeth into your lip to hold back words

examples.en: Bite your lip instead of arguing during the group feedback session.
examples.zh: 小组互评时先「咬住嘴唇」，别急着争辩。

examples.en: My roommate said, “Did you have to bite your lip to stop yourself from laughing?”
examples.zh: 室友问：“你是不是得「咬着嘴唇」才忍住没笑？”

collocations: bite your lip to stay quiet

words.enDefinition: very strange and hard to explain

examples.en: We found a bizarre collection of traffic cones stacked in our rental basement.
examples.zh: 我们在出租屋地下室发现一堆「怪异」的交通锥。

examples.en: The most bizarre part of orientation was the team-building chant nobody understood.
examples.zh: 迎新周最「离奇」的环节，是那句没人听得懂的团建口号。

words.enDefinition: tasting of almost nothing, without much flavor

examples.en: The cafeteria soup is so bland that everyone adds chili oil.
examples.zh: 食堂的汤「寡淡无味」，人人都要加辣椒油。

examples.en: Bland protein shakes go down easier if you blend in a banana.
examples.zh: 「没味道」的蛋白奶昔里打根香蕉，就好咽多了。

words.enDefinition: a tailored jacket designed to be worn without matching trousers

examples.en: I wore a blazer over a plain T-shirt for the final project presentation on campus.
examples.zh: 在学校做最终项目汇报时，我在素色T恤外穿了件「休闲西装外套」。

examples.en: The navy blazer worked with the trousers I'd already brought from home for the event.
examples.zh: 这件藏青色的「休闲西装外套」和我从家里带来出席活动的裤子挺搭。

words.enDefinition: a strong liquid that whitens clothes and kills stains

examples.en: Add a little bleach to the white load to keep the socks bright.
examples.zh: 洗白色衣物时加点「漂白剂」，袜子才能保持亮白。

examples.en: Careful with bleach in the laundry room; it splashes on colored clothes.
examples.zh: 在洗衣房用「漂白剂」要小心，会溅到有色的衣服上。

words.enDefinition: a family formed when parents with children remarry each other

examples.en: As a blended family, we celebrate two sets of holiday traditions.
examples.zh: 身为「重组家庭」，我们保留着两边的节日传统。

examples.en: Adjusting to a blended family takes time, especially for teenagers.
examples.zh: 适应「重组家庭」需要时间，对青少年来说尤其如此。

collocations: a blended family with two kids

words.enDefinition: an appliance that mixes food and liquids smoothly

examples.en: I use the blender every morning for quick fruit smoothies.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都用「搅拌机」打快速的水果奶昔。

examples.en: Someone left the blender unwashed with smoothie still inside it.
examples.zh: 有人用完「料理机」没洗，里面还留着果昔。

words.enDefinition: shut and open your eyes quickly and naturally

examples.en: People blink less when they stare at a screen too long.
examples.zh: 盯屏幕太久，人会「眨眼」变少，眼睛容易干。

examples.en: She blinked hard to stop tears at the airport farewell.
examples.zh: 机场送别时她使劲「眨眼」，忍住了眼泪。

words.enDefinition: a severe snowstorm with strong winds

examples.en: Yesterday's blizzard canceled every single shuttle bus to the airport.
examples.zh: 昨天的「暴风雪」让所有机场班车都停运了。

examples.en: Classes moved online after the blizzard dumped thirty centimeters of snow.
examples.zh: 「暴风雪」下了三十厘米厚的雪之后，课程改到了线上。

words.enDefinition: stop a caller or texter from contacting you again

examples.en: I finally blocked a number — the car insurance one that called every afternoon.
examples.zh: 我终于「屏蔽号码」了——就是那个每天下午打来的车险推销电话。

examples.en: Block a number immediately if it texts you about a package you never ordered.
examples.zh: 如果陌生号码发来你从没订过的包裹信息，立刻「屏蔽号码」。

collocations: block a number on your phone

words.enDefinition: a person related to you by birth, not marriage

examples.en: Adoption made him family even without being a blood relative.
examples.zh: 领养让他成了家人，尽管并非「血亲」。

examples.en: The form asked whether my emergency contact was a blood relative.
examples.zh: 表格询问我的紧急联系人是不是「血亲」。

collocations: blood relatives on my father's side

words.enDefinition: Press an absorbent material against spilled liquid to soak it up.

examples.en: I used an old towel to blot a spill on the rug before it spread.
examples.zh: 趁液体还没洇开，我用一条旧毛巾「吸去地毯上洒出的液体」。

examples.en: Keep a clean cloth nearby so you can blot a spill without rubbing the fabric.
examples.zh: 手边放块干净的布，方便你「吸去洒出的液体」，省得搓揉布料。

collocations: blot a spill with a towel

words.enDefinition: dry hair using a hair dryer

examples.en: I had time to blow-dry my hair before meeting my roommate downstairs for dinner.
examples.zh: 下楼和室友碰面吃饭前，我还来得及「用吹风机吹干」头发。

examples.en: She prefers to blow-dry her hair before heading out to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 她喜欢「用吹风机吹干」头发，再出门去公交站。

collocations: get ready to blow-dry your hair

words.enDefinition: to release anger or stress through energetic activity

examples.en: I play pickup basketball to blow off steam after exams.
examples.zh: 考完试我会去打半场篮球「发泄一下」。

examples.en: She blows off steam by singing loudly in the shower.
examples.zh: 她靠在淋浴时大声唱歌来「释放压力」。

collocations: blow off steam at the gym

words.enDefinition: pass and end without much damage, said of a storm

examples.en: The forecast says the storm will blow over by morning.
examples.zh: 天气预报说风暴到早上就会「平息」。

examples.en: We waited in the tunnel until the squall blew over.
examples.zh: 我们在通道里一直等到暴风雨「平息」。

words.enDefinition: a short-range wireless connection between nearby devices

examples.en: Turn on bluetooth in the car so the GPS directions play through the speakers.
examples.zh: 在车里打开「蓝牙」，导航提示就能从音箱播出来。

examples.en: My bluetooth keeps disconnecting from my earbuds on the bus.
examples.zh: 坐公交时，我的「蓝牙」总是和耳机断开。

words.enDefinition: a portable speaker that connects to phones without wires

examples.en: We brought a bluetooth speaker to the picnic and played our shared playlist.
examples.zh: 我们带了「蓝牙音箱」去野餐，放我们共同的歌单。

examples.en: My bluetooth speaker will not connect since I updated my phone.
examples.zh: 手机更新之后，我的「蓝牙音箱」就连不上了。

words.enDefinition: a narrow flat pin used to hold a small section of hair

examples.en: I used a bobby pin to hold a loose strand before rehearsal started.
examples.zh: 排练开始前，我用一个「一字发夹」别住了散下来的一绺头发。

examples.en: We found a bobby pin on the dressing room shelf after the student concert.
examples.zh: 学生音乐会结束后，我们在更衣室的架子上找到一个「一字发夹」。

collocations: secure hair with a bobby pin

words.enDefinition: the body's internal timing system for sleep and wakefulness

examples.en: My body clock still thinks it's Beijing time two weeks after landing.
examples.zh: 落地两周了，我的「生物钟」还以为是北京时间。

examples.en: Fix your body clock by waking up at the same hour every day.
examples.zh: 每天同一时间起床，就能把「生物钟」调回来。

collocations: body clock adjusts to a new time zone

words.enDefinition: liquid soap made for washing your body in the shower

examples.en: The communal shower has a shelf where you can keep your body wash.
examples.zh: 公共淋浴间有个架子，可以放你的「沐浴露」。

examples.en: I bought a big bottle of body wash at the drugstore for eight dollars.
examples.zh: 我在药妆店花八美元买了一大瓶「沐浴露」。

words.enDefinition: extremely hot and very uncomfortable to be in

examples.en: The top-floor bedroom is boiling every afternoon until the sun sets.
examples.zh: 顶楼卧室每天下午都「热」到日落才消停。

examples.en: I'm boiling in this sweater; the forecast completely lied to us.
examples.zh: 穿这件毛衣我都「热」冒烟了，天气预报纯属骗人。

words.enDefinition: run away suddenly at full speed

examples.en: Bolt for the last shuttle when the library closes at midnight.
examples.zh: 图书馆午夜闭馆时，就得「撒腿就跑」去赶末班校车。

examples.en: He bolted from the seminar the second it ended, phone in hand.
examples.zh: 研讨课一结束，他抓着手机「拔腿就跑」。

words.enDefinition: arrange a seat, table, or room in advance

examples.en: Book the group study room early during finals week—it fills up fast.
examples.zh: 期末周要早点「预订」小组研讨室，很快就会被订满。

examples.en: I booked a table for six at the Korean place near campus.
examples.zh: 我在校园附近那家韩餐馆「订」了六个位子。

words.enDefinition: having no free appointments or times left

examples.en: The dentist is booked up until the end of the month.
examples.zh: 牙医的号「排满」到月底了。

examples.en: I am booked up all weekend with the hackathon and work shifts.
examples.zh: 这个周末我「排满了」黑客马拉松和打工的班。

words.enDefinition: save a web address so you can find it quickly

examples.en: Bookmark the bus tracker page so you can find it each morning.
examples.zh: 把公交实时查询页面「收藏」起来，每天早上都要用。

examples.en: I bookmarked twenty recipes and cooked exactly none of them.
examples.zh: 我「收藏」了二十个菜谱，结果一个都没做过。

words.enDefinition: not interesting in any way

examples.en: The 8 a.m. statistics lecture is so boring that half the class quietly dozes off.
examples.zh: 早上八点的统计课「无聊」到一半人悄悄睡着。

examples.en: Waiting two hours at the DMV with no phone signal was beyond boring.
examples.zh: 在车管所等两个小时还没手机信号，「无聊」到家了。

words.enDefinition: A fixture designed for refilling drinking water bottles

examples.en: I used the bottle-filling station near the stairs before leaving for my next class.
examples.zh: 我去上下一节课前，在楼梯旁的「饮用水加水点」接了水。

examples.en: The sign showed a bottle-filling station on the next floor near the meeting room.
examples.zh: 标牌显示，楼上一层的会议室旁有一个「饮用水加水点」。

words.enDefinition: a tool that pries caps off glass bottles

examples.en: Our bottle opener is magnetic and sticks to the fridge door.
examples.zh: 我们的「开瓶器」带磁吸，直接贴在冰箱门上。

examples.en: Someone always loses the bottle opener right before game night starts.
examples.zh: 每次游戏之夜开始前，「开瓶器」总会莫名其妙消失。

words.enDefinition: to hide your feelings instead of expressing them

examples.en: Don't bottle up your stress; talk to someone you trust.
examples.zh: 别把压力「憋在心里」，找信任的人聊聊。

examples.en: She bottled up her frustration until it exploded at dinner.
examples.zh: 她一直「压抑着」不满，直到晚餐时才爆发。

words.enDefinition: drinking water sold in sealed bottles

examples.en: I always keep bottled water in my backpack for long lectures.
examples.zh: 我包里总备着「瓶装水」，上课长时间听讲用。

examples.en: Bottled water costs more here than soda, which seems backwards.
examples.zh: 这儿「瓶装水」比汽水还贵，感觉本末倒置。

words.enDefinition: bend your head or body forward to greet or thank

examples.en: Bow slightly when the visiting professor is introduced at the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课上介绍客座教授时，轻轻「鞠个躬」。

examples.en: The actors bowed twice before the packed campus theater audience.
examples.zh: 面对满座的校园剧场观众，演员们「鞠躬」谢幕两次。

words.enDefinition: talk too proudly about your own achievements

examples.en: He keeps bragging about his internship at the bank, which gets annoying.
examples.zh: 他不停地「吹嘘」自己在银行的实习，听得人有点烦。

examples.en: She bragged that she finished the whole group project in one night.
examples.zh: 她「吹牛」说自己一晚上就做完了整个小组项目。

words.enDefinition: a length of hair woven together from several strands

examples.en: She wore her hair in a braid for the walk along the windy beach.
examples.zh: 沿着风大的海滩散步时，她把头发编成了「辫子」。

examples.en: I tied the end of my braid just before leaving the dorm for class.
examples.zh: 我在离开宿舍去上课前，把「辫子」的末端扎好。

collocations: tie the end of a braid

words.enDefinition: completely new and never used by anyone

examples.en: I saved two months of tutoring pay for this brand new laptop.
examples.zh: 这台「崭新」的笔记本，我攒了两个月家教工资。

examples.en: Someone left a brand new rice cooker in the free pile outside.
examples.zh: 门口免费堆里有人放了一口「全新」的电饭煲。

words.enDefinition: to suddenly start crying or lose emotional control

examples.en: I broke down during the call home and couldn't stop crying.
examples.zh: 打回家的电话时我「情绪崩溃」，哭个不停。

examples.en: She completely broke down after reading her grandfather's old letter.
examples.zh: 读完爷爷的旧信，她彻底「绷不住了」。

words.enDefinition: end a romantic relationship

examples.en: They broke up after two years of doing long distance.
examples.zh: 异地恋两年后，他们「分手」了。

examples.en: She finally broke up with him calmly after months of arguing.
examples.zh: 争吵了几个月后，她终于平静地和他「分手」了。

words.enDefinition: letting air or moisture pass through, so you stay comfortable

examples.en: I wore a breathable top for the walk to class because it was warm outside.
examples.zh: 外面挺热，我穿了件「透气的」上衣走去教室。

examples.en: The studio was stuffy, so I was glad my shirt was made from breathable fabric.
examples.zh: 工作室里挺闷，我庆幸自己的衬衫用的是「透气的」布料。

words.enDefinition: so beautiful that it astonishes you

examples.en: The view from the library rooftop at sunset is absolutely breathtaking.
examples.zh: 日落时图书馆天台的景色「美得惊人」。

examples.en: We hiked three hours uphill, but the breathtaking scenery repaid every step.
examples.zh: 我们爬了三小时山路，但那「美得惊人」的风景让每一步都值了。

words.enDefinition: with a light pleasant wind blowing

examples.en: It is breezy by the lake, ideal for flying kites.
examples.zh: 湖边「微风习习」，正适合放风筝。

examples.en: The breezy afternoon finally made the sticky humidity feel bearable.
examples.zh: 「有风」的下午，黏腻的湿气终于变得可以忍受。

words.enDefinition: make tea or coffee with hot water

examples.en: I brew a pot of jasmine tea every evening while I review notes.
examples.zh: 我每天晚上复习时都会「泡」一壶茉莉花茶。

examples.en: She brewed a fresh pot of coffee before our three-hour library session.
examples.zh: 去图书馆自习三小时之前，她「冲」了一壶新咖啡。

words.enDefinition: very early in the morning, often cheerfully or on time

examples.en: My roommate's alarm rang bright and early at six for her morning run.
examples.zh: 我室友「一大早」六点闹钟就响了，去晨跑。

examples.en: The movers said they would arrive bright and early on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 搬家公司说他们周六「一大早」就会到。

words.enDefinition: how bright or dim a screen looks to your eyes

examples.en: Lower the brightness before bed so your eyes and battery both thank you.
examples.zh: 睡前调低「亮度」，眼睛和电池都会感谢你。

examples.en: I cannot read my screen outside because the brightness is too low.
examples.zh: 户外「亮度」太低，我根本看不清屏幕。

words.enDefinition: extremely good, clever, or impressive

examples.en: Splitting the bulk groceries three ways was a brilliant idea that saved everyone money.
examples.zh: 三个人分摊大包装采购真是个「绝妙」的主意，人人都省了钱。

examples.en: Her brilliant shared spreadsheet finally ended our roommates' fights over the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她那份「绝妙的」共享表格终于终结了室友间的厨房大战。

words.enDefinition: to take someone or something with you when you go to a place

examples.en: You can bring along a notebook if you want to record your ideas.
examples.zh: 你想记下想法的话，可以「随身带来」一本笔记本。

examples.en: The group asked us to bring along a jacket for the walk home.
examples.zh: 小组让我们「随身带来」一件夹克，走路回家时穿。

collocations: remember to bring along a jacket

words.enDefinition: start talking about a subject in conversation

examples.en: Don't bring up the rent issue at dinner tonight, please.
examples.zh: 今晚吃饭时请别「提起」房租的事。

examples.en: She brought up an interesting idea during our long chat.
examples.zh: 长聊时她「提出」了一个有意思的想法。

words.enDefinition: the brother of your spouse, or your sibling's husband

examples.en: My brother-in-law drove four hours to help me move into my dorm.
examples.zh: 我的「姐夫」开了四个小时的车，帮我把行李搬进宿舍。

examples.en: During the holidays, my brother-in-law always organizes the basketball game.
examples.zh: 放假时，我的「小叔」总是组织大家一起打篮球。

words.enDefinition: look through websites or shops without a fixed plan

examples.en: I spent the whole break browsing secondhand bike listings online.
examples.zh: 整个假期我都在网上「浏览」二手自行车信息。

examples.en: Browse the course catalog for a while before your advising appointment.
examples.zh: 导师见面之前，先花点时间「浏览」一下课程目录。

words.enDefinition: the program used to open and view websites

examples.en: My browser has forty tabs open, so my laptop sounds like a jet.
examples.zh: 我的「浏览器」开了四十个标签页，笔记本响得像喷气式飞机。

examples.en: Open the browser and search the professor's office hours instead of asking me.
examples.zh: 打开「浏览器」自己查教授的答疑时间，别来问我。

words.enDefinition: a late-morning meal that combines breakfast and lunch

examples.en: Sunday brunch at that cafe near campus is our weekly tradition.
examples.zh: 周日在校园附近那家咖啡馆吃「早午餐」是我们的每周传统。

examples.en: We're doing brunch at eleven, so don't eat too much breakfast.
examples.zh: 我们十一点去吃「早午餐」，所以早餐别吃太饱。

words.enDefinition: make your hair tidy with a brush or comb

examples.en: I brush my hair while I wait for the kettle to boil.
examples.zh: 我一边等水烧开，一边「梳头发」。

examples.en: Brush your hair before you put on your bike helmet.
examples.zh: 戴自行车头盔之前，先「梳一下头发」。

collocations: brush and tie up your hair

words.enDefinition: clean your teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste

examples.en: I brush my teeth right after breakfast so I don't forget.
examples.zh: 我早餐后马上「刷牙」，这样就不会忘。

examples.en: The dentist said to brush your teeth for two full minutes.
examples.zh: 牙医说每次要「刷牙」整整两分钟。

collocations: brush my teeth twice a day

words.enDefinition: quickly review skills or knowledge you once had

examples.en: I'm brushing up on my spoken English before the trip.
examples.zh: 出发前我在「温习」英语口语。

examples.en: She brushed up on her Italian before visiting Rome in May.
examples.zh: 五月去罗马之前，她「重温」了一下意大利语。

words.enDefinition: a sweet milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls

examples.en: Let's get bubble tea after our last final ends on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五最后一场期末考结束后，我们去喝「珍珠奶茶」吧。

examples.en: She orders her bubble tea with half sugar and less ice.
examples.zh: 她点「奶茶」都选半糖少冰。

words.enDefinition: fasten your seat belt before a ride begins

examples.en: Buckle up before the rideshare leaves the airport pickup zone.
examples.zh: 网约车驶离机场上车区前，先「系好安全带」。

examples.en: He buckled up in the back seat without being reminded this time.
examples.zh: 这次他没等提醒就在后座「系上了安全带」。

collocations: buckle up in the back seat

words.enDefinition: fasten the ends of a belt with its buckle

examples.en: Make sure to buckle your belt before we start taking photos for the play.
examples.zh: 我们开始给剧目拍照前，记得「扣好皮带」。

examples.en: It's easier to buckle your belt before you put the long jacket on.
examples.zh: 穿上长外套之前，「扣好皮带」更方便。

words.enDefinition: an informal word for a friend or partner in an activity

examples.en: My gym buddy waits for me at six every morning.
examples.zh: 我的健身「伙伴」每天早上六点都在等我。

examples.en: I signed up as a study buddy for the freshmen orientation program.
examples.zh: 我报名当了迎新项目的「学习伙伴」。

words.enDefinition: pausing to load a video when the internet is slow

examples.en: Constant buffering ruined the movie night in our common room.
examples.zh: 一直「缓冲」，把我们公共休息室的电影之夜毁了。

examples.en: The video keeps buffering right at the slide the professor said would be on the exam.
examples.zh: 视频偏偏在教授说必考的那一页一直「缓冲」。

collocations: buffering in the middle of a show

words.enDefinition: an error in a program's code that causes wrong behavior

examples.en: There is a bug where my deleted emails return the next morning.
examples.zh: 有个「程序错误」，我删掉的邮件第二天早上又回来了。

examples.en: The developer asked us to describe the bug step by step in the report.
examples.zh: 开发者请我们在报告里一步一步描述这个「程序错误」。

words.enDefinition: big and heavy, hard to carry or store

examples.en: Winter coats are bulky, so we vacuum-seal them under the bed each spring.
examples.zh: 冬衣「笨重」，每年开春我们都抽真空压到床底。

examples.en: Shipping a bulky desk across the city costs more than a new one.
examples.zh: 把「笨重」的书桌横穿城市运一趟，比买张新的还贵。

words.enDefinition: meet someone you know by pure chance

examples.en: I bumped into my high-school classmate at the campus coffee shop yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我在校园咖啡店「偶遇」了高中同学。

examples.en: You'll probably bump into her at the gym—she goes every evening.
examples.zh: 你在健身房很可能会「碰见」她，她每天晚上都去。

words.enDefinition: wear many warm layers in cold weather

examples.en: Bundle up before you head out, it's freezing this morning.
examples.zh: 出门前「穿暖和些」，今天早上特别冷。

examples.en: We bundled up in scarves and gloves for the long walk.
examples.zh: 长距离散步时，我们用围巾手套把自己「裹得严严实实」。

words.enDefinition: mentally exhausted after a long period of stress or work

examples.en: After nonstop deadlines this month, I feel completely burned out.
examples.zh: 这个月截止日期接连不断，我感觉已经完全「身心俱疲」。

examples.en: She was so burned out from studying that she slept all weekend.
examples.zh: 她学习学得「心力交瘁」，整个周末都在睡觉。

words.enDefinition: extreme tiredness caused by working too hard for too long

examples.en: Midterm burnout is real; our whole study group felt it.
examples.zh: 期中「倦怠」是真实存在的，我们整个学习小组都体会到了。

examples.en: Taking Sundays completely off helped me avoid burnout this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期周日彻底休息帮我避免了「身心透支」。

words.enDefinition: damaged by too much heat, blackened on the outside

examples.en: I burnt the garlic again, so the whole kitchen smells bitter.
examples.zh: 我又把蒜「炒糊」了，整个厨房一股苦味。

examples.en: Slightly burnt toast still counts as breakfast when you're running late.
examples.zh: 赶时间的话，「烤糊」一点的吐司也算早饭。

words.enDefinition: to suddenly begin crying

examples.en: She burst into tears when the acceptance letter finally arrived.
examples.zh: 录取信终于寄到时，她「一下子哭了出来」。

examples.en: I burst into tears the moment my mom landed at the airport.
examples.zh: 妈妈在机场落地的那一刻，我「放声大哭」。

words.enDefinition: a card or ticket letting you ride buses regularly

examples.en: The student bus pass costs less than paying each time you ride.
examples.zh: 学生「公交卡」比每次单独买票便宜。

examples.en: I lost my bus pass on Tuesday and had to pay cash all week.
examples.zh: 周二我把「公交卡」弄丢了，只好整整一周都付现金。

words.enDefinition: neat and informal in a way suited to some workplaces

examples.en: The employer described the campus networking lunch as business casual in the invitation.
examples.zh: 用人单位的邀请函写着，校园交流午餐会穿「商务休闲」服装。

examples.en: I asked whether clean sneakers were acceptable with business casual clothes for the event.
examples.zh: 我问活动穿「商务休闲」服装时，能不能配干净的运动鞋。

words.enDefinition: a shirt with buttons that hold down its collar points

examples.en: I wore a button-down shirt to my presentation because the collar stays flat under a sweater.
examples.zh: 做汇报时我穿了件「领尖带扣的衬衫」，因为套上毛衣后领子也能保持平整。

examples.en: The button-down shirt looked neat even after I took off my jacket in the library.
examples.zh: 在图书馆脱下夹克后，那件「领尖带扣的衬衫」看起来还是很整齐。

words.enDefinition: fasten the buttons on a shirt or coat

examples.en: Button up your coat, it's freezing on the walk to campus.
examples.zh: 走路去学校的路上特别冷，「把外套扣好」。

examples.en: He buttoned up his shirt properly for the career fair.
examples.zh: 为了参加招聘会，他把衬衫「扣得整整齐齐」。

words.enDefinition: clearly the most or best

examples.en: This dorm is by far the quietest one on campus.
examples.zh: 这栋宿舍「显然是」校园里最安静的。

examples.en: The library is by far my favorite place to study.
examples.zh: 图书馆「毫无疑问」是我最爱去自习的地方。

words.enDefinition: the stimulant found naturally in coffee and tea

examples.en: I cut caffeine after three p.m. and started sleeping much better.
examples.zh: 我下午三点后不再摄入「咖啡因」，睡眠明显变好。

examples.en: This energy drink has more caffeine than two cups of coffee.
examples.zh: 这罐「能量饮料」的咖啡因比两杯咖啡还多。

words.enDefinition: a phone tool for tracking dates, events, and deadlines

examples.en: Put every deadline into your phone calendar at the start of the term.
examples.zh: 学期一开始就把所有截止日期录进手机「日历」。

examples.en: My calendar reminders pop up before each lab session so I never forget.
examples.zh: 每次实验课前我的「日历」提醒都会弹出，所以我从不忘记。

words.enDefinition: phone someone again after missing their call

examples.en: I missed his call, so I'll call back after dinner.
examples.zh: 我没接到他的电话，晚饭后再「回电话」。

examples.en: Can you call the landlord back about the viewing time?
examples.zh: 你能「回电」房东确认看房时间吗？

collocations: call back as soon as possible

words.enDefinition: A button pressed to summon an elevator

examples.en: I pressed the call button beside the lift and waited for the light.
examples.zh: 我按了电梯旁的「呼梯按钮」，等灯亮起来。

examples.en: The call button was already lit when we reached the lobby after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我们到了门厅时，「呼梯按钮」已经亮着。

collocations: a call button beside the lift

words.enDefinition: stop an evening activity and go home to sleep

examples.en: We finished the practice problems and called it a night at midnight.
examples.zh: 我们把练习题做完，午夜「收工睡觉」。

examples.en: It's late and the library is closing, so let's call it a night.
examples.zh: 很晚了，图书馆也要闭馆了，今晚「就到这儿吧」。

collocations: call it a night at midnight
decided to call it a night

words.enDefinition: cancel a planned event or activity

examples.en: The coach called off practice because of the heat warning.
examples.zh: 因为高温预警，教练「取消」了训练。

examples.en: They called off the lakeside picnic when thunderclouds rolled in.
examples.zh: 雷雨云压过来时，他们「取消」了湖边野餐。

words.enDefinition: not angry, excited, or worried

examples.en: Try to stay calm when the professor asks you a surprise question.
examples.zh: 教授突击提问时，尽量保持「冷静」。

examples.en: A ten-minute meditation helps me stay calm before big exams.
examples.zh: 考前做十分钟冥想能帮我保持「平静」。

words.enDefinition: to become relaxed after being angry or excited

examples.en: Take a deep breath and calm down before you reply to that email.
examples.zh: 深呼吸「冷静」下来，再去回复那封邮件。

examples.en: He finally calmed down after walking around the block twice.
examples.zh: 在外面绕了两圈之后，他终于「平静」下来。

words.enDefinition: the album on a phone where taken photos are stored

examples.en: My camera roll is full of food pictures from the dining hall.
examples.zh: 我的「手机相册」里全是食堂饭菜的照片。

examples.en: Can you send me the photos from last night? Mine are still in my camera roll.
examples.zh: 你能把昨晚的照片发我吗？我的还躺在「手机相册」里。

words.enDefinition: a light sleeveless top with thin shoulder straps

examples.en: I wore a camisole under my open shirt on the walk across campus in July.
examples.zh: 七月走过校园时，我在敞开的衬衫里穿了件「细肩带上衣」。

examples.en: The camisole stayed comfortable under my sweater while I worked in the heated studio.
examples.zh: 我在有暖气的工作室做事时，毛衣下面穿「细肩带上衣」也挺舒服。

collocations: layer a camisole under a shirt

words.enDefinition: a free or cheap bus that loops around campus

examples.en: The campus shuttle runs every ten minutes between the dorms and the library.
examples.zh: 「校园班车」每十分钟一趟，往返于宿舍和图书馆之间。

examples.en: I missed the last campus shuttle and had to walk home in the rain.
examples.zh: 我没赶上末班「校园班车」，只好冒雨走回去。

collocations: the shuttle stops at the dorms

words.enDefinition: a small tool for opening metal food cans

examples.en: Does anyone in this dorm actually own a proper can opener?
examples.zh: 这个宿舍里到底有谁有正经的「开罐器」吗？

examples.en: I bought a manual can opener because electric ones take up space.
examples.zh: 我买了手动「开罐器」，电动的太占地方。

words.enDefinition: starchy and sugary foods that give quick energy

examples.en: I load up on carbs the night before a long run.
examples.zh: 长跑前一晚我会多补「碳水」。

examples.en: Cutting carbs completely is just not sustainable for most students.
examples.zh: 对大多数学生来说，完全断「碳水」是撑不住的。

words.enDefinition: a knitted garment that opens down the front

examples.en: I left my cardigan open because the study room warmed up when more people arrived.
examples.zh: 人多起来后，自习室暖和了，我就敞着「开襟毛衣」。

examples.en: She kept a cardigan over her chair so she could grab it after class.
examples.zh: 她把「开襟毛衣」搭在椅背上，下课就能拿走。

words.enDefinition: the sewn-in tag with washing instructions on clothes

examples.en: Always read the care label inside the collar before you bleach anything.
examples.zh: 漂白任何衣物之前，先读一下领口内侧的「洗涤标签」。

examples.en: The care label on my sweater says hand-wash only in cold water.
examples.zh: 我毛衣的「洗涤标签」写着只能用冷水手洗。

collocations: the care label says hand-wash only

words.enDefinition: trousers with large pockets, especially on the sides of the legs

examples.en: I wore cargo pants for the workshop because I could keep my tape measure handy.
examples.zh: 我穿「工装裤」去工坊，能把卷尺放在随手拿得到的地方。

examples.en: My cargo pants have a side pocket that fits my bus pass and keys.
examples.zh: 我的「工装裤」有个侧袋，可以放公交卡和钥匙。

words.enDefinition: kind and helpful about other people's needs

examples.en: My caring aunt drove two hours to deliver my forgotten passport.
examples.zh: 我那「有爱心的」姑姑开了两小时车，给我送来忘带的护照。

examples.en: Nursing attracts caring people who genuinely enjoy helping patients recover.
examples.zh: 护理行业吸引的是真心乐于帮病人康复的「有爱心的人」。

words.enDefinition: share a car ride with people going the same way

examples.en: Four of us carpool to the satellite campus every Tuesday and Thursday.
examples.zh: 我们四个人每周二、四「拼车」去分校区。

examples.en: Carpooling with classmates saves us almost thirty dollars a week on gas.
examples.zh: 和同学「拼车」，每周能省下将近三十美元的油费。

words.enDefinition: continue doing something without stopping

examples.en: Carry on with your homework while I start making dinner.
examples.zh: 你「继续」写作业，我去开始做晚饭。

examples.en: They carried on chatting until well after midnight that night.
examples.zh: 那晚他们一直「接着聊」到午夜过后。

words.enDefinition: informal clothes suitable for everyday activities

examples.en: The invitation says casual wear is fine, so I'll wear the same clothes as today.
examples.zh: 邀请函说穿「休闲服装」就行，我就穿今天这一套。

examples.en: I packed mostly casual wear because we were staying in a cabin for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末我们住小木屋，所以我带的大多是「休闲服装」。

words.enDefinition: arrive in time to board the bus

examples.en: If I leave by eight, I can catch the bus to campus.
examples.zh: 只要八点前出门，我就能「赶上公交车」去学校。

examples.en: She ran three blocks and still caught the bus with seconds to spare.
examples.zh: 她跑了三个街区，最后几秒还是「赶上了公交」。

words.enDefinition: share news with a friend you have not seen recently

examples.en: We met for bubble tea and caught up for two hours.
examples.zh: 我们约着喝奶茶，「聊了」两个小时近况。

examples.en: It's been months since we met, so we should catch up soon.
examples.zh: 都好几个月没见了，我们该「叙叙旧」了。

collocations: catch up with an old friend
catch up on each other's lives

words.enDefinition: sleep extra hours to recover lost sleep

examples.en: I plan to catch up on sleep this weekend after finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周过后，我打算这周末好好「补觉」。

examples.en: You can't fully catch up on sleep by sleeping until noon once.
examples.zh: 光靠某一天睡到中午，「补觉」是补不回来的。

collocations: catch up on sleep on weekends
try to catch up on sleep
catching up on sleep after finals

words.enDefinition: easy to remember and repeat, like a tune

examples.en: That convenience store jingle is so catchy that I hum it in the shower.
examples.zh: 便利店的广告曲特别「洗脑」，我洗澡都会哼。

examples.en: Our club finally wrote a catchy slogan that freshmen started repeating within a week.
examples.zh: 社团终于想出一句「朗朗上口」的口号，一周内新生都会念了。

words.enDefinition: difficult in a way that tests your ability

examples.en: The advanced statistics course is challenging, but the TA's office hours help enormously.
examples.zh: 高阶统计课「很有挑战」，不过助教答疑时间帮了大忙。

examples.en: Volunteering with a class of toddlers was challenging and tripled her patience.
examples.zh: 给一屋子学步小孩做志愿教学很「考验人」，她的耐心翻了三倍。

words.enDefinition: take off one set of clothes and wear another

examples.en: Give me a minute to change into something warmer before we walk over.
examples.zh: 等我一分钟，我「换」件暖和点的衣服再走过去。

examples.en: She changed into gym clothes right after her last seminar.
examples.zh: 最后一节研讨课一结束，她就「换上」了运动服。

words.enDefinition: a set of clothes to put on in place of what you're wearing

examples.en: I packed a change of clothes for dinner after we finished working in the garden.
examples.zh: 我带了「一套换洗衣服」，在花园干完活后换好去吃晚饭。

examples.en: She keeps a change of clothes in her gym locker for the walk home.
examples.zh: 她在健身房储物柜里放了「一套换洗衣服」，换完可以走回家。

collocations: keep a change of clothes handy

words.enDefinition: put fresh, clean sheets on the bed

examples.en: I change the sheets every two weeks and wash them right away.
examples.zh: 我每两周「换一次床单」，换下来马上就洗。

examples.en: Fresh sheets feel amazing, so I changed the sheets before my parents visited.
examples.zh: 干净床单太舒服了，爸妈来之前我特意「换了床单」。

words.enDefinition: connect a device to power so its battery fills up

examples.en: Charge your phone before the field trip because we will take photos all day.
examples.zh: 实地考察前先把手机「充电」，因为我们要拍一整天照片。

examples.en: I charge my laptop in the library because my dorm outlet is behind the bed.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆给笔记本「充电」，因为宿舍插座在床后面够不着。

words.enDefinition: pleasant and attractive in personality or manner

examples.en: Our charming tour guide made even the rainy campus walk enjoyable.
examples.zh: 我们那位「有魅力的」讲解员让雨中的校园漫步也变得有趣。

examples.en: My charming grandfather wins over every nurse at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我那「讨人喜欢的」爷爷总能赢得诊所护士的喜爱。

words.enDefinition: liking casual and friendly conversation

examples.en: The chatty barista remembers every regular customer's usual order by heart.
examples.zh: 那位「爱聊天的」咖啡师记得每位常客的固定口味。

examples.en: My chatty aunt turns every family dinner into a story session.
examples.zh: 我那位「爱聊天的」姑姑总能把家宴变成故事会。

words.enDefinition: to contact someone to see how they are doing

examples.en: My mom checks in on me every Sunday evening by video call.
examples.zh: 妈妈每周日晚上都会视频「问候」我。

examples.en: RAs check in on freshmen during their first few lonely weeks.
examples.zh: 宿管助理会在新生最孤单的头几周「关心探望」他们。

words.enDefinition: look at something interesting to judge it for yourself

examples.en: You should really check out the night market near campus.
examples.zh: 你真应该去「逛逛」学校附近的夜市。

examples.en: Check out this funny video my cousin just sent me.
examples.zh: 「瞧瞧」我表哥刚发给我的这个搞笑视频。

words.enDefinition: go and see what letters or packages have arrived

examples.en: I check the mail downstairs every evening after my last class.
examples.zh: 每天最后一节课之后，我都会下楼「取邮件」。

examples.en: Can you check the mail on your way in? My textbook should be there.
examples.zh: 你进来时能顺便「看看信箱」吗？我的教材应该到了。

collocations: check the mail on the way in

words.enDefinition: to become happier, or to make someone happier

examples.en: Come on, cheer up! Results come out Friday, and you studied hard.
examples.zh: 「开心点」啦！周五就出成绩了，你复习得那么努力。

examples.en: She brought me milk tea to cheer me up after the exam.
examples.zh: 考试结束后，她给我带奶茶「哄我开心」。

collocations: a little something to cheer you up

words.enDefinition: over-sentimental in an embarrassing, overused way

examples.en: The pickup lines at the welcome party were so cheesy that everyone burst out laughing.
examples.zh: 迎新派对上的搭讪台词「土味十足」，所有人笑作一团。

examples.en: I love that cheesy holiday movie even though the plot is completely predictable.
examples.zh: 那部情节「老套」的节日电影我照样百看不厌。

words.enDefinition: a pocket high on the front of a shirt or jacket

examples.en: I kept a pen in my chest pocket while checking people in at the event.
examples.zh: 给参加活动的人签到时，我把一支笔放在「胸前口袋」里。

examples.en: The chest pocket on my overshirt was just big enough for my student card.
examples.zh: 我外搭衬衫的「胸前口袋」刚好能装下学生证。

collocations: keep a pen in a chest pocket

words.enDefinition: fashionable in a simple, elegant way

examples.en: Her chic thrifted blazer looked like it came straight from a boutique downtown.
examples.zh: 她那件二手店淘来的外套「雅致时髦」，像市中心精品店的货。

examples.en: The new cafe near campus has a chic minimalist design with plants everywhere.
examples.zh: 校园旁新开的咖啡馆设计「简约别致」，到处摆着绿植。

words.enDefinition: a friend you have known since you were a child

examples.en: My childhood friend still sends me photos of our old neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我的「发小」还会给我发老街区的照片。

examples.en: I stayed with a childhood friend during my first week in Boston.
examples.zh: 到波士顿的第一周，我借住在一位「发小」家里。

collocations: childhood friend from the same block

words.enDefinition: behaving like a young child, in a negative way

examples.en: Ignoring her texts for a week was a childish way to handle it.
examples.zh: 一周不回她消息，这种处理方式太「幼稚」了。

examples.en: Their childish argument over the TV remote lasted three days.
examples.zh: 他们为遥控器爆发的「孩子气」争吵持续了三天。

words.enDefinition: to relax and stop being angry or nervous, informal

examples.en: Hey, chill out; one late assignment won't ruin your GPA.
examples.zh: 「放松点」哥们，一次迟交作业不会毁掉你的绩点。

examples.en: We chilled out on the quad after our last exam.
examples.zh: 考完最后一科，我们在中央草坪上「放松」了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: unpleasantly cool, slightly too cold

examples.en: It gets chilly after sunset, so bring a hoodie to the game.
examples.zh: 日落后会「凉飕飕的」，看比赛记得带件连帽衫。

examples.en: The lecture hall is always chilly, so I keep a cardigan there.
examples.zh: 教室里总是「凉飕飕的」，我在那儿放了件开衫。

words.enDefinition: casual trousers made from smooth cotton twill fabric

examples.en: I wore chinos to the campus tour because I wanted something comfortable but tidy.
examples.zh: 我穿着「斜纹棉布休闲裤」带人参观校园，想穿得既舒服又整齐。

examples.en: The chinos went with the sweater I'd brought for dinner with my project group.
examples.zh: 这条「斜纹棉布休闲裤」和我给项目组聚餐带的毛衣很搭。

words.enDefinition: add money to a shared amount for a purchase

examples.en: We each chipped in ten dollars for the shared pizza.
examples.zh: 那份披萨我们每人「凑了」十美元。

examples.en: Can you chip in for Sarah's birthday gift with us?
examples.zh: 莎拉的生日礼物你能和我们一起「凑份子」吗？

words.enDefinition: with a small piece broken off the edge

examples.en: I still use that chipped blue bowl from the free table outside.
examples.zh: 门口免费桌上那只「掉了瓷」的蓝碗我还在用。

examples.en: Be careful with the chipped edge on that glass; it cuts fingers easily.
examples.zh: 小心那个玻璃杯的「缺口」，很容易划到手。

words.enDefinition: to eat a meal, especially with enthusiasm

examples.en: The pizza just got here, so grab a plate and chow down.
examples.zh: 披萨刚送到，拿个盘子「开吃」吧。

examples.en: We chowed down on burgers after moving boxes all day long.
examples.zh: 搬了一整天箱子之后，我们「大快朵颐」地吃了顿汉堡。

words.enDefinition: slightly fat in a pleasant, soft-looking way

examples.en: My chubby baby cousin laughs whenever anyone makes airplane noises.
examples.zh: 我那「胖乎乎的」小表弟一听到飞机的声音就咯咯笑。

examples.en: The chubby cat in our dorm building has three different feeding schedules.
examples.zh: 宿舍楼里那只「胖乎乎的」猫被三拨人按不同时间喂。

words.enDefinition: to drink all of something quickly in big gulps

examples.en: He chugged his whole water bottle and ran back onto the field.
examples.zh: 他「猛灌」了一整瓶水，又跑回场上。

examples.en: Never chug an energy drink right before an exam starts.
examples.zh: 考试开始前千万别「猛灌」能量饮料。

words.enDefinition: return to a topic or person later on

examples.en: Let's circle back to the budget question after the demo.
examples.zh: 演示结束后我们再「回头讨论」预算问题。

examples.en: Can we circle back on the roommate schedule tonight after dinner?
examples.zh: 室友排班的事晚上吃完饭再「回头商量」，行吗？

words.enDefinition: the group of people you regularly spend time with

examples.en: Joining the hiking club expanded my circle of friends beyond my major.
examples.zh: 加入远足社团，让我的「朋友圈子」不再局限于同专业同学。

examples.en: Our circle of friends meets every Friday for hotpot night.
examples.zh: 我们的「朋友圈子」每周五晚上聚在一起吃火锅。

words.enDefinition: look unattractive together because colors or patterns compete
acceptedZhAnswers: 跟某物搭配起来不协调

examples.en: The bright scarf might clash with my patterned shirt in the theatre group's photo.
examples.zh: 拍剧团合照时，那条亮色围巾可能「和我的花衬衫不搭」。

examples.en: I picked plain trousers so they wouldn't clash with the jacket I'd already chosen.
examples.zh: 我选了素色长裤，这样就不会「和已选好的夹克不搭」。

collocations: clash with the rest of the outfit

words.enDefinition: stylish and high quality in a neat way

examples.en: He wore a classy navy suit to the career fair, and recruiters noticed immediately.
examples.zh: 他穿「有格调」的深蓝西装去招聘会，招聘官立刻注意到他。

examples.en: The hotel lobby feels classy even though their lunch menu is student-budget friendly.
examples.zh: 酒店大堂十分「有格调」，午餐菜单却很对学生钱包友好。

words.enDefinition: clothes that have been washed and are ready to wear

examples.en: I'm down to my last clean clothes, so laundry day is tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我的「干净衣服」只剩最后几件了，明天就是洗衣日。

examples.en: Pack a week of clean clothes for the conference trip.
examples.zh: 出差开会要带够一周的「干净衣服」。

words.enDefinition: empty a space by removing everything inside

examples.en: I clean out the fridge every week so nothing goes moldy.
examples.zh: 我每周都会把冰箱「清空」一次，免得东西发霉。

examples.en: She cleaned out her desk drawer and found ten old pens.
examples.zh: 她把书桌抽屉「清理」了一遍，找到了十支旧笔。

words.enDefinition: scrub and tidy the shared bathroom as a chore

examples.en: It's my turn to clean the bathroom, so I bought new sponges.
examples.zh: 这周轮到我「清洁浴室」，所以我买了新海绵。

examples.en: We clean the bathroom every Saturday morning before anyone takes a shower.
examples.zh: 我们每周六早上在大家洗澡之前「打扫浴室」。

collocations: my turn to clean the bathroom

words.enDefinition: remove dirt and mess until a place is clean

examples.en: We all cleaned up the dorm room together on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早上我们一起把宿舍「打扫干净」。

examples.en: Please clean up the microwave after you heat your food.
examples.zh: 热完食物后请把微波炉「清理干净」。

words.enDefinition: to finish all the food served to you

examples.en: I always clean my plate because my host mom cooks so well.
examples.zh: 寄宿妈妈手艺太好，我每次都「光盘」。

examples.en: You don't have to clean your plate here; leftovers can be boxed.
examples.zh: 在这儿不必硬「吃光盘子」，剩菜可以打包。

words.enDefinition: products and tools used for cleaning the home

examples.en: We split the cost of cleaning supplies and keep them by the door.
examples.zh: 「清洁用品」我们平摊费用，就放在门口。

examples.en: The campus store sells basic cleaning supplies like sponges and spray.
examples.zh: 校园超市有卖海绵、喷剂这类基础的「清洁用品」。

collocations: a closet full of cleaning supplies

words.enDefinition: remove dishes and leftovers from the table after eating

examples.en: After we eat, please clear the table and wipe the surface.
examples.zh: 吃完饭请「收拾桌子」，并把桌面擦一擦。

examples.en: I'll clear the table if you wash the pans tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我来「收拾桌子」，你来刷锅。

words.enDefinition: become bright and free of clouds

examples.en: The rain cleared up just in time for the festival.
examples.zh: 雨正好在音乐节开始前「放晴」了。

examples.en: It looks cloudy now, but it should clear up by noon.
examples.zh: 现在天色阴沉，不过中午应该会「转晴」。

words.enDefinition: to stop worrying for a while, often by walking

examples.en: A short walk around campus helps me clear my head.
examples.zh: 在校园里散散步帮我「理清思绪」。

examples.en: Go clear your head; you've stared at that essay for hours.
examples.zh: 去「放空一下脑子」吧，那篇论文你都盯了几个小时了。

collocations: go for a walk to clear your head

words.enDefinition: cough lightly to prepare your voice for speaking

examples.en: He cleared his throat before asking about the extension policy.
examples.zh: 询问延期政策之前，他先「清了清嗓子」。

examples.en: If the presenter freezes, just clear your throat to nudge them on.
examples.zh: 演讲的人卡壳时，「轻咳」一声提醒他继续就好。

collocations: clear your throat to get attention

words.enDefinition: close your fist or jaw together very tightly

examples.en: Clench your fists and take a breath before you reply to that email.
examples.zh: 回复那封邮件之前，先「攥紧」拳头深呼吸一下。

examples.en: She clenched her jaw when the landlord mentioned another rent hike.
examples.zh: 房东又提涨房租时，她「咬紧」了牙关。

words.enDefinition: block a pipe or drain so nothing can pass

examples.en: Pouring oil down the sink will clog the drain eventually.
