examples.zh: 把油倒进水池，下水道早晚会「堵」。

examples.en: The shower drain clogged with hair again, so water pooled around our feet.
examples.zh: 淋浴间的下水口又被头发「堵」住了，水积在我们脚边。

words.enDefinition: a friend you share personal thoughts and time with

examples.en: Only my close friends knew I was applying to programs abroad.
examples.zh: 只有几个「好友」知道我在申请出国的项目。

examples.en: She's a close friend, so I didn't mind picking her up at dawn.
examples.zh: 她是我的「好友」，所以天没亮去接她我也乐意。

words.enDefinition: almost; near a number or state

examples.en: My new apartment is close to both campus and the grocery store.
examples.zh: 我的新公寓「离校园和超市都很近」。

examples.en: We're close to finishing the group project, just one slide left.
examples.zh: 小组项目「快」完成了，只剩一页幻灯片。

words.enDefinition: Not open during the lunch break

examples.en: The reception area was closed for lunch, so we waited on a bench nearby.
examples.zh: 接待区「午休暂停开放」，我们就在附近长椅上等。

examples.en: I saw the “Closed for lunch” sign when I went back to collect my bag.
examples.zh: 我回去拿包时，看到了「午休暂停开放」的牌子。

words.enDefinition: Unavailable because repair or upkeep is taking place

examples.en: The smaller hall was closed for maintenance, so we met in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 小厅「因维护暂停开放」，我们就在院子里见面了。

examples.en: The notice said the fountain was closed for maintenance until the following Monday.
examples.zh: 告示说，喷泉「因维护暂停开放」，要到下周一才恢复。

words.zhGloss: 暂停开放直至另行通知
words.enDefinition: Closed with no reopening date given yet
acceptedZhAnswers: 暂停开放直至另行通知

examples.en: The notice said the courtyard was closed until further notice after the weekend storm.
examples.zh: 周末暴风雨过后，告示说院子「暂停开放直至另行通知」。

examples.en: The reading area was closed until further notice, so our group met outdoors instead.
examples.zh: 阅读区「暂停开放直至另行通知」，我们小组就改在室外见面了。

collocations: a Closed until further notice sign

words.enDefinition: the hour when a shop or bar stops serving

examples.en: During exam weeks the library's closing time is pushed to midnight.
examples.zh: 考试周图书馆的「打烊时间」会延到午夜。

examples.en: We ordered quickly because the diner was ten minutes from closing time.
examples.zh: 餐馆离「打烊时间」只剩十分钟，我们赶紧点了餐。

words.enDefinition: online space where files are kept instead of on a device

examples.en: The university gives every student free cloud storage for lecture notes.
examples.zh: 学校给每位学生提供免费的「云存储」，用来存课堂笔记。

examples.en: My cloud storage is full, so I have to decide which photos to keep.
examples.zh: 我的「云存储」满了，得决定到底留哪些照片。

words.enDefinition: covered with a lot of clouds

examples.en: It stays cloudy all week, so keep the rain jacket handy.
examples.zh: 整周都「多云」，雨衣要随手备着。

examples.en: The morning started cloudy but finally cleared up around noon.
examples.zh: 早晨「多云」，但中午前后终于放晴了。

words.enDefinition: moving awkwardly and often dropping or breaking things

examples.en: I'm so clumsy that I knocked my roommate's mug off the desk twice this week.
examples.zh: 我实在太「笨手笨脚」了，这周两次把室友的杯子碰下桌。

examples.en: Clumsy people like me should never carry four plates at once.
examples.zh: 像我这么「笨手笨脚」的人，一次绝不该端四个盘子。

words.enDefinition: hold something very tightly because you feel nervous

examples.en: Clutch the railing when the shuttle takes that sharp turn.
examples.zh: 校车急转弯的时候，一定要「紧握」扶手。

examples.en: She clutched her acceptance letter like it might fly away.
examples.zh: 她把录取通知书「紧紧攥在手里」，好像它会飞走似的。

words.enDefinition: full of too many things spread around untidily

examples.en: My desk gets cluttered with receipts, cables, and half-finished coffee.
examples.zh: 我桌上「堆满」小票、数据线和喝了一半的咖啡。

examples.en: The shared fridge is cluttered, so nothing ever fits inside.
examples.zh: 公共冰箱塞得「乱七八糟」，什么都放不进去。

words.enDefinition: A service that keeps visitors' coats during an event

examples.en: I left my coat at the coat check before walking into the hall.
examples.zh: 我进大厅前把外套留在了「外套寄存处」。

examples.en: The volunteer at the coat check handed me a ticket with my number.
examples.zh: 「外套寄存处」的志愿者递给我一张写着号码的票。

collocations: leave a jacket at coat check
pick up a coat from coat check

words.enDefinition: A hook used for hanging a coat

examples.en: I found a coat hook behind the door and hung my raincoat there.
examples.zh: 我在门后找到一个「挂衣钩」，就把雨衣挂在那儿。

examples.en: The coat hook by my seat was already holding two jackets and a bag.
examples.zh: 我座位旁的「挂衣钩」上已经挂了两件夹克和一个包。

collocations: hang a coat on a coat hook

words.enDefinition: a short rest during work or study for coffee

examples.en: Let's take a coffee break after finishing this forty-page chapter.
examples.zh: 啃完这四十页书，我们先来个「咖啡休息时间」吧。

examples.en: The ten o'clock coffee break is sacred in our research lab.
examples.zh: 我们实验室里十点的「咖啡休息」雷打不动。

words.enDefinition: a machine that brews drip coffee at home

examples.en: Our coffee maker runs on a timer, so breakfast feels civilized.
examples.zh: 我们的「咖啡机」定时启动，早餐顿时有了仪式感。

examples.en: Descale the coffee maker once a month or it slows down.
examples.zh: 「咖啡机」每月要除一次垢，不然水流会变慢。

words.enDefinition: a moving mass of cold air that changes the weather

examples.en: A cold front arrives Friday, bringing rain and gusty winds.
examples.zh: 周五有「冷锋」过境，带来降雨和大风。

examples.en: The weather app says a cold front will drop temperatures sharply.
examples.zh: 天气应用说「冷锋」会让气温骤降。

words.enDefinition: a short period of sudden cold weather

examples.en: The sudden cold snap froze the campus fountain solid overnight.
examples.zh: 突如其来的「寒潮」一夜之间把校园喷泉冻住了。

examples.en: Dig out your winter coat; the cold snap starts tomorrow.
examples.zh: 把冬衣翻出来，「寒潮」明天就到。

words.enDefinition: the part of a garment that fits around the neck

examples.en: I turned up my collar when the wind picked up outside the student centre.
examples.zh: 学生中心外起风了，我就把「衣领」竖起来。

examples.en: She straightened the collar of her shirt before we took the group photo.
examples.zh: 拍合影前，她理了理衬衫的「衣领」。

words.enDefinition: choose things with colors that look good together

examples.en: We decided to color-coordinate our shirts for the photo on the student magazine cover.
examples.zh: 我们决定给衬衫「协调配色」，拍学生杂志封面照片。

examples.en: I tried to color-coordinate my scarf and sweater before the end-of-term dinner on campus.
examples.zh: 学校的期末聚餐前，我试着给自己的围巾和毛衣「协调配色」。

words.enDefinition: a toothed tool used to arrange or smooth hair

examples.en: I packed a comb so I could tidy my hair after walking in the wind.
examples.zh: 我带了把「梳子」，走过风大的路段后可以整理一下头发。

examples.en: The comb was at the bottom of my bag under two notebooks and a towel.
examples.zh: 「梳子」在我包底，上面压着两本笔记本和一条毛巾。

collocations: run a comb through your hair

words.enDefinition: use a comb to arrange your hair

examples.en: I comb my hair in the hallway mirror when the bathroom is busy.
examples.zh: 卫生间有人用的时候，我就在走廊的镜子前「梳头」。

examples.en: I always comb my hair again after walking through the wind on the way to campus.
examples.zh: 顶风走到学校之后，我总会重新「梳一下头」。

collocations: comb my hair in the mirror

words.enDefinition: find something by chance while doing something else

examples.en: I came across an old photo of us while organizing files.
examples.zh: 整理文件时，我「偶然翻到」了我们的一张旧照片。

examples.en: You'll come across some great cafes if you explore the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 在附近转转，你会「偶然发现」一些很棒的咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: join someone in what they are about to do

examples.en: We're heading to the farmers' market on Saturday, so feel free to come along.
examples.zh: 我们周六要去农贸市场，欢迎你「一起来」。

examples.en: My roommate came along to the library even though she had nothing to read.
examples.zh: 室友虽然没书要看，还是「跟着」一起去了图书馆。

collocations: asked if I could come along

words.enDefinition: return to the place you left

examples.en: I'll come back for my umbrella this evening around six.
examples.zh: 今晚六点左右我会「回来」拿伞。

examples.en: He came back to the dorm after buying groceries downtown.
examples.zh: 他在市区买完菜就「回」宿舍了。

words.enDefinition: begin to feel the signs of an illness

examples.en: I think I'm coming down with a cold before the trip.
examples.zh: 出发前我好像「染上」感冒了。

examples.en: He came down with the flu during finals week last year.
examples.zh: 去年期末周他「得了」流感。

words.enDefinition: visit someone's home for a short time

examples.en: Come over after class this evening, we're ordering pizza together.
examples.zh: 今晚下课后「过来」吧，我们一起订披萨。

examples.en: My next-door neighbor came over to borrow a screwdriver yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天隔壁邻居「过来」借了一把螺丝刀。

words.enDefinition: become loose or undone after being tied

examples.en: My shoelaces tend to come untied when I walk quickly between classes.
examples.zh: 赶着在教室之间走时，我的鞋带经常「自己松开」。

examples.en: The drawstring can come untied if I leave the ends hanging outside my coat.
examples.zh: 如果把抽绳的两头留在外套外面，结就可能「自己松开」。

words.enDefinition: happen or appear unexpectedly in life or talk

examples.en: Something came up at home, so I'll be a bit late.
examples.zh: 家里突然「有事」，我会晚一点到。

examples.en: That old topic came up again during dinner yesterday evening.
examples.zh: 昨晚吃饭时又「聊到」了那个老话题。

words.enDefinition: think of an idea or plan suddenly

examples.en: We came up with a cheaper travel plan together last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们一起「想出了」一个更省钱的出行方案。

examples.en: She came up with a great gift idea for her mom.
examples.zh: 她给妈妈「想到」一个很棒的礼物点子。

words.enDefinition: to make someone feel better when they are sad

examples.en: My roommate comforted me after I failed my first midterm.
examples.zh: 第一次期中考砸后，室友「安慰」了我。

examples.en: She comforted her homesick friend with a plate of homemade dumplings.
examples.zh: 她用一盘手工饺子「安慰」想家的朋友。

words.enDefinition: food that makes you feel better when stressed or sad

examples.en: For me, instant noodles are the ultimate comfort food after exams.
examples.zh: 对我来说，考完试后的终极「疗愈食物」就是泡面。

examples.en: Her comfort food of choice during finals week is ice cream.
examples.zh: 期末周她选的「慰藉食物」是冰淇淋。

words.enDefinition: A hall used for events by local groups

examples.en: We met at the community hall for a book swap on Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们周六下午在「社区活动大厅」碰面，参加换书活动。

examples.en: The community hall put extra chairs out before the film screening started that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上电影开始放映前，「社区活动大厅」又摆出了一些椅子。

collocations: an event at the community hall

words.enDefinition: travel regularly between home and campus or work

examples.en: I commute by regional train for forty minutes twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周两次坐区间火车「通勤」四十分钟。

examples.en: She commutes from the suburbs because on-campus housing is expensive.
examples.zh: 校内住宿太贵，她从郊区「通勤」上学。

words.enDefinition: small and neatly arranged to save space

examples.en: This compact rice cooker fits on the tiniest dorm shelf.
examples.zh: 这款「小巧」的电饭煲连宿舍最小的架子都放得下。

examples.en: I keep a compact umbrella in my bag because weather here flips fast.
examples.zh: 我包里常备一把「小巧」的伞，这儿天气说变就变。

words.enDefinition: when measured or judged against something else

examples.en: Compared to last winter, this season feels surprisingly mild so far.
examples.zh: 与去年冬天「相比」，今年到目前为止暖和得出奇。

examples.en: My cooking skills have improved a lot compared to freshman year.
examples.zh: 与大一时「相比」，我的厨艺进步了很多。

words.enDefinition: able to work together with another device or system

examples.en: Check that the adapter is compatible with your laptop before checkout.
examples.zh: 结账前先确认转接头和你的笔记本「兼容」。

examples.en: The free editing software isn't compatible with my Chromebook, unfortunately.
examples.zh: 可惜这款免费剪辑软件跟我的 Chromebook「不兼容」。

words.enDefinition: say something nice about someone or their work

examples.en: Our professor complimented the whole team on a well-organized presentation.
examples.zh: 教授「称赞」了我们小组，说展示条理清晰。

examples.en: She complimented my cooking, even though the rice was slightly burnt.
examples.zh: 她「夸」我做饭好吃，尽管米饭有点糊。

words.enDefinition: share private feelings with someone you trust

examples.en: I confide in my older cousin because she never judges me.
examples.zh: 我喜欢向表姐「倾诉」，因为她从不评判我。

examples.en: Students rarely confide in professors, though office hours make it easier.
examples.zh: 学生很少向教授「吐露心事」，不过答疑时间让这变得容易。

collocations: have no one to confide in

words.enDefinition: careful not to inconvenience or hurt others

examples.en: It was considerate of Dan to text before inviting people over.
examples.zh: 丹请人来家里前先发消息问一声，真是「体贴」。

examples.en: A considerate roommate wears headphones instead of blasting music late at night.
examples.zh: 「体贴」的室友会戴耳机，而不是深夜外放音乐。

words.enDefinition: the saved list of people's phone numbers and emails

examples.en: I synced my contact list to my new phone in about two minutes.
examples.zh: 我花了大约两分钟就把「通讯录」同步到了新手机。

examples.en: Scroll through your contact list and delete the numbers you never call.
examples.zh: 翻翻你的「通讯录」，把从来不打的号码删掉。

collocations: add someone to your contact list

words.enDefinition: making you believe that something is true

examples.en: Her argument for keeping the writing center open was convincing, and the dean listened.
examples.zh: 她主张保留写作中心的理由「令人信服」，院长听了进去。

examples.en: His excuse for missing practice sounded convincing, but the coach still checked the schedule.
examples.zh: 他缺训的借口听着「可信」，教练还是去核了课表。

words.enDefinition: become cooler, said of the weather

examples.en: Evenings cool down fast here, so keep a jacket nearby.
examples.zh: 这里晚上「降温」很快，手边备件外套。

examples.en: The apartment finally cools down after ten o'clock at night.
examples.zh: 公寓要到晚上十点后才「凉快下来」。

words.enDefinition: an insulated box that keeps food and drinks cold

examples.en: We packed the cooler with drinks for the beach picnic tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们往「冰桶」里装满饮料，准备明天的海滩野餐。

examples.en: Keep the cooler in the shade so the ice lasts longer.
examples.zh: 把「保温冰盒」放在阴凉处，冰才化得慢。

words.enDefinition: to deal with a difficult situation well enough

examples.en: Keeping a journal really helps me cope with deadline stress.
examples.zh: 写日记确实帮我「应对」截止日期带来的压力。

examples.en: How do you cope with homesickness during such a long semester?
examples.zh: 学期这么长，你是怎么「应对」想家情绪的？

words.enDefinition: duplicate text or files and place them somewhere else

examples.en: Copy and paste the tracking number into the courier's website to follow the parcel.
examples.zh: 把快递单号「复制粘贴」到快递官网，就能追踪包裹。

examples.en: Do not just copy and paste my notes — rewrite them in your own words.
examples.zh: 别直接「复制粘贴」我的笔记，要用你自己的话重新整理。

words.enDefinition: Separated by a barrier to keep people out

examples.en: The corner by the hall was cordoned off while volunteers moved the heavy display.
examples.zh: 志愿者搬移沉重的展台时，大厅旁的那个角落「被围起来禁止通行」。

examples.en: We saw that part of the courtyard was cordoned off, so we walked around it.
examples.zh: 我们发现院子的一部分「被围了起来」，就绕过去了。

words.enDefinition: a small stick with a soft cotton tip

examples.en: I used a cotton swab to clear dust from the hinge of my hair clip.
examples.zh: 我用一根「棉签」清掉发夹转轴上的灰。

examples.en: A cotton swab rolled under the sink when I opened my wash bag.
examples.zh: 我打开洗漱包时，一根「棉签」滚到了洗手池下面。

words.enDefinition: someone who sits watching TV for hours

examples.en: During winter break I turn into a total couch potato.
examples.zh: 寒假一到，我就彻底成了「整天窝在沙发的人」。

examples.en: Stop being a couch potato and come to the gym with us.
examples.zh: 别做「整天窝在沙发的人」了，跟我们去健身房吧。

words.enDefinition: to track the energy value of everything you eat

examples.en: I count calories with an app during my training season.
examples.zh: 备赛期间我用软件「计算卡路里」。

examples.en: Counting calories made me anxious, so I stopped after a month.
examples.zh: 「数卡路里」让我很焦虑，一个月后就放弃了。

words.enDefinition: rely on someone to do what is needed

examples.en: You can count on me to bring the tickets tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚带票这事你可以「指望」我。

examples.en: I'm counting on you to water the plants this week.
examples.zh: 这周浇花就「靠」你了。

words.enDefinition: too many to count or list

examples.en: I've watched countless tutorial videos trying to fix my laptop.
examples.zh: 为了修好笔记本，我看了「无数」教学视频。

examples.en: She spent countless hours in the studio rehearsing for the spring concert.
examples.zh: 她在练功房花了「无数」小时为春季音乐会排练。

words.enDefinition: A sheltered place for people to wait

examples.en: We moved to the covered waiting area when the rain started getting heavier.
examples.zh: 雨下得更大时，我们移到了「带顶棚的等候区」。

examples.en: The covered waiting area had a low wall where I could rest my bag.
examples.zh: 「带顶棚的等候区」有一堵矮墙，我可以把包搁上去。

collocations: wait in a covered waiting area
shelter in a covered waiting area

words.enDefinition: A pedestrian path with shelter overhead

examples.en: We took the covered walkway back to the library when it started raining.
examples.zh: 开始下雨时，我们沿着「有顶步行道」回了图书馆。

examples.en: The covered walkway connects two buildings and stays open when the rooms are closed.
examples.zh: 「有顶步行道」连接两栋楼，室内各房间关闭后仍可通行。

words.enDefinition: small, warm, and comfortable in a pleasant way

examples.en: With fairy lights and a hot water bottle, my room feels really cozy.
examples.zh: 装上串灯、抱着暖水袋，我的房间「温馨」极了。

examples.en: This cafe is cozy on rainy afternoons, so I always study here.
examples.zh: 雨天下午这家咖啡馆「温馨」又舒服，我总来这里学习。

words.enDefinition: press your finger joints until they pop

examples.en: Please don't crack your knuckles while someone is speaking during the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课上有人发言时，请别「掰指关节」。

examples.en: My roommate cracked his knuckles before every practice problem set.
examples.zh: 每次开始刷题前，室友都要「掰一掰手指关节」。

words.enDefinition: having thin damage lines but not fully broken

examples.en: My cracked phone screen finally gave out during exam week.
examples.zh: 考试周里，我这台「裂了屏」的手机终于罢工了。

examples.en: We tossed the cracked mug rather than risk hot tea leaking everywhere.
examples.zh: 我们把「有裂纹」的马克杯扔了，免得热茶漏得到处都是。

words.enDefinition: a phone or laptop screen damaged with visible cracks

examples.en: I have been typing on a cracked screen since I dropped my phone at the gym.
examples.zh: 自从在健身房摔了手机，我就一直对着「碎屏」打字。

examples.en: A cracked screen still works, but the corners cut my thumb.
examples.zh: 「碎屏」还能凑合用，就是边角会割到拇指。

words.enDefinition: force too many things into a small space

examples.en: Pack your clothes first, then cram your textbooks in last.
examples.zh: 先塞衣服再放课本——衣服更占地方，课本最后再「塞进去」。

examples.en: Four of us crammed into the back of an Uber after the game.
examples.zh: 球赛后我们四个人「挤」在网约车后座。

words.enDefinition: too small and tight to move around comfortably

examples.en: Four people in one dorm room gets cramped really fast.
examples.zh: 一间宿舍住四个人很快就显得「拥挤」。

examples.en: My desk is so cramped that the lamp and laptop barely fit.
examples.zh: 我的书桌「逼仄」得很，台灯和电脑都差点放不下。

words.enDefinition: stop working suddenly, as an app does when overloaded

examples.en: The notes app crashed right before I saved my summary of chapter five.
examples.zh: 笔记应用在我保存第五章总结前突然「崩溃」了。

examples.en: Zoom tends to crash when forty students join the review session at once.
examples.zh: 四十个学生同时进复习课的时候，Zoom 容易「崩溃」。

words.enDefinition: a strong sudden desire for a specific food

examples.en: Late at night I always get a craving for fried chicken.
examples.zh: 深夜我总会「馋」炸鸡。

examples.en: My roommate gets cravings for spicy food right before every exam.
examples.zh: 我室友每到考试前就特别「馋」辣的。

words.enDefinition: strange in a frightening, unpleasant way

examples.en: The abandoned house at the end of our street looks creepy after dark.
examples.zh: 天黑之后，街尾那栋空屋看着就「令人发毛」。

examples.en: Getting friend requests from forty anonymous accounts felt creepy, so I blocked them all.
examples.zh: 一下子冒出四十个匿名好友申请，真「令人发毛」，我全拉黑了。

words.enDefinition: a round neckline that sits close to the base of the neck

examples.en: I chose a sweater with a crew neck for the walk home after class.
examples.zh: 我选了件「贴颈圆领」毛衣，下课后走回家时穿。

examples.en: The sweatshirt had a crew neck that sat flat under my raincoat all afternoon.
examples.zh: 卫衣是「贴颈圆领」，一下午都平贴在雨衣下面。

collocations: a crew neck on a sweater

words.enDefinition: socks that cover the ankle and reach partway up the calf

examples.en: I wore crew socks with my boots so the tops didn't rub against my legs.
examples.zh: 我穿靴子时搭了「中筒袜」，这样靴口就不会直接蹭腿。

examples.en: She packed crew socks for the weekend trip because the evenings were still cold.
examples.zh: 那几天晚上还冷，她给周末出行带上了「中筒袜」。

words.enDefinition: fresh, dry, and pleasantly cool, like autumn air

examples.en: A crisp autumn morning is perfect for the walk to campus.
examples.zh: 「清爽」的秋日早晨最适合走路去学校。

examples.en: The air turned crisp overnight, signaling the start of fall.
examples.zh: 空气一夜之间变得「干爽」，秋天来了。

words.enDefinition: firm and making a crunch when bitten

examples.en: The fried chicken stays crispy only if you eat it immediately.
examples.zh: 炸鸡只有趁热吃才「酥脆」。

examples.en: Roast the potatoes longer if you want them extra crispy.
examples.zh: 想让土豆「烤」得焦脆，就多烤一会儿。

words.enDefinition: not straight or level, bent to one side

examples.en: The picture frames in our hallway hang crooked because the walls tilt.
examples.zh: 走廊里的相框都挂「歪」了，因为墙本身是斜的。

examples.en: He grinned with one crooked tooth showing, right before his presentation.
examples.zh: 展示前一刻，他咧嘴一笑，露出一颗「歪」牙。

words.enDefinition: draw a line through written text to delete it

examples.en: Cross out the items you've already bought on the list.
examples.zh: 把清单上已经买到的项目「划掉」。

examples.en: He crossed out his old phone number on the form.
examples.zh: 他把表格上的旧手机号「划掉」了。

words.enDefinition: bend low with your knees bent and body forward

examples.en: Crouch behind the couch if you're hiding for the surprise.
examples.zh: 躲起来准备惊喜的话，就「蹲」在沙发后面。

examples.en: She crouched to pick up the scattered flashcards before the quiz.
examples.zh: 小测前她「蹲下身」捡起散落的单词卡。

words.enDefinition: the finished band at the end of a sleeve

examples.en: One cuff kept catching on the edge of my notebook during the lecture.
examples.zh: 上课时，一个「袖口」老是勾到笔记本的边。

examples.en: I loosened the cuff of my shirt before washing my hands in the studio.
examples.zh: 在工作室洗手前，我把衬衫的「袖口」松开了。

words.enDefinition: turn up the bottoms of your jeans to make them shorter

examples.en: You can cuff your jeans so the loose ends don't drag through the puddles.
examples.zh: 你可以「卷起牛仔裤脚」，这样松松的裤脚就不会拖过水坑。

examples.en: It's easier to cuff your jeans before you lace up those ankle boots.
examples.zh: 给那双短靴系鞋带之前，「卷起牛仔裤脚」会更方便。

collocations: cuff your jeans above your boots
learn how to cuff your jeans

words.enDefinition: awkward and complicated to do or use

examples.en: The scholarship application was so cumbersome that half of our cohort gave up halfway.
examples.zh: 奖学金申请流程「繁琐至极」，我们这届一半人半途放弃。

examples.en: Renting textbooks used to be cumbersome until the library added an online request form.
examples.zh: 以前租教材手续「麻烦」，图书馆上线申请表单后就好办多了。

words.enDefinition: sit or lie with your body drawn into a ball

examples.en: On rainy Sundays I curl up on the couch with a novel.
examples.zh: 下雨的周日，我就「窝在沙发上」看小说。

examples.en: The cat curled up on my clean laundry the second I left.
examples.zh: 我刚一走，猫就「蜷在」我刚洗好的衣服上。

collocations: curl up with a good book

words.enDefinition: the blinking marker that shows where you are typing

examples.en: My cursor kept jumping around while I was typing my essay.
examples.zh: 我写论文的时候「光标」总是乱跳。

examples.en: Click anywhere in the document and the cursor will move to that spot.
examples.zh: 在文档任意位置点一下，「光标」就会移到那里。

words.enDefinition: take a shorter path straight across an area

examples.en: Cut across the quad and you'll save ten minutes on the walk.
examples.zh: 从中央草坪「抄近路穿过去」，能省十分钟路程。

examples.en: I cut across the parking lot to catch the earlier shuttle.
examples.zh: 为了赶早一班的校车，我从停车场「斜插过去」。

words.enDefinition: use or spend less of something than before

examples.en: I'm cutting back on bubble tea to save some money.
examples.zh: 为了省点钱，我在「少喝」奶茶。

examples.en: He cut back on late-night snacks for the whole month.
examples.zh: 他一整个月都在「减少」宵夜。

words.enDefinition: To take a place ahead of people already waiting

examples.en: A volunteer reminded visitors not to cut in line when the other door opened.
examples.zh: 另一扇门打开时，志愿者提醒访客不要「插队」。

examples.en: I thought someone was trying to cut in line, but they were just passing through.
examples.zh: 我以为有人要「插队」，其实对方只是路过。

collocations: ask someone not to cut in line
cut in line ahead of someone

words.enDefinition: at the most advanced stage of development

examples.en: The robotics lab receives cutting-edge equipment that most undergraduate courses never touch.
examples.zh: 机器人实验室配「尖端」设备，多数本科课程根本碰不到。

examples.en: Her cutting-edge research on battery recycling won this year's undergraduate poster prize.
examples.zh: 她那项电池回收的「前沿」研究拿下了今年的本科生海报奖。

words.enDefinition: to touch something lightly with a cloth or sponge, often repeatedly

examples.en: My flatmate told me to dab the stain with a clean cloth.
examples.zh: 室友叫我用干净的布「轻轻点拭」那块污渍。

examples.en: I used a paper towel to dab the water around the bowl.
examples.zh: 我用纸巾「轻轻点拭」碗周围的水。

words.enDefinition: the usual things you do regularly every day

examples.en: Moving off campus completely changed my daily routine and my sleep schedule.
examples.zh: 搬出校园彻底改变了我的「日常作息」和睡眠时间。

examples.en: Try to keep a steady daily routine during exam week.
examples.zh: 考试周尽量保持稳定的「日常作息」。

collocations: fit workouts into my daily routine

words.enDefinition: made without milk, butter, cheese, or cream

examples.en: The coffee shop carries dairy-free oat milk at no extra charge.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡店免费提供「无奶」的燕麦奶。

examples.en: Ask about dairy-free toppings if cheese always upsets your stomach.
examples.zh: 如果吃芝士总是肠胃不舒服，可以问问「不含乳制品」的配料。

words.enDefinition: slightly wet in an unpleasant, clammy way

examples.en: The basement bedroom feels damp even after we run the dehumidifier.
examples.zh: 即使开了除湿机，地下室卧室还是「潮」的。

examples.en: Hang your towel outside; it went damp in the closet again.
examples.zh: 毛巾晾出去吧，在柜子里又「受潮」了。

words.enDefinition: a screen setting with dark backgrounds and lighter text

examples.en: Dark mode is easier on my eyes during late-night essay edits.
examples.zh: 深夜改论文时，「深色模式」对眼睛更友好。

examples.en: My phone switches to dark mode automatically at sunset every single day.
examples.zh: 每天日落时分，我的手机都会自动切换到「深色模式」。

words.enDefinition: move suddenly and quickly in one direction

examples.en: Dart between the raindrops if you forgot your umbrella again.
examples.zh: 又忘带伞的话，就在雨点间「飞快地窜」过去。

examples.en: A rabbit darted under the hedge as we walked back to the dorm.
examples.zh: 我们走回宿舍时，一只兔子「窜」进了树篱下。

words.enDefinition: run very fast for a short distance

examples.en: Dash across the quad when the app says the bus is two stops away.
examples.zh: App 显示公交还差两站时，就「飞奔」穿过中央草坪。

examples.en: I dashed out of the dorm when I heard the bus was early.
examples.zh: 听说公交提前到了，我从宿舍「飞奔」出去。

words.enDefinition: the time when daylight first appears in the morning

examples.en: We left at dawn to catch the early bus to the trailhead.
examples.zh: 我们「黎明」就出发，好赶上开往登山口的首班车。

examples.en: The bakery where I work opens before dawn every single morning.
examples.zh: 我打工的面包店每天「黎明」前就开门。

words.enDefinition: repeatedly, each day like the one before

examples.en: Day after day, the same lunch queue stretched outside the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 「日复一日」，食堂门口排着同样的长队。

examples.en: He practiced the piano day after day before the recital.
examples.zh: 演出之前，他「日复一日」地练琴。

words.enDefinition: A locker for storing belongings during the day

examples.en: I put my backpack in a day locker before entering the small exhibition.
examples.zh: 我进去看小型展览前，把背包放进了一个「当日使用的储物柜」。

examples.en: The day locker was just big enough for my coat and course notes.
examples.zh: 这个「当日使用的储物柜」刚好能放下我的外套和课程笔记。

words.enDefinition: a day when you have no work or classes

examples.en: With no classes on Friday, I finally have a day off.
examples.zh: 周五没课，我终于有了一个「休息日」。

examples.en: Use your day off to clean the room, not to sleep until three.
examples.zh: 「休息日」用来打扫房间吧，别一觉睡到下午三点。

words.enDefinition: the system of moving clocks forward one hour in spring

examples.en: Daylight saving time starts in March, so we lose an hour of sleep.
examples.zh: 「夏令时」三月开始，我们会少睡一个小时。

examples.en: I always forget to adjust my alarm for daylight saving time.
examples.zh: 我总是忘记为「夏令时」调闹钟。

collocations: the start of daylight saving time
set clocks for daylight saving time

words.enDefinition: a battery completely drained, leaving the device unpowered

examples.en: My dead battery left me without maps in the middle of the move.
examples.zh: 「电池没电」让我搬家搬到一半就没地图可用。

examples.en: A dead battery is the real reason I missed the group meeting, honestly.
examples.zh: 说实话，错过小组会的真正原因就是「电池没电」。

collocations: a phone with a dead battery

words.enDefinition: an area where phones get no signal at all

examples.en: The fourth-floor study lounge is a total dead zone for phone calls.
examples.zh: 四楼自习室是个「信号盲区」，打电话完全没戏。

examples.en: Every campus has one dead zone where group texts just never arrive.
examples.zh: 每个校园都有一个「信号盲区」，群消息永远收不到。

collocations: the dead zone in the library
calls drop in the dead zone

words.enDefinition: take action to handle a problem or task

examples.en: I'll deal with the landlord about the broken doorknob tomorrow.
examples.zh: 门把手坏了的事，我明天去跟房东「处理」。

examples.en: She dealt with the noisy neighbors very calmly last week.
examples.zh: 上周她非常冷静地「应对」了吵闹的邻居。

words.enDefinition: open to argument and reasonable disagreement

examples.en: Whether a gap year helps your career is debatable, so I asked several alumni first.
examples.zh: 间隔年对职业有没有帮助「见仁见智」，我先问了几位学长学姐。

examples.en: It's debatable which library floor is quietest, but the top one wins for most people.
examples.zh: 图书馆哪层最安静「说法不一」，不过多数人投顶楼。

words.enDefinition: coffee with most of the caffeine removed

examples.en: Evening decaf lets me join coffee chats without losing any sleep.
examples.zh: 晚上喝「无咖啡因咖啡」，既能参加咖啡社交又不怕失眠。

examples.en: Can I get this latte made with decaf instead of regular?
examples.zh: 这杯拿铁可以换成「低咖啡因」的吗？

words.enDefinition: good enough or acceptable, though not excellent

examples.en: The food truck by the library is decent, especially the falafel wrap.
examples.zh: 图书馆旁那辆餐车味道「还行」，尤其推荐鹰嘴豆丸卷饼。

examples.en: He speaks decent Japanese after one exchange semester in Osaka.
examples.zh: 在大阪交换一学期后，他的日语说得「挺像样」。

words.enDefinition: remove things you do not need to make space tidier

examples.en: We decluttered the shared closet and donated three bags to the thrift store.
examples.zh: 我们「清理」了公用的衣橱，捐了三袋东西给旧货店。

examples.en: Declutter your desk before finals—a clear space really helps you focus.
examples.zh: 期末前把书桌「收拾清爽」，整洁的环境确实有助于专注。

words.enDefinition: clean a place very thoroughly, beyond the usual routine

examples.en: We gave the apartment a deep clean before the landlord's inspection.
examples.zh: 房东来检查之前，我们给公寓做了一次「深度大扫除」。

examples.en: Sunday is my deep clean day for the bathroom and closet.
examples.zh: 周日是我的「深度打扫日」，专攻浴室和衣柜。

collocations: give the place a deep clean

words.enDefinition: feeling less confident or enthusiastic after a setback

examples.en: I felt deflated when the event I had helped organize was cancelled.
examples.zh: 得知自己参与筹办的活动取消后，我「一下泄了气」。

examples.en: She looked deflated after finding out that the workshop had filled up.
examples.zh: 得知培训名额已满后，她看起来「一下泄了气」。

words.enDefinition: make frozen food soft and ready to cook

examples.en: Defrost the chicken in the fridge overnight, not on the counter.
examples.zh: 鸡肉要提前一晚放冰箱「解冻」，别放在台面上。

examples.en: I forgot to defrost the dumplings, so dinner is running late.
examples.zh: 我忘了给饺子「解冻」，晚饭要推迟了。

words.enDefinition: remove something permanently from your device or account

examples.en: Delete the duplicate photos after every trip to keep your storage sane.
examples.zh: 每次旅行后「删除」重复照片，免得存储爆满。

examples.en: I accidentally deleted my whole draft and nearly cried in the library.
examples.zh: 我不小心「删除」了整篇草稿，在图书馆差点哭出来。

words.enDefinition: fragile clothes like silk or lace that need gentle washing

examples.en: Put your delicates in a mesh bag so the straps don't tangle.
examples.zh: 把「细软衣物」放进洗衣袋，免得肩带缠在一起。

examples.en: The care label says to wash delicates separately in cold water.
examples.zh: 洗涤标签说，「细软衣物」要用冷水单独洗。

words.enDefinition: very pleased about something that has happened

examples.en: I'm delighted that my host family invited me for Thanksgiving.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭邀请我一起过感恩节，我「高兴」极了。

examples.en: The professor said she was delighted with our group's presentation.
examples.zh: 教授说她对我们小组的展示「非常满意」。

words.enDefinition: requiring a lot of time, skill, or effort

examples.en: My organic chemistry course is demanding, so I block two library hours every evening.
examples.zh: 有机化学课「要求很高」，我每晚固定两小时泡图书馆。

examples.en: The demanding internship taught her more in three months than a year of lectures.
examples.zh: 那段「高强度」的实习三个月教她的东西比一年听课还多。

words.enDefinition: a jacket made from sturdy denim fabric

examples.en: I wore a denim jacket to the film club meeting because we sat outside.
examples.zh: 电影社开会坐在室外，我就穿了一件「牛仔夹克」。

examples.en: The denim jacket was just warm enough for the walk from residence to the station.
examples.zh: 从宿舍走到车站，穿那件「牛仔夹克」刚好够暖。

collocations: layer a denim jacket over a sweater

words.enDefinition: able to be trusted to do what you promise

examples.en: My dependable cousin picked me up at 5 a.m. without complaining.
examples.zh: 我那「靠得住的」表哥早上五点来接我，毫无怨言。

examples.en: Every team needs one dependable member who never misses deadlines.
examples.zh: 每个团队都需要一位从不误事、「靠得住」的成员。

words.enDefinition: very sad and without energy or hope for a while

examples.en: He felt depressed for weeks after failing his driving test.
examples.zh: 驾照考试没过后，他「消沉」了好几个星期。

examples.en: The long gray winters here make some international students depressed.
examples.zh: 这里漫长阴沉的冬天让一些留学生「情绪低迷」。

words.enDefinition: a person born in a later generation of a family

examples.en: As the youngest descendant, I inherited grandma's handwritten recipe book.
examples.zh: 作为最小的「后代」，我继承了奶奶的手写菜谱。

examples.en: The festival gathers descendants of the village's founding families every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，节日都会聚集起村里创始家族的「后代」。

words.enDefinition: the feeling that everything is wrong and nothing will improve

examples.en: A moment of despair hit me when my laptop crashed before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前电脑崩溃的那一刻，我感到一阵「绝望」。

examples.en: She almost gave up in despair before the scholarship office called.
examples.zh: 奖学金办公室来电之前，她几乎「绝望」得想放弃。

words.enDefinition: remove knots from hair so it can be combed freely

examples.en: I stopped to detangle my hair after taking off my scarf in the hallway.
examples.zh: 我在走廊摘下围巾后，停下来「梳开打结的头发」。

examples.en: It took me a minute to detangle my hair before the group photo.
examples.zh: 拍合影前，我花了一会儿「梳开打结的头发」。

words.enDefinition: extremely sad and shocked, often by very bad news

examples.en: She was absolutely devastated when she saw her final grade online.
examples.zh: 在网上看到期末成绩时，她整个人都「崩溃了」。

examples.en: He was devastated by the rejection and skipped the club meeting.
examples.zh: 被拒之后他「备受打击」，连社团会议都没去。

words.enDefinition: causing huge damage or a huge shock

examples.en: The storm had a devastating effect on the small coastal towns along the shore.
examples.zh: 那场风暴对沿岸小镇造成了「毁灭性」的打击。

examples.en: Losing her scholarship right before the semester started was devastating news for her.
examples.zh: 开学前夕失去奖学金，这个消息对她是「毁灭性」的打击。

words.enDefinition: enter a phone number and start the call

examples.en: Dial the campus safety number and save it under favorites for emergencies.
examples.zh: 「拨打电话」给校园安全中心，并把它存进收藏以备急用。

examples.en: Dial the number on the flyer to book a viewing this weekend.
examples.zh: 「拨打电话」给传单上的号码，预约这个周末看房。

words.enDefinition: cut food into small even cubes

examples.en: Dice the onions finely so they melt into the sauce.
examples.zh: 洋葱「切丁」切细一点，才能在酱汁里化开。

examples.en: He diced the potatoes while the pot came to a boil.
examples.zh: 等水烧开的时候，他把土豆「切成丁」。

words.enDefinition: soda with artificial sweetener instead of sugar

examples.en: I switched to diet soda to cut sugar out of my routine.
examples.zh: 为了减少糖分摄入，我改喝「无糖汽水」了。

examples.en: Does the vending machine stock diet soda or only the regular kind?
examples.zh: 自动售货机有「无糖汽水」吗？还是只有普通款？

words.enDefinition: to start eating a meal eagerly

examples.en: Dinner's finally ready, so dig in before it gets completely cold.
examples.zh: 晚饭终于好了，趁没凉赶紧「开动」。

examples.en: My roommate said we could dig in once everyone had a place to sit.
examples.zh: 室友说，等每个人都有座位，我们就可以「开吃」。

words.enDefinition: A screen showing information that can be updated

examples.en: The digital display near the door showed which rooms were open that evening.
examples.zh: 门旁的「电子显示屏」标出了那天晚上哪些房间开放。

examples.en: We watched the digital display until our group number appeared beside the room name.
examples.zh: 我们看着「电子显示屏」，直到组号出现在房间名称旁。

words.enDefinition: working carefully and steadily without giving up

examples.en: Diligent evening revision finally pulled my grades up a level.
examples.zh: 每晚「勤奋刻苦的」复习，终于让我的成绩上了一个台阶。

examples.en: My diligent deskmate reviews vocabulary for twenty minutes after dinner daily.
examples.zh: 我那「勤勉的」同桌每天晚饭后复习二十分钟单词。

words.enDefinition: not bright, so it is hard to see clearly

examples.en: The stairwell light is so dim that I tripped on my backpack twice.
examples.zh: 楼道灯太「昏暗」，我两次被自己的背包绊到。

examples.en: This dim corner of the library is great for napping, not for reading.
examples.zh: 图书馆这个「昏暗」角落适合打盹，不适合看书。

words.enDefinition: a social evening where guests share a cooked meal

examples.en: My host family threw a dinner party for the new neighbors.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭为新邻居们办了一场「晚餐聚会」。

examples.en: We're hosting a small dinner party before everyone leaves for break.
examples.zh: 假期大家各奔东西之前，我们办一场小型「晚宴聚会」。

collocations: invite someone to a dinner party

words.enDefinition: the table where the family eats its meals

examples.en: Phones stay off the dinner table in my host family's house.
examples.zh: 在寄宿家庭，手机不许上「餐桌」。

examples.en: We gathered around the dinner table to share stories from the week.
examples.zh: 我们围坐在「饭桌」旁，分享这一周的见闻。

words.enDefinition: An arrow indicating which way someone should go

examples.en: The directional arrow pointed upstairs, although I expected the hall to be straight ahead.
examples.zh: 「方向箭头」指向楼上，可我原以为一直走就能到大厅。

examples.en: I followed the directional arrow past two doors to the smaller meeting room.
examples.zh: 我跟着「方向箭头」走过两扇门，到了较小的会议室。

words.enDefinition: Immediately across from something

examples.en: The room was directly opposite the main door, so we found it right away.
examples.zh: 房间「就在大门的正对面」，我们一下就找到了。

examples.en: I waited on a bench directly opposite the lift while my friend asked for directions.
examples.zh: 朋友去问路时，我在「电梯正对面」的长椅上等着。

words.enDefinition: lose or end a device's link to a network

examples.en: The dorm Wi-Fi disconnects every night at two for maintenance.
examples.zh: 宿舍Wi-Fi每晚两点会「断开」进行维护。

examples.en: My Bluetooth headphones keep disconnecting in the middle of online seminars.
examples.zh: 上网课时，我的蓝牙耳机总是「断连」。

words.enDefinition: having lost your motivation to keep trying

examples.en: Don't get discouraged; everyone struggles with academic writing at first.
examples.zh: 别「灰心」，一开始人人都不适应学术写作。

examples.en: After failing the placement test twice, he felt pretty discouraged.
examples.zh: 分级考试两次都没过，他挺「泄气」的。

words.enDefinition: able to be washed in a dishwasher without damage

examples.en: Most of our mugs are dishwasher-safe except the wooden-handled one.
examples.zh: 我们的马克杯大多「可用洗碗机洗」，只有木柄那只要手洗。

examples.en: Nonstick pans usually aren't dishwasher-safe, so you should wash them by hand.
examples.zh: 不粘锅一般「不能进洗碗机」，要手洗。

words.enDefinition: made to be used once and then thrown away

examples.en: The lab hands out disposable gloves, so nobody shares a dirty pair.
examples.zh: 实验室发「一次性」手套，谁也不用共用脏的那副。

examples.en: We ran out of disposable chopsticks during the club fundraiser lunch.
examples.zh: 社团义卖午餐时，「一次性」筷子都用完了。

words.enDefinition: a family member not closely related, like a second cousin

examples.en: A distant relative from Chengdu reached out before my campus visit.
examples.zh: 我来学校参观之前，一位成都的「远亲」联系了我。

examples.en: We invited every distant relative we could find to grandma's ninetieth birthday.
examples.zh: 奶奶九十大寿，我们把能找到的「远房亲戚」都请来了。

collocations: a distant relative on my mother's side

words.enDefinition: making you worried, upset, or alarmed

examples.en: The documentary showed disturbing images of plastic waste washing up on beaches.
examples.zh: 纪录片里海滩上塑料垃圾的画面「令人不安」。

examples.en: It was disturbing to see how fast the rumor spread through the class group chat.
examples.zh: 谣言在班级群里传得那么快，看着真「让人不安」。

words.enDefinition: feeling that everything is spinning and you might fall

examples.en: I stood up too fast in the library and felt dizzy for a second.
examples.zh: 在图书馆起身起太快，我「晕」了一下。

examples.en: She skipped breakfast and felt dizzy during her morning lab.
examples.zh: 她没吃早饭，早上做实验时觉得「头晕」。

words.enDefinition: wash and dry a load of dirty clothes

examples.en: I do laundry on Thursday nights when the basement machines are free.
examples.zh: 我周四晚上「洗衣服」，那时地下室的洗衣机没人用。

examples.en: Do your laundry before the trip, or you'll pack a pile of dirty clothes.
examples.zh: 出发前把衣服「洗」了，不然你打包的全是脏衣服。

words.enDefinition: a mode that silences calls and alerts during chosen times

examples.en: I turn on do not disturb every night at eleven so late texts wait until morning.
examples.zh: 每晚十一点我都会开启「勿扰模式」，深夜的消息留到早上再看。

examples.en: Do not disturb blocks every call except the favorites list.
examples.zh: 「勿扰模式」会拦截所有来电，只放行收藏的联系人。

collocations: do not disturb during study hours

words.enDefinition: wash the plates and pans after a meal

examples.en: If you cook dinner tonight, I'll do the dishes afterwards.
examples.zh: 今晚你做饭的话，饭后我来「洗碗」。

examples.en: Let the pans soak so doing the dishes is easier later.
examples.zh: 先把锅泡上，等会儿「洗碗」会轻松些。

words.enDefinition: do the part of the work that is your responsibility

examples.en: If you do your share, cleaning the apartment takes half an hour.
examples.zh: 只要人人都「做好分内事」，打扫公寓半小时就够了。

examples.en: We all do our share around here, so nobody complains.
examples.zh: 在这儿大家都「做好分内事」，所以没人抱怨。

collocations: do your share of the chores

words.enDefinition: possible to finish or achieve within your ability

examples.en: The reading load looks scary but is doable if you start Friday.
examples.zh: 阅读量看着吓人，周五就开始的话还是「做得完」的。

examples.en: Cycling to both jobs is doable only while the weather holds.
examples.zh: 只有天气好的时候，骑车赶两份工才「行得通」。

words.enDefinition: move quickly out of the way to avoid being hit

examples.en: Dodge the scooters on the shared path; they don't slow down.
examples.zh: 共享道上要「躲」开电动车，他们不减速的。

examples.en: He dodged a frisbee that flew across the quad during the fair.
examples.zh: 招新集市上飞盘横穿草坪，他「躲」了一下。

words.enDefinition: give things or money to help others

examples.en: Donate your old winter coat to the collection box in the lobby.
examples.zh: 把旧冬衣「捐」到大厅的募捐箱吧。

examples.en: We donated our extra furniture to the incoming exchange students.
examples.zh: 我们把多余的家具「捐」给了新来的交换生。

words.enDefinition: A buzzer used to signal someone at a door

examples.en: I pressed the door buzzer and waited for a volunteer to let us in.
examples.zh: 我按了「门口呼叫铃」，等志愿者让我们进去。

examples.en: A note by the door buzzer said it was connected to the upstairs desk.
examples.zh: 「门口呼叫铃」旁的便条说，它连的是楼上的前台。

collocations: a sign by the door buzzer

words.enDefinition: A button that unlocks a door electronically

examples.en: The volunteer pointed to the door release button so we could leave by ourselves.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我们看「开门解锁按钮」，这样我们可以自己出去。

examples.en: The door release button was beside the coat hooks inside the meeting room.
examples.zh: 「开门解锁按钮」就在会议室里面的挂衣钩旁。

collocations: point out the door release button

words.enDefinition: A wedge set under a door to hold it in place.

examples.en: I slipped a door wedge under the kitchen door while carrying the groceries inside.
examples.zh: 我往厨房门下塞了一个「楔形门挡」，好把买来的食品搬进去。

examples.en: The door wedge kept the hallway door open long enough to bring in the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 「楔形门挡」让走廊那扇门一直开着，方便我们把书架搬进来。

collocations: slide a door wedge under the door

words.enDefinition: turn around and go back the way you came

examples.en: We double back to the trailhead if the fog gets worse.
examples.zh: 雾要是变大，我们就「原路折返」回登山口。

examples.en: I doubled back for my student card halfway to the exam hall.
examples.zh: 去考试楼走到一半，我「折返」拿了学生证。

words.enDefinition: check something a second time to be certain

examples.en: Double-check the locker code before you leave the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 离开游泳馆前，再「核对」一遍储物柜密码。

examples.en: I double-checked the train times because the app had crashed twice.
examples.zh: App崩了两次，我又「确认」了一遍火车时刻。

words.enDefinition: Two doors that together close one opening

examples.en: We carried the tables through the double doors at the back of the hall.
examples.zh: 我们从大厅后面的「双扇门」把桌子搬了进去。

examples.en: The guide said to wait outside the double doors until the event ended.
examples.zh: 指引写着要在「双扇门」外等到活动结束。

collocations: open a set of double doors

words.enDefinition: not likely to happen or succeed

examples.en: It's doubtful the campus shuttle will run on time during the snowstorm, so leave early.
examples.zh: 暴雪天校车能不能准点「很难说」，你最好早点出门。

examples.en: I'm doubtful the landlord will fix the heater before December, so I emailed him again today.
examples.zh: 房东十二月前修不修暖气我很「怀疑」，今天又给他发了邮件。

words.enDefinition: sad and low in energy for a short while

examples.en: I've been feeling a bit down since my best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 自从最好的朋友搬走后，我一直有点「情绪低落」。

examples.en: Missing my mom's cooking always gets me down in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天吃不到妈妈做的菜，总让我「情绪低落」。

words.enDefinition: practical and realistic, without pretending to be special

examples.en: My down-to-earth advisor told me exactly which deadlines actually matter.
examples.zh: 我那位「接地气的」导师会直接告诉我哪些截止日期才真正要紧。

examples.en: Our coach has national medals, yet he is surprisingly down-to-earth.
examples.zh: 我们教练拿过全国奖牌，为人却出奇地「接地气」。

words.enDefinition: copy a file from the internet onto your device

examples.en: Download the campus map app before orientation day so you don't get lost.
examples.zh: 迎新日前先「下载」校园地图App，免得迷路。

examples.en: I downloaded the lecture slides to read offline on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把课件「下载」下来，好在公交车上离线看。

words.enDefinition: a sudden very heavy fall of rain

examples.en: We got caught in a downpour walking back from the station.
examples.zh: 从车站走回来时，我们遇上了「倾盆大雨」。

examples.en: That sudden downpour flooded the shortcut path near the gym.
examples.zh: 那场「瓢泼大雨」把健身房旁的近道都淹了。

words.enDefinition: relaxed time when you are not working or studying

examples.en: I guard my Sunday downtime and refuse all study invitations.
examples.zh: 周日的「休息时间」我雷打不动，一律拒绝学习邀约。

examples.en: Even busy students need some downtime to avoid burning out.
examples.zh: 再忙的学生也需要一点「休息时间」，免得倦怠。

words.enDefinition: fall into light sleep without meaning to

examples.en: I keep dozing off in the warm back rows of the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 阶梯教室后排暖和，我总在那儿「打瞌睡」。

examples.en: He dozed off on the train and rode two stops past his station.
examples.zh: 他在火车上「打起了瞌睡」，坐过了两站才醒。

words.enDefinition: a large number, in multiples of twelve

examples.en: Dozens of students lined up outside the bookstore on the first day.
examples.zh: 开学第一天「几十个」学生在书店门口排队。

examples.en: I've applied to dozens of internships since the semester started.
examples.zh: 这学期开始以来，我已经投了「几十个」实习申请。

words.enDefinition: letting cold outside air in through gaps

examples.en: This old building is so drafty that we tape towels over the window frames.
examples.zh: 这栋老楼「漏风」厉害，我们只能用毛巾塞住窗缝。

examples.en: My bed sits under a drafty window, so I sleep in a hoodie.
examples.zh: 床正对一扇「透风」的窗，我只能穿着连帽衫睡。

words.enDefinition: move a file by holding and releasing it over a new spot

examples.en: Drag and drop the PDF into the upload box instead of browsing for it.
examples.zh: 把PDF「拖放」到上传框里就行，不用一层层去找。

examples.en: You can drag and drop photos straight from your desktop into the chat.
examples.zh: 你可以直接把照片从桌面「拖放」进聊天窗口。

words.enDefinition: last much longer than necessary or expected

examples.en: The orientation session dragged on for nearly three boring hours.
examples.zh: 迎新会「拖拖拉拉」开了将近三个小时。

examples.en: His story about the delayed flight dragged on and on.
examples.zh: 他讲航班延误的经历，「讲个没完」。

words.enDefinition: feeling that all your energy has been used up

examples.en: Back-to-back lectures leave me feeling totally drained by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 连轴转的课上下来，周五下午我已经觉得「精力耗尽」。

examples.en: Constant arguments with my roommate have left me emotionally drained.
examples.zh: 和室友不断的争执让我情绪上也被「耗尽」了。

words.enDefinition: extreme and sudden in effect or change

examples.en: Rent jumped so sharply that we made the drastic decision to move farther out.
examples.zh: 房租涨幅「急剧」，我们只好狠下心搬远些。

examples.en: The doctor warned me against drastic diets and suggested steady, regular meals instead.
examples.zh: 医生警告我别搞「极端」节食，建议三餐规律、循序渐进。

words.enDefinition: in an extreme and sudden way

examples.en: Bus fares dropped drastically after the city's new transport policy.
examples.zh: 新交通政策出台后，公交票价「大幅」下降。

examples.en: My study habits changed drastically after I joined the study group.
examples.zh: 加入学习小组后，我的学习习惯发生了「巨大」改变。

words.enDefinition: a cord pulled through an opening to tighten it

examples.en: I tightened the drawstring on my hood before cycling across the open courtyard.
examples.zh: 骑车穿过空旷的院子前，我把帽子上的「抽绳」拉紧了。

examples.en: The drawstring in my trousers worked its way loose on the way to class.
examples.zh: 去上课的路上，我裤子里的「抽绳」慢慢松开了。

words.enDefinition: to feel worried about something that is going to happen

examples.en: I always dread checking my grades after a difficult exam.
examples.zh: 考完难题之后，我总是「害怕」去查成绩。

examples.en: She dreaded telling her parents about the extra tuition fees.
examples.zh: 她一直「害怕」把额外学费的事告诉父母。

words.enDefinition: wear less formal clothes than usual or than expected

examples.en: We can dress down for the practice presentation because it's just our project group.
examples.zh: 练习汇报只有项目组自己人，我们可以「穿得随意些」。

examples.en: I decided to dress down for the picnic and left my blazer at home.
examples.zh: 我决定去野餐时「穿得随意些」，就把西装外套留在住处。

collocations: dress down for a casual event

words.enDefinition: choose clothes that suit the day's temperature and conditions

examples.en: Check the forecast and dress for the weather before your morning walk.
examples.zh: 出门前看看天气预报，「按天气穿衣」。

examples.en: In this city you learn fast to dress for the weather, not the calendar.
examples.zh: 在这座城市，你很快就会学会「按天气穿衣」，而不是按日历穿。

collocations: dress for the weather in layers

words.enDefinition: neat trousers meant for formal or professional occasions

examples.en: I saved my dress pants for the reception where we were meeting our project sponsors.
examples.zh: 我把「正装长裤」留到招待会穿，那时要见项目资助方。

examples.en: The dress pants looked fine with the only plain shirt I had in my room.
examples.zh: 这条「正装长裤」搭我房间里唯一那件素色衬衫就挺合适。

collocations: pair dress pants with a shirt

words.enDefinition: wear nicer or special clothes for an occasion

examples.en: Do we need to dress up for the birthday dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚的生日晚宴需要我们「盛装出席」吗？

examples.en: The kids dressed up as ghosts for the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 万圣节派对上孩子们「装扮」成了幽灵。

words.enDefinition: fall asleep slowly without noticing it

examples.en: I drifted off during the last episode and missed the ending.
examples.zh: 最后一集我「迷迷糊糊睡着了」，错过了结局。

examples.en: He drifted off on the bus and nearly missed his stop again.
examples.zh: 他在公交上「迷迷糊糊睡着」，差点又坐过站。

collocations: almost drifted off on the bus

words.enDefinition: fall in small drops of liquid

examples.en: The faucet keeps dripping at night, and I can hear it through the wall.
examples.zh: 水龙头夜里一直「滴水」，隔着墙都能听见。

examples.en: His wet umbrella dripped all over the shared hallway floor.
examples.zh: 他的湿伞把公共走廊的地板「滴」得到处都是水。

words.enDefinition: light fine rain with small drops

examples.en: A thin drizzle fell during our entire two-hour campus tour.
examples.zh: 我们两个小时的校园参观一直伴着「毛毛雨」。

examples.en: The forecast mentions light drizzle in the morning, clearing by noon.
examples.zh: 天气预报提到早上有「毛毛雨」，中午转晴。

words.enDefinition: raining lightly and steadily with fine drops

examples.en: It's drizzly all week, so my canvas shoes never fully dry.
examples.zh: 整周都「下毛毛雨」，帆布鞋就没干透过。

examples.en: A drizzly Sunday is perfect for the library and hot soup.
examples.zh: 「细雨绵绵」的周日正适合泡图书馆、喝热汤。

words.enDefinition: visit someone briefly without an appointment

examples.en: I'll drop by your dorm to return the notes tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天会「顺便去趟」你宿舍还笔记。

examples.en: Feel free to drop by my place anytime after five.
examples.zh: 五点以后随时欢迎来我家「坐坐」。

words.enDefinition: take someone or something to a place and leave

examples.en: I'll drop you off at the station on my way.
examples.zh: 顺路我「送你到」车站。

examples.en: She dropped off the package at the post office today.
examples.zh: 她今天把包裹「送到」了邮局。

words.enDefinition: a phone call that suddenly cuts off mid-conversation

examples.en: We lost the clinic's number after a dropped call, so we booked online instead.
examples.zh: 一次「通话中断」之后我们找不到诊所号码了，只好改成网上预约。

examples.en: Dropped calls happen all the time here whenever the rain gets heavy.
examples.zh: 这里雨一大，就经常发生「通话中断」。

collocations: a dropped call in the middle

words.enDefinition: half asleep and slow to react, often after medicine

examples.en: The allergy pills made me so drowsy that I skipped my morning seminar.
examples.zh: 抗过敏药让我「昏昏欲睡」，索性翘了早上的讨论课。

examples.en: I felt drowsy all afternoon after staying up past three.
examples.zh: 熬到凌晨三点之后，我一下午都「昏昏欲睡」。

words.enDefinition: a tag warning that water will ruin the garment

examples.en: That wool coat says dry clean only, so don't toss it in the machine.
examples.zh: 那件羊毛大衣标着「只能干洗」，别扔进洗衣机。

examples.en: I ignore the dry clean only label and hand-wash it very gently.
examples.zh: 我没理会「只可干洗」的标签，非常轻柔地手洗了它。

collocations: ignore the dry clean only tag

words.enDefinition: professional cleaning of clothes without water

examples.en: My blazer needs dry cleaning before the career fair next week.
examples.zh: 下周招聘会之前，我的西装外套得送去「干洗」。

examples.en: There's a dry cleaning shop two blocks from the east gate.
examples.zh: 东门外两个街区有一家「干洗店」。

words.enDefinition: remove water from your hair with a towel or dryer

examples.en: I dry my hair while checking messages on my phone.
examples.zh: 我一边看手机消息，一边「吹头发」。

examples.en: Dry your hair fully before you go out in this cold wind.
examples.zh: 外面风这么大，出门前一定要把头发「吹干」。

collocations: dry my hair with a towel

words.enDefinition: remove water from your body or hair with a towel

examples.en: Dry off completely with a towel before you put on clean clothes.
examples.zh: 用毛巾把身体「擦干」，再换上干净衣服。

examples.en: He dried off his hair in front of the shared bathroom heater.
examples.zh: 他在公共浴室的取暖器前「把头发擦干」。

words.enDefinition: enter somewhere quickly and quietly, often to shelter

examples.en: Duck into that bakery if it starts pouring before the bus comes.
examples.zh: 公交还没来雨要是下大了，就「闪进」那家面包店躲躲。

examples.en: He ducked into the library restroom to fix his interview tie.
examples.zh: 他「闪身」进了图书馆洗手间，整理面试领带。

words.enDefinition: leave a place early or briefly without ceremony

examples.en: I need to duck out of the seminar early for my pharmacy pickup.
examples.zh: 我得提前从研讨课「开溜」，去药房取药。

examples.en: She ducked out during the break and came back with snacks.
examples.zh: 她趁课间「溜出去」买了零食回来。

words.enDefinition: trousers with a front bib held up by shoulder straps

examples.en: At my UK university, I wore dungarees to the community garden cleanup last Saturday.
examples.zh: 上周六，我在英国的大学参加社区花园清理活动时，穿了「背带连体裤」。

examples.en: Her dungarees were useful in the art studio because they had several deep pockets.
examples.zh: 她的「背带连体裤」有几个很深的口袋，在美术工作室穿挺方便。

words.enDefinition: the dim period just after sunset before full darkness

examples.en: The streetlights switch on at dusk, around six in winter.
examples.zh: 路灯在「黄昏」时分亮起，冬天大约六点。

examples.en: Joggers fill the riverside path at dusk when the heat fades.
examples.zh: 暑气消退后，跑者在「黄昏」时挤满河边步道。

words.enDefinition: a soft clump of dust found under furniture

examples.en: There are dust bunnies under my bed the size of small animals.
examples.zh: 我床底下的「灰尘团」大得像小动物。

examples.en: Move the dresser when you clean, or the dust bunnies will stay hidden.
examples.zh: 打扫时把柜子挪开，不然「灰尘团」会一直藏在那儿。

words.enDefinition: to remove dust from an object, often with a cloth or brush

examples.en: I had to dust off my bicycle before taking it out after winter.
examples.zh: 过完冬天，我得先给自行车「掸去灰尘」再骑出去。

examples.en: We took a moment to dust off the folding chairs before guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前，我们先给折叠椅「掸去灰尘」。

collocations: take a moment to dust off a chair

words.enDefinition: covered with a layer of fine dry dirt

examples.en: The top shelf is so dusty that I sneeze every time I clean it.
examples.zh: 顶层架子「积灰」严重，每次清理都打喷嚏。

examples.en: My laptop fan got dusty, so the whole thing runs loud now.
examples.zh: 笔记本风扇「积」了不少灰，现在一开机就嗡嗡响。

words.enDefinition: to keep thinking too much about something bad

examples.en: Try not to dwell on one bad grade for too long.
examples.zh: 别在一门糟糕的成绩上「纠结」太久。

examples.en: He dwelled on the rejection for weeks before moving forward.
examples.zh: 被拒后的几周里他一直「耿耿于怀」，之后才重新出发。

words.enDefinition: a person who likes waking up and acting early

examples.en: As an early bird, I finish my essays before my roommates wake up.
examples.zh: 作为「早起的人」，我在室友们醒来前就写完了论文。

examples.en: The library is quiet at seven, perfect for early birds like me.
examples.zh: 早上七点的图书馆很安静，正适合我这样的「早鸟」。

words.enDefinition: an evening when you go to bed earlier than usual

examples.en: I'm having an early night so I'm fresh for the morning quiz.
examples.zh: 今晚我要「早点睡」，明早的小测才有精神。

examples.en: After three late nights, even my roommate suggested an early night.
examples.zh: 熬了三晚之后，连我室友都提议「今晚早睡」。

collocations: an early night before the exam

words.enDefinition: two padded covers worn over the ears to keep them warm

examples.en: I put on earmuffs for the walk to the bus stop before sunrise.
examples.zh: 天亮前走去公交站时，我戴了「保暖耳罩」。

examples.en: She took off her earmuffs as soon as we entered the heated library.
examples.zh: 我们一进有暖气的图书馆，她就摘了「保暖耳罩」。

words.enDefinition: relaxed and not easily annoyed or worried

examples.en: My host family is super easygoing, so the house rules are pretty relaxed.
examples.zh: 我的寄宿家庭非常「随和」，家规都很宽松。

examples.en: An easygoing roommate matters more than one who shares your major.
examples.zh: 室友「好相处」比和你专业相同更重要。

words.enDefinition: to have meals at home instead of going out

examples.en: We decided to eat in and split the cost of groceries.
examples.zh: 我们决定「在家吃」，分摊买菜钱。

examples.en: Eating in twice a week saves me around thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 每周「在家吃」两次，能省下大约三十美元。

words.enDefinition: to eat small or low-fat amounts of food

examples.en: I'm eating light today after that huge holiday brunch yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天假日晚餐吃太多了，今天我要「吃得清淡」些。

examples.en: Let's eat light tonight since we're having a big barbecue tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天要烧烤大吃一顿，今晚我们「吃清淡点」。

words.enDefinition: to eat very large amounts of food

examples.en: My swimmer roommate eats like a horse after every morning practice.
examples.zh: 我那个游泳队的室友每次早训后「饭量大得惊人」。

examples.en: My little host brother eats like a horse but stays really skinny.
examples.zh: 我家寄宿的弟弟「特别能吃」，却依然很瘦。

collocations: eat like a horse after practice

words.enDefinition: have a meal at a restaurant, not at home

examples.en: Let's eat out tonight, I'm too tired to cook anything.
examples.zh: 今晚我们「下馆子」吧，我累得什么都不想做了。

examples.en: Eating out every day gets expensive really fast for students.
examples.zh: 对学生来说，天天「出去吃」花钱非常快。

words.enDefinition: to eat all the food you have been given

examples.en: Eat up, everyone — I made extra portions on purpose tonight.
examples.zh: 大家把饭「吃干净」，我今晚特意多做了几份。

examples.en: My grandma never let us leave the table until we ate up.
examples.zh: 奶奶以前总要我们「吃干净」了才让离开饭桌。

words.enDefinition: a regular way that someone chooses and eats food

examples.en: Living with three roommates has completely changed my eating habits.
examples.zh: 和三个室友同住彻底改变了我的「饮食习惯」。

examples.en: Late-night study sessions built some terrible eating habits last year.
examples.zh: 深夜自习让我去年养成了不少糟糕的「饮食习惯」。

words.enDefinition: done so skillfully it looks easy

examples.en: Her effortless presentation came from rehearsing those same slides fifteen times.
examples.zh: 她的展示「轻松自如」，秘诀是把同样的幻灯片排练了十五遍。

examples.en: He made the lake swim look effortless, then admitted he was completely exhausted.
examples.zh: 他游过湖面显得「毫不费力」，上岸却承认累坏了。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that boils water quickly for tea

examples.en: My electric kettle boils enough water for tea in three minutes.
examples.zh: 我的「电热水壶」三分钟就能烧开泡茶的水。

examples.en: Dorm rules ban hot plates but allow a small electric kettle.
examples.zh: 宿舍禁用电磁炉，但允许用小「电热水壶」。

words.enDefinition: The doors that open for elevator entry and exit

examples.en: I stood to one side until the elevator doors opened and everyone got out.
examples.zh: 我站到一边，等「电梯门」打开，里面的人都出来了。

examples.en: The elevator doors opened on the floor below the room we'd booked for practice.
examples.zh: 「电梯门」在我们预约的练习室下一层开了。

collocations: stand back from the elevator doors
wait for the elevator doors to close

words.enDefinition: The area in front of a building's elevators

examples.en: My classmate waited in the elevator lobby while I checked the room number.
examples.zh: 我去核对房间号时，同学在「电梯厅」等我。

examples.en: The elevator lobby had a sign showing which floors needed a building pass.
examples.zh: 「电梯厅」里有块牌子，标出了哪些楼层需要通行证。

collocations: a sign in the elevator lobby

words.enDefinition: messages sent and received through an electronic mail service

examples.en: Check your university email twice a day because professors send updates there.
examples.zh: 每天查两次学校的「电子邮件」，教授的通知都发在那里。

examples.en: I drafted the email to my landlord twice before sending the complaint about heating.
examples.zh: 投诉暖气问题之前，我给房东的「电子邮件」打了两遍草稿。

collocations: an email from the housing office

words.enDefinition: the shy, uncomfortable feeling you have in front of others

examples.en: My face turned red with embarrassment when I forgot her name.
examples.zh: 忘了她的名字时，我「尴尬」得满脸通红。

examples.en: To everyone's embarrassment, the microphone stopped working during the speech.
examples.zh: 让大家「尴尬」的是，演讲中途麦克风没声了。

words.enDefinition: a small picture used in messages to show feelings

examples.en: My professor replied to my email with a thumbs-up emoji, so I guess it was fine.
examples.zh: 教授回我邮件时用了个点赞「表情符号」，应该没问题吧。

examples.en: A single emoji can change the whole tone of a message between roommates.
examples.zh: 室友之间，一个「表情符号」就能改变整条消息的语气。

words.enDefinition: easily moved to tears or strong feelings

examples.en: I get really emotional whenever I watch old graduation videos online.
examples.zh: 每次在网上看以前的毕业视频，我都会特别「动情」。

examples.en: Don't mind him; he's just emotional after the long flight.
examples.zh: 别介意他，他坐了长途飞机，有点「情绪化」。

words.enDefinition: the ability to imagine how another person feels

examples.en: Living abroad has taught me real empathy for other cultures.
examples.zh: 在国外生活教会了我对不同文化的「同理心」。

examples.en: Good peer mentors show empathy when freshmen struggle with homesickness.
examples.zh: 新生想家时，优秀的朋辈导师会展现「同理心」。

words.enDefinition: finally be in a place or situation, often unplanned

examples.en: We ended up walking home because the last bus had left.
examples.zh: 末班车已经开走，我们「最后只好」走路回家。

examples.en: He ended up staying the night on our couch after the party.
examples.zh: 派对结束后，他「最后」就在我们家的沙发上过夜了。

words.enDefinition: lasting or seeming to last forever without stopping

examples.en: Revision felt endless until we split the past papers across the group.
examples.zh: 刷题一度「没完没了」，后来我们把历年卷分给全组才轻松些。

examples.en: Bus detours turned a short commute into an endless wait.
examples.zh: 公交绕路让短短的通勤变成「没完没了」的等待。

words.enDefinition: having plenty of energy for activity

examples.en: Morning runs leave me feeling energetic instead of groggy in class.
examples.zh: 晨跑让我上课时「精力充沛」，不再昏昏沉沉。

examples.en: My roommate is unbelievably energetic; she hits the gym before her 8 a.m. class.
examples.zh: 我室友「精力充沛」得惊人，八点的课前还先去了趟健身房。

words.enDefinition: a caffeinated drink marketed for quick energy

examples.en: Two energy drinks before the all-nighter wrecked my sleep schedule.
examples.zh: 通宵复习前灌了两罐「能量饮料」，把睡眠彻底搞乱了。

examples.en: The gym actually advises against energy drinks before your workouts.
examples.zh: 健身房其实不建议训练前喝「能量饮料」。

words.enDefinition: the promise to marry, often marked with a ring

examples.en: My sister announced her engagement during our video call last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚视频通话时，我姐姐宣布了「订婚」的消息。

examples.en: Grandma still wears the simple ring from her 1960s engagement.
examples.zh: 奶奶还戴着六十年代「订婚」时的素圈戒指。

words.enDefinition: as much as is needed

examples.en: I didn't bring enough cash for the laundry machines downstairs.
examples.zh: 我带的现金「不够」用楼下的洗衣机。

examples.en: Two pillows and one blanket are enough for me, thanks.
examples.zh: 两个枕头加一床毯子对我来说就「足够」了，谢谢。

words.enDefinition: fun and enjoyable to watch or hear

examples.en: The campus improv show was entertaining enough that we forgot our midterm stress.
examples.zh: 校园即兴喜剧「好看又解压」，看完中期考试的焦虑都忘了。

examples.en: My uncle remains the most entertaining storyteller at every family dinner table.
examples.zh: 叔叔一直是家庭餐桌上最「有趣」的讲故事高手。

words.enDefinition: For going in rather than coming out

examples.en: The glass door was marked “Entrance only,” so we used the other side to leave.
examples.zh: 玻璃门标着「仅供进入」，我们就从另一侧出去了。

examples.en: I saw “Entrance only” on the left door and joined the line beside it.
examples.zh: 我看到左边的门写着「仅供进入」，就排到旁边的队伍里。

words.enDefinition: remove writing or recorded data completely

examples.en: Erase the whiteboard before the next seminar group comes in.
examples.zh: 下一组研讨课进来之前，把白板「擦」干净。

examples.en: I accidentally erased my whole draft instead of saving a copy.
examples.zh: 我一不小心把整个草稿「删」了，都没存副本。

words.enDefinition: a larger amount than before or expected

examples.en: The second exam was even more difficult than the first one.
examples.zh: 第二次考试比第一次「还要」难。

examples.en: Thanks! Now I'm even more excited about the study abroad program.
examples.zh: 谢谢！现在我对这个交换项目「更」期待了。

words.enDefinition: full of interesting or exciting things happening

examples.en: It was an eventful first week—lost luggage, a snowstorm, and three new friends.
examples.zh: 开学第一周真是「波澜起伏」：行李丢了、遇上涨雪，还交了三个新朋友。

examples.en: Our road trip was eventful enough to fill the group chat for a month.
examples.zh: 这趟自驾游「波折不断」，够群里聊一个月了。

words.enDefinition: on alternate days, with a day in between

examples.en: I water the plants in my dorm every other day.
examples.zh: 我「每隔一天」给宿舍的植物浇一次水。

examples.en: The free shuttle to the supermarket runs every other day.
examples.zh: 去超市的免费班车「隔天」发一班。

words.enDefinition: with one week skipped in between

examples.en: The cleaning crew comes to our floor every other week.
examples.zh: 保洁人员「每隔一周」来我们楼层一次。

examples.en: I visit my aunt in this city every other week.
examples.zh: 我「每两周」看望一次住在本市的姑妈。

words.enDefinition: each one without any exception

examples.en: I checked every single one of the clauses before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 签租约之前，「每一个」条款我都核对过了。

examples.en: Every single one of my professors posts grades online now.
examples.zh: 现在我「每一位」教授都在网上公布成绩。

words.enDefinition: occasionally, at irregular intervals

examples.en: Every so often the cafeteria surprises us with my favorite dumplings.
examples.zh: 食堂「时不时」会端出我最爱的饺子。

examples.en: My roommate and I deep clean the kitchen every so often.
examples.zh: 我和室友「时不时」会把厨房彻底打扫一遍。

words.enDefinition: a small stiff card used for notes and flashcards

examples.en: I write vocabulary on index cards to quiz myself on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把生词写在「索引卡」上，坐公交时自测。

examples.en: One index card per term works better than a crowded sheet.
examples.zh: 一个术语一张「索引卡」，比挤在一页上效果好。

words.enDefinition: a plug that fits foreign outlets for your devices

examples.en: Buy a travel adapter before flying home, or your laptop won't charge.
examples.zh: 回国前买好「旅行转换插头」，不然笔记本没法充电。

examples.en: This travel adapter covers European outlets, including the UK's chunky three-pin type.
examples.zh: 这个「转换插头」适配欧洲各国插座，包括英国那种粗三脚款。

words.enDefinition: a container used to carry meals from home

examples.en: My bento-style lunch box has compartments that keep rice and toppings apart.
examples.zh: 我的日式「饭盒」有分格，米饭和菜不串味。

examples.en: Microwave-safe lunch boxes are essential for the dorm common room.
examples.zh: 宿舍公共活动室里，可微波的「饭盒」必不可少。

words.enDefinition: a container for throwing away waste

examples.en: Line the trash can with two bags so leaks never reach the bin.
examples.zh: 「垃圾桶」套两层袋子，漏液就弄不脏桶身。

examples.en: The shared trash can fills fast during finals; empty it daily.
examples.zh: 期末公用「垃圾桶」满得快，每天都要清。

words.enDefinition: a soft band worn over the eyes to block light

examples.en: A contoured eye mask blocks the hallway light that leaks under the door.
examples.zh: 立体「眼罩」能挡住门缝漏进来的走廊灯。

examples.en: I pack my eye mask for red-eye flights and hostel stays.
examples.zh: 坐红眼航班或住青旅，我都带「眼罩」。

words.enDefinition: a chain or shackle lock that secures a bicycle

examples.en: Thread the bike lock through the frame and wheel, not just the wheel.
examples.zh: 「车锁」要穿过车架和轮子，不能只锁轮子。

examples.en: Campus security recommends a U-lock style bike lock over thin cables.
examples.zh: 校园保安建议用U型「车锁」，别用细钢缆。

words.enDefinition: a label attached to luggage showing owner contact details

examples.en: Attach a luggage tag before checking your suitcase at the airport.
examples.zh: 机场托运行李前，先挂好「行李牌」。

examples.en: My luggage tag shows my school email, not my home address.
examples.zh: 我的「行李牌」上写的是学校邮箱，不是家庭住址。

words.enDefinition: a small metal loop that holds loose papers together

examples.en: Use a paper clip to attach your receipt to the reimbursement form.
examples.zh: 用「回形针」把收据别在报销单上。

examples.en: The essay pages kept sliding, so a paper clip held them together.
examples.zh: 论文页总滑落，就用「回形针」别在一起。

collocations: clip papers with a paper clip

words.enDefinition: a small lamp placed on a desk for focused light

examples.en: My clip-on desk lamp clamps to the bunk frame for late reading.
examples.zh: 我的夹式「台灯」夹在床架上，夜读方便。

examples.en: A warm desk lamp is kinder to roommates than overhead lights at midnight.
examples.zh: 半夜用暖光「台灯」，比开顶灯对室友友好。

words.enDefinition: a small clip that holds clothes on a drying line

examples.en: Old-fashioned clothespins hold socks on the drying rack near the window.
examples.zh: 老式「晾衣夹」把袜子固定在窗边晾衣架上。

examples.en: Clip the chip bag with a clothespin when you lose the binder clip.
examples.zh: 找不到长尾夹，就用「晾衣夹」夹薯片袋口。

words.enDefinition: a small tool for trimming fingernails

examples.en: Borrow nail clippers from the RA desk instead of biting your nails.
examples.zh: 别啃指甲了，去宿管值班台借「指甲刀」。

examples.en: The grooming kit includes nail clippers, a small file, and tweezers.
examples.zh: 这套修容工具有「指甲刀」、小锉刀和镊子。

words.enDefinition: a ring or charm that holds keys together

examples.en: My dorm keychain has a mini bottle opener and a bell.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍「钥匙扣」上挂着迷你开瓶器和小铃铛。

examples.en: Attach your keys to a bright keychain so they never vanish in your bag.
examples.zh: 钥匙挂上显眼的「钥匙扣」，就不会在包里失踪。

words.enDefinition: a bag used to carry food and shopping home

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted a grocery bag for the apples.
examples.zh: 收银员问苹果要不要装「购物袋」。

examples.en: We collect grocery bags under the sink to line the small trash can.
examples.zh: 我们把「购物袋」攒在水槽下面，用来套小垃圾桶。

collocations: stuff grocery bags in a drawer

words.enDefinition: a device that fastens papers together with metal staples

examples.en: Ask the front desk for the stapler before you hand in your report.
examples.zh: 交报告前，先去前台借「订书机」。

examples.en: Our group's stapler ran out of staples right before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止日期前，我们小组的「订书机」偏偏没钉书钉了。

words.enDefinition: a support that raises a laptop to a comfortable angle

examples.en: A laptop stand raised my screen to eye level and saved my neck.
examples.zh: 「笔记本支架」把屏幕抬到视线高度，脖子舒服多了。

examples.en: My folding laptop stand fits flat at the bottom of my backpack.
examples.zh: 我的折叠「笔记本支架」能平放进背包底部。

words.enDefinition: a fragrant sheet tossed in the dryer to soften clothes

examples.en: Toss one dryer sheet in with the towels to cut static.
examples.zh: 烘毛巾时丢一张「烘干纸」，能少很多静电。

examples.en: A dryer sheet tucked in the suitcase keeps clothes smelling fresh.
examples.zh: 行李箱里塞一张「烘干香纸」，衣服香香的。

words.enDefinition: a waxy product that moisturizes dry lips

examples.en: Wind across the quad chaps lips, so carry lip balm in winter.
examples.zh: 校园风大嘴唇容易裂，冬天随身带「润唇膏」。

examples.en: My lip balm melted inside the car during the road trip.
examples.zh: 自驾游路上，「润唇膏」在车里化掉了。

words.enDefinition: a small pouch worn around the waist

examples.en: Tourists and students alike wear a fanny pack for crowded campus events.
examples.zh: 校园活动人挤人，游客学生都爱戴「腰包」。

examples.en: My fanny pack holds my keycard, cash, and lip balm.
examples.zh: 我的「腰包」装着门卡、现金和润唇膏。

words.enDefinition: a small rubber block that removes pencil marks

examples.en: My desk mate lent me an eraser when mine went missing.
examples.zh: 我的「橡皮」不见了，同桌借了我一块。

examples.en: Kneaded erasers pick up graphite marks without leaving crumbs behind.
examples.zh: 可塑「橡皮」能粘走石墨痕迹，还不掉碎屑。

words.enDefinition: a computer mouse that connects without a cable

examples.en: A wireless mouse makes spreadsheet work much faster on my laptop.
examples.zh: 用「无线鼠标」在笔记本上做表格快多了。

examples.en: My wireless mouse runs on one AA battery that lasts months.
examples.zh: 我的「无线鼠标」一节五号电池能用几个月。

words.enDefinition: a closed container where dirty clothes collect before washing

examples.en: A lidded laundry hamper hides the smell of post-gym clothes.
examples.zh: 带盖「脏衣篓」能盖住健身后衣服的味道。

examples.en: Sort colors straight into the laundry hamper to save time later.
examples.zh: 衣服脱下来直接按深浅色丢进「脏衣篓」，后面省事。

words.enDefinition: a cream product that moisturizes skin

examples.en: Winter dorm heating dries skin fast, so keep lotion by your bed.
examples.zh: 冬天宿舍暖气很干，「润肤乳」就放床边。

examples.en: This unscented lotion works on both hands and face before class.
examples.zh: 这款无香「润肤乳」上课前涂手涂脸都行。

words.enDefinition: a long fabric wrap worn around the neck

examples.en: Wrap the scarf twice around your neck; the lake wind is brutal.
examples.zh: 「围巾」在脖子上绕两圈，湖边的风太狠了。

examples.en: My professor knits a wool scarf for her students every December.
examples.zh: 每年十二月，教授都给学生织羊毛「围巾」。

words.enDefinition: a small pad of paper for jotting quick notes

examples.en: Keep a notepad by the phone to jot down package pickup codes.
examples.zh: 在电话旁放个「便签本」，随手记包裹取件码。

examples.en: The TA handed each student a small notepad during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周时助教给每个学生发了个小「便签本」。

collocations: flip to a fresh notepad page

words.enDefinition: a small dispenser that covers writing mistakes with tape

examples.en: Correction tape works better than liquid for neat handwritten edits.
examples.zh: 改手写稿，「修正带」比修正液更整洁。

examples.en: I ran out of correction tape halfway through the application form.
examples.zh: 申请表填到一半，「修正带」就用完了。

words.enDefinition: a handheld electric light powered by batteries

examples.en: Keep a flashlight by the door for dorm fire drills and blackouts.
examples.zh: 门口放个「手电筒」，消防演习和停电时用得上。

examples.en: We used a phone flashlight when the flashlight batteries died mid-hike.
examples.zh: 徒步途中「手电筒」没电了，只好开手机照明。

words.enDefinition: a sticky roll that removes lint and hair from clothes

examples.en: A lint roller rescues black clothes covered in cat hair from a visit home.
examples.zh: 从有猫的家里回来，衣服全是毛，全靠「粘毛器」。

examples.en: Keep a travel lint roller in your bag for interview outfits.
examples.zh: 包里放个便携「粘毛滚」，面试正装用得上。

words.enDefinition: a soft cushion that supports the head while sleeping

examples.en: Dorm mattresses are firm, so I brought an extra pillow for reading in bed.
examples.zh: 宿舍床垫偏硬，我多带了个「枕头」靠床上看书。

examples.en: Fluff your pillow nightly or it flattens into a pancake.
examples.zh: 「枕头」每晚拍松，不然会扁成一块饼。

words.enDefinition: a plastic sleeve that protects and displays an ID card

examples.en: A retractable badge holder stretches to swipe into the lab door.
examples.zh: 伸缩「证件卡套」一拉就能刷开实验室的门。

examples.en: Swap your clear badge holder each semester when the ID photo changes.
examples.zh: 每学期证件照更新，就换个新的透明「卡套」。

collocations: insert the card into the badge holder

words.enDefinition: a durable shopping bag used instead of disposable plastic ones

examples.en: Many grocery stores here charge for plastic bags, so I bring a reusable bag.
examples.zh: 这边超市对塑料袋收费，所以我自带「环保购物袋」。

examples.en: Keep a reusable bag folded in your backpack for unexpected errands.
examples.zh: 在背包里常备一个折叠的「环保袋」，临时买东西用得上。

words.enDefinition: a small device that performs mathematical calculations

examples.en: The stats professor allows a scientific calculator but no phones during exams.
examples.zh: 统计课教授允许用「科学计算器」，但考试不许用手机。

examples.en: I forgot my calculator, so my neighbor shared theirs during the drill.
examples.zh: 我忘带「计算器」了，做练习时邻座跟我共用。

words.enDefinition: a flat mat that improves mouse tracking on a desk

examples.en: The desk has no mouse pad, so my cursor jumps around.
examples.zh: 这张桌子没有「鼠标垫」，光标总乱跳。

examples.en: I bought a wide mouse pad that fits both the keyboard and mouse.
examples.zh: 我买了块加大「鼠标垫」，键盘鼠标都放得下。

words.enDefinition: a liquid or powder product for washing clothes

examples.en: The campus store sells laundry detergent in small pods for one load.
examples.zh: 校内超市卖小包「洗衣液」，一次一缸正好。

examples.en: Too much laundry detergent leaves residue that itches sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 「洗衣液」放太多会残留，敏感肌穿了痒。

words.enDefinition: a product applied under the arms to stop odor

examples.en: Gym-goers keep a spare deodorant stick in their locker for post-workout.
examples.zh: 常去健身房的人，储物柜里都备一支「除臭剂」。

examples.en: Solid deodorant survives flights better than aerosol sprays in carry-ons.
examples.zh: 「除臭剂」固体款比喷雾更适合随身登机。

words.enDefinition: dark glasses that protect eyes from sunlight

examples.en: Keep sunglasses in your bag for the walk across the main quad.
examples.zh: 去主草坪的路上阳光毒，包里备好「太阳镜」。

examples.en: These sunglasses are polarized, so the lake glare doesn't blind me.
examples.zh: 这副「太阳镜」是偏光的，湖面反光不晃眼。

words.enDefinition: a folder with metal rings that holds loose-leaf papers

examples.en: My biology binder has tab dividers for lecture notes and lab reports.
examples.zh: 我的生物「活页夹」用分页标签隔开课堂笔记和实验报告。

examples.en: The binder rings snapped shut before the syllabus slipped out.
examples.zh: 「活页夹」的环扣一合上，课程大纲就掉不出来了。

words.enDefinition: a device that supplies power to recharge a battery

examples.en: Can I borrow your laptop charger since mine is still in the dorm?
examples.zh: 能借你的「电脑充电器」吗？我的还落在宿舍。

examples.en: Public library desks now have a built-in charger and USB ports.
examples.zh: 公共图书馆的座位现在自带「充电器」和USB接口。

words.enDefinition: a bottle used for carrying drinking water

examples.en: Refill your water bottle at the gym fountain after practice.
examples.zh: 训练结束，去健身房饮水机把「水瓶」灌满。

examples.en: A dented aluminum water bottle survived being dropped down the stairs.
examples.zh: 我的铝制「水瓶」摔下楼梯也只凹了个小坑。

words.enDefinition: a small pan that collects swept dust and dirt

examples.en: A long-handled dustpan saves your back during finals week deep cleaning.
examples.zh: 长柄「簸箕」让期末大扫除不用弯腰。

examples.en: Sweep the glass shards toward the dustpan carefully, not with your hands.
examples.zh: 碎玻璃小心扫向「簸箕」，千万别用手捡。

words.enDefinition: a thick soft quilt filled with down or fibers

examples.en: Shake the duvet every morning so the filling spreads evenly again.
examples.zh: 每天早上抖抖「被子」，填充物才回弹均匀。

examples.en: An all-season duvet works from September right through spring finals.
examples.zh: 一床四季「被芯」从九月盖到春季期末。

collocations: stuff the duvet into its cover

words.enDefinition: a hard protective box for storing eyeglasses

examples.en: A hard glasses case survives being crushed by textbooks in a backpack.
examples.zh: 硬壳「眼镜盒」被课本挤压也不怕。

examples.en: Clip the glasses case to your belt loop during lab work.
examples.zh: 做实验时，把「眼镜盒」扣在裤腰带上。

words.enDefinition: a small bag worn across the body on a long strap

examples.en: She wears a crossbody bag so her wallet stays safe on the bus.
examples.zh: 她斜挎着「斜挎包」，坐公交时钱包更安全。
