examples.en: A crossbody bag is handy for quick runs to the dining hall.
examples.zh: 去食堂快取快走，带个「斜挎包」正合适。

words.enDefinition: a small device that sharpens pencil tips

examples.en: The classroom pencil sharpener jammed twice during the morning quiz.
examples.zh: 早上的随堂测验里，教室的「卷笔刀」卡了两次。

examples.en: I keep a tiny pencil sharpener in my pencil case for wooden pencils.
examples.zh: 我的笔袋里放着小「卷笔刀」，削木头铅笔用。

words.enDefinition: large headphones with cushions that cover both ears

examples.en: Over-ear headphones block dorm noise better than tiny earbuds do.
examples.zh: 「头戴式耳机」比小耳塞更能隔绝宿舍噪音。

examples.en: I bought over-ear headphones with a mic for online seminars.
examples.zh: 我买了带麦克风的「头戴式耳机」，上网课讨论用。

words.enDefinition: an open basket for carrying clothes to wash

examples.en: Carry your laundry basket to the basement machines on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 周日早上把「洗衣篮」搬到地下室洗衣房。

examples.en: A flexible laundry basket squishes flat when it is empty.
examples.zh: 软质「洗衣篮」空了可以压扁收纳。

collocations: line the laundry basket with a bag

words.enDefinition: a hair product that softens hair after shampooing

examples.en: Run conditioner through the ends only, not the roots, to avoid greasy hair.
examples.zh: 「护发素」只涂发梢别碰发根，不然头发容易油。

examples.en: The travel conditioner bottle leaked all over my toiletry bag.
examples.zh: 旅行装「护发素」漏得我洗漱包到处都是。

words.enDefinition: hand coverings with separate fingers for warmth

examples.en: I keep touchscreen gloves for walking to morning lectures in January.
examples.zh: 一月早课路上，全靠触屏「手套」边走边回消息。

examples.en: Wool gloves shrink if you toss them in the dryer by mistake.
examples.zh: 「手套」误进烘干机，羊毛款会缩水。

words.enDefinition: a light cardboard cover for organizing loose papers

examples.en: I keep a blue folder for printed readings I haven't annotated yet.
examples.zh: 我用一个蓝色「文件夹」装还没标注的打印阅读材料。

examples.en: Hand in your essay in a folder with your name on the tab.
examples.zh: 交论文时装进「文件夹」，标签处写上名字。

words.enDefinition: a portable battery that charges phones on the go

examples.en: My power bank died halfway through the campus tour, of all days.
examples.zh: 偏偏在校园参观那天，我的「充电宝」半路没电了。

examples.en: Airline rules let you carry a power bank in cabin luggage only.
examples.zh: 按航空规定，「充电宝」只能随身携带，不能托运。

words.enDefinition: a sealed insulated cup for hot drinks on the go

examples.en: Most campus cafés discount refills if you bring a travel mug.
examples.zh: 自带「随行咖啡杯」的话，校园咖啡馆续杯有折扣。

examples.en: The travel mug's lid locks, so it survives a bag full of textbooks.
examples.zh: 「随行咖啡杯」的盖子能锁紧，扔进课本堆里也不漏。

collocations: travel mug with a lockable lid

words.enDefinition: a cleaning tool with an absorbent head for floors

examples.en: Run the mop over the kitchen floor after every stir-fry session.
examples.zh: 每次炒完菜，都用「拖把」拖一遍厨房。

examples.en: The spray mop came with refillable bottles and two washable pads.
examples.zh: 这把喷雾「拖把」带可灌装瓶和两块可洗拖布。

words.enDefinition: a washable fabric shell that encloses a duvet

examples.en: A duvet cover means you wash the cover, never the duvet itself.
examples.zh: 有了「被套」，要洗的只是套，被芯不用动。

examples.en: Zip the duvet cover closed so the insert stays put overnight.
examples.zh: 「被套」拉链拉好，被芯整晚不乱跑。

words.enDefinition: a detachable lock with a shackle for lockers and doors

examples.en: Gym lockers need a padlock; the front desk sells combination ones.
examples.zh: 健身房储物柜要用「挂锁」，前台卖密码款。

examples.en: Buy a weatherproof padlock for the bike cage behind the dorm.
examples.zh: 给宿舍后面的自行车棚配把防水「挂锁」。

words.enDefinition: a bag with two straps worn on your back

examples.en: My backpack is so heavy that my shoulders hurt after Monday classes.
examples.zh: 「双肩背包」太沉了，周一上完课肩膀都疼。

examples.en: I always keep a charger and an umbrella in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我总是在「背包」里备着充电器和雨伞。

words.enDefinition: a marker with bright ink used to emphasize text

examples.en: Use a yellow highlighter sparingly, or the whole page glows.
examples.zh: 黄色「荧光笔」要少用，不然整页都在发光。

examples.en: She color-codes her highlighters: pink for terms, green for examples.
examples.zh: 她的「荧光笔」分色使用：粉色标术语，绿色标例句。

words.enDefinition: a power strip that shields devices from voltage spikes

examples.en: A surge protector shields your laptop during summer thunderstorm season.
examples.zh: 夏天雷雨多，「防浪涌插座」能保护你的笔记本。

examples.en: The housing office requires a surge protector for any appliance with a motor.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室要求带电机的电器必须接「浪涌保护插座」。

collocations: joule rating of a surge protector

words.enDefinition: a plastic bag that seals by pressing its edges together

examples.en: Pack wet swimwear in a ziplock bag before it goes into your duffel.
examples.zh: 湿泳衣先用「密封袋」装好，再放进旅行包。

examples.en: Portion trail mix into ziplock bags for long library study days.
examples.zh: 长时间泡图书馆，把坚果干果分装进「密封袋」。

words.enDefinition: a soft porous block for washing dishes or wiping surfaces

examples.en: Replace the kitchen sponge every two weeks; bacteria love damp foam.
examples.zh: 「海绵擦」两周一换，细菌最爱湿海绵。

examples.en: The scratch-free sponge handles nonstick pans without ruining the coating.
examples.zh: 不划涂层的「海绵」专门洗不粘锅。

words.enDefinition: a machine that adds moisture to dry indoor air

examples.en: The mini humidifier runs beside my bed all winter for dry sinuses.
examples.zh: 冬天床头的小「加湿器」一直开着，缓解鼻腔干燥。

examples.en: Clean the humidifier weekly or the tank turns pink with mold.
examples.zh: 「加湿器」每周清洗，不然水箱长粉色霉。

words.enDefinition: adhesive strips that hang items without damaging walls

examples.en: Use command strips to hang posters without losing your housing deposit.
examples.zh: 用「无痕挂钩贴」贴海报，不会损失租房押金。

examples.en: These command strips peel off cleanly when you move out in May.
examples.zh: 五月搬走时，这些「无痕贴」能干净撕下。

words.enDefinition: a padded case that protects a laptop inside another bag

examples.en: My laptop sleeve has extra padding, so I never worry about bumps.
examples.zh: 我的「电脑内胆包」有加厚夹层，从不担心磕碰。

examples.en: Slide the laptop sleeve into your backpack before heading to the library.
examples.zh: 去图书馆前，先把「电脑内胆包」塞进背包里。

words.enDefinition: a marker whose ink does not wash off easily

examples.en: Label your meal containers with a permanent marker so no one takes them.
examples.zh: 用「油性记号笔」给饭盒写名字，免得被人拿走。

examples.en: A permanent marker wrote our dorm room number on the moving boxes.
examples.zh: 我们用「记号笔」把宿舍房间号写在搬家纸箱上。

words.enDefinition: a long flexible cord that brings power to distant spots

examples.en: We ran an extension cord behind the couch so both lamps reach the outlet.
examples.zh: 我们把「延长线」从沙发后面引过去，两盏台灯都够得到插座了。

examples.en: Never daisy-chain extension cords; the housing inspection sheet says so explicitly.
examples.zh: 「延长线」不能串联使用，宿舍检查表上写得明明白白。

words.enDefinition: thin metal paper used to wrap and cover food

examples.en: Cover the leftovers with aluminum foil before reheating them in the shared oven.
examples.zh: 剩菜盖上「锡纸」，再放进公用烤箱加热。

examples.en: A sheet of aluminum foil under the pan saves the baking tray.
examples.zh: 烤盘上垫一张「锡纸」，洗起来省事多了。

words.enDefinition: a small brush used to clean teeth

examples.en: Replace your toothbrush after recovering from a cold, dentists say.
examples.zh: 牙医说，感冒好了要换「牙刷」。

examples.en: Pack a travel toothbrush in your carry-on for long flights.
examples.zh: 长途航班随身行李里放一支旅行「牙刷」。

words.enDefinition: a portable device that warms a single room

examples.en: Check the housing rules before buying a space heater for your room.
examples.zh: 给房间买「电暖器」前，先查住宿规定。

examples.en: Our space heater trips the breaker if the fridge runs at the same time.
examples.zh: 小冰箱同时开，我们的「暖风机」会跳闸。

collocations: tip-over protection on a space heater

words.enDefinition: sticky wall hooks for hanging towels and bags

examples.en: Two adhesive hooks behind the door hold my bathrobe and tote bag.
examples.zh: 门后两个「粘钩」挂着我的浴袍和托特包。

examples.en: Weight limits matter; overloaded adhesive hooks peel off the wall overnight.
examples.zh: 「粘钩」要注意承重，超重一夜就脱落。

words.enDefinition: an insulated bag that keeps packed lunches fresh

examples.en: My insulated lunch bag keeps my meal cold until noon.
examples.zh: 我的「午餐保温包」能让饭菜到中午还是凉的。

examples.en: Don't forget your lunch bag in the shared lab fridge overnight.
examples.zh: 别把「午餐包」忘在实验室公用冰箱里过夜。

words.enDefinition: a cutting tool with two blades and finger holes

examples.en: Craft scissors for poster-making live in the student council supply drawer.
examples.zh: 做海报的工艺「剪刀」放在学生会用品抽屉里。

examples.en: Please return the scissors to the art room after cutting the felt.
examples.zh: 剪完毛毡，请把「剪刀」归还美术教室。

words.enDefinition: a small portable device for storing and moving files

examples.en: Bring a flash drive to the print shop for large poster files.
examples.zh: 打印大海报要去图文店，记得带「U盘」。

examples.en: The lab computers block cloud drives, so use a flash drive instead.
examples.zh: 机房电脑不让用网盘，改用「U盘」吧。

collocations: copy files to a flash drive

words.enDefinition: a liquid added to laundry to make clothes soft

examples.en: Pour fabric softener into the marked dispenser, never onto the clothes.
examples.zh: 「衣物柔顺剂」要倒进指定投放口，别直接浇衣服上。

examples.en: Skip fabric softener on sportswear; it ruins the sweat-wicking coating.
examples.zh: 运动服别用「柔顺剂」，会毁掉吸汗涂层。

words.enDefinition: a gel that cleans hands without water

examples.en: The lecture hall installed hand sanitizer dispensers by every entrance.
examples.zh: 阶梯教室每个入口都装了「免洗洗手液」出液器。

examples.en: Alcohol-based hand sanitizer dries my skin, so I follow it with cream.
examples.zh: 酒精「免洗洗手液」拔干，用完得抹护手霜。

words.enDefinition: a small folding umbrella that fits in a bag

examples.en: A travel umbrella in your bag beats sprinting between buildings in storms.
examples.zh: 暴雨里与其在楼间狂奔，不如包里备把「折叠伞」。

examples.en: My travel umbrella flipped inside out twice on the exposed bridge.
examples.zh: 没遮挡的大桥上，我的「折叠伞」翻了两次。

words.enDefinition: a notebook whose pages are held by a wire coil

examples.en: I fill one spiral notebook per course to keep my notes organized.
examples.zh: 我每门课用一本「线圈笔记本」，笔记好整理。

examples.en: The spiral notebook's cover is jammed with handouts from this semester.
examples.zh: 这本「线圈本」封皮里塞满了这学期的讲义。

collocations: tear a page from a spiral notebook

words.enDefinition: a twist-up tube of solid adhesive for paper crafts

examples.en: A glue stick holds photo corners flat without wrinkling the page.
examples.zh: 「固体胶」能把照片角粘平，纸面不起皱。

examples.en: For the poster project, one glue stick per group is enough.
examples.zh: 做海报项目，每组一支「固体胶」就够了。

words.enDefinition: an insulated bottle that keeps drinks hot or cold

examples.en: My thermos keeps my soup hot through three back-to-back lectures.
examples.zh: 我的「保温杯」能让汤在三节连堂课里保持热度。

examples.en: Fill the thermos before morning labs; the water fountain is far away.
examples.zh: 早上实验课前把「保温壶」灌满，饮水机离得远。

words.enDefinition: a long-handled brush for sweeping floors

examples.en: The hallway broom is missing, so crumbs migrate toward my room.
examples.zh: 走廊的「扫帚」不见了，碎屑全往我房间跑。

examples.en: Sweep weekly with the broom; dust builds up fast near the vent.
examples.zh: 每周用「扫帚」扫一次，出风口附近特别容易积灰。

words.enDefinition: a cloth covering laid over a mattress

examples.en: Buy extra-long twin bed sheets; dorm mattresses run longer than regular ones.
examples.zh: 买加长单人「床单」，宿舍床垫比普通的长。

examples.en: Wash bed sheets every two weeks to keep allergies under control.
examples.zh: 「床单」两周洗一次，过敏才不会加重。

words.enDefinition: a slim wallet for carrying bank and campus cards

examples.en: My slim card holder carries the campus ID, bank card, and transit pass.
examples.zh: 我的薄「卡包」装着校园卡、银行卡和交通卡。

examples.en: A zippered card holder is safer than a bulging wallet at festivals.
examples.zh: 参加活动时，拉链「卡包」比鼓钱包安全。

collocations: organize cards in a card holder

words.enDefinition: a padded bag designed to carry a laptop and accessories

examples.en: He bought a laptop bag with a shoulder strap for commute days.
examples.zh: 他买了个带肩带的「笔记本电脑包」，通勤时用。

examples.en: The laptop bag's front pocket fits my chargers and sticky notes.
examples.zh: 「电脑包」的前袋装得下充电器和便利贴。

collocations: laptop bag with a shoulder strap

words.enDefinition: a marker whose ink wipes off whiteboards easily

examples.en: The whiteboard marker had dried out, so I grabbed a spare from the tray.
examples.zh: 那支「白板笔」干了，我从笔托里拿了支备用的。

examples.en: Borrow my roommate's whiteboard marker for tonight's group study session.
examples.zh: 今晚小组学习，先跟室友借好「白板笔」。

words.enDefinition: a wall socket where plugs connect to electricity

examples.en: Every bunk in our dorm has one outlet, so we split it with a strip.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍每个床位只有一个「插座」，只好用插排分给两个人。

examples.en: The outlet behind the desk is loose, so report it to maintenance.
examples.zh: 书桌后面那个「插座」松了，报修给物业吧。

words.enDefinition: a clear clingy film that covers food and bowls

examples.en: Stretch plastic wrap over the bowl so the fridge smells stay contained.
examples.zh: 碗口蒙上「保鲜膜」，冰箱里就不串味。

examples.en: The dorm keeps plastic wrap and foil by the microwave for shared use.
examples.zh: 宿舍把「保鲜膜」和锡纸放在微波炉旁，供大家取用。

words.enDefinition: a paste used with a toothbrush to clean teeth

examples.en: A travel-size toothpaste tube clears airport security without any fuss.
examples.zh: 旅行装「牙膏」过安检毫不费事。

examples.en: We split a big tube of toothpaste between three roommates to save money.
examples.zh: 三个室友分一大管「牙膏」，省钱。

words.enDefinition: soft light shoes worn indoors

examples.en: Communal bathrooms at 3 a.m. are survivable with warm slippers.
examples.zh: 凌晨三点去公共浴室，有双保暖「拖鞋」好熬多了。

examples.en: The host insisted we swap sneakers for house slippers at the door.
examples.zh: 主人坚持让我们进门就把运动鞋换成室内「拖鞋」。

words.enDefinition: a paper wrapper for mailing letters and documents

examples.en: Seal the envelope properly or the financial aid office rejects your form.
examples.zh: 「信封」要封好，否则资助办公室会退表。

examples.en: Address the envelope in block letters so the sorter reads it correctly.
examples.zh: 「信封」地址用大写正体写，分拣机才读得清。

words.enDefinition: a paper folder with tabs for organizing documents

examples.en: The advisor keeps every student's records in a separate file folder.
examples.zh: 导师把每个学生的资料分放在单独的「档案文件夹」里。

examples.en: Label each file folder clearly so the drawer stays organized.
examples.zh: 每个「档案夹」都贴好标签，抽屉才能保持整齐。

words.enDefinition: a cord that connects a device to its charger

examples.en: A frayed charging cable is a fire risk, so replace it right away.
examples.zh: 破损的「充电线」有起火风险，要立刻换掉。

examples.en: I label my charging cable with washi tape so no one mistakes it.
examples.zh: 我用和纸胶带给「充电线」做标记，免得拿混。

words.enDefinition: a cylindrical cup with a handle for hot drinks

examples.en: My roommate's mug collection fills half the shared drying rack.
examples.zh: 室友的「马克杯」占了公用沥水架的一半。

examples.en: There's a chipped mug in the cupboard that everyone secretly avoids.
examples.zh: 橱柜里有个缺口的「马克杯」，大家都不碰。

words.enDefinition: an electric machine that sucks dust off floors and rugs

examples.en: Borrow the dorm's shared vacuum for the rug before room inspection.
examples.zh: 宿舍检查前，借公用「吸尘器」清理地毯。

examples.en: A cordless vacuum charges on the wall bracket and grabs cereal fast.
examples.zh: 无线「吸尘器」挂在墙上充电，撒了麦片很快吸净。

words.enDefinition: a thin padded layer placed over a mattress

examples.en: A quilted mattress pad softens the rock-hard dorm mattress instantly.
examples.zh: 绗缝「床垫软垫」立刻让硬床垫变舒服。

examples.en: Waterproof mattress pads protect against spilled tea and midnight accidents.
examples.zh: 防水「床垫保护垫」能挡住打翻的茶水。

words.enDefinition: a lock opened by dialing the correct number sequence

examples.en: Set your own code when the combination lock arrives from the bookstore.
examples.zh: 书店买的「密码锁」到手先设好密码。

examples.en: I forgot my combination lock code and missed my own lab session.
examples.zh: 我忘了「密码锁」密码，差点误了实验课。

words.enDefinition: a large open bag with two parallel handles

examples.en: I carry my tote bag to seminars instead of my heavy backpack.
examples.zh: 上研讨课我背「托特包」，不背沉重的双肩包。

examples.en: This canvas tote bag from the campus bookstore holds all my textbooks.
examples.zh: 校园书店买的这款「托特包」能装下我全部课本。

words.enDefinition: a pencil with replaceable lead that needs no sharpening

examples.en: I always carry a mechanical pencil with extra lead for exams.
examples.zh: 考试时我总带着「自动铅笔」和备用铅芯。

examples.en: Scantron forms require pencil, so my mechanical pencil gets heavy use.
examples.zh: 答题卡要用铅笔填涂，我的「自动铅笔」使用率超高。

words.enDefinition: small cells that store energy to power devices

examples.en: The smoke detector chirped all night until we swapped the batteries.
examples.zh: 烟雾报警器叫了一整晚，直到我们换了「电池」。

examples.en: Keep spare batteries for your mouse in the desk organizer.
examples.zh: 在桌面收纳盒里给鼠标备几节「电池」。

words.enDefinition: a disposable paper sheet for wiping and cleaning

examples.en: Blot the spilled noodles with a paper towel before they stain the carpet.
examples.zh: 泡面洒了先用「厨房纸」吸掉，免得弄脏地毯。

examples.en: The kitchen roll holder ran empty, so grab paper towels from the storage closet.
examples.zh: 厨房纸架空了，去储物间再拿些「厨房纸巾」。

words.enDefinition: thin thread used to clean between teeth

examples.en: Keep dental floss in your backpack; cafeteria popcorn is a trap.
examples.zh: 背包里常备「牙线」，食堂爆米花是陷阱。

examples.en: The dentist reminded me that dental floss matters more than mouthwash.
examples.zh: 牙医提醒我，「牙线」比漱口水更重要。

words.enDefinition: a waterproof coat worn in rain

examples.en: A packable raincoat lives in my backpack from October to April.
examples.zh: 从十月到四月，背包里一直备着可收纳的「雨衣」。

examples.en: The raincoat hood fits over a beanie without blowing off.
examples.zh: 「雨衣」帽子罩得住毛线帽，风吹不掉。

words.enDefinition: a fare card used to ride city public transit

examples.en: Tap your metro card on the reader before the turnstile light turns red.
examples.zh: 闸机灯变红前，把「地铁卡」贴到读卡区。

examples.en: Student metro cards cost half fare once the university verifies enrollment.
examples.zh: 学校核实注册后，学生「地铁卡」能半价。

words.enDefinition: a soft bag closed by pulling a string at the top

examples.en: I keep a drawstring bag in my locker for gym sessions.
examples.zh: 我在储物柜里放了个「束口袋」，体育课用。

examples.en: The drawstring bag cinches tight, so nothing falls out while I bike.
examples.zh: 「束口袋」一拉收紧，骑车时东西不会掉出来。

words.enDefinition: a pen that writes with smooth, thick gel ink

examples.en: My gel pen skips on glossy paper, so I use a ballpoint for handouts.
examples.zh: 我的「中性笔」在铜版纸上断墨，打印讲义我改用圆珠笔。

examples.en: She bought a pastel gel pen set for annotating her planner.
examples.zh: 她买了一组浅色「中性笔」，用来给手账做批注。

words.enDefinition: a glass part that produces light inside a lamp

examples.en: The ceiling light flickered until we replaced the light bulb ourselves.
examples.zh: 吸顶灯一直闪，最后我们自己换了「灯泡」。

examples.en: Buy warm-white light bulbs for the desk lamp; bright ones strain your eyes.
examples.zh: 台灯买暖白「灯泡」，太亮的白光伤眼。

words.enDefinition: a small paper or cloth square for wiping your mouth

examples.en: Grab a stack of napkins when you pick up the pizza order.
examples.zh: 去取披萨时，顺手多拿几沓「餐巾纸」。

examples.en: Dining hall dispensers give one napkin per pull, so plan ahead.
examples.zh: 食堂「餐巾纸」机一次只出一张，要提前多抽。

words.enDefinition: a bladed tool used to shave body hair

examples.en: Store your razor outside the shower to keep the blades from rusting.
examples.zh: 「剃须刀」别放在淋浴间，刀片容易锈。

examples.en: The pharmacy sells razors in multipacks that last a whole semester.
examples.zh: 药店的多支装「剃须刀」够用一学期。

words.enDefinition: waterproof rubber boots worn in wet weather

examples.en: Rain boots are essential for the puddle maze between lecture halls.
examples.zh: 教学楼之间全是水坑，没「雨靴」真不行。

examples.en: My short rain boots slip into a tote bag after the storm passes.
examples.zh: 暴雨过后，短筒「雨靴」能塞进托特包里。

words.enDefinition: a prepaid card redeemable at a specific store

examples.en: A bookstore gift card makes a safe birthday present for any classmate.
examples.zh: 送同学生日礼物，书店「礼品卡」最保险。

examples.en: She redeemed her coffee gift card gradually across final exam weeks.
examples.zh: 期末那几周，她一点点用完了咖啡「礼品卡」。

words.enDefinition: small papers with reusable adhesive for quick reminders

examples.en: I stick sticky notes on my monitor to remember homework deadlines.
examples.zh: 我把「便利贴」贴在显示器上，提醒自己作业截止日期。

examples.en: She left sticky notes on shared dishes asking roommates to wash them.
examples.zh: 她在公用碗盘上贴「便利贴」，请室友自己洗。

words.enDefinition: a strong metal clip that grips thick stacks of paper

examples.en: A binder clip keeps my thick lab manual from falling apart.
examples.zh: 一个「长尾夹」让厚厚的实验手册不散架。

examples.en: Use binder clips to seal the chip bag instead of folding it.
examples.zh: 找不到封口夹就用「长尾夹」夹住薯片袋，别折它。

collocations: binder clip on a chip bag

words.enDefinition: a frame where wet clothes hang to air dry

examples.en: Delicates go flat on the drying rack instead of the machine.
examples.zh: 贴身衣物平铺在「晾衣架」上，别丢进机器。

examples.en: Our drying rack by the radiator dries sweaters overnight in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天暖气旁的「晾衣架」，毛衣一晚就干。

collocations: lay flat on the drying rack

words.enDefinition: an electric device that blows hot air to dry hair

examples.en: The communal bathroom's hair dryer is first-come, first-served after 8 a.m.
examples.zh: 公共浴室的「吹风机」，八点后先到先用。

examples.en: My compact hair dryer folds in half to fit the suitcase pocket.
examples.zh: 我的便携「吹风机」能对折，塞进行李箱口袋正好。

words.enDefinition: a strap worn around the neck to hold an ID card

examples.en: Wear your student ID on a lanyard so it's visible at every gate.
examples.zh: 学生证挂在「挂绳」上，过每个闸机都看得清。

examples.en: The orientation lanyard color shows which campus tour group you joined.
examples.zh: 迎新「挂绳」的颜色代表你所在的参观小组。

collocations: clip the badge onto a lanyard

words.enDefinition: a large cylindrical bag for sports gear or short trips

examples.en: My roommate packed her duffel bag for the weekend trip home.
examples.zh: 室友收拾好了「圆筒旅行包」，周末回家用。

examples.en: The gym requires a locker, so I leave my duffel bag there.
examples.zh: 健身房要求用储物柜，所以我把「旅行包」存在那里。

words.enDefinition: a small bag or box for holding pens and pencils

examples.en: My pencil case has three compartments: pens, highlighters, and erasers.
examples.zh: 我的「笔袋」有三个隔层：笔、荧光笔和橡皮。

examples.en: Zip your pencil case closed before tossing it into your backpack.
examples.zh: 把「笔袋」拉链拉好，再塞进背包。

words.enDefinition: small cordless headphones worn inside each ear

examples.en: My wireless earbuds died right before my recorded lecture finished.
examples.zh: 录播课快听完时，我的「无线耳机」没电了。

examples.en: Keep wireless earbuds in their case so they charge between classes.
examples.zh: 「无线耳机」不用时放回充电盒，课间正好充电。

words.enDefinition: a pair of slender sticks used to pick up food

examples.en: The dining hall keeps disposable chopsticks by the noodle station.
examples.zh: 食堂在面档旁边放着一次性「筷子」。

examples.en: I carry my own chopsticks so I skip the plastic ones.
examples.zh: 我自带「筷子」，就不用一次性塑料的了。

words.enDefinition: a soap product for washing hair

examples.en: The dorm shower caddy holds everyone's shampoo bottles side by side.
examples.zh: 宿舍浴室置物架上，大家的「洗发水」并排站着。

examples.en: Solid shampoo bars last longer than liquid bottles in hard-water cities.
examples.zh: 水质硬的城市里，「固体洗发皂」比瓶装洗发水耐用。

words.enDefinition: a close-fitting knitted cap without a brim

examples.en: My campus beanie survived four winters and still holds its shape.
examples.zh: 我的校园款「毛线帽」戴了四个冬天还没变形。

examples.en: Tuck the beanie over your ears; the wind cuts right through.
examples.zh: 把「毛线帽」拉低盖住耳朵，风直灌。

words.enDefinition: a hard board with a clip that holds papers while writing

examples.en: The club recruiter carried a clipboard to collect email sign-ups on the quad.
examples.zh: 社团招新的人在草坪上拿「写字板」收集报名邮箱。

examples.en: For lab safety training, sign the form on this clipboard.
examples.zh: 实验室安全培训的表格，请在这块「带夹写字板」上签。

words.enDefinition: a block with several outlets expanding a single socket

examples.en: The dorm only allows a power strip with a surge breaker.
examples.zh: 宿舍只允许用带过载保护的「插线板」。

examples.en: Plug the mini fridge and kettle into separate power strips, not one.
examples.zh: 小冰箱和热水壶各插一个「电源插排」，别共用一个。

words.enDefinition: a lidded box for storing leftovers or packed food

examples.en: Label your food container with your name before it enters the shared fridge.
examples.zh: 「保鲜盒」放进公用冰箱前，先贴上名字。

examples.en: A leak-proof food container saved my backpack from soup disaster.
examples.zh: 一个防漏「保鲜盒」让我的背包躲过了汤水劫。

words.enDefinition: a plastic bag that lines a trash can

examples.en: Tie the trash bag before hauling it to the chute on our floor.
examples.zh: 把「垃圾袋」系紧，再拿到本楼层垃圾道扔。

examples.en: Buy tall-kitchen trash bags; the wrong size slips into the can.
examples.zh: 买大号厨房「垃圾袋」，尺寸不对会滑进桶里。

words.enDefinition: small foam plugs worn in ears to block noise

examples.en: Foam earplugs save sleep during finals week when the hall stays loud.
examples.zh: 期末周楼道很吵，泡沫「耳塞」保住了睡眠。

examples.en: Squeeze the earplugs small before they expand to seal your ears.
examples.zh: 「耳塞」先捏细再放，回弹膨胀才堵得住耳朵。

words.enDefinition: a pin with a protective clasp over its sharp point

examples.en: A safety pin closed the gap in my blazer minutes before the presentation.
examples.zh: 演讲前几分钟，一枚「安全别针」别住了外套开缝。

examples.en: Keep safety pins in your sewing kit for loose buttons and hems.
examples.zh: 针线包里备几枚「安全别针」，纽扣松了能应急。

words.enDefinition: made to seem larger or better than reality

examples.en: His story about the blizzard was slightly exaggerated, though the roads truly were terrible.
examples.zh: 他讲暴风雪的经历略有「夸张」，不过路况当时确实糟糕。

examples.en: Online reviews here tend to be exaggerated, so I test products before judging them.
examples.zh: 这里的网评往往「夸大其词」，所以我先试用再下判断。

words.enDefinition: unusually good and standing out

examples.en: She made exceptional progress in academic writing after one semester in the language program.
examples.zh: 在语言项目读了一个学期，她的学术写作进步「格外出色」。

examples.en: The professor praised my group's exceptional field research on campus recycling.
examples.zh: 教授称赞我们小组关于校园回收的实地调研「格外出色」。

words.enDefinition: more than is reasonable, needed, or allowed

examples.en: The landlord charged an excessive fee for one tiny nail hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上就一个钉子眼，房东却收了笔「过高」的费用。

examples.en: The doctor blamed my excessive screen time for the headaches and told me to cut back.
examples.zh: 医生说我持续的头痛源于「过度」刷屏，让我少看点。

words.enDefinition: the feeling of being very happy about something coming

examples.en: The whole dorm was buzzing with excitement on move-in day.
examples.zh: 搬入日那天，整栋宿舍楼都洋溢着「兴奋」。

examples.en: I could barely sleep because of my excitement about the trip.
examples.zh: 因为对这次旅行太「激动」，我几乎睡不着。

words.enDefinition: extremely tired with no energy left at all

examples.en: I was completely exhausted after pulling two all-nighters in a row.
examples.zh: 连熬两个通宵之后，我已经「筋疲力尽」。

examples.en: She looked exhausted but kept studying until the library closed.
examples.zh: 她一脸「疲惫」，却还坚持学习到图书馆闭馆。

words.enDefinition: making you extremely tired, using up all your energy

examples.en: Orientation week was exhausting; I slept eleven hours on Saturday.
examples.zh: 迎新周「累」得够呛，周六我一觉睡了十一个小时。

examples.en: Carrying boxes up to a fifth-floor walk-up is utterly exhausting.
examples.zh: 把箱子扛上没有电梯的五楼，真是「累」到虚脱。

words.enDefinition: For going out rather than coming in

examples.en: I walked around to the other door after seeing the “Exit only” sign.
examples.zh: 看到「仅供离开」的标示后，我绕到了另一扇门。

examples.en: The side door said “Exit only,” but there was another way in from the courtyard.
examples.zh: 侧门写着「仅供离开」，不过从院子还有一个入口。

words.enDefinition: A sign showing the way out

examples.en: I spotted an exit sign above the door at the far end of the hall.
examples.zh: 我在大厅尽头的门上方看见了一个「出口标志」。

examples.en: The exit sign pointed back toward the courtyard rather than into the next room.
examples.zh: 「出口标志」指回院子方向，并没有指向旁边的房间。

collocations: an exit sign above the door

words.enDefinition: past the printed date for safety or validity

examples.en: Check your passport before booking flights; mine expired last spring.
examples.zh: 订机票前查查护照，我的已经「过期」，去年春天的事。

examples.en: I tossed the expired yogurt rather than risk a rough night.
examples.zh: 那盒「过期」酸奶我还是扔了，免得夜里遭罪。

words.enDefinition: relatives beyond your immediate family, like aunts, uncles and cousins

examples.en: My extended family flies in every Christmas, so the house gets crowded.
examples.zh: 每年圣诞节，我的「大家庭」亲戚都会飞过来，家里变得特别挤。

examples.en: Growing up with an extended family nearby taught me to share everything.
examples.zh: 从小身边就有「大家庭」的亲戚，让我学会了分享一切。

words.enDefinition: a person who gains energy from being around people

examples.en: Being an extrovert, my brother chats with everyone in the elevator.
examples.zh: 我弟弟是个「外向的人」，连坐电梯都会跟人聊起来。

examples.en: Extroverts usually break the ice first at the orientation events.
examples.zh: 迎新活动上，「外向的人」通常第一个打破沉默。

words.enDefinition: a product used to clean the skin on your face

examples.en: I packed a small tube of face wash for the weekend trip with my flatmates.
examples.zh: 我带了一小管「洁面产品」，准备周末和室友一起出门玩。

examples.en: The face wash was still on the bathroom shelf when I got back from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回来时，「洁面产品」还在浴室架子上。

words.enDefinition: having lost color through washing or sunlight

examples.en: My favorite hoodie is so faded that the logo is barely visible.
examples.zh: 我最爱的连帽衫「褪色」严重，logo 都快看不见了。

examples.en: The faded curtains make the whole room look older than it is.
examples.zh: 窗帘「褪」了色，整个房间显得比实际更旧。

words.enDefinition: the temperature scale used in the United States

examples.en: My American roommates always quote temperatures in Fahrenheit, which confuses me.
examples.zh: 美国室友总用「华氏温度」报天气，让我很困惑。

examples.en: The app switches between Celsius and Fahrenheit in the settings.
examples.zh: 在设置里可以把应用切换成摄氏或「华氏」温度。

words.enDefinition: not real although made to look real

examples.en: Campus security warned us about fake parking ticket emails going around this week.
examples.zh: 校警提醒大家，本周流传着「假的」停车罚单邮件。

examples.en: That 'leather' jacket from the night market fell apart in a month—totally fake.
examples.zh: 夜市买的"皮"夹克一个月就散架——纯属「假货」。

words.enDefinition: change from being awake to sleeping

examples.en: I fell asleep on the couch halfway through the movie.
examples.zh: 电影放到一半，我就在沙发上「睡着了」。

examples.en: Try to fall asleep before midnight so you wake up fresh.
examples.zh: 尽量在午夜前「入睡」，这样醒来才有精神。

words.enDefinition: make less progress than others around you

examples.en: I fell behind on my reading during the long holiday.
examples.zh: 长假期间我的阅读进度「落后」了。

examples.en: He fell behind the group halfway through the long hike.
examples.zh: 长途远足走到一半他就「掉队」了。

words.enDefinition: have a serious argument that ends a friendship

examples.en: They fell out with their housemate over unpaid electricity bills.
examples.zh: 因为没人付电费，他们和合住的室友「闹掰」了。

examples.en: I fell out with my best friend once, but we made up a year later.
examples.zh: 我和挚友「闹翻」过一次，但一年后我们和好了。

collocations: fall out with a close friend

words.enDefinition: an evening meal eaten together with family members

examples.en: Sunday family dinner is the one time everyone is home together.
examples.zh: 周日的「家庭晚餐」是全家人唯一都在家的时刻。

examples.en: My roommate skips family dinners because his parents live overseas.
examples.zh: 我室友从不参加「家庭晚餐」，因为他父母远在海外。

words.enDefinition: suitable for adults and children together

examples.en: We picked a family-friendly restaurant so my little cousin could join our dinner.
examples.zh: 我们挑了家「老少皆宜」的餐厅，好让小表妹也来聚餐。

examples.en: The campus movie night stays family-friendly, so nothing too scary ever gets screened.
examples.zh: 校园电影之夜走「合家欢」路线，从来不放太吓人的片子。

words.enDefinition: an event where relatives spend time together

examples.en: Every Mid-Autumn Festival, our family gathering fills my parents' apartment with noise.
examples.zh: 每年中秋，我们的「家庭聚会」都会让我父母的公寓热闹非凡。

examples.en: I skipped a club party because my family gathering ran late.
examples.zh: 我没去社团派对，因为「家庭聚会」拖得太晚。

words.enDefinition: a similar appearance shared by people in one family

examples.en: The family resemblance between you and your sister is impossible to miss.
examples.zh: 你和姐姐「一家人长得像」这一点，想忽视都难。

examples.en: People point out the family resemblance whenever my cousins visit campus.
examples.zh: 每次表哥们来学校，大家都会说我们「一家人长得像」。

words.enDefinition: an occasion when scattered relatives come together again

examples.en: Our family reunion at my aunt's farmhouse lasted the whole weekend.
examples.zh: 在姑妈农庄举办的「家庭团聚」持续了整个周末。

examples.en: Graduation week doubles as a family reunion for many international students.
examples.zh: 对很多留学生来说，毕业周同时也是一次「家庭团聚」。

words.enDefinition: a chart showing how your family members are related

examples.en: For our writing class, I had to draw my family tree back three generations.
examples.zh: 写作课作业要求我把「家谱」画到上三代。

examples.en: Talking with my grandmother filled in the missing branches of our family tree.
examples.zh: 和奶奶聊天，补全了我们「家谱」上缺失的分支。

words.enDefinition: extremely hungry, almost to the point of weakness

examples.en: After back-to-back labs, I walked into the apartment completely famished.
examples.zh: 连上两节实验课后，我进门时已经「饿坏了」。

examples.en: You look famished — let's eat something before your night class.
examples.zh: 看你「饿坏了」的样子，晚课前我们先吃点东西吧。

words.enDefinition: hard to believe because too unlikely

examples.en: His excuse that a raccoon ate his homework sounded far-fetched even to the tutor.
examples.zh: 他的借口——作业被浣熊吃了——实在「牵强」，连助教都不信。

examples.en: The movie's plot was so far-fetched that we couldn't take the villain seriously.
examples.zh: 电影情节「太过牵强」，反派都显得毫无威慑力。

words.enDefinition: not at all close to being something

examples.en: The results were far from perfect, but I passed the course.
examples.zh: 结果「远非」完美，但我通过了这门课。

examples.en: My Spanish is far from fluent after just one semester.
examples.zh: 才学了一个学期，我的西班牙语「远谈不上」流利。

words.enDefinition: much more than is desirable

examples.en: The auditorium gets far too noisy for studying during lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时间的礼堂「过于」嘈杂，没法学习。

examples.en: He spends far too much money on food delivery every month.
examples.zh: 他每月花在外卖上的钱「过于」多了。

words.enDefinition: extremely interesting and holding your full attention

examples.en: The museum's exhibit of ancient sea maps was fascinating—I stayed two extra hours.
examples.zh: 博物馆的古海图展「太吸引人」了，我多待了两个小时。

examples.en: My linguistics professor makes regional accents absolutely fascinating to study and compare.
examples.zh: 语言学教授把各地口音讲得「引人入胜」，比较起来特别有意思。

words.enDefinition: food prepared and served very quickly at chain restaurants

examples.en: We grabbed fast food on the road trip because everything was closed.
examples.zh: 公路旅行时店都关了，我们随便吃了点「快餐」。

examples.en: Eating fast food every day gets expensive and unhealthy really fast.
examples.zh: 天天吃「快餐」，既费钱又不健康。

words.enDefinition: moving, changing, or happening very quickly

examples.en: It took a full month to adjust to the fast-paced schedule of medical school.
examples.zh: 足足一个月我才适应医学院「快节奏」的课表。

examples.en: The fast-paced city exhausted her at first, but now she loves the energy.
examples.zh: 这座「快节奏」的城市起初让她筋疲力尽，如今她爱上了这份活力。

words.enDefinition: the father of your husband or wife

examples.en: My father-in-law picked us up from the airport with a homemade sign.
examples.zh: 我的「岳父」举着一块手写的牌子来机场接我们。

examples.en: My father-in-law helped us move into the new apartment last month.
examples.zh: 上个月，我的「公公」帮我们搬进了新公寓。

words.enDefinition: possible to do with available resources

examples.en: Graduating a semester early is feasible if I take two summer courses online.
examples.zh: 只要修两门暑期网课，提前一学期毕业是「可行」的。

examples.en: The committee questioned whether the rooftop garden was feasible within this year's budget.
examples.zh: 委员会质疑按今年预算建天台花园是否「行得通」。

words.enDefinition: a large special meal with plenty of good food

examples.en: Thanksgiving at my aunt's place is always a huge feast.
examples.zh: 在姑姑家过的感恩节总是一场「盛宴」。

examples.en: The dining hall put on a real feast for Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 食堂为农历新年准备了实实在在的一顿「大餐」。

words.enDefinition: annoyed beyond patience and wanting a situation to stop

examples.en: I'm fed up with my roommate leaving dirty dishes in the sink.
examples.zh: 我真是「受够了」室友总把脏盘子留在水槽里。

examples.en: After three straight weeks of rain, the whole campus is fed up.
examples.zh: 连下了三个星期的雨，全校的人都「烦透了」。

words.enDefinition: give the family or roommate's dog its food

examples.en: I feed the dog at seven, then take her for a quick walk.
examples.zh: 我七点「喂狗」，然后带她出去遛一小圈。

examples.en: Who was supposed to feed the dog while I was on the trip?
examples.zh: 我出差的时候本来该谁「喂狗」的？

collocations: feed the dog twice a day

words.enDefinition: want to have or do something right now

examples.en: I don't feel like cooking tonight, so let's order something.
examples.zh: 今晚我「不想」做饭了，我们点些吃的吧。

examples.en: Do you feel like bubble tea after our last class?
examples.zh: 最后一节课下课后你「想不想」喝奶茶？

words.enDefinition: to feel that you do not fit or belong in a particular situation

examples.en: I began to feel out of place when everyone else knew one another.
examples.zh: 其他人都互相认识，我开始「感觉自己格格不入」。

examples.en: I used to feel out of place at large events on campus.
examples.zh: 我以前参加校内大型活动时，总「感觉自己格格不入」。

collocations: feel out of place at a party
start to feel out of place

words.enDefinition: to have strong reasons or wishes pulling you in two different directions

examples.en: I still feel torn between the local placement and visiting my family in summer.
examples.zh: 我在本地实习和暑假回家探亲之间还是「感觉左右为难」。

examples.en: You can feel torn when two close friends need help at once.
examples.zh: 两个好朋友同时需要帮忙时，可能会「感觉左右为难」。

words.enDefinition: the emotions you have about a person or situation

examples.en: It's healthy to talk about your feelings with close friends.
examples.zh: 和亲近的朋友聊聊自己的「内心感受」很健康。

examples.en: My careless comment at dinner that night really hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 那晚饭桌上我随口一句话，真的「伤了她的感情」。

words.enDefinition: keep making small restless movements when nervous or bored

examples.en: I always fidget during long online lectures, so I take notes by hand.
examples.zh: 上线上长课时我总是「坐立不安」，所以我改用手写笔记。

examples.en: Stop fidgeting with your pen; the recruiter will notice on camera.
examples.zh: 视频面试时别「坐立不安地」转笔，招聘官看得见。

words.enDefinition: understand something by thinking carefully about it

examples.en: I finally figured out how the shared washing machine works.
examples.zh: 我终于「搞懂」了公用洗衣机怎么用。

examples.en: We need to figure out who's bringing the cooler on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们得「弄清楚」周六谁带保温箱。

words.enDefinition: to do someone's work temporarily while they are absent or unavailable

examples.en: I agreed to fill in for a classmate at the library desk.
examples.zh: 我同意「暂时代替」一位同学在图书馆柜台上班。

examples.en: The club asked me to fill in for the person running the meeting.
examples.zh: 社团请我「暂时代替」原定主持会议的人。

collocations: ask someone to fill in for you
fill in for the regular host

words.enDefinition: write the answers on an official form

examples.en: Fill out this form and hand it to the front desk.
examples.zh: 「填好」这张表格，然后交给前台。

examples.en: I filled out the delivery form in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 我只用了五分钟就「填完」了快递单。

words.enDefinition: give someone the details they missed

examples.en: Fill me in on the group meeting; I was at the dentist.
examples.zh: 我去看牙了，你「跟我说说」组会的情况吧。

examples.en: My sister filled our parents in about the wedding date over dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭时，姐姐把婚期的安排「告知」了父母。

collocations: fill someone in on the plan

words.enDefinition: make a container or tank completely full

examples.en: Fill up my water bottle before we leave for class, please.
examples.zh: 出发上课前请帮我把水壶「装满」水。

examples.en: We filled up the tank before the long drive home.
examples.zh: 回家长途开车前我们把油箱「加满」了。

words.enDefinition: making you feel full for a long time

examples.en: Oatmeal with peanut butter is cheap and really filling before evening labs.
examples.zh: 燕麦加花生酱便宜又「顶饱」，撑到晚上做实验都没问题。

examples.en: The salad bar looks healthy but isn't filling enough after practice.
examples.zh: 沙拉吧看着健康，训练完吃却「不扛饿」。

words.enDefinition: extremely dirty and unpleasant to look at

examples.en: The shared microwave was filthy, so we put up a cleaning schedule.
examples.zh: 公共微波炉「脏」得不行，我们贴了张清洁轮值表。

examples.en: After moving that old sofa, my hands and sleeves were absolutely filthy.
examples.zh: 挪完那个旧沙发，我的手和袖子「脏」得不像话。

words.enDefinition: learn a fact you did not know before

examples.en: I found out that the library closes early on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我「打听到」图书馆周五很早闭馆。

examples.en: Call the store to find out if they still have stock.
examples.zh: 打电话给店里「问问」还有没有货。

words.enDefinition: Given to people in the order they arrive

examples.en: The sign said seats were first come, first served, so we got there early.
examples.zh: 告示说座位「先到先得」，所以我们早到了。

examples.en: Tickets were first come, first served at the community hall that Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 那周六下午，社区活动大厅的票「先到先得」。

collocations: first come first served at the door
first come first served for a seat

words.enDefinition: before anything else, early in the day

examples.en: Email the professor first thing tomorrow morning about the extension.
examples.zh: 「明早第一件事」就是给教授发邮件申请延期。

examples.en: I check my schedule first thing when I wake up.
examples.zh: 我起床「第一件事」就是查看日程。

words.enDefinition: a light tap of two closed fists as a greeting

examples.en: We finished the move-in with a fist bump instead of a handshake.
examples.zh: 搬完家，我们用「碰拳」代替握手庆祝。

examples.en: He greeted his new gym partner with a quick fist bump.
examples.zh: 他和健身房新搭档「碰了下拳」打招呼。

words.enDefinition: often canceling plans or forgetting promises

examples.en: Don't count on Mia to drive us; she's been really flaky lately.
examples.zh: 别指望米娅开车捎我们了，她最近特别「不靠谱」。

examples.en: He's a nice guy but so flaky that he bailed on movie night twice.
examples.zh: 他人不错，就是爱「放鸽子」，电影之夜爽约了两次。

words.enDefinition: loudly impressive in order to attract attention

examples.en: He parked his flashy sports car outside the library, which felt odd for a TA.
examples.zh: 他把「浮夸」的跑车停在图书馆外，助教开这车有点怪。

examples.en: I skip flashy phone cases and choose plain ones that actually survive drops.
examples.zh: 我不买「花里胡哨」的手机壳，只挑耐摔的素款。

words.enDefinition: British word for someone sharing a rented flat

examples.en: My flatmate leaves sticky notes on the fridge to divide chores.
examples.zh: 我的「合租室友」会在冰箱上贴便利贴来分工。

examples.en: We found a flatmate through the university housing group chat.
examples.zh: 我们通过学校的租房群聊找到了一位「合租室友」。

words.enDefinition: a soft warm jacket made of fleece fabric

examples.en: The fleece jacket kept me warm in the studio while the windows were open.
examples.zh: 工作室开着窗，我穿「抓绒外套」也不觉得冷。

examples.en: I left a fleece jacket in my gym locker for the walk home afterwards.
examples.zh: 我在健身房的储物柜里放了件「抓绒外套」，以便结束后走回家时穿。

words.enDefinition: tighten a muscle or bend a joint to show strength

examples.en: Flex your wrists for a minute before long essay-writing sessions.
examples.zh: 写长论文前，先「绷一绷」手腕热个身。

examples.en: He flexed in the dorm mirror after two months at the campus gym.
examples.zh: 去健身房两个月后，他对着宿舍镜子「秀了秀肌肉」。

words.enDefinition: able to change easily to fit different situations

examples.en: My shift schedule is flexible, so I can swap Fridays with Priya.
examples.zh: 我的班表很「灵活」，周五可以和普丽娅换班。

examples.en: Keep your weekend plans flexible until the group project settles.
examples.zh: 小组作业没定下来之前，周末安排先「灵活」一点。

words.enDefinition: hit something lightly with a sudden small finger movement

examples.en: Flick the switch twice if the projector still doesn't respond.
examples.zh: 如果投影仪还没反应，就快速「轻弹」两下开关。

examples.en: She flicked a crumb off the table with her thumbnail.
examples.zh: 她用拇指指甲把桌上的面包屑「轻弹」掉了。

words.enDefinition: A continuous set of steps between floors or landings

examples.en: We went up a short flight of stairs to reach the smaller reading area.
examples.zh: 我们上了「一小段楼梯」，到了较小的阅读区。

examples.en: There was one more flight of stairs beyond the door beside the noticeboard.
examples.zh: 公告栏旁那扇门后面还有「一段楼梯」。

collocations: go up a flight of stairs

words.enDefinition: thin and light, likely to break easily

examples.en: The flimsy plastic hangers snap the moment you hang a wet coat.
examples.zh: 这种「不结实」的塑料衣架，挂件湿外套就断。

examples.en: That flimsy folding chair scared me every time I sat on it.
examples.zh: 那把「不结实」的折叠椅，每次坐上去我都心惊胆战。

words.enDefinition: make a small sudden movement away from pain or surprise

examples.en: I always flinch when the toast pops up out of nowhere.
examples.zh: 烤面包突然弹起来时，我总会「吓得一缩」。

examples.en: She flinched at the loud crash from the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 公用厨房传来一声巨响，她「下意识缩了一下」。

words.enDefinition: throw something forcefully and without much care

examples.en: Fling your wet towel over the drying rack before you rush out.
examples.zh: 冲出门前，把湿毛巾「甩」到晾衣架上。

examples.en: Try not to fling your bag onto the couch while someone is sitting there.
examples.zh: 有人坐在沙发上时，别把包一把「扔」过去。

collocations: fling your bag on the bed

words.enDefinition: flat open sandals held by a strap between the toes

examples.en: Wear flip-flops in the communal shower instead of walking barefoot.
examples.zh: 公共淋浴间里要「穿人字拖」，别光脚走。

examples.en: I keep a pair of flip-flops by the dorm bathroom door.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍卫生间门口放了「一双人字拖」。

words.enDefinition: turn pages quickly without reading carefully

examples.en: I flipped through the guidebook to find the cheapest hostel option.
examples.zh: 我「翻」了一遍旅行指南，找最便宜的青旅。

examples.en: She flipped through her notes one last time before the quiz.
examples.zh: 小测前她把笔记最后「翻看」了一遍。

words.enDefinition: A display showing where an elevator is

examples.en: I watched the floor indicator while waiting for the lift outside the meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 我在会议室外等电梯时，看着「电梯楼层显示器」。

examples.en: The floor indicator showed that the lift was already coming down from the top floor.
examples.zh: 「电梯楼层显示器」显示，电梯已经在从顶楼往下走了。

collocations: the floor indicator above the lift doors

words.enDefinition: A mark on the floor showing a position

examples.en: I stood on the floor marker while the volunteer checked who was next.
examples.zh: 志愿者查看轮到谁时，我站在「地面标记」上等着。

examples.en: The floor marker near the doorway showed where the line should begin that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，门口附近的「地面标记」指明了从哪里开始排队。

collocations: a floor marker beside the entrance

words.enDefinition: of time, pass very quickly

examples.en: Finals week flew by, and suddenly it was summer break.
examples.zh: 考试周「飞快过去」，转眼就放暑假了。

examples.en: Time flies by when you are having fun with friends.
examples.zh: 和朋友玩得开心时，时间总是「过得飞快」。

words.enDefinition: full of fog, with poor visibility

examples.en: The entire campus looks mysterious and quiet on foggy November mornings.
examples.zh: 「有雾」的十一月清晨，整个校园神秘又安静。

examples.en: It was so foggy that the shuttle crawled along the road.
examples.zh: 那天「雾很大」，班车在路上慢得像爬。

words.enDefinition: bend something flat so it becomes smaller

examples.en: Fold up the map when you finish checking the route.
examples.zh: 查看完路线后把地图「叠起来」。

examples.en: She folds up her laundry before putting it in the drawer.
examples.zh: 她把洗好的衣服「叠起来」再放进抽屉。

words.enDefinition: To go where signs indicate

examples.en: You can follow the signs to the courtyard from either side of the hall.
examples.zh: 在大厅的任意一侧都可以「跟着指示牌走」，到院子里去。

examples.en: We tried to follow the signs but missed the arrow by the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们想「跟着指示牌走」，却没看到楼梯旁那个箭头。

collocations: follow the signs to the exit

words.enDefinition: contact someone again to check on progress

examples.en: I emailed the landlord on Monday and followed up with a call on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我周一给房东发了邮件，周三又打电话「跟进」。

examples.en: Please follow up on the maintenance request; it's been a week.
examples.zh: 维修申请请「跟进」一下，已经过去一周了。

words.enDefinition: a bad immune reaction to a particular food

examples.en: Always tell the server about your food allergy before ordering anything.
examples.zh: 点餐前一定要告知服务员你的「食物过敏」。

examples.en: Because of his food allergy, our study snacks are strictly nut-free.
examples.zh: 因为他的「食物过敏」，学习小组的零食严格无坚果。

words.enDefinition: the sleepy feeling right after eating a big meal

examples.en: I hit a food coma after the holiday dinner and napped for two hours.
examples.zh: 节日大餐后我立刻「饭气攻心」，睡了两个小时。

examples.en: Walk around campus after lunch to avoid the dreaded food coma.
examples.zh: 午饭后在校园里走一走，避免可怕的「饭后困倦」。

words.enDefinition: edible food that gets thrown away uneaten

examples.en: The dining hall started publicly tracking food waste last semester.
examples.zh: 食堂上学期开始公开统计「食物浪费」。

examples.en: Taking smaller portions cuts down on food waste at the buffet.
examples.zh: 自助餐少拿一点，就能减少「食物浪费」。

words.enDefinition: a person who loves trying interesting new food

examples.en: My roommate is such a foodie that she rates every dining hall.
examples.zh: 我室友是个十足的「吃货」，连食堂都要打分。

examples.en: As a self-declared foodie, I plan trips around local food markets.
examples.zh: 作为自封的「美食爱好者」，我旅行都是围绕当地市场规划的。

words.enDefinition: A bin with a lid operated by a pedal

examples.en: The foot pedal bin fit under the counter next to the washroom door.
examples.zh: 「脚踏垃圾桶」放得进洗手间门旁的台面下。

examples.en: I dropped my paper towel into the foot pedal bin before leaving the washroom.
examples.zh: 离开洗手间前，我把擦手纸扔进了「脚踏垃圾桶」。

words.enDefinition: The movement or number of people on foot

examples.en: The doorway had a lot of foot traffic just after the afternoon event ended.
examples.zh: 下午的活动刚结束，门口的「行人流量」很大。

examples.en: We chose a table away from heavy foot traffic so we could hear each other.
examples.zh: 我们找了张桌子，避开「行人来往密集」的地方，这样能听清彼此说话。

collocations: direct foot traffic away from an entrance

words.enDefinition: for some period of time, not permanently

examples.en: I studied Japanese for a while before switching to Spanish.
examples.zh: 我「有一阵子」在学日语，后来换成了西班牙语。

examples.en: Let's sit on the lawn for a while before class.
examples.zh: 上课前我们在草坪上「坐一会儿」吧。

words.enDefinition: for now, until the situation changes

examples.en: For the time being our study group is meeting online instead.
examples.zh: 「暂时」我们的学习小组先改为线上碰面。

examples.en: The old printer works for the time being, so do not order parts.
examples.zh: 旧打印机「眼下」还能用，先别订购配件。

words.enDefinition: close an app immediately when it stops responding

examples.en: Force quit the app and reopen it if the video stops loading halfway.
examples.zh: 如果视频放到一半不加载了，就「强制退出」应用再重新打开。

examples.en: I had to force quit the whole browser because one tab froze everything.
examples.zh: 一个标签页把一切都卡死了，我只好「强制退出」整个浏览器。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of future weather conditions

examples.en: The forecast says sunshine all weekend, perfect for the picnic.
examples.zh: 「天气预报」说周末全程晴，野餐正合适。

examples.en: Check tomorrow's forecast before you bike to campus in the morning.
examples.zh: 明早骑车上学前，先看看「天气预报」。

words.enDefinition: not special enough for anyone to remember it

examples.en: The movie had great special effects, but the plot itself was completely forgettable.
examples.zh: 这部电影特效不错，但剧情本身「看过就忘」。

examples.en: His first stand-up set was so forgettable that I can't recall a single joke.
examples.zh: 他的脱口秀首秀平淡得让人「看过就忘」，我一个段子都想不起来。

words.enDefinition: To arrange people in a line to wait

examples.en: The volunteer asked us to form a queue along the wall beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者请我们沿着入口旁的墙「排成一队」。

examples.en: We began to form a queue after the doors opened for the book sale.
examples.zh: 图书义卖开门后，我们开始「排成一队」。

collocations: ask people to form a queue

words.enDefinition: clothing intended for formal occasions or ceremonies

examples.en: I borrowed formalwear from a friend for the awards ceremony in the main hall.
examples.zh: 我向朋友借了「正式场合服装」，去主礼堂参加颁奖典礼。

examples.en: The invitation asked for formalwear because the student orchestra was performing at a gala.
examples.zh: 邀请函要求穿「正式场合服装」，学生管弦乐团那天要在正式晚会上演出。

words.enDefinition: a period of two weeks, used mainly in British English

examples.en: Under my current lease, rent is due at the start of every fortnight.
examples.zh: 按我现在这份租约，房租每「两周」交一次。

examples.en: The flatmates meet once a fortnight to split the bills.
examples.zh: 室友们每「两周」碰头一次，一起分摊账单。

words.enDefinition: send a received message on to another chat or person

examples.en: Did you remember to forward a message to the students who missed orientation?
examples.zh: 给错过迎新活动的同学「转发消息」这件事，你记着做了吗？

examples.en: You can forward a message to several chats at once by tapping the arrow.
examples.zh: 点一下箭头图标，就能一次向多个聊天「转发消息」。

collocations: forward the message from the group

words.enDefinition: adults who temporarily care for children not their own

examples.en: My foster parents drove six hours so I could visit my birth grandmother.
examples.zh: 为了让我探望亲奶奶，我的「寄养父母」开车开了六个小时。

examples.en: Her foster parents encouraged her to apply for the scholarship abroad.
examples.zh: 她的「寄养父母」鼓励她申请出国奖学金。

words.enDefinition: Something misplaced by its owner and discovered by someone

examples.en: The volunteer labelled the found item with the date and place it was discovered.
examples.zh: 志愿者给「拾获物品」贴了标签，写明捡到的日期和地点。

examples.en: I told the desk where I had picked up the found item after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后告诉前台，自己是在哪里捡到这件「拾获物品」的。

words.enDefinition: easily broken or damaged if dropped or knocked

examples.en: Mark the box fragile or the movers will stack textbooks on it.
examples.zh: 箱子上要标「易碎」，不然搬家工人会把教材摞在上面。

examples.en: That teacup from my grandma is far too fragile for the dishwasher.
examples.zh: 外婆给的茶杯太「易碎」，不能放进洗碗机。

words.enDefinition: one of two twins who develop from two different eggs

examples.en: My fraternal twin sister and I took completely different majors.
examples.zh: 我和「异卵双胞胎」姐姐选了完全不同的专业。

examples.en: Unlike identical twins, fraternal twins can look completely different from each other.
examples.zh: 和同卵双胞胎不同，「异卵双胞胎」可能长得完全不一样。

words.enDefinition: to suddenly lose control of yourself from fear or worry

examples.en: I freaked out when I couldn't find my passport this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上发现护照不见了，我简直「抓狂」了。

examples.en: Don't freak out, but the final exam schedule just changed.
examples.zh: 先别「抓狂」，期末考试安排刚刚有变动。

words.enDefinition: make time available by rearranging plans

examples.en: I canceled my Friday club meeting to free up study time.
examples.zh: 我取消了周五的社团活动，好「腾出」学习时间。

examples.en: My new class schedule frees up my whole Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 新课表把我周五整个下午都「空出来」了。

words.enDefinition: remove files to make room for new storage

examples.en: Free up space by deleting old lecture recordings you never rewatch.
examples.zh: 删掉从不回看的旧课堂录音，来「清理存储空间」。

examples.en: Free up space on your laptop before you install the new design software.
examples.zh: 安装新的设计软件之前，先给笔记本「清理存储空间」。

collocations: free up space on your phone

words.enDefinition: extremely cold, at or below the ice point

examples.en: The waiting room at the bus stop is absolutely freezing.
examples.zh: 公交站的候车室「冷得要命」。

examples.en: It is freezing in the library basement, so bring a thermos of tea.
examples.zh: 图书馆地下室「冷极了」，带壶热茶去吧。

words.enDefinition: quickly wash and tidy yourself, especially your face

examples.en: I stopped by the dorm just to freshen up before the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨会开始前，我顺路回宿舍「梳洗了一下」。

examples.en: There's a restroom near the library entrance if you want to freshen up.
examples.zh: 如果你想「梳洗一下」，图书馆入口附近有洗手间。

words.enDefinition: occasionally, but not regularly

examples.en: I video call my grandparents from time to time on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我会「偶尔」和祖父母视频通话。

examples.en: The department organizes career talks for students from time to time.
examples.zh: 系里「偶尔」会为学生组织职业讲座。

collocations: check in from time to time
from time to time I still

words.enDefinition: the camera on the screen side used for selfies and video calls

examples.en: The front camera is perfect for quick selfies between classes.
examples.zh: 课间用「前置摄像头」随手自拍非常方便。

examples.en: My front camera is smudged, so every video call looks slightly blurry.
examples.zh: 我的「前置摄像头」沾了指纹，视频通话画面总有点糊。

words.enDefinition: The end of a queue where people are served first

examples.en: I reached the front of the queue just as the volunteer called the next group.
examples.zh: 我刚排到「队头」，志愿者就叫下一组了。

examples.en: From the front of the queue I could see which door had opened.
examples.zh: 在「队头」，我能看到开的是哪扇门。

collocations: reach the front of the queue
stand at the front of the queue
move to the front of the queue

words.enDefinition: a thin white layer of ice on cold surfaces

examples.en: Frost covered the windshield, so I scraped it before class.
examples.zh: 挡风玻璃结满了「霜」，上课前我先把它刮掉。

examples.en: The first frost of the season killed the balcony basil.
examples.zh: 今季的第一场「霜冻」把我阳台的罗勒冻死了。

words.enDefinition: a screen that stops responding to any touch

examples.en: A frozen screen in the middle of my presentation was my worst nightmare.
examples.zh: 演讲中途遇到「死机」是我最糟糕的噩梦。

examples.en: Tap the power and volume buttons together if you get a frozen screen.
examples.zh: 如果遇到「死机」，就同时按住电源键和音量键。

collocations: a frozen screen during the presentation

words.enDefinition: annoyed because you cannot achieve or change what you want

examples.en: I get frustrated when I can't express my ideas in English.
examples.zh: 没法用英语表达自己的想法时，我会很「沮丧」。

examples.en: He sounded frustrated after failing the driving test a third time.
examples.zh: 驾照考试第三次没过，他听起来很「懊恼」。

words.enDefinition: the annoyed feeling when things keep going wrong

examples.en: Learning to write essays in English is full of frustration.
examples.zh: 用英语学写论文的过程充满了「挫败感」。

examples.en: He closed his laptop in frustration after losing his entire essay.
examples.zh: 论文全丢了之后，他满怀「挫败感」地合上了电脑。

words.enDefinition: giving you satisfaction and purpose

examples.en: Tutoring middle schoolers on weekends is tiring but genuinely fulfilling.
examples.zh: 周末给初中生做辅导很累，但真的「有成就感」。

examples.en: She switched majors after two semesters because accounting felt efficient but never fulfilling.
examples.zh: 读了两个学期后她转了专业，会计虽然吃香却让她毫无「成就感」。

words.enDefinition: having eaten enough that you don't want more food

examples.en: No thanks, I'm full — I finished two helpings of pasta.
examples.zh: 不用了，我「吃饱了」，两份意面都下肚了。

examples.en: The portions here are huge; you'll be full after half of it.
examples.zh: 这家菜量特别大，吃到一半你就「饱」了。

words.enDefinition: handle things awkwardly while searching or feeling unsure

examples.en: I always fumble for my key card when my hands are full.
examples.zh: 两只手都占着的时候，我总要「摸索」半天门禁卡。

examples.en: He fumbled with the zipper until the taxi reached the airport.
examples.zh: 出租车到机场时，他还在「笨手笨脚地」拉拉链。

words.enDefinition: reports that progress is fine up to now

examples.en: The roommates take turns cooking, and so far so good — no arguments yet.
examples.zh: 室友们轮流做饭，目前「一切顺利」——还没吵过架。

examples.en: It's day two of his study plan, and so far so good.
examples.zh: 这是他学习计划的第二天，目前为止「一切顺利」。

collocations: ask how it's going so far

words.enDefinition: a fun way to wish a performer good luck

examples.en: Break a leg at the spring concert — your solo is going to shine.
examples.zh: 春季音乐会上「祝你演出成功」——你的独奏一定会大放光彩。

examples.en: Backstage, the whole cast told the nervous lead singer to break a leg.
examples.zh: 后台里，全体演员都叮嘱紧张的领唱「演出顺利」。

words.enDefinition: a friendly way to agree to a request

examples.en: Sure thing, I'll forward you the professor's slides right after class.
examples.zh: 「好的，没问题」，下课后我马上把教授的幻灯片转发给你。

examples.en: When I asked him to grab me a coffee, he said sure thing.
examples.zh: 我请他帮我带杯咖啡时，他答应了声「好的，没问题」。

words.expression: Could you say that more slowly?
words.lemma: could you say that more slowly?
words.enDefinition: requests a slower repeat to follow better
acceptedEnVariants: Could you say that more slowly?
could you say that more slowly

examples.en: Could you say that more slowly? I want to write down the room number.
examples.zh: 您能「说得慢一点吗」？我想记下教室门牌号。

examples.en: Could you say that more slowly — my notebook is still on question two.
examples.zh: 您能「说得慢一点吗」——我的笔记还停在第二题。

words.enDefinition: asks for the story behind a sudden situation

examples.en: Why is the hallway flooded? What happened while I was in class?
examples.zh: 走廊怎么全是水？我上课的时候「发生什么了」？

examples.en: He rushed over, saw the broken window, and immediately asked what had happened.
examples.zh: 他冲过来看到碎玻璃，立刻问「出了什么事」。

words.enDefinition: politely gets attention or pardons a small interruption

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken? The row looks almost empty.
examples.zh: 「打扰一下」，这个座位有人吗？这一排看起来几乎空着。

examples.en: She said excuse me twice while squeezing past the crowded bookshelves.
examples.zh: 挤过拥挤的书架时，她说了两声「借过」。

words.enDefinition: a light apology for a minor slip

examples.en: Sorry about that, I didn't realize my phone kept buzzing during the movie.
examples.zh: 「不好意思啊」，我没意识到看电影时我的手机一直在响。

examples.en: He stepped on my foot in the crowded bus and said sorry about that.
examples.zh: 拥挤的公交上他踩了我的脚，说了句「不好意思啊」。

words.expression: Let me know if you need anything.
words.lemma: let me know if you need anything.
words.enDefinition: kindly offers help for whenever it might be needed
acceptedEnVariants: Let me know if you need anything.
let me know if you need anything
let me know if you need anything else

examples.en: Get some rest after the clinic — let me know if you need anything.
examples.zh: 看完病回来好好休息——「有事随时跟我说」。

examples.en: My neighbor promised to let me know if she needed anything while I was away.
examples.zh: 邻居答应我出差期间她「有需要会叫我」。

words.enDefinition: softens a statement you are not fully sure about

examples.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but the seminar was moved to Thursday, right?
examples.zh: 「如果我说错了请指正」——研讨会改到周四了，对吧？

examples.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but you mentioned a group discount for students.
examples.zh: 「如果我说错了请指正」——你之前提到过学生团体折扣。

words.enDefinition: builds excitement before sharing surprising news

examples.en: Guess what? The campus cafe is giving out free smoothies today.
examples.zh: 「你猜怎么着」？校园咖啡店今天免费发放冰沙。

examples.en: She burst into the room shouting guess what before telling us her news.
examples.zh: 她冲进房间喊着「你猜怎么着」，然后才公布消息。

words.enDefinition: shows you have no preference between options

examples.en: Window seat or aisle? I don't mind, whatever is easier for you.
examples.zh: 靠窗还是靠过道？「我都行」，哪个方便选哪个。

examples.en: When asked whether to stay or head home, I said, “I don’t mind.”
examples.zh: 别人问是留下还是回家，我说：「我都行。」

collocations: say you don't mind either way

words.enDefinition: thanks a host when leaving their home or event

examples.en: Thanks for having me over — the dumplings we made together were delicious.
examples.zh: 「多谢款待」——我们一起包的饺子太好吃了。

examples.en: At the door, every guest thanked the host family for having them.
examples.zh: 临走时每位客人都感谢寄宿家庭的「盛情招待」。

words.enDefinition: the standard polite reply when someone thanks you

examples.en: When I thanked her for the notes, she just smiled and said you're welcome.
examples.zh: 我谢她借我笔记时，她只是笑着说「不客气」。

examples.en: You're welcome — next time just ask me before the exam week starts.
examples.zh: 「不客气」——下次考试周开始前直接找我就行。

words.enDefinition: casually declines an offer or activity this time

examples.en: Karaoke until midnight? I'll pass, I have an eight a.m. lecture.
examples.zh: 唱卡拉OK到半夜？「这次就不去了」，我早上八点有课。

examples.en: Everyone signed up for the spicy food challenge, but I told them I'll pass.
examples.zh: 大家都报名吃辣挑战，我跟他们说我「就不参加了」。

words.enDefinition: casually says you are completely exhausted

examples.en: Two football practices and a lab report — I'm beat tonight.
examples.zh: 两场足球训练加一份实验报告——今晚我「累坏了」。

examples.en: “I'm beat,” he said, dropping onto the sofa after carrying boxes up three flights.
examples.zh: 搬着箱子爬了三段楼梯后，他一屁股坐到沙发上说：“我「累趴了」。”

words.enDefinition: a remark when you share an unexpected connection

examples.en: Wait, you took violin lessons from my aunt too? Small world!
examples.zh: 等等，你也跟我姨妈学过小提琴？这「世界真小」！

examples.en: When we discovered our moms were college roommates, we kept saying small world.
examples.zh: 发现我们的妈妈曾是大学室友时，我们不停感叹「世界真小」。

collocations: exclaim that it's a small world

words.enDefinition: praises someone for doing something exactly right

examples.en: You nailed it — your saxophone solo got the loudest applause of the night.
examples.zh: 「你吹得太棒了」——你的萨克斯独奏赢得了当晚最热烈的掌声。

examples.en: After my roommate's job interview, we all agreed she totally nailed it.
examples.zh: 室友面试回来后，我们都说她「表现得非常出色」。

words.enDefinition: reacts happily to positive news

examples.en: That's great news — your scholarship application went through on the first try.
examples.zh: 「太好了」——你的奖学金申请一次就通过了。

examples.en: She texted that the landlord accepted our offer, and I replied that's great news!
examples.zh: 她发消息说房东接受了我们的报价，我回复「这消息太好了」！

words.enDefinition: expresses complete agreement with someone's opinion

examples.en: I couldn't agree more — the campus gym definitely needs longer opening hours.
examples.zh: 「我完全赞同」——校园健身房确实需要延长开放时间。

examples.en: When she praised the new study lounge, I said I couldn't agree more.
examples.zh: 她夸新的自习室时，我说「再同意不过了」。

words.enDefinition: softens a comment that might sound rude

examples.en: No offense, but your essay would read better with shorter sentences.
examples.zh: 「无意冒犯」，你的文章多用短句读起来会更顺。

examples.en: He started with no offense, then said the movie was way too long.
examples.zh: 他先说了句「别介意我直说」，然后说这部电影实在太长了。

words.enDefinition: confirms that you will definitely attend

examples.en: Your graduation recital is at six? I'll be there, front and center.
examples.zh: 你的毕业演奏会在六点？「我一定到」，坐最前排。

examples.en: “I'll be there,” my flatmate said when I asked about the poster presentation.
examples.zh: 我问起海报展示时，室友说：“我「会到场」的。”

words.enDefinition: says something is starting or has finally arrived

examples.en: Here we go — our group presentation is the first one on stage.
examples.zh: 「开始了」——我们小组的展示第一个上场。

examples.en: The professor dimmed the lights, loaded the slides, and said here we go.
examples.zh: 教授调暗灯光、放好幻灯片，说了声「开始吧」。

words.enDefinition: responds warmly to positive news

examples.en: Your grandma is out of the hospital? Good to hear, send her my best.
examples.zh: 你奶奶出院了？「听到这个真好」，代我向她问好。

examples.en: When he said the tutoring had finally clicked, I smiled and said good to hear.
examples.zh: 他说辅导终于见效时，我笑着说「那就好」。

words.enDefinition: tells someone to forget what you just said

examples.en: Never mind, I found my ID card at the bottom of my backpack.
examples.zh: 「没关系，不用麻烦了」，我在背包底部找到校园卡了。

examples.en: I started to ask about the fee, but the clerk said never mind and waived it.
examples.zh: 我刚想问手续费的事，柜员说「算了，不用了」，直接给我免了。

words.enDefinition: a friendly casual way to thank someone

examples.en: Thanks a lot for covering my dish duty while I was sick.
examples.zh: 我生病时你帮我值日洗碗，「多谢啦」。

examples.en: He passed me the worksheet and whispered thanks a lot before the quiz.
examples.zh: 测验前他递给我练习纸，小声说了句「多谢」。

words.enDefinition: says while handing something to someone

examples.en: Here you go — one iced americano and a blueberry muffin.
examples.zh: 「给，您拿好」——一杯冰美式和一个蓝莓麦芬。

examples.en: The librarian scanned my card, handed over the book, and said here you go.
examples.zh: 图书管理员扫了我的卡，把书递过来，说了句「给你」。

collocations: pass an item across the counter

words.enDefinition: a friendly greeting after a long time apart

examples.en: Hey Marco, long time no see! When did you get back from winter break?
examples.zh: 嗨，马可，「好久不见」！你寒假什么时候回来的？

examples.en: I ran into my old roommate at the library and we both said long time no see.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆偶遇了以前的室友，我们互相说了声「好久不见」。

words.enDefinition: asks for repetition after missing what was said

examples.en: Sorry, I didn't catch your room number — this hallway echo is terrible.
examples.zh: 「不好意思，我没听清」你的房间号——走廊回音太大了。

examples.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that — the line kept breaking up on the bus.
examples.zh: 「不好意思，我没听清」——公交上信号一直断断续续。

words.enDefinition: encourages someone struggling through a difficult time
acceptedEnVariants: hang in there, it gets better

examples.en: Finals week is brutal, but hang in there — only three exams left.
examples.zh: 考试周确实难熬，但「坚持住」——只剩三门了。

examples.en: When she wanted to quit the debate team, her coach told her to hang in there.
examples.zh: 她想退出辩论队时，教练让她「再撑一撑」。

collocations: hang in there a bit longer

words.enDefinition: insists on paying for a shared meal or treat

examples.en: Put your wallet away — it's on me to celebrate your birthday.
examples.zh: 把钱包收起来——庆祝你生日，「这顿我请」。

examples.en: “It’s on me,” he said, picking up the bill before I could reach it.
examples.zh: 他先拿到了账单，说：「这顿算我的。」

words.expression: It was nice talking to you.
words.lemma: it was nice talking to you.
words.enDefinition: a polite closing line after an enjoyable chat
acceptedEnVariants: It was nice talking to you.
it was nice talking to you
it was great talking to you

examples.en: As I left the club fair, I told the senior it was nice talking to her.
examples.zh: 离开社团招新摊位时，我跟学姐说「跟你聊得很开心」。

examples.en: It was nice talking to you at the bus stop — here's my number.
examples.zh: 在公交站「跟你聊得很开心」——这是我的联系方式。

collocations: say it was nice talking to you

words.enDefinition: politely announces that it is time to leave

examples.en: It's past ten and my bus leaves soon — I should get going.
examples.zh: 已经十点多，班车快发了——「我该走了」。

examples.en: “I should get going,” he said when he saw the time on his phone.
examples.zh: 他看到手机上的时间，说：“我「该走了」。”

words.enDefinition: gives an undecided answer to avoid committing now

examples.en: Can we get a puppy next semester? We'll see how your grades look.
examples.zh: 下学期能养小狗吗？「到时候再说」，看你的成绩怎么样。

examples.en: I asked Dad about the road trip, and he just said we'll see.
examples.zh: 我问爸爸自驾游的事，他只说了句「到时候再说吧」。

words.enDefinition: shows you now understand what was explained

examples.en: Oh, I see — the discount only applies to the student meal plan.
examples.zh: 「哦，原来如此」——这个折扣只适用于学生套餐。

examples.en: He explained the shuttle route twice before I finally said I see.
examples.zh: 他把班车路线讲了两遍，我才终于说「明白了」。

words.enDefinition: a polite way to brush off someone's thanks

examples.en: Don't mention it — anyone would have lent you the lecture notes.
examples.zh: 「不用谢」——换谁都会把课堂笔记借给你的。

examples.en: When I thanked him for the ride, he waved and said don't mention it.
examples.zh: 我谢他顺路载我时，他摆摆手说「不用客气」。

words.enDefinition: expresses sincere gratitude for someone's help

examples.en: You drove me to the airport at six — I really appreciate it.
examples.zh: 你六点开车送我去机场——「真的太感谢了」。

examples.en: “I really appreciate it,” he said after I sent him the lecture notes.
examples.zh: 我把课堂笔记发给他后，他说：「我真的很感激。」

words.enDefinition: says you will arrive at the meeting spot very soon

examples.en: Order my milk tea please — I'm almost there, like two minutes.
examples.zh: 先帮我点奶茶——我「马上就到」，大约两分钟。

examples.en: He kept texting I'm almost there, but the bus was still ten stops away.
examples.zh: 他一直发消息说「快到了」，可公交还有十站路。

words.enDefinition: a warm goodbye asking someone to look after themselves

examples.en: It's getting cold, so take care and text me when you're home.
examples.zh: 天气转凉了，「保重」，到家给我发个消息。

examples.en: She hugged me at the station and told me to take care on the trip.
examples.zh: 她在车站抱了抱我，叮嘱我旅途中「保重」。

words.enDefinition: praises someone for finishing a task very well

examples.en: Well done on the debate — your closing argument was really powerful.
examples.zh: 辩论赛「干得好」——你的结辩陈词非常有力量。

examples.en: Our coach clapped and said well done after the relay team won gold.
examples.zh: 接力队夺金后，教练拍着手连声说「干得漂亮」。

collocations: say well done with a smile

words.enDefinition: says any option is fine as long as it fits

examples.en: Meet at eight or eight thirty? Whatever works for your bus schedule.
examples.zh: 八点还是八点半碰头？按你的公交时间「怎么方便怎么来」。

examples.en: He said we could video call or just text, and I said whatever works.
examples.zh: 他说可以视频也可以发消息，我说「怎么方便怎么来」。

collocations: let the other person arrange it

words.enDefinition: tells a guest to relax and feel comfortable

examples.en: Make yourself at home — the remote is on the coffee table.
examples.zh: 「别拘束，随意」——遥控器在茶几上。

examples.en: “Make yourself at home,” my aunt told the exchange student when he arrived.
examples.zh: 交换生到家时，姨妈说：「随意一点，别拘束。」

words.enDefinition: readily agrees to a suggestion with casual enthusiasm

examples.en: There's a free yoga class tonight after practice — sure, why not?
examples.zh: 今晚练完有一节免费瑜伽课——「好啊，为什么不呢」？

examples.en: When I suggested trying the new ramen place, my friends said why not.
examples.zh: 我提议去尝尝新开的拉面店，朋友们说「好啊，走啊」。

words.enDefinition: says while handing something over, often with a smile

examples.en: There you go, one chicken wrap — that'll be eight fifty total.
examples.zh: 「给，拿好了」——一份鸡肉卷，一共八块五。

examples.en: He tightened the last screw on my chair, handed it back, and said there you go.
examples.zh: 他拧紧椅子的最后一颗螺丝递还给我，说了句「好了，拿去」。

words.enDefinition: buys a moment while you think or check
acceptedEnVariants: let me see, where did I put it

examples.en: Let me see — the cheapest flight is either Tuesday or Thursday night.
examples.zh: 「让我看看」——最便宜的航班在周二或周四晚上。

examples.en: He paused, said let me see, and scrolled through his phone calendar.
examples.zh: 他停顿了一下，说了句「让我想想」，然后翻看手机日历。

words.enDefinition: a polite reply showing you were happy to help

examples.en: After I helped him carry boxes upstairs, he thanked me and I said my pleasure.
examples.zh: 我帮他搬箱子上楼后，他道了谢，我说「乐意效劳」。

examples.en: My pleasure — you'd do the same for me if I locked myself out.
examples.zh: 「乐意效劳」——要是我被锁在门外，你也会这么帮我的。

words.enDefinition: wishes a sick person a quick recovery

examples.en: Get well soon — the dorm feels way too quiet without you around.
examples.zh: 「早日康复」——没有你在，宿舍实在太安静了。

examples.en: We signed the card for our sick roommate and wrote get well soon inside.
examples.zh: 我们给生病的室友在贺卡里写下「祝早日康复」。

words.enDefinition: introduces a new topic you just thought of

examples.en: By the way, did you finish signing up for the spring workshop?
examples.zh: 「顺便问一下」，春季工作坊你报上名了吗？

examples.en: By the way, your bike light is still clipped to my backpack.
examples.zh: 「对了」，你的车灯还别在我的背包上。

words.enDefinition: promises to inform someone once you decide
acceptedEnVariants: I'll let you know by tonight

examples.en: Not sure about Saturday yet, but I'll let you know by tomorrow night.
examples.zh: 周六的事我还没定，但最晚明晚「我会告诉你」。

examples.en: “I'll let you know,” she replied as she opened her calendar to check Friday.
examples.zh: 她打开日历查看周五安排时回答：“我「再告诉你」。”

words.enDefinition: casually says you would appreciate some help
acceptedEnVariants: I could use a hand with this

examples.en: I could use a hand moving this sofa — it's heavier than it looks.
examples.zh: 搬这个沙发我需要「有人搭把手」——它比看起来沉多了。

examples.en: “I could use a hand,” she called as she tried to set up the booth.
examples.zh: 她试着布置摊位时喊了一声：“我「需要搭把手」。”

collocations: could use a hand with the move
request an extra pair of hands

words.enDefinition: encourages someone right before a challenge

examples.en: You've got this — you've rehearsed the presentation at least ten times already.
examples.zh: 「你能行的」——这个演讲你已经排练了至少十遍。

examples.en: My roommate squeezed my hand before the driving test and said you've got this.
examples.zh: 路考前室友握着我的手说「你一定行」。

words.enDefinition: a mild exclamation of surprise or shock
acceptedEnVariants: oh my gosh, look at that

examples.en: Oh my gosh, your presentation slides look so professional now.
examples.zh: 「我的天哪」，你的演讲幻灯片现在看起来太专业了。

examples.en: When the fire alarm went off at dawn, everyone groaned oh my gosh.
examples.zh: 清晨火警响起时，大家都哀嚎「我的天哪」。

words.enDefinition: a toast said before drinking together

examples.en: Cheers to surviving finals week — here's to our hard-earned break.
examples.zh: 「干杯」，庆祝熬过考试周——敬我们应得的假期。

examples.en: He clinked glasses with everyone and said cheers to our new roommate.
examples.zh: 他和每个人碰杯，说「为我们新室友干杯」。

words.expression: What have you been up to?
words.lemma: what have you been up to?
words.enDefinition: asks what someone has been busy with recently
acceptedEnVariants: What have you been up to?
what have you been up to

examples.en: You disappeared from the group chat — what have you been up to?
examples.zh: 你从群聊里消失了好一阵子，「最近都在忙什么」？

examples.en: My cousin wrote, “What have you been up to?” after seeing my first campus photos.
examples.zh: 表哥看了我的第一批校园照片后发消息问：「最近都在忙些什么？」

collocations: ask what someone has been up to
share what you've been up to

words.enDefinition: clarifies your real meaning before it sounds negative
acceptedEnVariants: don't get me wrong, I like it

examples.en: Don't get me wrong — I love the apartment, but the rent is too high.
examples.zh: 「别误会」——我很喜欢这套公寓，只是租金太高。

examples.en: He insisted, don't get me wrong, that he respected her final decision.
examples.zh: 他强调「别误会」，他尊重她的最终决定。

words.enDefinition: restates an idea in simpler or clearer words

examples.en: In other words, we can skip chapter five since it won't be tested.
examples.zh: 「换句话说」，第五章可以跳过，因为不考。

examples.en: The TA put the grading rule in other words so the freshmen could follow.
examples.zh: 助教「换了个说法」讲评分规则，好让新生听懂。

words.enDefinition: politely says you have not understood an explanation

examples.en: I don't quite follow — could you explain the second step of the proof again?
examples.zh: 「我没太听懂」——证明的第二步能再讲一遍吗？

examples.en: “I don't quite follow,” I said when the tutor moved to the next equation.
examples.zh: 老师开始讲下一个方程时，我说：“我「没太跟上」。”

collocations: lose the thread of a talk

words.enDefinition: politely declines an offer while staying friendly

examples.en: Would you like some more fries before the movie? I'm good, thanks.
examples.zh: 看电影前还要再来点薯条吗？「不用了，谢谢」。

examples.en: The vendor offered me a sample, but I smiled and said, “I'm good, thanks.”
examples.zh: 摊主请我试吃，我笑着说：「不用了，谢谢。」

collocations: say I'm good with a smile

words.enDefinition: wishes someone success before an exam or event

examples.en: Good luck with your driving test this afternoon — you've practiced plenty.
examples.zh: 下午路考「祝你好运」——你练习得够多了。

examples.en: The whole dorm floor wished me good luck before my scholarship interview.
examples.zh: 奖学金面试前，整层宿舍楼的同学都「祝我好运」。

words.enDefinition: invites a guest to serve food or drinks freely

examples.en: Help yourself to the fruit bowl — the mangoes are extra sweet today.
examples.zh: 果盘「随便吃」——今天的芒果特别甜。

examples.en: She pointed at the fruit on the table and said, “Help yourself.”
examples.zh: 她指着桌上的水果说：「想吃就自己拿。」

words.enDefinition: confirms an agreement or bargain between two people

examples.en: You cook tonight and I do the dishes — deal, shake on it?
examples.zh: 今晚你做饭我洗碗——「一言为定」，击个掌？

examples.en: He offered to trade his Friday shift for my Sunday one, and I said deal.
examples.zh: 他提出用他的周五班换我的周日班，我答应道「成交」。

collocations: say deal to seal an agreement
strike a deal with a friend

words.enDefinition: a friendly goodbye wishing someone a nice day

examples.en: The barista handed me my latte and said have a good one with a smile.
examples.zh: 咖啡师递上我的拿铁，笑着说了句「祝你今天顺利」。

examples.en: Thanks for helping me move — have a good one, and see you Monday.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬家——「祝你今天顺利」，周一见。

words.enDefinition: shows a fact suddenly explains something confusing

examples.en: No wonder you're exhausted — you only slept four hours before the exam.
examples.zh: 「怪不得」你累成这样——考试前只睡了四个小时。

examples.en: The bus didn't stop today, and no wonder, since it's a public holiday.
examples.zh: 今天公交不停靠，「难怪」——今天是公共假期。

words.enDefinition: checks someone's availability before making an invitation

examples.en: Are you free tonight? A few of us are playing basketball at seven.
examples.zh: 你「今晚有空吗」？我们几个七点要打篮球。

examples.en: She texted to ask if I was free tonight for a study session.
examples.zh: 她发消息问我「今晚有没有空」一起自习。

collocations: ask if someone is free tonight

words.enDefinition: a casual greeting that invites the other person's news

examples.en: Maya waved from across the quad and asked what's up before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前，玛雅从草坪对面朝我挥手，问我「最近怎么样」。

examples.en: What's up? I haven't seen you since the dorm barbecue.
examples.zh: 「最近怎么样」？宿舍烧烤之后我就一直没见过你。

words.enDefinition: agrees strongly because you share the same experience

examples.en: When he complained about noon lines, I sighed and said tell me about it.
examples.zh: 他抱怨中午排长队时，我叹了口气说「可不是嘛」。

examples.en: Tell me about it — I waited twenty minutes just for a sandwich.
examples.zh: 「可不是嘛」——我光是买个三明治就排了二十分钟。

collocations: reply with tell me about it

words.enDefinition: suggests stopping the current work or activity for now

examples.en: We've finished four slides since noon — let's call it a day.
examples.zh: 从中午到现在我们做完了四页幻灯片——「今天就到这儿吧」。
