examples.en: The dentist promised a painless filling, and for once she kept her word.
examples.zh: 牙医承诺补牙「不会疼」，这次她还真说到做到。

words.enDefinition: done with extremely careful attention to detail

examples.en: Her painstaking lecture notes saved the whole study group before the comprehensive exam.
examples.zh: 通识大考前，她「一丝不苟」的课堂笔记救了整个学习小组。

examples.en: Restoring the old campus mural took painstaking work from the art department volunteers.
examples.zh: 修复老校园壁画是件「费尽心思」的活儿，全靠艺术系志愿者。

words.enDefinition: connect two devices wirelessly for the first time

examples.en: Pair your earbuds with the new phone by holding the button on the case.
examples.zh: 按住充电盒上的按钮，就能把耳机和新手机「配对」。

examples.en: My earbuds refuse to pair whenever the bluetooth setting gets switched off.
examples.zh: 只要蓝牙设置被关掉，我的耳机就没法「配对」。

words.enDefinition: loose comfortable clothes worn for sleeping

examples.en: I answer the door in pajamas and my roommate laughs at me.
examples.zh: 我穿着「睡衣」就去开门，室友都笑了。

examples.en: Some morning lectures are casual enough that students show up in pajamas.
examples.zh: 有的早课氛围很随意，学生「穿着睡衣」就来了。

words.enDefinition: to suddenly feel so worried that you cannot think calmly

examples.en: I started to panic when I couldn't log into the exam portal.
examples.zh: 登不进考试系统时，我开始「慌了」。

examples.en: Try not to panic; the library has spare laptop chargers.
examples.zh: 别「惊慌」，图书馆有备用的笔记本充电器。

words.enDefinition: a cupboard or small room where food is stored

examples.en: Our pantry is stacked with instant noodles and canned beans.
examples.zh: 我们的「食品储藏柜」堆满了泡面和罐装豆子。

examples.en: Restock the shared pantry before someone raids it at midnight.
examples.zh: 趁还没人在深夜扫荡，先把公共「储藏柜」补满。

words.enDefinition: a disposable plate made of thick paper

examples.en: For the dorm party, we bought three sleeves of paper plates.
examples.zh: 宿舍派对我们买了三沓「纸盘子」。

examples.en: Using paper plates means nobody fights over dish duty tonight.
examples.zh: 用「纸盘」的话，今晚就没人抢着洗碗了。

words.enDefinition: A holder that dispenses paper towels for drying hands

examples.en: I found the paper towel dispenser on the wall behind the washroom door.
examples.zh: 我在洗手间门后的墙上找到了「擦手纸盒」。

examples.en: The paper towel dispenser was empty, so I used the hand dryer instead.
examples.zh: 「擦手纸盒」空了，我就改用烘手机。

words.enDefinition: park a car parallel to the curb between two others

examples.en: Parallel park behind the blue hatchback; the spot just opened.
examples.zh: 那个车位刚空出来，把车「侧方停」进蓝色两厢车后面。

examples.en: I practiced parallel parking between cones before my road test.
examples.zh: 路考前我先用锥桶练习「侧方停车」。

words.enDefinition: very dry mouth because you need a drink

examples.en: Two lectures straight with no water bottle left me absolutely parched.
examples.zh: 连上两节课又没带水杯，我「口干舌燥」。

examples.en: After soccer practice I was so parched that I drank two sports drinks.
examples.zh: 足球训练后我「渴坏了」，一口气喝了两瓶运动饮料。

words.enDefinition: A long outdoor seat in a park

examples.en: I found my classmate on a park bench beside the path after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我在小路旁的「公园长椅」上找到了同学。

examples.en: The park bench under the tree was still dry after the brief shower.
examples.zh: 那阵短雨停后，树下的「公园长椅」还是干的。

words.enDefinition: A narrow way linking areas inside or between buildings

examples.en: We found a passageway behind the main hall that led into the courtyard.
examples.zh: 我们在主厅后面找到一条通向院子的「通道」。

examples.en: The passageway was wide enough for us to walk side by side with our bags.
examples.zh: 这条「通道」足够宽，我们带着包也能并排走。

words.enDefinition: the short number code that unlocks a phone screen

examples.en: I changed my passcode after my little cousin guessed it twice.
examples.zh: 表弟两次猜中我的「锁屏密码」，我就换了一个。

examples.en: Type your passcode to unlock the phone and hand it to me.
examples.zh: 输入「锁屏密码」解锁后，把手机递给我。

words.enDefinition: a secret combination of characters that protects an account

examples.en: I forgot my password again and had to reset it through my email.
examples.zh: 我又忘了「密码」，只好通过邮箱重置。

examples.en: Never share your password with anyone, not even your closest roommate.
examples.zh: 别把「密码」告诉任何人，哪怕是最要好的室友。

words.enDefinition: later than the time you usually go to sleep

examples.en: It's way past my bedtime, but this novel is too good to stop.
examples.zh: 早就「过了我平时睡觉的点」，可这本小说实在停不下来。

examples.en: One more episode and I'm past my bedtime for sure.
examples.zh: 再看一集，我就真的「超过睡觉时间」了。

collocations: stay up way past my bedtime

words.enDefinition: put copied text or images into a new place

examples.en: Copy the meeting link and paste it into the group chat.
examples.zh: 复制会议链接，然后「粘贴」到群聊里。

examples.en: I accidentally pasted the wrong paragraph into my application essay.
examples.zh: 我一不小心把错误的段落「粘贴」进了申请文书。

words.enDefinition: touch someone lightly and gently with a flat hand

examples.en: My coach patted me on the back after the tryout ended.
examples.zh: 选拔结束后，教练在我背上「轻拍」了一下。

examples.en: Pat the dough flat before you put it in the oven.
examples.zh: 把面团「轻拍」平之后再放进烤箱。

words.enDefinition: return money that someone lent you

examples.en: I'll pay you back the twenty dollars on Friday, promise.
examples.zh: 周五我就把这二十美元「还」给你，说到做到。

examples.en: She paid back her roommate for the movie tickets last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚她把电影票的钱「还」给了室友。

words.enDefinition: The busiest hours at a particular place or service

examples.en: The courtyard gets crowded during peak hours when two classes finish around the same time.
examples.zh: 两节课差不多同时结束的「高峰时段」，院子里会很挤。

examples.en: I avoided the hall during peak hours so I could find a quiet seat.
examples.zh: 为了找个安静座位，我避开「高峰时段」去大厅。

collocations: open an extra door during peak hours

words.enDefinition: slightly hungry, wanting a small snack

examples.en: I get peckish around three, so I stash nuts in my desk drawer.
examples.zh: 我下午三点总会「有点饿」，所以在抽屉里藏了坚果。

examples.en: Feeling a little peckish? There's leftover pizza in the shared fridge.
examples.zh: 有点「饿」？公共冰箱里还有剩披萨。

words.enDefinition: unusual, often in a way you distrust

examples.en: There was a peculiar smell in the hallway, so we reported it to the front desk.
examples.zh: 走廊里有股「怪异」的气味，我们报给了前台。

examples.en: He has a peculiar habit of sorting his notes by color before every single exam.
examples.zh: 他有个「古怪」的习惯，每场考试前都按颜色整理笔记。

words.enDefinition: look quickly and secretly at something

examples.en: Don't peek at your neighbor's answer sheet during the quiz.
examples.zh: 小测时别「偷看」邻座的答卷。

examples.en: She peeked into the kitchen to check whether the dumplings were ready.
examples.zh: 她「探头」进厨房，看看饺子好了没有。

words.enDefinition: to look quickly or discreetly inside a place or object

examples.en: I opened the box just enough to peek inside before carrying it upstairs.
examples.zh: 我把箱子开了一条缝，「往里面偷看一眼」后才搬上楼。

examples.en: We stopped to peek inside the empty hall while the caretaker unlocked it.
examples.zh: 管理员给空大厅开锁时，我们停下「往里面偷看一眼」。

collocations: take a moment to peek inside

words.enDefinition: remove the outer skin of a fruit or vegetable

examples.en: Peel the cucumbers if the wax on the skin bothers you.
examples.zh: 黄瓜皮的蜡要是让你不放心，就「削皮」再吃。

examples.en: She peeled the oranges and split them between the study group.
examples.zh: 她把橙子「剥」好，分给自习小组的每个人。

words.enDefinition: In British English, hang washed clothes outside using pegs to secure them.

examples.en: Let's peg out the washing while there is still some sun in the back garden.
examples.zh: 趁后花园还有阳光，咱们「用夹子把衣物晾出去」吧。

examples.en: I usually peg out the washing before breakfast if the forecast looks dry.
examples.zh: 天气预报说没雨的话，我通常在吃早饭前「用夹子把衣物晾出去」。

collocations: peg out the washing in the garden
peg out the washing before breakfast

words.enDefinition: note something tentatively in a schedule, subject to change

examples.en: Let me pencil you in for Tuesday and confirm later.
examples.zh: 我先把你「暂定」在周二，之后再确认。

examples.en: Pencil in the review session; we might move it after the quiz.
examples.zh: 复习课先「暂定」下来，测验后也许还要调整。

words.enDefinition: someone who enjoys company and connects with others easily

examples.en: My aunt is a people person; strangers become her friends in minutes.
examples.zh: 我姑姑是个「善于交际的人」，陌生人几分钟就能聊成熟人。

examples.en: Being a people person helped her land the campus tour guide job.
examples.zh: 因为「善于交际」，她拿到了校园讲解员的兼职。

words.enDefinition: a short encouraging talk that makes you feel confident

examples.en: My dad gave me a pep talk before my scholarship interview.
examples.zh: 奖学金面试前，爸爸给我「加油打气」。

examples.en: Our captain's five-minute pep talk lifted the whole team's spirits.
examples.zh: 队长五分钟的「动员」让全队士气大振。

words.enDefinition: sit on the narrow edge of something

examples.en: Perch on the arm of the couch; all the seats are taken.
examples.zh: 座位都满了，先在沙发扶手上「将就坐一下」。

examples.en: She perched on the edge of my desk during our quick chat.
examples.zh: 简短聊天时她「斜坐在」我书桌边上。

collocations: perch on the edge of the desk

words.enDefinition: good at making people agree or act

examples.en: Our persuasive poster campaign convinced the student council to fund the rooftop garden.
examples.zh: 我们「有说服力」的海报攻势让学生会批准了天台花园的经费。

examples.en: Writing persuasive essays got easier once I learned to answer the other side's points first.
examples.zh: 学会先回应对方观点之后，写「有说服力的」议论文就容易多了。

words.enDefinition: a vegetarian who also eats fish and seafood

examples.en: I'm pescatarian, so I skip the chicken but take the salmon.
examples.zh: 我是「鱼素者」，不吃鸡肉但会拿三文鱼。

examples.en: Being pescatarian makes the campus menu much easier to navigate.
examples.zh: 当个「鱼素食者」，校园菜单就好选多了。

words.enDefinition: allowing tenants or guests to keep animals

examples.en: Most student housing isn't pet-friendly, so my cat lives with my aunt.
examples.zh: 多数学生公寓「不允许养宠物」，我的猫只好寄养在姑姑家。

examples.en: We found a pet-friendly cafe where dogs get free biscuits.
examples.zh: 我们找到一家「宠物友好」咖啡馆，狗狗还能领免费饼干。

words.enDefinition: a protective cover that wraps around the back of a phone

examples.en: My phone case has a card slot, so I keep my dorm key inside it.
examples.zh: 我的「手机壳」带卡槽，所以我把宿舍钥匙放在里面。

examples.en: She bought a clear phone case so the phone color still shows through.
examples.zh: 她买了个透明「手机壳」，这样还能看到手机本来的配色。

collocations: a phone case with a card holder

words.enDefinition: A locker with a connection for charging phones

examples.en: I put my phone in a phone charging locker while I joined the reading group.
examples.zh: 我参加读书小组活动时，把手机放在「手机充电储物柜」里。

examples.en: The hall had a phone charging locker with a separate key for each compartment.
examples.zh: 大厅有一个「手机充电储物柜」，每一格都有单独的钥匙。

collocations: a compartment in a phone charging locker

words.enDefinition: the digits people dial to reach your phone

examples.en: Write your phone number on the lab signup sheet next to your student ID.
examples.zh: 在实验登记表上你的学号旁边写下「电话号码」。

examples.en: Give me your phone number so the group can reach you about the project.
examples.zh: 把「电话号码」给我，小组有事好联系你。

words.enDefinition: to eat food slowly without real interest or appetite

examples.en: She just picked at her salad, too nervous to actually eat.
examples.zh: 她紧张得根本吃不下，只是「拨弄着」那份沙拉。

examples.en: He picked at his dinner all evening while worrying about the interview.
examples.zh: 他一晚上都在为面试发愁，晚餐只是「挑挑拣拣」没怎么吃。

words.enDefinition: choose one item from a group

examples.en: Can you pick out a nice birthday card for Leo?
examples.zh: 你能帮利奥「挑」一张好看的生日贺卡吗？

examples.en: She picked out the ripest bananas at the street market.
examples.zh: 她在街边市场里「挑」了最熟的香蕉。

words.enDefinition: become stronger, said of wind or a storm

examples.en: The wind picked up during the concert, flipping our ponchos.
examples.zh: 演唱会上「风变大」，把我们的雨衣都掀翻了。

examples.en: The storm is expected to pick up again around midnight.
examples.zh: 预计风暴午夜前后再度「增强」。

words.enDefinition: hard to please, especially about small details

examples.en: My picky roommate returns soup if the noodles are too soft.
examples.zh: 我那位「挑剔的」室友嫌面太软，会把汤退回去。

examples.en: Don't be picky about dorms in your first year; apply early instead.
examples.zh: 大一别对宿舍太「挑剔」，尽早申请才对。

words.enDefinition: someone who refuses many kinds of food

examples.en: My host family says their youngest son is a really picky eater.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭说他们家的小儿子很「挑食」。

examples.en: As a picky eater, I always check the menu before dinner plans.
examples.zh: 作为一个「挑食的人」，我答应饭局前一定会先看菜单。

words.enDefinition: a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park

examples.en: The weather is perfect for a picnic by the lake this weekend.
examples.zh: 这周末天气正好，适合去湖边「野餐」。

examples.en: We spread our picnic out on the grass after morning lectures.
examples.zh: 上午的课结束后，我们在草地上铺开「野餐」。

words.enDefinition: a woven basket that carries food for outdoor meals

examples.en: She packed the picnic basket with sandwiches and homemade lemonade.
examples.zh: 她往「野餐篮」里装了三明治和自制柠檬水。

examples.en: The checkered picnic basket was a graduation gift from my aunt.
examples.zh: 那只格子「野餐篮」是姑姑送我的毕业礼物。

words.enDefinition: An outdoor table used for eating or gathering

examples.en: We spread our notes out on a picnic table while waiting for the hall to open.
examples.zh: 等大厅开门时，我们把笔记摊在一张「野餐桌」上。

examples.en: The picnic table near the path had enough room for all six of us.
examples.zh: 小路旁的「野餐桌」够我们六个人坐。

words.enDefinition: eat a very large amount of food at once

examples.en: We pigged out on hotpot right after the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考试一结束我们就吃火锅「大吃了一顿」。

examples.en: I always pig out on snacks while binge-watching shows at night.
examples.zh: 我晚上追剧的时候总会「猛吃」零食。

words.enDefinition: gather into a growing stack over time

examples.en: The dirty mugs keep piling up next to the sink in our flat.
examples.zh: 我们公寓水槽边的脏杯子越「堆」越多。

examples.en: Unread emails pile up fast during midterms, so check them daily.
examples.zh: 期中期间未读邮件「堆积」得飞快，最好每天查看。

words.zhGloss: 用发卡把头发别到后面
words.enDefinition: Secure hair away from the face using a pin or clip.
acceptedZhAnswers: 用发卡把头发别到后面

examples.en: I usually pin back my hair before kneading dough at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 我在餐桌上揉面前，通常会「用发卡把头发别到后面」。

examples.en: She had to pin back her fringe before trying on the new glasses.
examples.zh: 她得先「用发卡把刘海别到后面」，再试戴新眼镜。

words.enDefinition: squeeze something small tightly between your fingers

examples.en: Pinch the excess tape together so the package stays sealed.
examples.zh: 把多余的胶带「捏」在一起，包裹就封好了。

examples.en: She pinched my arm during the movie because I kept talking.
examples.zh: 电影放到一半她「捏」了我的胳膊一下，因为我一直在讲话。

collocations: pinch the bridge of your nose

words.enDefinition: join others in sharing a task or job

examples.en: Everyone in our flat pitched in to clean the shared kitchen tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们公寓里所有人都「出力」打扫了公用厨房。

examples.en: We all pitched in to set up the party decorations.
examples.zh: 我们都「搭把手」布置了派对装饰。

words.enDefinition: turn suddenly on one foot to face another way

examples.en: Pivot slowly on the wet kitchen floor after washing dishes.
examples.zh: 洗完碗后厨房地面湿滑，转身时慢一点「转」。

examples.en: He pivoted on his heel and hurried back to the lab.
examples.zh: 他「一个转身」，快步赶回实验室。

words.enDefinition: a mat placed under plates to protect the table

examples.en: We set the table with placemats before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到之前，我们铺好「餐垫」摆好了桌子。

examples.en: A plastic placemat makes cleanup so much easier after spaghetti night.
examples.zh: 意面夜之后，塑料「餐垫」让收拾省事多了。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling food and everyday household items

examples.en: I stop at the grocery store near campus twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周去学校附近的「杂货店」两次。

examples.en: The grocery store on Fifth Street closes at eleven tonight.
examples.zh: 第五街的「杂货店」今晚十一点关门。

words.enDefinition: a small shop open long hours selling snacks and basics

examples.en: Grab some snacks at the convenience store across from the dorm.
examples.zh: 去宿舍对面的「便利店」买点零食吧。

examples.en: The convenience store near my apartment is open twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 我公寓附近的「便利店」二十四小时营业。

words.enDefinition: a small neighborhood shop on a street corner

examples.en: Our corner store sells fresh fruit and cheap instant noodles.
examples.zh: 我们的「街角小店」卖新鲜水果和便宜的泡面。

examples.en: I grab milk at the corner store on my way home.
examples.zh: 回家路上我在「街角小店」顺带买了牛奶。

words.enDefinition: an open market where local farmers sell fresh produce

examples.en: The farmers market downtown sells fresh vegetables every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 市中心的「农贸市场」每周六早上卖新鲜蔬菜。

examples.en: We bought homemade bread and berries at the farmers market.
examples.zh: 我们在「农贸市场」买了自制面包和浆果。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling donated secondhand clothes and goods cheaply

examples.en: I found a nearly new winter coat at the thrift store.
examples.zh: 我在「二手商店」淘到一件几乎全新的冬衣。

examples.en: Thrift stores near campus are perfect for cheap Halloween costumes.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「二手商店」是买便宜万圣节服装的好地方。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling tools and home repair supplies

examples.en: I went to the hardware store to buy hooks for my posters.
examples.zh: 我去「五金店」买挂海报用的挂钩。

examples.en: The hardware store downtown also rents power tools on weekends.
examples.zh: 市中心的「五金店」周末还出租电动工具。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells flowers and arrangements

examples.en: I ordered a small bouquet at the florist for my host mom.
examples.zh: 我在「花店」给寄宿妈妈订了一小束花。

examples.en: The florist next to the bakery sells single roses cheaply.
examples.zh: 面包店旁边的「花店」单支玫瑰卖得便宜。

words.enDefinition: a shop licensed to sell beer, wine, and spirits

examples.en: You must show ID when buying beer at the liquor store.
examples.zh: 在「酒类专卖店」买啤酒必须出示证件。

examples.en: There is a liquor store two blocks from our apartment.
examples.zh: 我们公寓两个街区外有一家「酒类专卖店」。

collocations: show ID at the liquor store

words.enDefinition: a large enclosed building with many shops and restaurants

examples.en: The shopping mall downtown has a cinema and a huge food court.
examples.zh: 市中心的「购物商场」里有电影院和一个超大的美食广场。

examples.en: We spent all Saturday afternoon wandering around the new shopping mall.
examples.zh: 我们整个周六下午都在那家新开的「购物商场」里闲逛。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor retail area with several attached stores

examples.en: Our shopping center has a supermarket, a bank, and a pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我们的「购物中心」里有超市、银行和药房。

examples.en: The new shopping center opened with a big discount store.
examples.zh: 新开的「购物中心」带了一家大型折扣店。

words.enDefinition: a row of shops sharing a parking lot

examples.en: Our favorite ramen place is hidden in a small strip mall.
examples.zh: 我们最爱的拉面店就藏在一片小「沿街商铺区」里。

examples.en: Most of the strip malls along this road offer free parking.
examples.zh: 这条路沿线的「沿街商铺区」大多提供免费停车。

words.enDefinition: a discount shop selling cheap everyday items

examples.en: I buy party cups and tape at the dollar store.
examples.zh: 我在「平价商店」买派对纸杯和胶带。

examples.en: Everything in that dollar store costs only a few dollars.
examples.zh: 那家「平价商店」里的东西只卖几美元。

words.enDefinition: an area with many fast food stalls sharing seating

examples.en: Let's meet at the food court on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我们在二楼的「美食广场」碰面吧。

examples.en: The mall food court has dumplings, burritos, and bubble tea.
examples.zh: 商场的「美食广场」有饺子、墨西哥卷饼和奶茶。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle that sells meals on the street

examples.en: A taco food truck parks outside the library at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 午餐时间一辆塔可「流动餐车」会停在图书馆外。

examples.en: The food trucks parked near campus are cheaper than most restaurants.
examples.zh: 校园附近停着的「流动餐车」比大多数餐馆便宜。

collocations: grab lunch from a food truck

words.enDefinition: a window where customers order without leaving the car

examples.en: We grabbed coffee at the drive-thru before our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上早课前我们先在「免下车窗口」买了咖啡。

examples.en: The pharmacy has a drive-thru window for picking up prescriptions.
examples.zh: 那家药房设有「免下车窗口」，不用下车就能取药。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells fresh bread and pastries

examples.en: The little bakery around the corner sells amazing cinnamon rolls.
examples.zh: 街角那家小「面包店」卖的肉桂卷特别好吃。

examples.en: I pick up fresh bread from the bakery on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我每周日都会去「面包店」买新鲜面包。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling sandwiches, cold cuts, and prepared foods

examples.en: The deli near campus makes huge sandwiches for under eight dollars.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「熟食店」八美元以内就能买到超大三明治。

examples.en: I grabbed potato salad and cold cuts at the deli counter.
examples.zh: 我在「熟食店」柜台买了土豆沙拉和切片冷肉。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells fresh cuts of meat

examples.en: The butcher shop downtown sells better meat than the supermarket.
examples.zh: 市中心的「肉铺」卖的肉比超市好。

examples.en: Ask the butcher shop to cut the pork into thin slices.
examples.zh: 可以请「肉铺」把猪肉切成薄片。

words.enDefinition: a casual cafe serving coffee drinks and light snacks

examples.en: We study at the coffee shop next to the library every Friday.
examples.zh: 每周五我们都在图书馆旁边的「咖啡店」学习。

examples.en: This coffee shop offers a student discount with your ID card.
examples.zh: 这家「咖啡店」凭学生证可以享受折扣。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells new and used books

examples.en: I sold my old textbooks back to the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 我把旧课本卖回给了校园「书店」。

examples.en: The independent bookstore downtown hosts author events on most weekends.
examples.zh: 市中心那家独立「书店」大多数周末都办作家分享活动。

words.enDefinition: a city library anyone can use for free

examples.en: The public library downtown offers free printing and quiet study rooms.
examples.zh: 市中心的「公共图书馆」提供免费打印和安静的自习室。

examples.en: You can borrow movies from the public library with a free card.
examples.zh: 办一张免费借书证就能在「公共图书馆」借电影碟片。

words.enDefinition: a charity that gives free groceries to people in need

examples.en: The neighborhood food pantry offers groceries on Saturday mornings in the building behind the library.
examples.zh: 社区「食品救济站」周六上午发放食品，地点在图书馆后面的楼里。

examples.en: Our neighbors collected sealed packages of rice for the food pantry during the winter drive.
examples.zh: 冬季募捐活动中，邻居们收集了未开封的大米，准备送给「食品救济站」。

words.enDefinition: a self-service shop with coin-operated washing machines

examples.en: Our dorm has no washers, so I use the laundromat downtown.
examples.zh: 宿舍没有洗衣机，所以我用市中心的「自助洗衣店」。

examples.en: Remember to bring quarters because the laundromat machines only take coins.
examples.zh: 记得带硬币，因为「自助洗衣店」的机器只收硬币。

words.enDefinition: a shop that cleans clothes with chemical solvents

examples.en: Take your suit to the dry cleaner before the career fair.
examples.zh: 求职招聘会之前把西装拿到「干洗店」洗一下。

examples.en: The dry cleaner near campus removed the coffee stain completely.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「干洗店」把咖啡渍完全去掉了。

collocations: drop off at the dry cleaner

words.enDefinition: a government office handling mail, packages, and stamps

examples.en: I mailed my tax forms at the post office on Monday.
examples.zh: 我周一在「邮局」寄出了报税表格。

examples.en: The post office sells boxes and tape for shipping packages.
examples.zh: 「邮局」卖寄包裹用的纸箱和胶带。

collocations: ship a package at the post office

words.enDefinition: a public box where outgoing mail is collected

examples.en: Drop your letters in the blue mailbox across from the cafe.
examples.zh: 把信投进咖啡店对面的蓝色「邮筒」。

examples.en: The mailbox on our street gets emptied every weekday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们街上的「邮筒」每个工作日下午都会被清空。

collocations: mail a letter in the mailbox

words.enDefinition: a local office of a bank for in-person service

examples.en: I opened my checking account at a bank branch near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的一家「银行分行」开了支票账户。

examples.en: The bank branch closes at five, so go before class ends.
examples.zh: 那家「银行分行」五点关门，所以要在下课前赶过去。

words.enDefinition: a business where professionals cut and style hair

examples.en: I booked a haircut at the hair salon near the campus gate.
examples.zh: 我在学校门口的「美发店」预约了剪发。

examples.en: That hair salon gives student discounts on weekday mornings before ten.
examples.zh: 那家「美发店」工作日上午十点前对学生打折。

words.enDefinition: a shop where barbers cut men's hair

examples.en: My roommate gets a fade at the barbershop every three weeks.
examples.zh: 我室友每三周去「理发店」剪一次渐变发型。

examples.en: The barbershop next to campus accepts walk-ins on most weekdays.
examples.zh: 校园旁的「理发店」大多数工作日可以随到随剪。

words.enDefinition: a place where vehicles are cleaned inside and out

examples.en: The automatic car wash near campus costs twelve dollars per wash.
examples.zh: 学校附近的自动「洗车场」洗一次十二美元。

examples.en: Wash the salt off your car at the car wash in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天要在「洗车场」把车上的融雪盐洗掉。

words.enDefinition: a garage where mechanics fix car problems

examples.en: The auto repair shop quoted me two hundred for new brakes.
examples.zh: 「汽车修理厂」给我换刹车片的报价是两百美元。

examples.en: My roommate recommends the auto repair shop near the stadium.
examples.zh: 我室友推荐体育馆附近那家「汽车修理厂」。

words.enDefinition: a place where drivers refuel their cars

examples.en: Fill up at the gas station off Exit 5 because it's cheaper.
examples.zh: 在五号出口的「加油站」加油，那边更便宜。

examples.en: Most gas stations here let you pay at the pump.
examples.zh: 这里的多数「加油站」可以直接在油泵边刷卡。

words.enDefinition: a rented room for storing personal belongings off-site

examples.en: We rented a storage unit for our stuff over the summer.
examples.zh: 暑假我们把东西放进租的「自助仓库」。

examples.en: A small storage unit costs about sixty dollars a month here.
examples.zh: 这里一个小型「自助仓库」每月大约六十美元。

words.enDefinition: a facility where residents drop off recyclable materials

examples.en: Take your empty bottles to the recycling center on Elm Street.
examples.zh: 把空瓶子送到榆树街的「废品回收站」。

examples.en: The city recycling center accepts electronics on the first Sunday.
examples.zh: 市「废品回收站」每月第一个周日回收电子产品。

collocations: drop off at the recycling center

words.enDefinition: a public building offering local activities and services

examples.en: The community center near my apartment offers free yoga classes.
examples.zh: 我公寓附近的「社区中心」提供免费瑜伽课。

examples.en: We rent a room at the community center for club meetings.
examples.zh: 我们在「社区中心」租了个房间开社团例会。

words.enDefinition: the store area with fresh fruits and vegetables

examples.en: The produce section at our supermarket gets fresh stock every morning.
examples.zh: 我们超市的「蔬果区」每天早上都会上新货。

examples.en: Pick your own vegetables in the produce section near the entrance.
examples.zh: 在入口旁边的「蔬果区」自己挑蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: a passage between shelves in a supermarket

examples.en: Canned tomatoes are in aisle five, next to the pasta.
examples.zh: 番茄罐头在「5号货架通道」，就在意面旁边。

examples.en: Our cart got stuck behind another shopper in a narrow aisle.
examples.zh: 我们的购物车在狭窄的「货架通道」里被别的顾客堵住了。

words.enDefinition: a machine letting shoppers scan and pay without a cashier

examples.en: Most of the self-checkout machines accept cards, coins, and phone payments.
examples.zh: 大多数「自助结账机」都支持刷卡、硬币和手机支付。

examples.en: Use the self-checkout lane if you only bought a few items.
examples.zh: 东西买得少就走「自助结账」通道。

words.enDefinition: the queue where shoppers pay for their items

examples.en: The checkout line gets really long right after work hours.
examples.zh: 下班时间「结账队伍」会排得特别长。

examples.en: We switched to a shorter checkout line near the front.
examples.zh: 我们换到了前面一条更短的「结账队伍」。

words.enDefinition: a wheeled basket for carrying items while shopping

examples.en: Grab a shopping cart because we're buying groceries for the week.
examples.zh: 推一辆「购物车」吧，我们要买一整周的食材。

examples.en: Return the shopping cart to the corral after loading your car.
examples.zh: 装完车要把「购物车」推回停放栏。

words.enDefinition: the service area of a drugstore where prescriptions are filled

examples.en: Ask the pharmacist at the pharmacy counter about drug interactions.
examples.zh: 可以在「药房柜台」向药剂师咨询药物相互作用。

examples.en: Pick up your prescription at the pharmacy counter with your ID.
examples.zh: 带上证件到「药房柜台」取你的处方药。

words.enDefinition: an indoor facility with exercise equipment for workouts

examples.en: The campus gym gets really crowded around six every evening.
examples.zh: 学校「健身房」每天傍晚六点左右特别挤。

examples.en: My membership includes access to any gym in the chain.
examples.zh: 我的会员卡在连锁的任何一家「健身房」都能用。

words.enDefinition: a pool built for swimming and water exercise

examples.en: The hotel swimming pool opens at seven in the morning.
examples.zh: 酒店「游泳池」早上七点开放。

examples.en: Lap swim at the campus swimming pool is free with student ID.
examples.zh: 凭学生证可以免费使用学校「游泳池」的泳道。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor area with swings and slides for children

examples.en: The playground behind our apartment complex finally has new swings.
examples.zh: 我们公寓楼后面的「游乐场」终于装上了新秋千。

examples.en: Kids from the neighborhood gather at the playground after school.
examples.zh: 附近社区的孩子们放学后都聚在「游乐场」。

collocations: take the kids to the playground

words.enDefinition: a fenced park where dogs can play off-leash

examples.en: We take my roommate's dog to the dog park on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我们带室友的狗去「狗狗公园」。

examples.en: The fenced dog park lets dogs run around without leashes.
examples.zh: 这个有围栏的「狗狗公园」可以让狗不拴绳撒欢。

collocations: take your dog to the dog park

words.enDefinition: a court marked for playing basketball

examples.en: The basketball court next to the dorm is free until ten.
examples.zh: 宿舍旁的「篮球场」晚上十点前免费开放。

examples.en: We play pickup games at the park basketball court on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 周六我们在公园的「篮球场」打野球。

words.enDefinition: a room with lockers for changing clothes

examples.en: Leave your bag in the locker room before swim practice.
examples.zh: 游泳训练前把包放进「更衣室」。

examples.en: The locker room showers at the gym were finally fixed last week.
examples.zh: 健身房「更衣室」的淋浴上周终于修好了。

words.enDefinition: a walk-in clinic for non-life-threatening medical problems

examples.en: I twisted my ankle, so I went to urgent care instead of the ER.
examples.zh: 我扭了脚踝，所以去了「急诊门诊」而不是医院急诊室。

examples.en: Urgent care visits usually cost much less than a hospital ER.
examples.zh: 「急诊门诊」的费用通常比医院急诊室低得多。

words.enDefinition: the hospital unit treating sudden serious injuries and illnesses

examples.en: She waited three hours in the emergency room with a broken wrist.
examples.zh: 她手腕骨折，在「急诊室」等了三个小时。

examples.en: Go to the emergency room if the fever won't break.
examples.zh: 如果高烧一直不退，就去「急诊室」。

words.enDefinition: a room where patients or visitors sit before appointments

examples.en: The clinic waiting room was packed, so we waited outside.
examples.zh: 诊所「等候室」挤满了人，我们只好在外面等。

examples.en: Fill out these forms while you sit in the waiting room.
examples.zh: 你坐在「等候室」里时把这些表格填一下。

words.enDefinition: an office that stores items people have misplaced

examples.en: Someone turned my student ID in at the library lost and found.
examples.zh: 有人把我的学生证交到了图书馆「失物招领处」。

examples.en: Check the lost and found in the student union first.
examples.zh: 先去学生会「失物招领处」看看吧。

words.enDefinition: a toilet facility open to everyone in a public place

examples.en: Ask the barista for the key to the public restroom.
examples.zh: 向咖啡师要「公共洗手间」的钥匙。

examples.en: Free public restrooms are available on every floor of the mall.
examples.zh: 商场每一层都有免费的「公共洗手间」。

words.enDefinition: a device in public buildings that provides drinking water

examples.en: Refill your bottle at the water fountain near the stairs.
examples.zh: 在楼梯旁边的「直饮水机」把水瓶灌满。

examples.en: Our hallway water fountain finally has a bottle filling station.
examples.zh: 我们走廊的「直饮水机」终于装上了灌水瓶台。

words.enDefinition: the reception counter where visitors check in

examples.en: Tell the front desk if your room key stops working.
examples.zh: 如果房卡失灵，就告诉「前台」。

examples.en: Leave your package with the front desk if nobody answers.
examples.zh: 没人应门的话，就把包裹交给「前台」代收。

collocations: check in at the front desk

words.enDefinition: a local office where police officers work and take reports

examples.en: Report the stolen bike at the police station with the serial number.
examples.zh: 带上自行车的序列号去「警察局」报失。

examples.en: The police station downtown also runs a neighborhood safety office.
examples.zh: 市中心的「警察局」还设有社区安全办公室。

words.enDefinition: a building where firefighters and fire trucks are based

examples.en: The fire station two blocks away held an open house.
examples.zh: 隔两个街区的「消防站」办了一次开放日活动。

examples.en: Firefighters from the local fire station taught us CPR basics.
examples.zh: 当地「消防站」的消防员教了我们心肺复苏的基础操作。

words.enDefinition: a cinema where films are shown on big screens

examples.en: The movie theater near campus gives discounts on Tuesday nights.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「电影院」周二晚上有优惠。

examples.en: We caught the last show at the movie theater downtown.
examples.zh: 我们在市中心的「电影院」赶上了最后一场。

words.enDefinition: a marked place where buses pick up passengers

examples.en: The bus stop outside the library serves routes 12 and 45.
examples.zh: 图书馆外的「公交车站」停靠12路和45路。

examples.en: Wait at the bus stop because the next bus is due soon.
examples.zh: 在「公交车站」等一下吧，下一班车快到了。

words.enDefinition: a hub where intercity buses arrive and depart

examples.en: The Greyhound bus station downtown is a fifteen-minute walk away.
examples.zh: 市中心的灰狗「长途汽车站」步行十五分钟就到。

examples.en: Buy your ticket online because the bus station closed early.
examples.zh: 网上买票吧，「长途汽车站」提前关门了。

words.enDefinition: an underground stop where passengers board subway trains

examples.en: The subway station nearest my apartment was closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 离我公寓最近的「地铁站」因维修关闭了。

examples.en: Take the escalator down into the subway station and turn left.
examples.zh: 坐扶梯下到「地铁站」，然后左转。

words.enDefinition: a hub where passenger trains arrive and depart

examples.en: We met at the train station an hour before departure.
examples.zh: 我们在「火车站」碰面，比发车早了一个小时。

examples.en: The old train station downtown is now a weekend market.
examples.zh: 市中心的老「火车站」现在变成了周末集市。

words.enDefinition: a main building where passengers board planes or buses

examples.en: International flights leave from the newer terminal, so check your gate.
examples.zh: 国际航班在较新的「航站楼」起飞，出发前确认好登机口。

examples.en: The airport bus stops at every terminal before heading downtown.
examples.zh: 机场大巴在进城前会停靠每一个「航站楼」。

words.enDefinition: a complex where planes take off and land

examples.en: The shuttle to the airport picks up passengers outside the student union.
examples.zh: 去「机场」的班车在学生会大楼外接乘客。

examples.en: Leave for the airport three hours before an international flight.
examples.zh: 坐国际航班要提前三小时出发去「机场」。

words.enDefinition: a marked spot where taxis wait for passengers

examples.en: There is a taxi stand right outside the arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 到达大厅外正好有一个「出租车候客点」。

examples.en: The taxi stand near the hotel charges a flat airport rate.
examples.zh: 酒店旁的「出租车候客点」有去机场的一口价。

words.enDefinition: a multilevel building for parking cars indoors

examples.en: The parking garage under the mall charges five dollars flat.
examples.zh: 商场楼下的「室内停车场」一口价五美元。

examples.en: Keep your ticket because the parking garage validates with store receipts.
examples.zh: 保管好票，因为「室内停车场」凭商店小票能减免停车费。

words.enDefinition: a single marked space where one car parks

examples.en: We circled the block twice before finding a parking spot.
examples.zh: 我们绕了两个街区才找到一个「停车位」。

examples.en: Residents can apply for a reserved parking spot on this street.
examples.zh: 居民可以申请这条街的固定「停车位」。

words.enDefinition: a device that collects payment for street parking

examples.en: Feed the parking meter with coins before you shop downtown.
examples.zh: 去市中心购物前，先往「停车计时器」里投硬币。

examples.en: The parking meter expired, and we got a twenty-dollar ticket.
examples.zh: 「停车计时器」超时了，我们吃了张二十美元的罚单。

words.enDefinition: a road lane reserved for cyclists

examples.en: Always ride in the bike lane, not on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 骑车要待在「自行车道」里，别上人行道。

examples.en: The city added a protected bike lane along University Avenue.
examples.zh: 市里沿大学大道新增了一条带隔离的「自行车道」。

words.enDefinition: a metal frame for parking and securing bicycles

examples.en: Lock your frame to the bike rack, not just the wheel.
examples.zh: 把车架锁在「自行车停放架」上，别只锁车轮。

examples.en: Every dorm entrance has a covered bike rack right outside.
examples.zh: 每栋宿舍门口外面都有带顶棚的「自行车停放架」。

collocations: secure your bike to the rack

words.enDefinition: a marked crossing where pedestrians can safely cross streets

examples.en: Always use the crosswalk and wait for the walking signal.
examples.zh: 过马路一定要走「人行横道」，等行人信号灯亮。

examples.en: In this state, cars must stop for people in the crosswalk.
examples.zh: 在这个州，汽车必须给「人行横道」上的行人让路。

words.enDefinition: a paved path beside a road for pedestrians

examples.en: Biking on the sidewalk downtown is against the city rules.
examples.zh: 在市中心「人行道」上骑车是违反城市规定的。

examples.en: The sidewalk outside our building gets very icy in January.
examples.zh: 我们楼外的「人行道」一月份结冰后非常滑。

words.enDefinition: the point where two streets meet

examples.en: Musicians often perform on the street corner near the square.
examples.zh: 音乐人经常在广场附近的「街角」表演。

examples.en: Meet me on the street corner by the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 我们在校园书店旁的「街角」碰面。

words.enDefinition: the place where two or more roads cross

examples.en: That intersection near campus is dangerous because cars rarely stop.
examples.zh: 校园附近那个「十字路口」很危险，因为车很少让人。

examples.en: Turn right at the next intersection with the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 在下一个有红绿灯的「十字路口」右转。

words.enDefinition: a circular junction where traffic flows around an island

examples.en: When entering a roundabout, yield to traffic already inside it.
examples.zh: 进「环岛」时要让已经在里面的车辆先行。

examples.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout onto Maple Road.
examples.zh: 在「环岛」走第二个出口，进入枫树路。

words.enDefinition: a bridge carrying one road over another

examples.en: The pedestrian overpass over the highway is closed for repairs this month.
examples.zh: 高速公路上方那座行人「高架桥」这个月封闭维修。

examples.en: We got slightly lost under the overpass near the stadium.
examples.zh: 我们在体育馆附近那座「高架桥」下有点迷了路。

words.enDefinition: a path or road passing underneath another road

examples.en: Use the underpass to cross under the busy railway line.
examples.zh: 走「地下通道」从繁忙的铁路下方穿过去。

examples.en: The underpass near campus floods whenever it rains hard for hours.
examples.zh: 校园附近的「地下通道」一下大雨就会积水。

words.enDefinition: a major multilane road with no traffic signals

examples.en: Take the freeway north and get off at the Fourth Street exit.
examples.zh: 上「高速公路」往北开，从第四街出口下来。

examples.en: Freeway traffic jams are worst here between five and seven.
examples.zh: 这里的「高速公路」五点到七点堵得最厉害。

words.enDefinition: a booth where drivers pay to use a road

examples.en: Slow down as you approach the toll booth on the bridge.
examples.zh: 快到桥上的「收费亭」时要减速。

examples.en: Most toll booths on this freeway accept electronic payment only now.
examples.zh: 这条高速的「收费亭」现在大多只支持电子支付。

words.enDefinition: a roadside stop with parking, restrooms, and food

examples.en: Stop at the rest area halfway through the long drive.
examples.zh: 长途开车中途可以在「高速服务区」歇一下。

examples.en: That rest area off Interstate 90 has clean restrooms and coffee.
examples.zh: 90号州际公路旁那个「高速服务区」卫生间干净，还有咖啡卖。

words.enDefinition: a street with no exit at one end

examples.en: Google Maps led us into a dead end behind the factory.
examples.zh: 谷歌地图把我们导进了工厂后面的「死路」。

examples.en: The street sign clearly marks this road as a dead end.
examples.zh: 路牌清楚地标明这条路是「死路」。

words.enDefinition: a street where vehicles may travel in only one direction

examples.en: Careful, this is a one-way street, so you can't turn here.
examples.zh: 小心，这是条「单行道」，不能在这里转弯。

examples.en: Downtown has many narrow one-way streets, so double-check your route.
examples.zh: 市中心有很多狭窄的「单行道」，出发前再核对一遍路线。

words.enDefinition: the central street of a town with shops

examples.en: Almost every American town has a Main Street with local shops.
examples.zh: 几乎每个美国小镇都有一条开着本地小店的「主街」。

examples.en: The Independence Day parade marches down Main Street every July.
examples.zh: 独立日游行每年七月都会沿「主街」行进。

words.enDefinition: a narrow passage between or behind buildings

examples.en: Our building's trash bins are kept in the back alley.
examples.zh: 我们楼的垃圾桶放在后面的「小巷」里。

examples.en: The shortcut runs through a narrow alley behind the shops.
examples.zh: 这条近路穿过商店后面的狭窄「小巷」。

words.enDefinition: the parts of a town farthest from the center

examples.en: Their warehouse apartment sits on the northern outskirts of town.
examples.zh: 他们的改建公寓坐落在城市北面的「市郊」。

examples.en: Rents drop sharply once you reach the outskirts of the city.
examples.zh: 一到城市「市郊」，房租就明显降下来。

words.enDefinition: the area of a town where people live

examples.en: Our neighborhood has a laundry, a park, and two cafes.
examples.zh: 我们「社区」有一家洗衣店、一个公园和两家咖啡馆。

examples.en: It's a quiet neighborhood with mostly students and young families.
examples.zh: 这是个安静的「社区」，住的多是学生和年轻家庭。

words.enDefinition: a district with mostly housing rather than businesses

examples.en: Speed limits drop to twenty-five miles in most residential areas.
examples.zh: 大多数「住宅区」的限速会降到二十五英里每小时。

examples.en: The residential area near campus is walkable and safe at night.
examples.zh: 校园旁边的「住宅区」适合步行，晚上也安全。

words.enDefinition: a city area with mainly offices and shops

examples.en: Internships in the business district usually start at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 「商业区」的实习通常九点整开始。

examples.en: The entire business district empties out completely on weekend evenings.
examples.zh: 周末晚上整个「商业区」几乎完全空了。

words.enDefinition: an open public space at the center of town

examples.en: The annual Christmas tree lighting happens at the town square.
examples.zh: 一年一度的圣诞点灯仪式在「城镇广场」举行。

examples.en: Students gather at the town square for the farmers market.
examples.zh: 学生们聚在「城镇广场」逛农夫市集。

words.enDefinition: the building where local government operates

examples.en: You can register to vote at the city hall downtown.
examples.zh: 你可以到市中心「市政厅」登记成为选民。

examples.en: The square outside city hall hosts free concerts every summer.
examples.zh: 「市政厅」外的广场每年夏天都举办免费音乐会。

words.enDefinition: a famous building or site that marks a place

examples.en: The clock tower is the most famous landmark in town.
examples.zh: 钟楼是这个镇上最有名的「地标」。

examples.en: Use that tall church as a landmark so you don't get lost.
examples.zh: 用那座高高的教堂当「地标」，免得迷路。

words.enDefinition: the outline of tall buildings against the sky

examples.en: You can see the whole skyline from the bridge at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分从桥上能看到整条城市「天际线」。

examples.en: The rooftop terrace overlooks the downtown skyline and the river.
examples.zh: 从屋顶露台能俯瞰「市中心天际线」和河流。

words.enDefinition: a very tall city building with many floors

examples.en: Chicago's skyscrapers look stunning when the evening lights come on.
examples.zh: 傍晚亮灯时，芝加哥的「摩天大楼」美极了。

examples.en: We rode the elevator up a skyscraper for the view.
examples.zh: 我们坐电梯上了一栋「摩天大楼」看风景。

words.enDefinition: a signal controlling vehicle flow at crossings

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic light by the gas station.
examples.zh: 在加油站旁边的「红绿灯」处左转。

examples.en: The traffic light on this street stays green for ages.
examples.zh: 这条街的「红绿灯」绿灯时间特别长。

words.enDefinition: a tall lamp that lights streets at night

examples.en: The old streetlights along this road flicker annoyingly after midnight.
examples.zh: 这条路上的旧「路灯」一过午夜就一闪一闪，很烦人。

examples.en: Wait for me under the streetlight right outside the dorm.
examples.zh: 在宿舍外面那盏「路灯」下等我。

words.enDefinition: a red sign requiring drivers to stop completely

examples.en: Come to a complete stop at every stop sign when driving.
examples.zh: 开车时遇到「停车标志」都要完全停稳再走。

examples.en: The stop sign at this corner is hidden by branches.
examples.zh: 这个路口的「停车标志」被树枝挡住了。

words.enDefinition: a quicker route than the usual way

examples.en: There's a shortcut through the park that saves ten minutes.
examples.zh: 穿过公园有条「近路」，能省十分钟。

examples.en: Don't take that shortcut at night; the lighting is poor.
examples.zh: 晚上别走那条「近路」，灯光太暗了。

words.enDefinition: a lifting cabin that moves people between floors

examples.en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor and turn right.
examples.zh: 坐「电梯」到五楼，然后右转。

examples.en: The elevator in our dormitory building breaks down almost monthly.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼的「电梯」几乎每个月都坏一次。

words.enDefinition: a moving staircase between building floors

examples.en: Stand on the right and walk on the left of the escalator.
examples.zh: 坐「自动扶梯」时靠右站立，把左边留给赶路的人。

examples.en: The mall escalator between floors two and three is broken.
examples.zh: 商场二楼到三楼的「自动扶梯」坏了。

words.enDefinition: a set of stairs inside a building

examples.en: The emergency staircase at the end of the hallway is marked in red.
examples.zh: 走廊尽头的紧急「楼梯」用红色标了出来。

examples.en: Our third-floor walkup apartment has a very narrow wooden staircase.
examples.zh: 我们无电梯的三楼公寓有一段很窄的木「楼梯」。

words.enDefinition: a passage connecting rooms inside a building

examples.en: Your room is the third door down the hallway on the left.
examples.zh: 你的房间在「走廊」左手边第三扇门。

examples.en: Quiet hours apply to the hallways after ten at night.
examples.zh: 晚上十点以后「走廊」里也要保持安静。

words.enDefinition: the floor below ground level in a building

examples.en: Our shared washer and dryer are down in the basement.
examples.zh: 我们公用的洗衣机和烘干机在楼下「地下室」。

examples.en: The basement of our building floods during heavy spring rains.
examples.zh: 春季大雨时我们楼的「地下室」会有点渗水。

words.enDefinition: the storage space directly under a roof

examples.en: Extra winter blankets are stored up in the dusty attic.
examples.zh: 备用的冬被都收在上面落灰的「阁楼」里。

examples.en: My host family turned the attic into a guest room.
examples.zh: 我的寄宿家庭把「阁楼」改成了客房。

words.enDefinition: a raised platform outside an upper-floor window

examples.en: Our tiny balcony fits two chairs and a small table.
examples.zh: 我们的小「阳台」放得下两把椅子和一张小桌子。

examples.en: We usually dry our laundry on the balcony in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我们通常在「阳台」上晾衣服。

words.enDefinition: a covered entrance area outside a house door

examples.en: We sat on the porch and watched the thunderstorm roll in.
examples.zh: 我们坐在「门廊」上，看着雷雨一点点逼近。

examples.en: The delivery driver left my package on the porch this morning.
examples.zh: 快递员今早把我的包裹放在了「门廊」上。

words.enDefinition: the private outdoor area behind a house

examples.en: We grilled burgers in the backyard for Labor Day weekend.
examples.zh: 劳工节周末我们在「后院」烤了汉堡。

examples.en: Their backyard is big enough for a badminton net and chairs.
examples.zh: 他们「后院」够大，能支起羽毛球网和椅子。

words.enDefinition: the grassy area in front of a house

examples.en: Someone on our street planted tulips all over the front yard.
examples.zh: 我们街上一户人家在「前院」种满了郁金香。

examples.en: Keep the front yard tidy because the landlord checks monthly.
examples.zh: 保持「前院」整洁，房东每个月都会检查。

words.enDefinition: a short private road leading to a house garage

examples.en: Pull into the driveway and park right behind my car.
examples.zh: 开进「私家车道」，停在我车正后面。

examples.en: Don't block the driveway because the landlord needs to leave.
examples.zh: 别把「私家车道」堵住，房东要用车出门。

words.enDefinition: the top outer surface of a building

examples.en: Our dorm rooftop has tables with a view of downtown.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍的「天台」摆了桌子，能望见市中心。

examples.en: The apartment rooftop closes at ten pm for safety reasons.
examples.zh: 出于安全考虑，公寓「天台」晚上十点关闭。

words.enDefinition: an open space surrounded by buildings or walls

examples.en: The library's inner courtyard is perfect for reading between classes.
examples.zh: 图书馆的内「庭院」是课间读书的好地方。

examples.en: Every apartment in the complex opens onto the shared courtyard.
examples.zh: 这个小区每套公寓都通向公共「庭院」。

words.enDefinition: very close, just past the next street turn

examples.en: The coffee shop is just around the corner from the dorm.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡店离宿舍很近，就在「拐角附近」。

examples.en: The bus stop is around the corner, next to the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 公交车站就在「拐角处」，紧挨着药房。

words.enDefinition: a short distance of two city blocks

examples.en: The gym is only two blocks away from our apartment.
examples.zh: 健身房离我们公寓只有「两个街区」远。

examples.en: The laundromat is two blocks away, so carrying loads is easy.
examples.zh: 自助洗衣店离这儿只有「两个街区」，把衣服搬过去很轻松。

words.enDefinition: along the route between two places

examples.en: That convenience store is right on the way to the subway station.
examples.zh: 那家便利店就在去地铁站的「路上」。

examples.en: Pick up your package on the way home from class.
examples.zh: 下课回家「顺路」把包裹取了。

words.enDefinition: a short distance along the same street

examples.en: There's a great ramen place just down the street from us.
examples.zh: 就在我们住处「沿街不远处」有一家很棒的拉面店。

examples.en: He lives just down the street from the grocery store.
examples.zh: 他住在杂货店「沿街不远处」。

words.enDefinition: on the opposite side of the road

examples.en: The pharmacy is right across the street from the campus gate.
examples.zh: 药房就在校园大门「马路对面」。

examples.en: Our neighbor across the street sometimes collects our mail for us.
examples.zh: 「马路对面」的邻居有时会帮我们收信。

words.enDefinition: in the very next building or room

examples.en: The girl next door watered our plants while we traveled.
examples.zh: 我们出门旅行时「隔壁」的女孩帮我们浇了花。

examples.en: The little cafe next door always smells like fresh bread.
examples.zh: 「隔壁」的小咖啡店总是飘着面包香。

words.enDefinition: close enough to reach on foot

examples.en: Everything we need is within walking distance of the dorm.
examples.zh: 我们需要的一切都在宿舍「步行可达」的范围内。

examples.en: Is the gym within walking distance, or should we drive?
examples.zh: 「健身房」走着就能到吗，还是我们得开车？

words.enDefinition: far from any town or populated area

examples.en: Our GPS died, and we were in the middle of nowhere.
examples.zh: 导航突然失灵，我们被困在「前不着村后不着店」的地方。

examples.en: The cabin rental looked great but sat in the middle of nowhere.
examples.zh: 那间出租木屋照片里很美，实际上位于「偏僻之地」。

collocations: lost in the middle of nowhere
cabin in the middle of nowhere

words.enDefinition: in a place few tourists or people visit

examples.en: That ramen shop is a bit off the beaten path but worth it.
examples.zh: 那家拉面店位置有点「冷门僻静」，但很值得一去。

examples.en: We found a tiny bookshop off the beaten path in the old town.
examples.zh: 我们在老城区一条「冷门僻静」的小巷里找到一家书店。

words.enDefinition: directly forward in the direction you face

examples.en: Go straight ahead and the library entrance is on your left.
examples.zh: 「一直向前」走，图书馆入口就在你左手边。

examples.en: The restrooms are straight ahead, just past the information desk.
examples.zh: 洗手间「一直向前」走，过了问询台就是。

words.enDefinition: away from home, visiting another city or area

examples.en: My roommate is out of town until late Sunday night.
examples.zh: 我室友「出城在外」，周日深夜才回来。

examples.en: We went out of town for the long weekend to visit Boston.
examples.zh: 长周末我们「出城」去波士顿玩了。

words.enDefinition: in the rear area of a store or building

examples.en: If the shelf is empty, ask staff to check in the back.
examples.zh: 如果货架空了，可以让店员去「后面」仓库找找。

examples.en: The restrooms are in the back, past the frozen food aisle.
examples.zh: 洗手间在店铺「后面」，过了冷冻食品区就是。

collocations: in the back of the store

words.enDefinition: in the area near this place

examples.en: Do you know a good coffee shop somewhere around here?
examples.zh: 你知道「这附近」哪里有不错的咖啡店吗？

examples.en: Finding parking around here is nearly impossible on weekend evenings.
examples.zh: 周末晚上想在「这附近」停车几乎不可能。

words.enDefinition: made mostly or entirely from plant ingredients

examples.en: Plant-based burgers are now stocked next to the regular beef patties.
examples.zh: 「植物基」汉堡现在就摆在普通牛肉饼旁边卖。

examples.en: I follow a mostly plant-based diet during the busy school week.
examples.zh: 上学日我基本坚持「以植物为主」的饮食。

words.enDefinition: seeming reasonable or likely to be true

examples.en: His explanation for the lost package sounded plausible, so I waited one more week.
examples.zh: 他对包裹丢失的解释听着「合理」，我就又等了一周。

examples.en: The tutor offered a plausible reason for the calculus error and walked me through the fix.
examples.zh: 助教对微积分错误给出了「说得通」的解释，还带我一步步改正。

words.enDefinition: A polite direction to stay in this spot

examples.en: A sign reading “Please wait here” stood by the entrance to the smaller room.
examples.zh: 较小房间的入口旁立着一块牌子，上面写着「请在此等候」。

examples.en: The volunteer said, “Please wait here until I check whether the hall is ready.”
examples.zh: 志愿者请我们「在此等候」，他要先看看大厅准备好了没有。

words.enDefinition: as much or as many as you need

examples.en: Don't rush, we still have plenty of time before the bus arrives.
examples.zh: 别急，公交来之前我们的时间还很「充裕」。

examples.en: There's plenty of space in the fridge for your groceries.
examples.zh: 冰箱里的空间很「充裕」，放得下你买的菜。

words.enDefinition: connect a device to the electricity supply

examples.en: Plug in the kettle before you boil the water, please.
examples.zh: 烧水前请先把水壶「插上电源」。

examples.en: My phone died because I forgot to plug it in.
examples.zh: 手机没电了，因为我忘了「插上充电器」。

words.enDefinition: tell someone a fact or mistake they missed

examples.en: He pointed out that we forgot the power adapter again.
examples.zh: 他「指出」我们又忘了带电源转换头。

examples.en: Thank you for pointing out the typo in my message.
examples.zh: 谢谢你「指出」我消息里的错别字。

words.enDefinition: having no useful result, purpose, or effect

examples.en: Cramming at 3 a.m. is pointless; sleep helps your memory more.
examples.zh: 凌晨三点临时抱佛脚「没意义」，睡觉对记忆更有用。

examples.en: It feels pointless to format the bibliography twice, so follow the guide first.
examples.zh: 参考文献排两遍太「白费功夫」，先看好规范再动手。

words.enDefinition: push a finger or object quickly into something

examples.en: Poke a few holes in the plastic wrap before microwaving the leftovers.
examples.zh: 用微波炉热剩菜前，先在保鲜膜上「戳」几个小孔。

examples.en: He poked me in the ribs to ask if the seminar was over.
examples.zh: 他「戳」了戳我的肋骨，问研讨课是不是结束了。

words.enDefinition: a casual top with a collar and short button opening

examples.en: We each wore a polo shirt and dark trousers during our shifts at the registration desk.
examples.zh: 我们去登记台值班时穿「翻领短袖衫」和深色长裤。

examples.en: I packed a polo shirt for the student society dinner after the afternoon game.
examples.zh: 我在包里放了件「翻领短袖衫」，准备下午比赛后去参加社团聚餐。

words.enDefinition: hair gathered and tied at the back of the head

examples.en: I wore my hair in a ponytail so it stayed out of the clay.
examples.zh: 我把头发扎成「马尾辫」，这样就不会碰到黏土。

examples.en: My ponytail flattened against the back of my coat as I leaned against the wall.
examples.zh: 我往墙上一靠，「马尾辫」就压在外套后背上了。

collocations: tie your hair in a ponytail

words.enDefinition: visit somewhere very briefly on the way

examples.en: Pop in to the print shop before class; the queue moves fast.
examples.zh: 上课前「顺路进一下」打印店，队走得快。

examples.en: She popped in for five minutes just to drop off my textbook.
examples.zh: 她「进来待了五分钟」，放下教材就走。

words.enDefinition: leave for a very short time and soon come back

examples.en: I'll pop out for ten minutes to grab my printed essay.
examples.zh: 我「出去十分钟」，取一下打印好的论文。

examples.en: He popped out during the break to call his parents back home.
examples.zh: 课间他「出去一下」，给国内的父母回了个电话。

words.enDefinition: come for a short casual visit

examples.en: Pop over to my room after dinner and I'll debug your code.
examples.zh: 晚饭后「顺路来一趟」我房间，我帮你调代码。

examples.en: He popped over with my borrowed notes just before my quiz.
examples.zh: 小测开始前，他把我借他的笔记「送了过来」。

words.enDefinition: a small window that suddenly appears over what you are viewing

examples.en: A pop-up offered me 20 percent off right when I was about to check out.
examples.zh: 我正要结账，就弹出一个打八折的「弹窗」。

examples.en: Close every pop-up carefully so you do not accidentally agree to something weird.
examples.zh: 关「弹窗」时要小心，别一不小心同意了什么奇怪条款。

words.enDefinition: easy to carry or move from place to place

examples.en: A portable monitor makes group work on the quad actually possible.
examples.zh: 有了「便携」显示器，在草坪上搞小组作业才真正可行。

examples.en: She brought a portable fan to the packed lecture hall.
examples.zh: 她带了台「便携」小风扇去挤满人的阶梯教室。

words.enDefinition: limiting how much food you eat at one time

examples.en: Using smaller plates makes portion control much easier at home.
examples.zh: 用小盘子在家「控制食量」容易多了。

examples.en: The meal planning app taught me the basics of portion control.
examples.zh: 那个饮食计划软件教会了我基础的「分量控制」。

words.enDefinition: Opening times displayed on a sign or notice

examples.en: I checked the posted hours before asking my classmate to meet me there.
examples.zh: 约同学在那里见面之前，我看了「公示的开放时间」。

examples.en: The posted hours on the door were different from the ones on the website.
examples.zh: 门上「公示的开放时间」和网站上的不一样。

words.enDefinition: move something to a later time

examples.en: The professor postponed the quiz until after the reading week.
examples.zh: 教授把测验「推迟」到了阅读周之后。

examples.en: They postponed the career fair because of the storm warning.
examples.zh: 因为风暴预警，招聘会「延期」了。

words.enDefinition: a shared meal where each guest brings one dish

examples.en: Our study group is hosting a potluck before finals start.
examples.zh: 我们学习小组打算在期末前办一场「各带一菜的聚餐」。

examples.en: Sign up on the sheet so our potluck doesn't end up with five desserts.
examples.zh: 在表格上登记你想带的菜，免得这场「聚餐」最后全是甜点。

words.enDefinition: of rain, falling very heavily

examples.en: It is pouring outside, so the intramural game is postponed.
examples.zh: 外面「雨下得很大」，校内联赛只能推迟。

examples.en: By the time we reached the dorm, it was pouring.
examples.zh: 我们走到宿舍时，雨已经「下成了瓢泼」。

words.enDefinition: the button pressed to switch a device on or off

examples.en: Hold the power button and the volume key together to restart your phone.
examples.zh: 同时按住「电源键」和音量键就能重启手机。

examples.en: The power button on my laptop is loose, so I always press it twice.
examples.zh: 我笔记本的「电源键」松了，每次都得按两下。

words.enDefinition: a short daytime sleep that restores energy quickly

examples.en: A twenty-minute power nap between lectures keeps me sharp all afternoon.
examples.zh: 两节课之间「小憩」二十分钟，一下午都精神。

examples.en: Set an alarm so your power nap doesn't turn into two hours.
examples.zh: 设个闹钟，别让「小憩」变成两小时的大睡。

words.enDefinition: easy to foresee exactly what will happen

examples.en: The plot was predictable, but we still enjoyed the film's gorgeous soundtrack.
examples.zh: 剧情「毫无悬念」，但电影的配乐我们依然喜欢。

examples.en: His late replies became so predictable that she stopped waiting by her phone.
examples.zh: 他的回复总是「迟得可以预见」，她干脆不等手机了。

words.enDefinition: a typing feature that suggests whole words as you type

examples.en: Predictive text suggested my professor's full name after I typed it twice.
examples.zh: 「联想输入」在我输过两次后，自动推荐了教授的全名。

examples.en: I type so fast that predictive text guesses entire sentences for me.
examples.zh: 我打字太快，「联想输入」直接帮我猜出整句话。

words.enDefinition: almost completely; nearly

examples.en: I've finished pretty much all of my assignments for this week.
examples.zh: 这周的作业我「基本上」全写完了。

examples.en: The two phone plans cost pretty much the same per month.
examples.zh: 这两个手机套餐每月费用「基本一样」。

words.enDefinition: so valuable that no money can replace it

examples.en: The old photos of my grandparents are priceless, so I back them up in two places.
examples.zh: 祖父母的旧照片「无价」，我存在两个地方做备份。

examples.en: Her advice about internship applications was priceless when I started job hunting.
examples.zh: 我开始找工作时，她给的实习申请建议简直「无价」。

words.enDefinition: costing more than you would like to pay

examples.en: The boba place near campus is pricey, so we go on discount days.
examples.zh: 校门口那家奶茶店「小贵」，所以我们专挑打折日去。

examples.en: Dorm meal plans are pricey compared with cooking with roommates.
examples.zh: 和室友搭伙做饭相比，宿舍的餐饮套餐「偏贵」。

words.enDefinition: make a paper copy of a computer file

examples.en: I need to print out my boarding pass tonight before ten.
examples.zh: 今晚十点前我得把登机牌「打印」出来。

examples.en: She printed out the recipe to keep in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她把菜谱「打印出来」放在厨房备用。

words.enDefinition: in perfect condition with no damage at all

examples.en: The listing promised pristine condition, and the bike really looks it.
examples.zh: 广告说车况「完好如新」，这辆自行车确实如此。

examples.en: Her resale phone was pristine, without a single scratch on the screen.
examples.zh: 她转卖的手机「九九新」，屏幕上一道划痕都没有。

words.enDefinition: achieving a lot within the time available

examples.en: Early mornings at the quiet cafe are my most productive study hours.
examples.zh: 清晨安静的咖啡馆是我学习「效率最高」的时段。

examples.en: It was a productive meeting—we assigned every task and set real deadlines.
examples.zh: 这场会议「卓有成效」：每项任务都分派到人，还定了真正的截止日。

words.enDefinition: the small photo representing you on an app or website

examples.en: She finally changed her profile picture from a cartoon to a real photo.
examples.zh: 她终于把「头像」从卡通图换成了真人照片。

examples.en: I cropped a graduation photo to use as my new profile picture.
examples.zh: 我裁了一张毕业照，用作新的「头像」。

words.enDefinition: a drink mixed from protein powder, usually after workouts

examples.en: He downs a protein shake right after lifting weights at the gym.
examples.zh: 他在健身房练完力量马上喝一杯「蛋白粉奶昔」。

examples.en: I blend my protein shake with banana and a spoon of peanut butter.
examples.zh: 我会在「蛋白奶昔」里加香蕉和一勺花生酱一起打。

words.enDefinition: A building or place provided for public use

examples.en: We used a public facility near the park for our weekend language exchange.
examples.zh: 周末语言交流活动是在公园附近的一处「公共活动设施」举行的。

examples.en: The town turned the old building into a public facility with meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 镇上把这栋旧楼改成了设有会议室的「公共活动设施」。

words.enDefinition: A printer made available for public use

examples.en: I found a public printer in the community centre after leaving my notes at home.
examples.zh: 我把笔记忘在家里，后来在社区中心找到一台「公用打印机」。

examples.en: The volunteer showed me where to collect the pages from the public printer.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看从「公用打印机」哪里取纸。

collocations: a public printer near the desk

words.enDefinition: A place available for people to use together

examples.en: The new public space has tables where students can work between their afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 新开放的「公共空间」里有桌子，学生下午没课时可以在那里学习。

examples.en: We chose a public space near the library so everyone could get there easily.
examples.zh: 我们选了图书馆附近的一处「公共空间」，这样大家都容易到。

words.enDefinition: Wireless internet offered for general public use

examples.en: I connected to the public Wi-Fi to check which room our group had booked.
examples.zh: 我连上「公共无线网」，查看我们小组预约了哪个房间。

examples.en: The sign on the wall gave the name of the public Wi-Fi network.
examples.zh: 墙上的标牌写了「公共无线网」的名称。

words.enDefinition: a small pool of water on the ground

examples.en: I stepped in a puddle on the way to my lecture.
examples.zh: 去上课的路上，我踩进了一个「水坑」。

examples.en: After the thunderstorm, puddles stretched across the whole parking lot.
examples.zh: 雷雨过后，停车场里到处都是「积水洼」。

words.enDefinition: a warm jacket with filling in puffed sections

examples.en: I waited for the bus in my puffer jacket while frost formed on the benches.
examples.zh: 长椅上慢慢结了霜，我穿着「蓬松绗缝保暖外套」等公交。

examples.en: The puffer jacket took up most of the space on my tiny coat hook.
examples.zh: 我那小小的衣钩几乎都被「蓬松绗缝保暖外套」占满了。

words.enDefinition: drive off the road to stop at the side

examples.en: Pull off at the rest area if the rain gets too heavy.
examples.zh: 雨要是太大，就「靠边停进」休息区。

examples.en: The driver pulled off the highway to let the convoy pass.
examples.zh: 司机把车从高速主线「靠边停下」，让车队先过。

collocations: pull off at the rest area

words.enDefinition: drive a car to the roadside and stop

examples.en: He pulled over to the side to check the flat tire safely.
examples.zh: 他把车「停到路边」，安全地检查瘪胎。

examples.en: Let's pull over here and check the route map again.
examples.zh: 我们在这儿「靠边停一下」，再看一遍路线图。

words.enDefinition: stop a vehicle at the side of a road

examples.en: Pull up at the curb for drop-off; don't block the bike lane.
examples.zh: 落客时把车「停」在路缘旁，别挡自行车道。

examples.en: The rideshare pulled up right outside the dorm gate, hazard lights on.
examples.zh: 网约车打着双闪，正好在宿舍门口「停下」。

words.enDefinition: to control your emotions and act normally again

examples.en: Hey, pull yourself together; you still have two finals to go.
examples.zh: 「振作起来」，你还有两门期末要考。

examples.en: She took a deep breath and pulled herself together before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前她深吸一口气，「稳住了自己」。

words.enDefinition: very excited and full of energy for something, informal

examples.en: I'm so pumped for the basketball final against our rivals tonight!
examples.zh: 今晚和死对头打篮球决赛，我「热血沸腾」。

examples.en: Our intramural team was totally pumped after winning the championship.
examples.zh: 赢得校内联赛冠军后，我们队「士气高涨」。

words.enDefinition: move a plan or meeting to a later time

examples.en: They pushed back the department party to avoid the storm.
examples.zh: 系里把聚会「往后推」，避开暴风雨。

examples.en: Can we push back our Thursday meeting by an hour?
examples.zh: 周四的会能「推后」一个小时吗？

words.enDefinition: a short alert an app sends to your lock screen

examples.en: I turned off every push notification from shopping apps to protect my wallet.
examples.zh: 我关掉了购物应用的全部「推送通知」，好守住钱包。

examples.en: You will get a push notification when your laundry is done.
examples.zh: 衣服洗好后，你会收到一条「推送通知」。

words.enDefinition: trying too hard to make people do what you want

examples.en: The salesman got pushy when I said I was just looking around.
examples.zh: 我说只是随便看看，销售就开始「强人所难」。

examples.en: Some club recruiters are way too pushy during welcome week.
examples.zh: 迎新周有些社团招新的同学特别「咄咄逼人」，让人反感。

words.enDefinition: return something to its usual storage place

examples.en: Put away your clothes before you start playing video games.
examples.zh: 打游戏之前先把衣服「收好」。

examples.en: Remember to put away the groceries as soon as we get home.
examples.zh: 到家后记得把采购的东西「收纳」好。

words.enDefinition: sit back and rest after working hard

examples.en: After moving boxes all afternoon, I put my feet up with a show.
examples.zh: 搬了一下午箱子，我「歇着脚」看了会儿剧。

examples.en: Put your feet up for ten minutes, then we'll clean the kitchen.
examples.zh: 先「歇十分钟」，然后我们再收拾厨房。

collocations: put my feet up on the couch
sit down and put your feet up
put my feet up after class

words.enDefinition: tie your hair back with a band or clip

examples.en: I put my hair up when I'm cooking so it stays out of the way.
examples.zh: 做饭的时候我会「把头发扎起来」，免得碍事。

examples.en: Put your hair up before you wash your face at the sink.
examples.zh: 在水池边洗脸之前，先「把头发扎起来」。

collocations: put my hair up in a bun
put your hair up before bed

words.enDefinition: delay doing something, usually again and again

examples.en: I keep putting off my laundry until the basket overflows.
examples.zh: 我总「拖着」不洗衣服，直到篮子堆满。

examples.en: Don't put off booking your driving test; slots go fast.
examples.zh: 别「拖延」驾照考试的预约，名额很快就没了。

words.enDefinition: place a piece of clothing or glasses onto your body

examples.en: Put on a jacket before you go out tonight, it's cold.
examples.zh: 今晚出门前「穿上」外套，外面很冷。

examples.en: He put on his glasses to read the small print.
examples.zh: 他「戴上」眼镜看那些小字。

words.enDefinition: build something by joining its separate parts

examples.en: It took us two hours to put together the new bookshelf.
examples.zh: 我们花了两个小时才把新书架「组装」好。

examples.en: Can you help me put together this desk I bought online?
examples.zh: 你能帮我「拼装」这张网上买的桌子吗？

words.enDefinition: to accept an unpleasant situation without complaining

examples.en: I can't put up with my roommate's 2 a.m. alarm anymore.
examples.zh: 我再也「受不了」室友凌晨两点的闹钟了。

examples.en: We've put up with the construction noise all semester long.
examples.zh: 整个学期我们都在「忍受」施工的噪音。

words.enDefinition: a square pattern you scan with a phone camera to open something

examples.en: Scan the QR code on the poster to join the club's group chat.
examples.zh: 扫描海报上的「二维码」就能加入社团群聊。

examples.en: The restaurant has a QR code on the table instead of paper menus.
examples.zh: 餐厅桌上放的是「二维码」，没有纸质菜单。

collocations: a QR code on the poster

words.enDefinition: feeling slightly sick in the stomach

examples.en: The long bus ride on mountain roads left me feeling queasy.
examples.zh: 山路大巴坐下来，我有点「恶心想吐」。

examples.en: I felt queasy after eating that leftover sushi from last night.
examples.zh: 吃了昨晚剩的寿司之后，我一直觉得「恶心」。

words.enDefinition: to drink something that stops you feeling thirsty

examples.en: Nothing quenches your thirst like iced water after a long run.
examples.zh: 长跑之后，没有什么比冰水更「解渴」的了。

examples.en: Sports drinks are designed to quench your thirst after long workouts.
examples.zh: 运动饮料专为长时间锻炼后「止渴」而设计。

words.enDefinition: probably not honest, good, or reliable

examples.en: The secondhand seller's answer about the cracked screen was questionable, so I walked away.
examples.zh: 二手卖家对屏幕裂缝的解释「有问题」，我扭头就走。

examples.en: His claim that the deposit was nonrefundable seemed questionable, so we reread the lease.
examples.zh: 他说押金一律不退，这点「存疑」，我们又把租约读了一遍。

words.enDefinition: A barrier used to guide a queue

examples.en: The queue barrier curved around the corner so people could still use the stairs.
examples.zh: 「排队隔栏」绕过拐角，这样人们还可以走楼梯。

examples.en: The volunteer moved the queue barrier a little farther from the front doors.
examples.zh: 志愿者把「排队隔栏」往离大门稍远的地方挪了一点。

words.enDefinition: A sign marking where people should start queuing

examples.en: The sign said “Queue starts here” next to the rope beside the wall.
examples.zh: 墙边的绳子旁有块牌子，上面写着「请从此处排队」。

examples.en: I looked for “Queue starts here” because two groups were waiting by the door.
examples.zh: 门边有两群人在等，我就找写着「请从此处排队」的牌子。

collocations: a floor sticker reading “Queue starts here”
mark the spot with “Queue starts here”

words.enDefinition: becoming dry again in a short time

examples.en: I packed a quick-drying shirt because we were spending the afternoon at the lake.
examples.zh: 下午要在湖边玩，所以我带了件「快干的」衬衫。

examples.en: The quick-drying socks were handy on the field trip after we got caught in rain.
examples.zh: 实地考察时我们遇上了雨，「快干的」袜子派上了用场。

words.enDefinition: An area where people are expected to make little noise

examples.en: I took my phone into the hallway because we were sitting in a quiet area.
examples.zh: 我们坐的是「安静区」，所以我拿着手机去了走廊。

examples.en: The sign by the stairs showed which part of the building was a quiet area.
examples.zh: 楼梯旁的告示标出了楼里哪片是「安静区」。

words.enDefinition: a fairly large amount of something

examples.en: I saved quite a bit of money by cooking instead of eating out.
examples.zh: 自己做饭而不下馆子，我省了「不少」钱。

examples.en: She travels quite a bit for her part-time marketing job.
examples.zh: 因为兼职做市场工作，她要跑「不少」地方。

words.enDefinition: a fairly large number of things or people

examples.en: Quite a few students failed the first physics quiz this term.
examples.zh: 这学期「相当多」学生第一次物理测验没及格。

examples.en: I know quite a few people who work at the campus coffee shop.
examples.zh: 我认识「相当多」在校内咖啡店打工的人。

words.enDefinition: to some degree; fairly

examples.en: The campus gym is quite crowded right after five p.m.
examples.zh: 下午五点过后，健身房「相当」拥挤。

examples.en: Her presentation was quite impressive for someone so new to debating.
examples.zh: 对辩论新手来说，她的表现「相当」出色。

words.enDefinition: whatever the weather is like

examples.en: The Saturday flea market runs every weekend, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 周六跳蚤市场每周都开，「风雨无阻」。

examples.en: I jog around the lake every morning, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 我每天早上绕湖跑步，「风雨无阻」。

words.enDefinition: force an event to be canceled because of rain

examples.en: The baseball final got rained out and moved to Sunday.
examples.zh: 棒球决赛「因雨取消」，改到周日举行。

examples.en: Our field trip was rained out, so we met in the lab instead.
examples.zh: 我们的实地考察「被雨搅了」，改在实验室碰头。

words.enDefinition: a loose waterproof covering worn over the shoulders and body

examples.en: I packed a rain poncho because the campus concert was going ahead outdoors.
examples.zh: 校园音乐会照常在室外举行，我就带了件「雨披」。

examples.en: The rain poncho covered my backpack when I walked from the station to residence.
examples.zh: 我从车站走回宿舍时，「雨披」把背包也罩住了。

words.enDefinition: the time of year with the most rain

examples.en: The rainy season here lasts from June to early August.
examples.zh: 这里的「雨季」从六月持续到八月初。

examples.en: Keep a folding umbrella in your backpack during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 「雨季」期间，记得在背包里放把折叠伞。

words.enDefinition: care for children until they are adults

examples.en: My grandparents raised me while my parents worked in another city.
examples.zh: 父母在外地工作时，是爷爷奶奶把我「抚养」大的。

examples.en: Raising three kids on a small shop's income took real discipline.
examples.zh: 靠小店的收入「抚养」三个孩子，需要极强的自律。

words.enDefinition: not often; almost never

examples.en: I rarely manage to eat breakfast before my eight a.m. class.
examples.zh: 早八课之前我「很少」来得及吃早餐。

examples.en: The dining hall rarely runs out of pizza on Fridays.
examples.zh: 周五食堂「很少」把披萨卖完。

words.enDefinition: to a noticeable degree; fairly

examples.en: The walk to the far lecture hall is rather long in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天走去远端教学楼的路「颇为」漫长。

examples.en: I found the reading list for this course rather confusing at first.
examples.zh: 起初我觉得这门课的阅读清单「颇为」费解。

words.enDefinition: instead of the thing mentioned

examples.en: I take the stairs rather than wait for the crowded elevator.
examples.zh: 我走楼梯「而不是」去等拥挤的电梯。

examples.en: We cooked at home rather than eating out this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我们在家做饭，「没」下馆子。

words.enDefinition: to contact someone for help or emotional support

examples.en: Please reach out if coursework ever starts to overwhelm you.
examples.zh: 如果课业让你喘不过气，请随时「向我求助」。

examples.en: She reached out to the counseling center during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周她主动「联系」了心理咨询中心。

words.enDefinition: An entrance at the back of a building

examples.en: The rear entrance opens onto the courtyard where volunteers unload chairs for events.
examples.zh: 「后门」通向院子，志愿者在那里卸下活动用的椅子。

examples.en: I found the rear entrance by following the paved path past the garden.
examples.zh: 我沿着铺好的路走过花园，找到了「后门」。

collocations: a sign at the rear entrance

words.enDefinition: to change the positions or order of a group of things

examples.en: We wanted to rearrange the chairs so we could all see the screen.
examples.zh: 我们想「重新摆放」椅子，让所有人都看得到屏幕。

examples.en: I helped rearrange the books after we cleared some space on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我们在架子上腾出空间后，我帮忙把书「重新摆放」。

collocations: rearrange the chairs in a circle

words.enDefinition: to rest so that your energy and good mood return

examples.en: I spent the whole weekend offline to recharge before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前我整个周末都不上网，好好「充电」。

examples.en: A short nap at the library recharges me between classes.
examples.zh: 课间在图书馆小睡一会儿，帮我「恢复精力」。

words.enDefinition: able to be refilled with power and reused

examples.en: I switched to rechargeable batteries for my mouse and keyboard.
examples.zh: 鼠标键盘的电池，我换成了「可充电」的。

examples.en: Pack rechargeable batteries for the trip; the campsite shop charges a fortune.
examples.zh: 出行带上「充电电池」，营地商店的价钱贵得离谱。

words.enDefinition: doing dangerous things without thinking about the results

examples.en: Cycling down that hill with no brakes was honestly pretty reckless.
examples.zh: 骑没闸的自行车冲下那个坡，说实话挺「鲁莽」的。

examples.en: He was reckless with his credit card during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周那会儿他刷信用卡毫无节制，太「鲁莽」了。

words.enDefinition: link to the network again after losing connection

examples.en: The dorm wifi logs everyone out, and you must reconnect each morning.
examples.zh: 宿舍WiFi会把所有人登出，每天早上都得「重新连接」。

examples.en: Reconnect your earbuds by putting them back in the case for five seconds.
examples.zh: 把耳机放回充电盒五秒钟，就能「重新连接」。

words.enDefinition: put used glass, paper, or plastic out for reuse

examples.en: Recycle the cardboard boxes right away; they block the whole hallway otherwise.
examples.zh: 纸箱要及时「回收」，不然会把整条走廊都堵住。

examples.en: Our dorm recycles batteries at the front desk every month.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼每个月在前台「回收」电池。

words.enDefinition: A place with separate bins for recyclable materials

examples.en: I carried the empty cans to the recycling station outside the community hall.
examples.zh: 我把空罐拿到社区活动大厅外面的「垃圾分类回收点」。

examples.en: The recycling station had pictures showing which bins were for paper and bottles.
examples.zh: 「垃圾分类回收点」有图示，标明哪些桶收纸张、哪些收瓶子。

words.enDefinition: A schedule in which a place opens for less time

examples.en: The hall had reduced opening hours while most of the volunteers were away.
examples.zh: 大部分志愿者不在时，大厅按「缩短后的开放时间」开放。

examples.en: I checked the reduced opening hours before planning our evening reading group that week.
examples.zh: 安排那周晚上的读书小组活动前，我核对了「缩短后的开放时间」。

collocations: reduced opening hours during the holidays

words.enDefinition: to fold something again, often to change its size or shape

examples.en: I had to refold the map because it would not fit in my pocket.
examples.zh: 地图塞不进口袋，所以我得「重新折叠」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped me refold the blanket so it fit on the shelf.
examples.zh: 室友帮我把毯子「重新折叠」，好放上架。

words.enDefinition: reload a page so it shows the newest content

examples.en: Refresh the page after you pay, or the order will look unfinished.
examples.zh: 付款后记得「刷新」页面，不然订单看起来像是没完成。

examples.en: I keep refreshing the grades page, but the professor has not posted them yet.
examples.zh: 我不停「刷新」成绩页面，可教授还没发布。

words.enDefinition: making you feel fresh and less tired

examples.en: An iced americano is so refreshing before a two-hour statistics lecture.
examples.zh: 上两小时的统计课前，一杯冰美式特别「提神」。

examples.en: The lake water was freezing but incredibly refreshing after the run.
examples.zh: 湖水冰凉，跑完步跳进去却「无比清爽」。

words.enDefinition: able to be paid back if you cancel

examples.en: Book a refundable train ticket in case the seminar moves.
examples.zh: 讨论课可能改时间，先订「可退」的火车票吧。

examples.en: The deposit is refundable if the walls have no new holes.
examples.zh: 只要墙面没有新钉孔，押金是「可退」的。

words.enDefinition: to warm cooked food again before eating

examples.en: You can reheat the pizza in the microwave for thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 把披萨放进微波炉「加热」三十秒就行。

examples.en: Reheat the leftover rice with a splash of water to keep it soft.
examples.zh: 「加热」剩饭时加一点点水，米饭才会保持松软。

words.enDefinition: easy to connect with from your own life

examples.en: Her blog about first-year visa struggles is relatable for almost every international student.
examples.zh: 她写的第一年签证波折博客，几乎每个留学生都「有共鸣」。

examples.en: The speaker shared relatable stories about failing his driving test three straight times.
examples.zh: 演讲者连挂三次驾照考试的经历让大家特别「有代入感」。

words.enDefinition: calm and free from worry or tension

examples.en: I felt so relaxed after the hot spring trip with friends.
examples.zh: 和朋友们泡完温泉回来，我「放松」极了。

examples.en: She looked completely relaxed and confident during her thesis defense.
examples.zh: 答辩全程她都显得十分「放松」、自信。

words.enDefinition: the happy feeling when something bad ends or is avoided

examples.en: Finishing my last final brought instant relief and a long nap.
examples.zh: 考完最后一科，我顿时感到「如释重负」，补了个长觉。

examples.en: It was such a relief to hear my package wasn't lost.
examples.zh: 听说包裹没有丢，真是「如释重负」。

words.enDefinition: happy that something bad ended or did not happen

examples.en: I was so relieved when the professor postponed the quiz.
examples.zh: 教授推迟测验时，我「如释重负」。

examples.en: She felt deeply relieved after finally submitting her thesis draft.
examples.zh: 终于交上论文初稿后，她深感「松了一口气」。

words.enDefinition: to put things into a bag or container again, often in a different arrangement

examples.en: I had to repack my bag after remembering the shoes for tomorrow's practice.
examples.zh: 想起明天训练还要带鞋后，我只好「重新打包」。

examples.en: We needed to repack the boxes after one of them split at the bottom.
examples.zh: 有个纸箱底部裂了，我们需要「重新打包」。

words.enDefinition: answer the sender and everyone else on the email

examples.en: Do not reply all to the professor's announcement; the whole class sees it.
examples.zh: 教授发的通知别「回复全部」，全班都看得见。

examples.en: Someone replied all with a meme, and the thread grew to eighty emails.
examples.zh: 有人「回复全部」发了个梗图，邮件串涨到八十封。

words.enDefinition: to read something that you have already read one more time

examples.en: I had to reread the message because I missed the last sentence.
examples.zh: 我漏看了最后一句，所以得把消息「再读一遍」。

examples.en: I took a minute to reread the instructions before opening the form.
examples.zh: 打开表格之前，我花了一分钟把说明「再读一遍」。

words.enDefinition: arrange something for a different time

examples.en: Can we reschedule our study session to Thursday evening instead?
examples.zh: 我们的学习小组能「改到」周四晚上吗？

examples.en: I rescheduled my dentist appointment because it clashed with my seminar.
examples.zh: 我「重新约了」牙医的时间，因为和研讨课冲突了。

words.enDefinition: to close a package or container so that its opening is sealed again

examples.en: I used the plastic strip to reseal the bag after pouring out the oats.
examples.zh: 倒出燕麦后，我用塑料封条把袋子「重新封好」。

examples.en: I forgot to reseal the packet before putting it back in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我忘了先把袋子「重新封好」，就放回了柜子。

words.enDefinition: an angry, bitter feeling after being treated unfairly

examples.en: Quiet resentment built up as I always cleaned the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 公共厨房总是我在打扫，「怨气」慢慢积了起来。

examples.en: She hid her resentment when her teammate took all the credit.
examples.zh: 队友抢走了全部功劳，她把「不满」埋在心里。

words.enDefinition: to put something back into a pile or make a new pile from it
