examples.zh: 一位「给予支持的」室友能让想家的日子好过得多。

words.enDefinition: give one thing and receive another in return

examples.en: Want to swap shifts? I'll take your Tuesday if you cover my Friday.
examples.zh: 要不要「换」班？你替我周五，我替你周二。

examples.en: We swapped our textbooks instead of each buying a secondhand copy.
examples.zh: 我们没有各自买二手书，而是把课本「交换」着用。

words.enDefinition: a knitted top worn for warmth, often pulled over the head

examples.en: I keep a sweater in my locker for afternoons when the seminar room gets cold.
examples.zh: 下午研讨课教室有时很冷，所以我在储物柜里放了件「毛衣」。

examples.en: The sweater was warm enough for our walk back across campus after the film.
examples.zh: 电影散场后，这件「毛衣」够暖，穿着走回校园另一头也不冷。

words.enDefinition: soft casual trousers made of thick sweatshirt material

examples.en: I stayed in sweatpants all morning while I worked on the presentation in my room.
examples.zh: 我一上午都穿着「厚软运动裤」在房间里做演示稿。

examples.en: The sweatpants were warm enough for sitting outside after our early morning sports session.
examples.zh: 清早的运动课结束后，在外面坐着穿「厚软运动裤」也够暖。

words.enDefinition: a warm casual pullover made from thick soft fabric

examples.en: I grabbed a sweatshirt on my way out because the library gets chilly after dark.
examples.zh: 我出门时随手拿了件「卫衣」，图书馆天黑后有点冷。

examples.en: My roommate recognized the sweatshirt from the small logo on its left sleeve.
examples.zh: 室友从左袖上的小标志认出了那件「卫衣」。

words.enDefinition: covered in sweat or making you sweat

examples.en: Biking across campus to my seminar left me completely sweaty.
examples.zh: 骑车横穿校园去上讨论课，到教室时我已「满身是汗」。

examples.en: Ten minutes on the treadmill leaves me sweaty because the gym AC is weak.
examples.zh: 这家健身房空调太弱，跑步机上十分钟我就「汗流浃背」。

words.enDefinition: clean dust off the floor with a broom

examples.en: Please sweep the floor after you trim your hair in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 你在卫生间剪完头发之后，记得「扫地」。

examples.en: I swept the floor twice this week; it keeps getting sandy.
examples.zh: 这周我已经「扫了两遍地」，还是总感觉有沙子。

collocations: sweep the floor with a broom

words.enDefinition: a lasting liking for sweet foods and desserts

examples.en: I have a serious sweet tooth, so dessert tables are dangerous for me.
examples.zh: 我特别「爱吃甜食」，所以甜品区对我来说很危险。

examples.en: Everyone in my host family has a sweet tooth except the dad.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭里除了爸爸，人人「爱吃甜食」。

words.enDefinition: short trousers worn for swimming

examples.en: I packed swim trunks and a towel for the residence trip to the pool.
examples.zh: 宿舍集体去游泳池，我带上了「泳裤」和毛巾。

examples.en: My swim trunks were still damp when I got back from the campus pool.
examples.zh: 从学校游泳池回来时，我的「泳裤」还是潮的。

words.enDefinition: visit a place briefly on the way somewhere else

examples.en: I'll swing by the pharmacy after my lecture to pick up the prescription.
examples.zh: 下课后我会「顺路去趟」药房取处方药。

examples.en: Swing by my dorm if you want the borrowed charger back today.
examples.zh: 想今天拿回借的充电器，就「顺路过一下」我宿舍。

collocations: swing by on your way home

words.enDefinition: move a finger quickly across a screen or card reader

examples.en: Swipe left to see more photos of the dorm room.
examples.zh: 往左「滑动」可以看更多宿舍房间的照片。

examples.en: Just swipe your student card at the gate and walk through.
examples.zh: 在大门口「刷」一下学生卡就能进去。

words.enDefinition: the feeling of being sorry for someone with problems

examples.en: I have a lot of sympathy for first-year students during finals.
examples.zh: 我很「同情」期末周里的大一新生。

examples.en: He sent flowers as a gesture of sympathy after her loss.
examples.zh: 她遭遇不幸后，他送上鲜花以表「慰问」。

words.enDefinition: make the same data appear on all your devices

examples.en: Sync your calendar so the group schedule shows on your phone too.
examples.zh: 把日历「同步」一下，小组日程在手机上也能看。

examples.en: My notes didn't sync between my laptop and my tablet last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我的笔记在笔记本和平板之间没「同步」成功。

words.enDefinition: a casual collarless top usually with short sleeves

examples.en: I wore a T-shirt to the club picnic because the afternoon was still warm.
examples.zh: 下午还挺暖和，我穿着「T恤」去参加了社团野餐。

examples.en: The T-shirt from last year's campus run is still my favorite thing to sleep in.
examples.zh: 去年校园跑活动发的「T恤」还是我最喜欢穿着睡觉的衣服。

words.enDefinition: a single open page inside the browser window

examples.en: I opened a tab for every source my essay needs, and now my laptop is dying.
examples.zh: 论文要用的每份文献我都开了个「标签页」，电脑快撑不住了。

examples.en: Close that tab with the concert tickets until after your midterm.
examples.zh: 先关掉那个卖演唱会门票的「标签页」，等期中考完再说。

words.enDefinition: a flat touch-screen device bigger than a phone, smaller than a laptop

examples.en: I read lecture slides on my tablet instead of printing them out.
examples.zh: 我用「平板电脑」看课件，省得打印出来。

examples.en: My roommate takes notes on a tablet with a stylus during lectures.
examples.zh: 室友上课时用「平板电脑」加触控笔记笔记。

words.enDefinition: looking cheap and showing poor taste

examples.en: The club's neon banner is a bit tacky, but it photographs well.
examples.zh: 社团那条霓虹横幅有点「俗」，但拍照效果不错。

examples.en: Glitter phone cases felt tacky in high school, yet here I am.
examples.zh: 亮片手机壳高中时我觉得挺「土」，结果现在真香。

words.enDefinition: to accompany people who already have plans to go somewhere

examples.en: I asked if I could tag along when my roommates went shopping.
examples.zh: 室友们去购物时，我问能不能「跟着一起去」。

examples.en: We told our classmate she could tag along on the walk home.
examples.zh: 我们告诉同学，步行回家时她可以「跟着一起去」。

words.enDefinition: wash yourself by sitting in a tub of water

examples.en: After a week of exams, I just want to take a hot bath.
examples.zh: 考完一整周的试，我只想「泡个热水澡」。

examples.en: Most dorms only have showers, so I take a bath when I visit home.
examples.zh: 宿舍大多只有淋浴，所以我回家时才「泡澡」。

collocations: take a hot bath before bed

words.enDefinition: stop working for a short time to rest

examples.en: You've been studying for hours, so take a break now.
examples.zh: 你已经连着学好几个小时了，现在「休息一下」吧。

examples.en: Let's take a coffee break between our two morning lectures.
examples.zh: 上午两节课之间我们「歇一下」，喝杯咖啡。

words.enDefinition: sleep for a short time during the day

examples.en: I take a nap after lunch to survive the afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 午饭后我会「小睡一会儿」，好撑过下午的课。

examples.en: He took a twenty-minute nap before his evening shift today.
examples.zh: 今天上晚班之前他「打了个盹」，睡了二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: politely postpone an invitation to a later time

examples.en: I have a lab report tonight, so can I take a rain check?
examples.zh: 今晚我要赶实验报告，能不能「改天再约」？

examples.en: She took a rain check on dinner but suggested Sunday instead.
examples.zh: 她把晚餐「改约到下次」，提议改到周日。

words.enDefinition: capture a picture of whatever is showing on the screen

examples.en: Take a screenshot of the confirmation page in case the website crashes later.
examples.zh: 把确认页面「截屏」保存下来，以防网站待会儿崩溃。

examples.en: I always take a screenshot of my grades before the portal updates again.
examples.zh: 在教务系统再次更新前，我总会先「截屏」保存成绩。

words.enDefinition: wash your body under running water

examples.en: I take a shower right after I finish at the gym.
examples.zh: 我在健身房练完就「洗澡」。

examples.en: Wait for the water to get warm before you take a shower.
examples.zh: 等水热了再「洗澡」。

words.enDefinition: resemble an older family member in looks or character

examples.en: Everyone says I take after my mom, especially her stubborn streak.
examples.zh: 大家都说我「随我妈」，尤其是那股倔劲。

examples.en: Do you take after your father's side or your mother's side?
examples.zh: 你「随」爸爸这边还是妈妈这边？

words.enDefinition: return a purchase to the store

examples.en: This jacket is too small, so I'll take it back tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这件夹克太小了，我明天拿去「退掉」。

examples.en: You need the receipt if you take the shoes back.
examples.zh: 「退鞋」的话需要出示收据。

collocations: take an item back to the store

words.enDefinition: look after a person, pet, or task

examples.en: Can you take care of my cat this weekend while I'm away?
examples.zh: 这周末我不在，你能帮我「照顾」我的猫吗？

examples.en: I'll take care of the groceries while you cook dinner.
examples.zh: 你做晚饭，采购的事我来「打理」。

words.enDefinition: to take much longer than expected

examples.en: The campus laundromat always seems to take forever on Sunday evenings.
examples.zh: 周日晚上校内自助洗衣店总是「慢得要命」。

examples.en: Waiting for the dorm elevator takes forever during morning rush.
examples.zh: 早高峰等宿舍电梯「要等好久」。

words.enDefinition: to relax and stop pushing yourself so hard

examples.en: You should take it easy this weekend; you've studied enough.
examples.zh: 这周末「放轻松」，现阶段你复习得够多了。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take it easy after the flu.
examples.zh: 流感之后，医生叮嘱我「放轻松」，别太累。

collocations: take it easy for a while
told me to take it easy

words.enDefinition: remove a piece of clothing or your shoes

examples.en: Take off your wet coat before you catch a cold.
examples.zh: 把湿外套「脱掉」，免得感冒。

examples.en: We take off our shoes at the door in this apartment.
examples.zh: 这间公寓进门要「脱鞋」。

words.enDefinition: carry something from inside a building to outside

examples.en: It's your turn to take out the trash; the bag is already tied.
examples.zh: 轮到你「倒」垃圾了，垃圾袋已经系好了。

examples.en: I take out the recycling every Tuesday before my nine o'clock lecture.
examples.zh: 每周二九点的课前，我都会把回收物「拿出去」。

words.enDefinition: carry the garbage bags outside to the bin

examples.en: It's your turn to take out the trash tonight after dinner.
examples.zh: 今晚吃完饭轮到你「倒垃圾」。

examples.en: I'll take out the trash before the collection truck arrives.
examples.zh: 垃圾车来之前我会去「倒垃圾」。

collocations: take the trash out after dinner

words.enDefinition: choose to support one person in a dispute

examples.en: When my two roommates argue, I refuse to take sides.
examples.zh: 两个室友吵架时，我拒绝「站队」。

examples.en: Parents shouldn't take sides when their kids quarrel over toys.
examples.zh: 孩子们为玩具争吵时，父母不该「偏袒任何一方」。

words.enDefinition: To go up or down using the stairs

examples.en: We decided to take the stairs because we only needed to go up one floor.
examples.zh: 我们只需要上一层，就决定「走楼梯」。

examples.en: I asked whether visitors could take the stairs from the hall into the garden.
examples.zh: 我问访客能不能从大厅「走楼梯」到花园里。

collocations: take the stairs to the next floor

words.enDefinition: travel by underground train in a city

examples.en: I take the subway to campus because parking costs too much.
examples.zh: 我去学校都「坐地铁」，因为停车费太贵。

examples.en: We took the subway downtown and got there in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我们「坐地铁」去市中心，二十分钟就到了。

words.enDefinition: do something one after another in order

examples.en: My roommate and I take turns taking out the trash every week.
examples.zh: 我和室友每周「轮流」倒垃圾。

examples.en: We took turns doing the dishes so it felt fair to both of us.
examples.zh: 我们「轮流」洗碗，这样对两个人都公平。

words.enDefinition: start a new hobby or activity

examples.en: I took up badminton to make new friends this year.
examples.zh: 今年我为了交新朋友「开始打」羽毛球。

examples.en: She wants to take up photography as a hobby this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天她想「开始学」摄影，培养个爱好。

words.enDefinition: to help you stop thinking about something worrying

examples.en: Our Friday board game nights take my mind off upcoming deadlines.
examples.zh: 周五的桌游之夜让我「暂时忘掉」临近的截止日期。

examples.en: Cooking takes her mind off the stress of job hunting.
examples.zh: 做饭能让她「不去想」找工作的压力。

collocations: a good way to take your mind off

words.enDefinition: do something slowly and carefully, without rushing

examples.en: Take your time with the form; the deadline is next month.
examples.zh: 表格你「慢慢来」，截止日期在下个月。

examples.en: There is no rush, so take your time and double-check the figures.
examples.zh: 不着急，「慢慢来」，把数字再核对一遍。

words.enDefinition: suddenly surprised and momentarily unsure how to respond

examples.en: I was taken aback when the tutor invited me to lead the discussion.
examples.zh: 导师请我主持讨论时，我「愣了一下」。

examples.en: My friend seemed taken aback by the question about her hometown.
examples.zh: 朋友听到关于她老家的问题时，好像「愣了一下」。

collocations: be taken aback by a question

words.enDefinition: discuss someone negatively when they are not present

examples.en: It hurts when classmates talk behind your back about your grades.
examples.zh: 同学「背后议论」你的成绩，让人很难受。

examples.en: I'd rather hear criticism directly than have friends talk behind my back.
examples.zh: 我宁愿听直接的批评，也不愿朋友「在背后议论我」。

words.enDefinition: enjoying talking a lot with other people

examples.en: Our talkative taxi driver shared his whole life story on the ride.
examples.zh: 我们那位「健谈的」出租车司机一路讲完了自己的人生故事。

examples.en: The talkative guy in my dorm makes silence impossible at meetings.
examples.zh: 宿舍里那位「话多的」同学让会议根本安静不下来。

words.enDefinition: a sleeveless top with straps over the shoulders

examples.en: I wore a tank top under my shirt because the lecture hall gets warm.
examples.zh: 我在衬衫里穿了件「无袖背心」，因为阶梯教室里会变热。

examples.en: She changed into a tank top before joining the group for badminton in the garden.
examples.zh: 加入大家在花园打羽毛球前，她换上了一件「无袖背心」。

collocations: layer a jacket over a tank top

words.enDefinition: water that comes from the kitchen faucet

examples.en: In this city, tap water is safe to drink straight from the faucet.
examples.zh: 这座城市的「自来水」可以直接喝。

examples.en: Can I just get tap water? I don't need bottled.
examples.zh: 我可以要「自来水」吗？不用瓶装水。

words.enDefinition: showing good judgment of style and beauty

examples.en: They decorated the tiny studio with tasteful string lights and two framed prints.
examples.zh: 他们用「雅致」的串灯和两幅装裱画装点了小公寓。

examples.en: Her tasteful thank-you card made the host family feel appreciated for months.
examples.zh: 她那张「有品位」的感谢卡让寄宿家庭感动了好几个月。

words.enDefinition: make fun of someone in a playful or unkind way

examples.en: His roommates tease him about his terrible sense of direction.
examples.zh: 室友们老是「取笑」他方向感差。

examples.en: We teased our friend gently about falling asleep during the movie.
examples.zh: 朋友看电影时睡着了，我们轻轻「打趣」了他一下。

words.enDefinition: long and slow in a boring way

examples.en: Copying citations by hand is tedious, so I finally learned a reference manager.
examples.zh: 手抄参考文献太「枯燥繁琐」，我终于学会了文献管理软件。

examples.en: Data entry for the survey was tedious, but it covered my textbook budget.
examples.zh: 问卷数据录入虽「单调乏味」，却够我买这学期的教材。

words.enDefinition: the tendency to become angry suddenly or easily

examples.en: My roommate has a short temper before her morning coffee.
examples.zh: 室友早上没喝到咖啡前，「脾气」很差。

examples.en: I lost my temper when the printer ate my homework again.
examples.zh: 打印机又吞了我的作业，我忍不住「发火」了。

words.enDefinition: how hot or cold the air is

examples.en: The temperature dropped ten degrees overnight, so please dress warmly.
examples.zh: 「气温」一夜降了十度，记得穿暖和些。

examples.en: Always check the outside temperature before dressing for morning classes.
examples.zh: 早课前先看看室外「气温」再决定穿什么。

words.enDefinition: Closed for a short period of time

examples.en: The courtyard was temporarily closed while volunteers set up for the afternoon event.
examples.zh: 志愿者为下午的活动布置场地时，院子「暂时关闭」。

examples.en: I saw “Temporarily closed” on the sign and waited by the side entrance.
examples.zh: 我看到牌子上写着「暂时关闭」，就在侧门旁边等。

words.enDefinition: An entrance provided for a limited time

examples.en: We used the temporary entrance while workers were replacing the front doors at the hall.
examples.zh: 大厅正门在更换，我们走了「临时入口」。

examples.en: The temporary entrance was at the far end of the path beyond the courtyard.
examples.zh: 「临时入口」在穿过院子后那条小路的尽头。

collocations: a sign for the temporary entrance

words.enDefinition: so nervous that your body or the atmosphere feels stiff

examples.en: The room went tense when the professor mentioned a surprise quiz.
examples.zh: 教授提到突击测验时，教室里的气氛一下子「紧绷」起来。

examples.en: My shoulders get tense after hours of staring at my thesis.
examples.zh: 盯着论文好几个小时后，我的肩膀都「绷紧」了。

words.enDefinition: a nervous, unfriendly feeling between people or in a place

examples.en: There was real tension in the room when the grades were posted.
examples.zh: 成绩一公布，教室里顿时充满了「紧张气氛」。

examples.en: Chores have created some tension between me and my roommate.
examples.zh: 家务分工让我和室友之间产生了些「紧张气氛」。

words.enDefinition: send a short written message to someone on their phone

examples.en: Text me when you get to the station and I will come pick you up.
examples.zh: 你到车站后「发短信」给我，我来接你。

examples.en: My landlord prefers tenants to text her rather than call about small repairs.
examples.zh: 房东更希望房客遇到小维修时「发短信」，而不是打电话。

words.enDefinition: a short written message sent from one phone to another

examples.en: I got a text message from the bank asking me to confirm my new card.
examples.zh: 我收到银行的「短信」，让我确认新卡。

examples.en: She replies to every text message within a minute, even in lectures.
examples.zh: 每条「短信」她都在一分钟内回复，上课也不例外。

words.enDefinition: the day following tomorrow, two days from now

examples.en: My presentation is the day after tomorrow, so tonight I rehearse.
examples.zh: 我的展示「后天」进行，所以今晚得排练。

examples.en: The forecast says it will rain again the day after tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气预报说「后天」还会下雨。

words.enDefinition: the day that came before yesterday, two days ago

examples.en: The day before yesterday I finally picked up my student card.
examples.zh: 「前天」我终于领到了学生证。

examples.en: It snowed heavily the day before yesterday, then melted by noon.
examples.zh: 「前天」雪下得很大，到中午就化了。

words.enDefinition: most of the people or things in a group

examples.en: The majority of students take the shuttle to morning classes.
examples.zh: 「大多数」学生坐班车去上早课。

examples.en: The majority of my classmates prefer to submit essays online now.
examples.zh: 现在我的同学「大多数」都更喜欢在线提交论文。

words.enDefinition: a few days ago, not long ago

examples.en: The other day I ran into our economics professor at the mall.
examples.zh: 「前几天」我在商场偶遇了经济学教授。

examples.en: Just the other day my roommate found a cheap bike on the marketplace app.
examples.zh: 就「前几天」，我室友在二手交易软件上淘到一辆便宜自行车。

words.enDefinition: what remains after the part already mentioned

examples.en: You finish the slides and I'll handle the rest of the presentation.
examples.zh: 你把幻灯片做完，报告的「其余部分」我来处理。

examples.en: The rest of my family is flying in for graduation.
examples.zh: 我家的「其他人」会飞过来参加毕业典礼。

words.enDefinition: exactly like another thing

examples.en: My new schedule is the same as my roommate's this term.
examples.zh: 这学期我的课表和室友「一模一样」。

examples.en: Is the dining hall menu the same as last year's?
examples.zh: 食堂的菜单和去年「一样」吗？

words.enDefinition: noticing what others need and acting kindly

examples.en: It was thoughtful of my neighbor to water my plants during break.
examples.zh: 假期里邻居帮我浇花，真是「体贴周到」。

examples.en: A thoughtful housemate left cough drops on my desk when I was sick.
examples.zh: 我生病时，「体贴的」室友在我桌上留了润喉糖。

words.enDefinition: an extremely large number of things

examples.en: Thousands of fans watched our graduation livestream from home last year.
examples.zh: 去年「数以千计」的观众在家里看了我们的毕业直播。

examples.en: My phone holds thousands of photos from my first year abroad.
examples.zh: 我手机里存着「数以千计」出国第一年拍的照片。

words.enDefinition: the normal pattern of eating morning, noon, and evening

examples.en: With my packed class schedule, I barely manage three meals a day.
examples.zh: 课程表排得太满，我几乎凑不齐「一日三餐」。

examples.en: My doctor told me to eat three meals a day, no skipping.
examples.zh: 医生让我好好吃「一日三餐」，不许再跳过任何一餐。

words.enDefinition: three times every day

examples.en: Take the medicine three times a day after each meal.
examples.zh: 这种药「一天三次」，随餐服用。

examples.en: The campus shuttle passes my stop three times a day.
examples.zh: 校园班车「一天三次」经过我那一站。

collocations: take it three times a day

words.enDefinition: extremely excited and pleased about something good

examples.en: I was thrilled to hear I got the research assistant position.
examples.zh: 听说拿到了研究助理的职位，我「激动」极了。

examples.en: She was thrilled when her favorite singer replied to her comment.
examples.zh: 喜欢的歌手回复了她的评论，她「乐坏了」。

words.enDefinition: put something unwanted into the trash

examples.en: This milk smells sour, so you should throw it away.
examples.zh: 这牛奶发酸了，你应该把它「扔掉」。

examples.en: Don't throw away that box, I still need it for shipping.
examples.zh: 别把那个盒子「扔掉」，我寄快递还要用。

words.enDefinition: put something on quickly without much planning

examples.en: I had time to throw on a jacket before the others left the flat.
examples.zh: 其他人离开公寓前，我来得及「随手穿上」一件夹克。

examples.en: I'll throw on whatever sweater is closest and meet you by the lift.
examples.zh: 我「随手穿上」离我最近的那件毛衣，在电梯旁和你碰面。

words.enDefinition: the loud sound that follows a lightning flash

examples.en: The thunder woke everyone in the dorm around two a.m.
examples.zh: 凌晨两点左右的「雷声」把全宿舍都吵醒了。

examples.en: We saw the lightning flash first, then heard thunder seconds later.
examples.zh: 我们先看到闪电，几秒后才听到「雷声」。

words.enDefinition: A machine giving numbered slips to people waiting

examples.en: The ticket dispenser was beside the door where people came into the hall.
examples.zh: 「排队取号机」就在大家进大厅的那扇门旁边。

examples.en: I took a slip from the ticket dispenser and sat near the display.
examples.zh: 我从「排队取号机」拿了张号码纸，坐在显示屏旁。

collocations: take a slip from the ticket dispenser
a ticket dispenser by the entrance

words.enDefinition: arranged neatly, with everything in its place

examples.en: Keep the common room tidy, or the RA will send a reminder email.
examples.zh: 公共活动室要保持「整洁」，不然宿管会发提醒邮件。

examples.en: Her kitchen stays tidy even while she cooks for ten people.
examples.zh: 就算同时给十个人做饭，她的厨房也一直「整整齐齐」。

words.enDefinition: make a messy place neat and in order

examples.en: Please tidy up the kitchen before your roommate gets home.
examples.zh: 室友到家之前，请把厨房「收拾整齐」。

examples.en: I spent twenty minutes tidying up my desk after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我花了二十分钟把书桌「收拾整齐」。

words.enDefinition: taking a lot of time to finish

examples.en: Transcribing the whole interview myself was time-consuming but weirdly calming.
examples.zh: 自己转录访谈很「费时间」，但莫名让人平静。

examples.en: Sunday meal prep saves me from time-consuming cooking every weeknight.
examples.zh: 周日备好菜，省得每个工作日晚上「耗时」做饭。

words.enDefinition: a fixed period assigned within a schedule

examples.en: My lab time slot moved to Tuesday afternoons this term.
examples.zh: 这学期我的实验「时间段」挪到了周二下午。

examples.en: Book a gym time slot through the app to avoid queues.
examples.zh: 用应用程序预约健身房「时段」，免得排队。

words.enDefinition: a region that shares the same standard clock time

examples.en: Calling my parents means juggling a thirteen-hour time zone difference.
examples.zh: 给爸妈打电话得应付十三个小时的「时区」差。

examples.en: The webinar time was listed in another time zone, so I nearly missed it.
examples.zh: 讲座时间标的是另一个「时区」，我差点错过。

words.enDefinition: not dated by fashion or passing time

examples.en: That little black dress is timeless—my mother has worn hers for twenty years.
examples.zh: 那条小黑裙「永不过时」，我妈妈的一条穿了二十年。

examples.en: The professor says Shakespeare stays timeless because its emotions never age.
examples.zh: 教授说莎士比亚「历久弥新」，因为其中的情感从不过时。

words.enDefinition: a device or app that counts down a set period

examples.en: I use the timer app on my phone to pace my study sessions.
examples.zh: 我用手机上的「定时器」来控制学习节奏。

examples.en: Set a timer for the pasta so it does not boil over.
examples.zh: 给意面设个「定时器」，免得煮溢出来。

words.enDefinition: shy and lacking confidence to speak or act

examples.en: The timid freshman whispered her question after the lecture ended.
examples.zh: 那位「胆怯的」新生等讲座结束了才小声提出问题。

examples.en: Even now, my timid puppy hides whenever the doorbell rings.
examples.zh: 直到现在，我那只「胆小的」狗一听门铃就躲起来。

words.enDefinition: extremely small in size or amount

examples.en: Our kitchen is tiny, but we still manage to cook together.
examples.zh: 我们的厨房「极小」，但大家还是能一起做饭。

examples.en: There's a tiny cafe two blocks from the dorm that I love.
examples.zh: 宿舍两条街外有家「小小的」咖啡馆，我很喜欢。

words.enDefinition: fall sideways from an upright position, or make something do so

examples.en: The laundry basket tipped over as I squeezed past the bunk.
examples.zh: 我从床铺边挤过去时，洗衣篮「翻倒」了。

examples.en: Don't stack your mugs so high; they'll tip over in the sink.
examples.zh: 马克杯别摞那么高，水槽里会「倒下来」摔碎的。

words.enDefinition: walk quietly on the tips of your toes

examples.en: Tiptoe past the sleeping roommate's door if you come back late.
examples.zh: 晚归的话，「踮着脚」轻声走过室友关着的房门。

examples.en: I tiptoed out of the group study room to take the call.
examples.zh: 我「踮着脚」溜出小组自习间去接电话。

words.enDefinition: a written list of tasks you plan to finish

examples.en: My Monday to-do list has laundry, a lab report, and a dentist appointment.
examples.zh: 我周一的「待办清单」上有洗衣服、写实验报告和看牙医。

examples.en: I keep a to-do list app on my home screen so I see it first.
examples.zh: 我把「待办清单」应用放在主屏幕上，一打开手机就能看到。

words.enDefinition: partly, but not completely

examples.en: To some extent, living abroad has made me more independent.
examples.zh: 「某种程度上」，留学让我变得更独立了。

examples.en: His grades dropped to some extent after he started the part-time job.
examples.zh: 开始打工之后，他的成绩「多少」下滑了一些。

words.enDefinition: a small appliance that browns sliced bread

examples.en: The shared toaster in our kitchen seriously needs a good clean.
examples.zh: 公共厨房的「烤面包机」真该好好清理一下了。

examples.en: Our toaster has a bagel setting for thicker, chewier slices.
examples.zh: 我们的「烤面包机」有贝果模式，可以烤厚而有嚼劲的面包片。

words.enDefinition: A small enclosed space containing one toilet

examples.en: I noticed a small hook inside the toilet cubicle for hanging my coat.
examples.zh: 我看到「卫生间隔间」里面有个小钩子，可以挂外套。

examples.en: The light above the toilet cubicle was on when I walked into the washroom.
examples.zh: 我走进洗手间时，「卫生间隔间」上方的灯亮着。

collocations: a lock on a toilet cubicle

words.enDefinition: an extremely large amount of something

examples.en: Thanks for sending the notes, they saved me tons of time.
examples.zh: 谢谢你发笔记给我，帮我省了「超多」时间。

examples.en: The dining hall has tons of choices during dinner hours.
examples.zh: 晚餐时段食堂有「超多」选择。

words.enDefinition: a larger number than is needed

examples.en: There are too many people waiting for the elevator at noon.
examples.zh: 正午电梯口等着的人「太多」了。

examples.en: I signed up for too many clubs and my schedule is packed.
examples.zh: 我这学期报的社团「太多」，课表全排满了。

words.enDefinition: more than is needed or wanted

examples.en: I spent too much time scrolling on my phone last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我刷手机刷了「太多」时间。

examples.en: There's too much sugar in the boba from that new shop.
examples.zh: 那家新店的奶茶含糖「太多」了。

words.enDefinition: a small pointed stick for cleaning between teeth

examples.en: There's a jar of toothpicks by the register at that diner.
examples.zh: 那家小餐馆收银台边放着一罐「牙签」。

examples.en: Use a toothpick for the spinach stuck between your teeth.
examples.zh: 用「牙签」把塞在牙缝里的菠菜弄出来。

words.enDefinition: of the highest quality or standard

examples.en: The campus gym has top-notch equipment, so I squeeze in workouts between classes.
examples.zh: 学校健身房器械「一流」，我就趁课间去练一会儿。

examples.en: Her presentation was top-notch, and the recruiter invited her back for a second round.
examples.zh: 她的展示堪称「一流」，招聘官直接请她进入二面。

words.enDefinition: ripped, with a hole or split in it

examples.en: My backpack strap is torn, so the library books hang at an angle.
examples.zh: 书包带「磨破」了，图书馆借的书都斜挂着。

examples.en: He showed up to the interview with a torn jacket and still got the job.
examples.zh: 他穿着「破」了的夹克去面试，居然还是拿到了那份工作。

words.enDefinition: a violently rotating column of air from a storm

examples.en: The tornado warning sent the whole dorm to the basement stairwell.
examples.zh: 「龙卷风」警报一响，全楼的人都躲进了地下楼梯间。

examples.en: We practiced the campus tornado drill twice during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周我们练习了两次校园「龙卷风」演习。

words.enDefinition: keep moving in bed because you cannot sleep

examples.en: I tossed and turned all night before the results came out.
examples.zh: 出成绩前那晚，我「翻来覆去」睡不着。

examples.en: Coffee after four p.m. makes me toss and turn until two.
examples.zh: 下午四点以后喝咖啡，我会「翻来覆去」到凌晨两点。

words.enDefinition: a screen you control by tapping and swiping directly

examples.en: The touch screen stopped responding, so I could not type my password.
examples.zh: 「触摸屏」没反应了，我密码都输不了。

examples.en: Library printers still use a touch screen to select your files.
examples.zh: 图书馆的打印机还是用「触摸屏」来选文件。

words.enDefinition: causing tender, sympathetic feelings

examples.en: His touching farewell note to the dorm staff made a couple of RAs tear up.
examples.zh: 他写给宿舍管理员的「动人」告别便条让两位宿管红了眼眶。

examples.en: It was a touching moment when the whole class signed a card for our recovering professor.
examples.zh: 全班为康复中的教授签名写贺卡，那一刻十分「动人」。

words.enDefinition: the flat sensitive panel on a laptop that replaces a mouse

examples.en: My touchpad stopped working, so I borrowed a wireless mouse from my roommate.
examples.zh: 我的「触控板」坏了，就跟室友借了个无线鼠标。

examples.en: Two-finger scrolling on the touchpad feels much faster than the arrow keys.
examples.zh: 用「触控板」双指滚动比方向键快多了。

words.enDefinition: full of tourists and shops aimed at them

examples.en: The old harbor is pretty touristy, so prices double near the water.
examples.zh: 老码头一带「游客扎堆」，海边的价格翻倍。

examples.en: Skip the touristy streets; the food two blocks inland is better.
examples.zh: 别去「游客扎堆」的那几条街，往里走两个街区的吃的更好。

words.enDefinition: dry something by rubbing or pressing it with a towel

examples.en: I usually towel-dry my hair before grabbing my bag and leaving the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 我通常先「用毛巾擦干」头发，再拎包离开共用浴室。

examples.en: She had time to towel-dry her hair before walking back from the campus pool.
examples.zh: 从学校游泳池走回去之前，她还来得及「用毛巾擦干」头发。

words.enDefinition: find someone or something after a difficult search

examples.en: It took me a week to track down the lost package slip.
examples.zh: 我花了一周才「找到」那张丢失的包裹单。

examples.en: I finally tracked down the owner of the umbrella left in the lab.
examples.zh: 我终于「找到」了那把落在实验室的雨伞的主人。

words.enDefinition: involving terrible sadness, often death or disaster

examples.en: Local news covered the tragic highway crash near campus for the entire week.
examples.zh: 本地新闻整整一周都在报道校园附近那起「悲惨的」高速车祸。

examples.en: His grandfather's tragic journey across the war zone made the seminar go quiet.
examples.zh: 他祖父穿越战区的「悲惨」经历让整个研讨课安静下来。

words.enDefinition: a flat board for carrying plates, cups, and food

examples.en: At the dining hall, you load everything onto one tray.
examples.zh: 在食堂，所有东西都装在一个「托盘」上。

examples.en: Carry your tray to the return rack when you finish eating.
examples.zh: 吃完把「托盘」放到回收架上。

words.enDefinition: shake slightly from fear, cold, or strong emotion

examples.en: Your voice may tremble at first, but it settles after the first slide.
examples.zh: 开头声音可能会「发颤」，讲过第一页幻灯就稳了。

examples.en: The kitten trembled in my jacket until the heating kicked in.
examples.zh: 小猫在我外套里「发抖」，直到暖气热起来才安分。

words.enDefinition: currently fashionable and popular

examples.en: That trendy boba shop opened two blocks from our dorm last weekend.
examples.zh: 那家「新潮」的奶茶店上周末开到了宿舍两条街外。

examples.en: Thrift stores are trendy again because students want style on a part-time budget.
examples.zh: 二手店又「时髦」回来了，学生党想靠兼职预算穿出风格。

words.enDefinition: needing care or skill because easily got wrong

examples.en: The parallel parking section of my driving test was tricky, but I passed anyway.
examples.zh: 路考的侧方停车环节很「难缠」，好在我还是过了。

examples.en: Splitting the security deposit three ways got tricky when one roommate left early.
examples.zh: 一位室友提前搬走后，三个人怎么分押金就「不好办」了。

words.enDefinition: a small cut to tidy hair or shorten it slightly

examples.en: I only asked for a trim before the choir's group photo on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五合唱团拍合影前，我只要求「稍微修剪一下头发」。

examples.en: The trim took about fifteen minutes, so I had time to walk across campus.
examples.zh: 这次「修剪头发」用了大概十五分钟，我还有时间走到校园另一头。

words.enDefinition: hit your foot against something and fall or nearly fall

examples.en: Watch out for the bike rack; people trip over it every week.
examples.zh: 小心那个自行车架，每周都有人被它「绊倒」。

examples.en: I nearly tripped over my flatmate's sneakers by the door.
examples.zh: 我差点被室友丢在门口的运动鞋「绊倒」。

words.enDefinition: of very little importance or value

examples.en: Don't spend your whole weekend on trivial formatting—outline the main argument first.
examples.zh: 别把整个周末耗在「琐碎」的排版上，先列出核心论点。

examples.en: The building manager dismissed our trivial complaints but finally fixed the heating.
examples.zh: 楼管把我们的「鸡毛蒜皮」晾在一边，总算修了暖气。

words.enDefinition: find the cause of a problem by testing step by step

examples.en: It took us an hour to troubleshoot the printer before we called IT.
examples.zh: 我们「排查」了一个小时打印机的问题，才叫IT支持。

examples.en: The IT desk taught me to troubleshoot Wi-Fi issues on my own.
examples.zh: IT服务台教了我自己「排查」Wi-Fi问题的方法。

words.enDefinition: walk slowly with heavy, tired steps

examples.en: We trudged up the hill to the dorm after the 8 a.m. final.
examples.zh: 考完早上八点的期末考，我们「拖着沉重的步子」爬坡回宿舍。

examples.en: I trudged through the snow to the bus stop with two grocery bags.
examples.zh: 我拎着两袋食品在雪里「深一脚浅一脚」走向公交站。

words.enDefinition: honest and reliable, safe to trust with secrets

examples.en: I only lend my laptop to classmates I find truly trustworthy.
examples.zh: 我只把电脑借给我认为真正「值得信赖的」同学。

examples.en: A trustworthy friend keeps your secrets even after you argue.
examples.zh: 「值得信赖的朋友」就算和你吵过架也会守住秘密。

words.enDefinition: wear clothes briefly to check the fit

examples.en: Try on the jeans before you decide which size to buy.
examples.zh: 先「试穿」这条牛仔裤，再决定买哪个尺码。

examples.en: She tried on three dresses but ended up buying none.
examples.zh: 她把三条裙子都「试穿」了，结果一件也没买。

collocations: try on clothes in the fitting room

words.enDefinition: test something new to see if you like it

examples.en: I want to try out that new bubble tea shop nearby.
examples.zh: 我想去「试试」附近新开的那家奶茶店。

examples.en: She tried out the free gym pass this whole week.
examples.zh: 这一周她「试用」了健身房体验卡。

collocations: try out a gym for free

words.enDefinition: push the edge of a shirt inside pants or a skirt

examples.en: The career center says tuck in your shirt for the networking night.
examples.zh: 就业指导中心说，求职社交晚宴上要「把衬衫塞好」。

examples.en: Tuck in the back of your shirt before you meet the advisor.
examples.zh: 见导师之前，「把衬衫后摆塞好」。

words.enDefinition: put the bottom of your shirt inside your trousers or skirt

examples.en: Could you tuck in your shirt before we take the photo for the society newsletter?
examples.zh: 拍社团通讯用的照片前，你能「把衬衫塞进裤腰」吗？

examples.en: It's easier to tuck in your shirt if you take off the jacket first.
examples.zh: 可以先把外套脱下来，这样更容易「把衬衫塞进裤腰」。

collocations: tuck in your shirt before a photo
remember to tuck in your shirt

words.enDefinition: pull something quickly and gently several times

examples.en: Tug the rope twice to check that your bike is really secure.
examples.zh: 「拽两下」绳子，确认自行车真的锁稳了。

examples.en: The puppy tugged at my shoelace all the way to the park.
examples.zh: 去公园的路上，小狗一直「轻拽」着我的鞋带。

words.enDefinition: fall down suddenly, often rolling over

examples.en: She tumbled down the last three steps of the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 她在阶梯教室最后三级台阶上「摔了个跟头」。

examples.en: The laundry pile tumbled off the chair when I opened the door.
examples.zh: 我一开门，椅子上那堆衣服「哗啦滚落」下来。

words.enDefinition: brand-name plastic containers for storing leftovers

examples.en: Pack the extra pasta in tupperware for tomorrow's lunch break.
examples.zh: 把多余的意面装进「保鲜盒」，明天午休时吃。

examples.en: Every shelf of our shared fridge is crammed with tupperware boxes.
examples.zh: 公共冰箱每一层都塞满了「塑料保鲜盒」。

words.enDefinition: to reverse clothes so that their inner surface becomes their outer surface

examples.en: The laundry guide says to turn clothes inside out if they have printed designs.
examples.zh: 洗衣指南说，衣物有印花时要「把衣物翻到里面朝外」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to turn clothes inside out before putting them in the wash.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样在洗涤前「把衣物翻到里面朝外」。

collocations: turn clothes inside out before washing
turn clothes inside out to protect a print
turn clothes inside out to check the seams

words.enDefinition: say no to an offer or invitation

examples.en: She turned down the party invitation to study for finals.
examples.zh: 为了备考期末，她「拒绝」了派对邀请。

examples.en: He turned down the extra shift because of his exams.
examples.zh: 因为要考试，他「谢绝」了额外的排班。

words.enDefinition: go to bed at the end of the day

examples.en: I'm exhausted after practice, so I'm turning in early tonight.
examples.zh: 训练完我累坏了，今晚要早点「睡觉」。

examples.en: It's getting late, so we should turn in pretty soon.
examples.zh: 时间不早了，我们该去「睡」了。

words.enDefinition: stop a machine or light from working

examples.en: Turn off the lights when you leave the room, please.
examples.zh: 离开房间时请把灯「关掉」。

examples.en: Did you turn off the stove after cooking dinner last night?
examples.zh: 昨晚做完晚饭后你把炉灶「关」了吗？

words.enDefinition: prove to be true or good in the end

examples.en: The small party turned out better than we had expected.
examples.zh: 这场小型派对「结果」比我们预期的更好。

examples.en: It turned out that the store was closed on Mondays.
examples.zh: 「原来」那家店周一不营业。

words.enDefinition: move something so its other side faces up

examples.en: Turn over the pancake when the edges start to look dry.
examples.zh: 边缘开始发干时，把煎饼「翻过来」。

examples.en: I turned over the mattress because my back was complaining.
examples.zh: 腰有点酸，我把床垫「翻了个面」。

words.enDefinition: go to someone for help when in trouble

examples.en: Whenever the lease confuses me, I turn to my cousin who studies law.
examples.zh: 每当看不懂租约，我都会向学法律的表哥「求助」。

examples.en: First-year students can turn to the dorm supervisor for any emergency.
examples.zh: 大一新生遇到紧急情况，可以「求助」宿舍管理员。

collocations: turn to your family for help
have no one to turn to

words.enDefinition: A rotating barrier allowing people through one at a time

examples.en: We walked through the turnstile one by one at the exhibition hall entrance.
examples.zh: 我们在展览厅入口处挨个通过「旋转闸机」。

examples.en: The volunteer directed our group to the wider gate beside the turnstile near reception.
examples.zh: 志愿者把我们一行人领到前台附近「旋转闸机」旁较宽的入口。

words.enDefinition: a top with a tall collar that folds around the neck

examples.en: My turtleneck kept my neck warm on the walk to the library after sunset.
examples.zh: 太阳下山后走去图书馆的路上，我的「高领上衣」把脖子裹得挺暖。

examples.en: I wore a turtleneck under the blazer for our presentation in the cold lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我们在冷飕飕的阶梯教室做汇报，我在西装外套下面穿了「高领上衣」。

words.enDefinition: a packaged frozen meal heated and eaten from its tray

examples.en: Living off TV dinners during midterms saved me so much time.
examples.zh: 期中期间靠「速冻盒装晚餐」过活，帮我省了不少时间。

examples.en: He heated a TV dinner while rewatching last night's game.
examples.zh: 他一边重看昨晚的比赛，一边热了一份「速冻晚餐」。

words.enDefinition: a small tool with two arms used to pick up tiny objects

examples.en: I used tweezers to get a small thread out of the clasp on my hair clip.
examples.zh: 我用「小镊子」把卡在发夹搭扣里的一根细线夹了出来。

examples.en: My tweezers were at the bottom of the bag underneath the towel I'd packed.
examples.zh: 我的「小镊子」在包底，上面压着我带的毛巾。

collocations: keep tweezers in a wash bag

words.enDefinition: two times in each week

examples.en: I go to the campus gym twice a week these days.
examples.zh: 我最近「每周两次」去健身房。

examples.en: The shuttle to the airport runs twice a week during breaks.
examples.zh: 假期期间，去机场的班车「每周两班」。

words.enDefinition: double the amount of something

examples.en: The campus bookstore charges twice as much for the same calculator.
examples.zh: 同样的计算器，校内书店的售价是「两倍」。

examples.en: I drink twice as much water now that I carry a bottle.
examples.zh: 自从随身带水瓶，我的饮水量「翻了一倍」。

words.enDefinition: enter words using a keyboard

examples.en: I can type my notes faster than I can write them by hand now.
examples.zh: 现在我「打字」记笔记比手写快多了。

examples.en: Type the room number into the search bar and the map will guide you.
examples.zh: 在搜索框里「输入」房间号，地图就会带你过去。

words.enDefinition: a small spelling mistake made while typing quickly

examples.en: There is a typo in my essay title, but the deadline is in five minutes.
examples.zh: 我的论文标题里有个「笔误」，可距离截止只剩五分钟了。

examples.en: Sorry, that was a typo — I meant Thursday, not Tuesday.
examples.zh: 抱歉，那是个「笔误」，我是想说周四，不是周二。

words.enDefinition: A holder for umbrellas near an entrance

examples.en: I left my wet umbrella in the umbrella stand just inside the door.
examples.zh: 我把湿伞放在刚进门的「伞架」上。

examples.en: The umbrella stand was full after the group arrived in the afternoon rain.
examples.zh: 下午下着雨，那群人到齐后，「伞架」就放满了。

collocations: leave an umbrella in the umbrella stand
an umbrella stand by the door

words.enDefinition: too painful, difficult, or annoying to accept

examples.en: The heat in our un-air-conditioned dorm was unbearable, so we studied at the cafe.
examples.zh: 没空调的宿舍热得「难以忍受」，我们只能去咖啡馆自习。

examples.en: The wait at the visa office became unbearable without headphones or a good book.
examples.zh: 签证办公室的等待，没耳机没书简直「熬不住」。

words.enDefinition: slightly ill or not feeling well

examples.en: I feel a bit under the weather, so I will skip practice.
examples.zh: 我「有点不舒服」，今天就不去训练了。

examples.en: She stayed under the weather all week and missed two labs.
examples.zh: 她整整一周都「不大舒服」，缺了两次实验课。

words.enDefinition: cooked too briefly and still raw inside

examples.en: The chicken was undercooked in the middle, so we sent it back.
examples.zh: 鸡肉中间「没熟」，我们退了这道菜。

examples.en: Undercooked rice gets fixed with ten extra minutes and a splash of water.
examples.zh: 饭「夹生」了就加点水再焖十分钟。

words.enDefinition: to draw a line underneath a word or passage to mark it

examples.en: I used a pencil to underline the dates I needed for revision.
examples.zh: 我用铅笔在复习要用的日期「下面划线」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to underline the phrase that supported each answer.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在能支持各个答案的短语「下面划线」。

words.enDefinition: better or more important than people realize

examples.en: The library basement is an underrated study spot—quiet, warm, and rarely full.
examples.zh: 图书馆地下室是个「被低估」的自习好去处，安静、暖和还几乎不挤。

examples.en: That tiny noodle shop is seriously underrated; their broth beats the famous chains.
examples.zh: 那家小面馆真的「被低估」了，汤底比连锁名店还好。

words.enDefinition: willing to forgive and consider others' feelings

examples.en: My understanding professor let me submit the essay one day late.
examples.zh: 我那位「善解人意的」教授允许我晚一天交论文。

examples.en: An understanding landlady reduced our rent during the tough month.
examples.zh: 那位「体谅人的」房东太太在我们最艰难的那个月减了房租。

words.enDefinition: less impressive than you expected or hoped

examples.en: The trailer looked amazing, but the film itself turned out pretty underwhelming.
examples.zh: 预告片看着很燃，正片却相当「平平无奇」。

examples.en: His first draft was underwhelming, so the professor asked for stronger evidence.
examples.zh: 他的初稿写得「平平无奇」，教授要求补充更有力的论据。

words.enDefinition: unfasten one button on a piece of clothing

examples.en: I stopped to undo a button because the seminar room was getting quite warm.
examples.zh: 研讨课教室越来越暖和，我停下来「解开了一颗扣子」。

examples.en: I had to undo a button before I could get the shirt over my head.
examples.zh: 我得先「解开一颗扣子」，才能把衬衫从头上套过去。

collocations: undo a button on your collar
undo a button at the cuff

words.enDefinition: slightly worried that something is wrong or unsafe

examples.en: I felt uneasy leaving my laptop unattended in the library.
examples.zh: 把笔记本电脑留在图书馆没人看，我心里很「不踏实」。

examples.en: Something about his tone made me uneasy during our group meeting.
examples.zh: 小组会议上，他说话的语气让我有点「不安」。

words.enDefinition: open out something that was folded flat

examples.en: Unfold the map if your phone dies on the hiking trail.
examples.zh: 徒步时手机要是没电，就把地图「展开」用。

examples.en: He unfolded the campus brochure and circled the two dorm options.
examples.zh: 他「展开」校园手册，圈出了两个宿舍选项。

words.enDefinition: impossible to forget because it is so special

examples.en: Studying abroad gave me unforgettable memories of late-night talks with my roommates.
examples.zh: 留学让我收获了和室友深夜长谈这段「难以忘怀」的回忆。

examples.en: The sunrise from the mountaintop after that overnight hike was absolutely unforgettable.
examples.zh: 那次通宵徒步后山顶的日出，美得「难以忘怀」。

words.enDefinition: remove an app completely from your phone or computer

examples.en: I uninstall games every finals season or I never get any studying done.
examples.zh: 每到考试周我就「卸载」游戏，不然根本没法学习。

examples.en: The app keeps freezing, so I uninstalled it and reinstalled the latest version.
examples.zh: 这个应用老是卡死，我把它「卸载」后重装了最新版本。

words.enDefinition: open your phone by verifying it is really you

examples.en: My phone unlocks with my fingerprint, but I can also unlock it with the passcode.
examples.zh: 我的手机用指纹就行，也可以输密码「解锁」。

examples.en: Unlock the bike in the app by scanning the code on the handlebar.
examples.zh: 扫描车把上的二维码，就能在应用里「解锁」单车。

words.enDefinition: turn the microphone or sound back on

examples.en: Remember to unmute yourself before you start presenting your part.
examples.zh: 轮到你展示之前，记得「取消静音」。

examples.en: The professor asked me to unmute because nobody could hear my answer.
examples.zh: 教授让我「打开麦克风」，因为没人能听到我的回答。

words.enDefinition: take your things out of bags after arriving

examples.en: I'll unpack my suitcase tomorrow; tonight I'm too jet-lagged to do anything.
examples.zh: 行李箱我明天再「拆」，今晚时差太重，什么都不想干。

examples.en: She unpacked her boxes and hung the curtains on her first day.
examples.zh: 搬来的第一天她就「拆箱整理」，还挂好了窗帘。

words.enDefinition: remove a device's connection to the electricity supply

examples.en: Unplug the heater when you leave the room—it's a fire risk.
examples.zh: 离开房间要「拔掉」暖气的插头，有火灾隐患。

examples.en: I unplugged everything before leaving for the week-long trip home.
examples.zh: 回家一周前，我把所有电器插头都「拔」了。

words.enDefinition: not opened or read yet, often shown with a red badge

examples.en: I keep one unread message in each chat as a reminder to reply.
examples.zh: 每个聊天我都留一条「未读」消息，提醒自己别忘了回复。

examples.en: The little red badge says I have forty unread messages in my class group.
examples.zh: 红色小角标显示班级群里我有四十条「未读」消息。

words.enDefinition: not sensible or possible in real life

examples.en: Joining five study groups every week was unrealistic once midterms actually started.
examples.zh: 期中一开始，每周参加五个学习小组就成了「不现实」的想法。

examples.en: The landlord's strict no-guests rule felt unrealistic for students whose families visit from abroad.
examples.zh: 房东不许留访客的死规定，对有海外家人来访的学生来说「不现实」。

words.enDefinition: to open a container or envelope by removing or breaking its seal

examples.en: I waited until my roommate arrived before I tried to unseal the parcel.
examples.zh: 我等室友来了才把包裹「拆封」。

examples.en: We had to unseal the envelope to check which form was inside.
examples.zh: 我们得把信封「拆开」，看看里面是哪张表。

words.enDefinition: cancel a mailing list so you stop receiving its emails

examples.en: Unsubscribe from the bookstore's emails or your inbox will drown in discount codes.
examples.zh: 赶紧「退订」书店的邮件，不然你的收件箱会被优惠码淹没。

examples.en: Scroll to the bottom of the newsletter and click unsubscribe to stop the daily blasts.
examples.zh: 滚动到新闻邮件底部，点击「退订」，不再每天被轰炸。

words.enDefinition: to separate things that are twisted or caught around one another

examples.en: I stopped to untangle my earphones before the recording started in the lecture.
examples.zh: 课堂录音开始前，我停下来「解开」缠在一起的耳机线。

examples.en: We needed to untangle the straps before carrying the bags down to reception.
examples.zh: 我们得先「解开」缠在一起的背带，再把包拿到前台。

words.enDefinition: to undo a knot or release something held by tied string or rope

examples.en: I stopped to untie my shoelaces before trying on the boots in the shop.
examples.zh: 在店里试靴子之前，我先把鞋带「解开」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped me untie the cord around the folded camping mat.
examples.zh: 室友帮我把折叠露营垫外面的绳结「解开」。

words.enDefinition: to relax after a period of work or tension

examples.en: I unwind by watching cooking videos after long study days.
examples.zh: 长时间学习之后，我靠看美食视频「放松」。

examples.en: A hot shower helps me unwind before bed after my shift.
examples.zh: 下班后洗个热水澡，帮我睡前「放松身心」。

words.enDefinition: take the paper or covering off a gift or item

examples.en: Unwrap the sandwich at the table, not inside the library.
examples.zh: 三明治要到餐桌上再「拆」，别在图书馆里拆。

examples.en: She unwrapped the care package from her mom right at the mailroom.
examples.zh: 她在收发室当场就「拆开」了妈妈寄来的包裹。

words.enDefinition: open something by sliding its zipper down or across

examples.en: You can unzip your jacket once we get inside the warm lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我们进了暖和的阶梯教室，你就可以「拉开夹克的拉链」。

examples.en: I had to unzip the pocket to find my key at the residence entrance.
examples.zh: 到了宿舍入口，我得「拉开口袋的拉链」找钥匙。

words.enDefinition: as many or as much as a limit

examples.en: The study room fits up to eight people at one time.
examples.zh: 这间自习室「最多能容纳」八个人。

examples.en: You can borrow up to six books with your student card.
examples.zh: 用学生证你一次「最多」可以借六本书。

words.enDefinition: the way someone was raised and cared for as a child

examples.en: My strict upbringing meant homework came before any screen time.
examples.zh: 我从小受到的「教养」很严格，写作业永远排在玩之前。

examples.en: A multicultural upbringing helped her adapt to campus life quickly.
examples.zh: 多元的「成长背景」让她很快适应了校园生活。

words.enDefinition: making you feel happier and more hopeful

examples.en: The choir's graduation performance was so uplifting that the whole crowd stood up.
examples.zh: 合唱团的毕业演出「振奋人心」，全场都起立了。

examples.en: I keep an uplifting playlist for slow mornings when I need a mood boost.
examples.zh: 状态低迷的早晨，我靠一张「振奋人心」的歌单打气。

words.enDefinition: send a file from your device to a website

examples.en: Upload your essay to the portal before eleven tonight—no extensions.
examples.zh: 今晚十一点前把论文「上传」到系统，不能延期。

examples.en: The portal crashed while I was uploading my group presentation.
examples.zh: 我「上传」小组展示文件的时候，系统崩了。

words.enDefinition: nervous and unable to relax

examples.en: Don't get uptight about the presentation; even seniors stumble sometimes.
examples.zh: 别对这次演讲这么「紧绷」，学长们也常有失误。

examples.en: My roommate gets uptight whenever the floor meeting starts five minutes late.
examples.zh: 楼层会议晚开始五分钟，我的室友就「紧张拘谨」得不行。

words.enDefinition: the slot where you plug in a USB cable

examples.en: The USB port on the library computer is right next to the card reader.
examples.zh: 图书馆电脑的「USB接口」就在读卡器旁边。

examples.en: My USB port is loose, so my phone stops charging whenever I move it.
examples.zh: 我的「USB接口」松了，手机一动就断充。

words.enDefinition: finish the whole supply of something

examples.en: We always use up the dish soap before anyone remembers to buy more.
examples.zh: 总是等洗洁精「用光」，才有人想起来去买。

examples.en: Don't use up the hot water, I still want a shower.
examples.zh: 别把热水「用完」，我还要洗澡。

words.enDefinition: not able to do anything helpful

examples.en: The old printer in the study room is useless—it jams on every third page.
examples.zh: 自习室那台旧打印机「没用」，每打三页卡一次。

examples.en: I felt useless in the group project until someone finally shared the folder with me.
examples.zh: 没人给我共享文件夹之前，我在小组作业里感觉特别「没用」。

words.enDefinition: the unique name that identifies you when logging in

examples.en: My username for the school portal is just my student number.
examples.zh: 我学校门户的「用户名」就是我的学号。

examples.en: It says my username is already taken, which is so annoying.
examples.zh: 系统提示「用户名」已被占用，真烦人。

words.enDefinition: completely, without any doubt

examples.en: After the all-nighter, I felt utterly exhausted in my morning class.
examples.zh: 熬完夜，早课上我「完全」筋疲力尽。

examples.en: His phone died, leaving him utterly lost without the campus map.
examples.zh: 手机没电后，没有校园地图的他「完全」迷失了方向。

words.enDefinition: a neckline shaped like the letter V

examples.en: The sweater has a V-neck, so the collar of my shirt stays visible.
examples.zh: 毛衣是「V形领口」，我的衬衫领还能露出来。

examples.en: I preferred the V-neck on the blue sweater with the scarf I already owned.
examples.zh: 搭我原来的围巾时，我更喜欢蓝毛衣的「V形领口」。

words.enDefinition: not clearly expressed or specific

examples.en: Her vague directions to the pickup point had me circling the science building for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 她给的取货地点「含糊不清」，我绕着理科楼转了二十分钟。

examples.en: The syllabus was vague about grading, so I emailed the TA for the exact rubric.
examples.zh: 教学大纲对评分「说得含糊」，我发邮件向助教要了评分细则。

words.enDefinition: relax completely, often watching TV and doing nothing

examples.en: After finals I just vegged out in front of the TV for three days.
examples.zh: 期末结束后，我「彻底躺平放松」，看了三天电视。

examples.en: Let's veg out tonight and start cleaning the apartment tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今晚咱们先「躺平放松」，打扫明天再说。

collocations: veg out in front of the TV

words.enDefinition: a person who eats no animal products at all

examples.en: As a vegan, she checks every label for hidden milk powder.
examples.zh: 作为「纯素食者」，她会检查每个标签里有没有隐藏的奶粉。

examples.en: The dining hall added a vegan station this semester, thankfully.
examples.zh: 谢天谢地，食堂这学期新增了「纯素」餐台。

words.enDefinition: A machine that sells items without an attendant

examples.en: I bought a bottle of water from the vending machine beside the smaller hall.
examples.zh: 我在小厅旁的「自动售货机」买了一瓶水。

examples.en: The vending machine near the entrance had a small shelf for collecting drinks.
examples.zh: 入口旁的「自动售货机」有个取饮料的小托架。

collocations: buy something from a vending machine

words.enDefinition: to release angry feelings by talking about them

examples.en: I called my sister just to vent about my group project.
examples.zh: 我给姐姐打电话，就是为了「吐槽」小组作业。

examples.en: She vented about her noisy neighbors while we ate late-night hotpot.
examples.zh: 吃深夜火锅时，她「大吐苦水」，抱怨吵闹的邻居。

words.enDefinition: useful for many different purposes

examples.en: A versatile denim jacket works for class, part-time shifts, and weekend hikes.
examples.zh: 一件「百搭」的牛仔外套上课、兼职、周末徒步都能穿。

examples.en: Eggs are so versatile—fried rice, omelets, or a quick ramen upgrade at midnight.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋「用途超广」：蛋炒饭、煎蛋，或深夜给泡面升级。

words.enDefinition: the general feeling a place or person gives you, informal

examples.en: This café has such cozy vibes that I study here daily.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆「氛围感」超好，我每天都来学习。

examples.en: I got weird vibes from that guy at the welcome party.
examples.zh: 迎新会上那个男生给我的「感觉」怪怪的。

words.enDefinition: shake gently instead of ringing to alert you quietly

examples.en: Set your phone to vibrate during the seminar so it never rings out loud.
examples.zh: 研讨会期间把手机调成「震动」，就不会突然响铃了。

examples.en: I set the alarm to vibrate so it wakes me without waking my roommate.
examples.zh: 我把闹钟调成「震动」，能叫醒自己又不吵到室友。

words.enDefinition: a phone or internet call where you can see each other

examples.en: We do a weekly video call with my parents so they can see the dorm.
examples.zh: 我们每周和爸妈「视频通话」，让他们看看我的宿舍。

examples.en: Can we switch this video call to audio? My roommate is sleeping.
examples.zh: 这通「视频通话」能改成语音吗？我室友在睡觉。

words.enDefinition: old or old-fashioned in an attractive way

examples.en: I found a vintage denim jacket at the flea market for eight dollars.
examples.zh: 我在跳蚤市场花八块钱淘到一件「复古」牛仔外套。

examples.en: Her vintage film camera is older than both of us combined.
examples.zh: 她那台「老式」胶片相机比我们俩岁数加起来还大。

words.enDefinition: an audio recording sent instead of a typed text

examples.en: My mom sends me a two-minute voice message instead of texting like everyone else.
examples.zh: 我妈不像别人那样打字，偏要给我发两分钟的「语音消息」。

examples.en: Just send me a voice message when your hands are busy cooking.
examples.zh: 你做饭腾不出手的时候，发条「语音消息」给我就行。

words.enDefinition: a recorded voice message left when someone does not answer

examples.en: I left a voicemail with the clinic, but they only return calls in the morning.
examples.zh: 我给诊所留了「语音留言」，但他们只在早上回电。

examples.en: My voicemail box is full, so new callers cannot leave messages anymore.
examples.zh: 我的「语音留言」信箱满了，新来电者没法再留言。

words.enDefinition: how loud or quiet the sound from a device is

examples.en: Turn the volume down at night so you do not wake your roommate.
examples.zh: 晚上把「音量」调小点，别吵醒室友。

examples.en: The volume on my headphones creeps up by itself during videos.
examples.zh: 看视频时，我耳机的「音量」会自己悄悄变大。

words.enDefinition: the strip of material around the waist of trousers or a skirt

examples.en: I sat for most of the train journey, and the elastic waistband felt comfortable.
examples.zh: 火车上大部分时间我都坐着，裤子有「松紧腰头」，穿着挺舒服。

examples.en: The loose end of the drawstring disappeared into the waistband during our practice.
examples.zh: 练习时，抽绳松开的那一头缩进了「裤腰」里。

words.enDefinition: a sleeveless garment typically worn over a shirt and under a suit jacket

examples.en: My cousin wore a waistcoat for the college concert and took his jacket off backstage.
examples.zh: 我表弟穿着「西装马甲」参加学院音乐会，在后台脱了外套。

examples.en: I borrowed a waistcoat from a friend for our student theatre production last term.
examples.zh: 上学期学生剧团演出时，我跟朋友借了一件「西装马甲」。

words.enDefinition: stand at the stop until the bus arrives

examples.en: I wait for the bus at the stop nearest the dining hall.
examples.zh: 我在离食堂最近的站台「等公交」。

examples.en: Waiting for the bus in January without gloves is a mistake.
examples.zh: 一月里不戴手套「等公交」是个错误。

collocations: wait for the bus at the stop
a long wait for the bus
wait for the bus in the rain

words.enDefinition: To stay in a queue until it is your turn

examples.en: We had to wait in line to return the chairs after the event.
examples.zh: 活动结束后，我们得「排队等候」归还椅子。

examples.en: I didn't mind having to wait in line because the hall was warm.
examples.zh: 大厅里暖和，我不介意「排队等候」。

collocations: wait in line for a seat

words.enDefinition: To stay until one's name or number is called

examples.en: We were told to wait to be called after taking a slip from the machine.
examples.zh: 我们从机器取号后，对方让我们「等候叫号」。

examples.en: I sat near the doorway to wait to be called for my turn.
examples.zh: 我坐在门口附近「等候叫号」，等轮到自己。

collocations: sit down and wait to be called
wait to be called by number
wait to be called by name

words.enDefinition: stop sleeping and become awake

examples.en: I woke up to the sound of my roommate's alarm clock.
examples.zh: 我在室友闹钟的响声中「醒来」。

examples.en: Set two alarms in case you don't wake up on time.
examples.zh: 设两个闹钟，以防你到点没「睡醒」。

collocations: wake up in the middle of the night

words.enDefinition: take a dog outside on a leash for exercise

examples.en: I walk the dog around the block every evening after dinner.
examples.zh: 每天晚饭后我都会在街区周围「遛狗」。

examples.en: Can you walk the dog while I'm in class today?
examples.zh: 今天我上课时你能帮忙「遛狗」吗？

collocations: walk the dog twice a day
walk the dog in the park

words.enDefinition: close enough that you can reach places on foot

examples.en: I picked this flat because campus and two supermarkets are walkable.
examples.zh: 选这套房子，就是看中去校园和两家超市都能「步行到达」。

examples.en: The riverside area is walkable, unlike the dorms up on the hill.
examples.zh: 河边的街区适合「步行」，山腰的宿舍区就差远了。

words.enDefinition: the background picture shown on a phone or computer screen

examples.en: I changed my phone wallpaper to a photo of my dog back home.
examples.zh: 我把手机「壁纸」换成了家里狗狗的照片。

examples.en: Her lock screen wallpaper is a picture of our whole dorm floor.
examples.zh: 她的锁屏「壁纸」是我们整层宿舍的合影。

words.enDefinition: become warmer, said of the weather

examples.en: It is finally warming up, so the patio cafes are open again.
examples.zh: 天气终于「回暖」，露天咖啡馆又开门了。

examples.en: Afternoons warm up quickly in April, so dress in layers.
examples.zh: 四月午后「升温」很快，穿衣要有层次。

words.enDefinition: slowly begin to like someone you first felt unsure about

examples.en: The shy exchange student warmed up to our group after two game nights.
examples.zh: 玩了两晚桌游之后，那位交换生渐渐「喜欢上了」我们这群人。

examples.en: It took weeks for my cat to warm up to my new roommate.
examples.zh: 花了好几个星期，我的猫才渐渐「接受」我的新室友。

words.enDefinition: to wash something manually instead of using a washing machine or dishwasher

examples.en: The sweater label said to wash by hand and lay it flat.
examples.zh: 毛衣标签要求「用手洗」，然后平放晾干。

examples.en: I chose to wash by hand because the shared machine was already running.
examples.zh: 共用洗衣机已经在用了，我决定「用手洗」。

collocations: wash by hand in cool water

words.enDefinition: the washing pattern you select on a laundry machine

examples.en: Choose the gentle wash cycle for sweaters and gym clothes.
examples.zh: 毛衣和运动服要选「轻柔洗涤程序」。

examples.en: This old machine's normal wash cycle takes almost an hour.
examples.zh: 这台旧机器的标准「洗涤程序」要将近一个小时。

words.enDefinition: to swallow food with the help of a drink

examples.en: I washed down the salty fries with a large soda.
examples.zh: 我用一大杯汽水「送下」了那些咸薯条。

examples.en: These dry crackers need something to wash them down with.
examples.zh: 这饼干太干了，得就着点什么「咽下去」。

collocations: need something to wash it down

words.enDefinition: clean your face with water and cleanser

examples.en: Splashing cold water to wash my face is how I wake up fastest.
examples.zh: 用冷水「洗脸」是我醒得最快的办法。

examples.en: Wash your face before bed so the pillowcase stays clean longer.
examples.zh: 睡前「洗把脸」，枕套就能久一点不脏。

collocations: wash my face with cold water

words.enDefinition: clean your hair with shampoo and water

examples.en: I wash my hair every other day to keep it from drying out.
examples.zh: 我「隔天洗一次头」，免得头发太干。

examples.en: Wash your hair tonight so it's dry in time for the morning class.
examples.zh: 今晚就把头「洗了」，明早上课前才来得及干。

collocations: wash my hair every other day
too lazy to wash my hair

words.enDefinition: clean your hands with soap and water

examples.en: Wash your hands for twenty seconds after you get home.
examples.zh: 到家之后要「洗手」至少二十秒。

examples.en: I always wash my hands before I start cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 开始做晚饭之前，我总会先「洗手」。

words.enDefinition: to remove a substance from a surface by washing it

examples.en: I went back inside to wash off the mud on my hands.
examples.zh: 我回屋把手上的泥「用水洗掉」。

examples.en: I used cold water to wash off the paint on the desk.
examples.zh: 我用凉水把书桌上的颜料「洗掉」。

words.enDefinition: a small square cloth used for washing your face or body

examples.en: I hung my washcloth beside the sink so it would dry before the morning.
examples.zh: 我把「洗脸小毛巾」挂在洗手池旁边，好让它第二天早上前晾干。

examples.en: The washcloth was still damp, so I left it out while I went to class.
examples.zh: 「洗脸小毛巾」还是潮的，我就把它晾在外面，自己去上课。

words.enDefinition: using more money, time, or things than needed

examples.en: Ordering takeout every night turned out wasteful, so our floor started a cooking rota.
examples.zh: 每晚点外卖其实很「浪费」，我们一层楼搞起了轮值做饭。

examples.en: Leaving the heater on all day is wasteful when the timer switch costs nothing.
examples.zh: 暖气全天开着实在「浪费」，定时开关又不花钱。

words.enDefinition: be alert to possible danger around you

examples.en: Watch out for the bike lane when you cross here.
examples.zh: 在这儿过马路要「当心」自行车道。

examples.en: Watch out for the wet floor near the sink in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房水池边地板很滑，「小心」点。

words.enDefinition: give plants liquid so they keep growing well

examples.en: Could you water my basil while I'm home for spring break?
examples.zh: 我回家过春假期间，能帮我给罗勒「浇水」吗？

examples.en: He watered the succulents too often and they started to rot.
examples.zh: 他给多肉「浇水」太勤，多肉都开始烂了。

words.enDefinition: able to keep out some water during light exposure

examples.en: I wore a water-resistant jacket for the short walk from the library to the café.
examples.zh: 从图书馆走一小段到咖啡馆时，我穿了件「防泼水的」夹克。

examples.en: The water-resistant fabric kept the light drizzle off my trousers during the campus tour.
examples.zh: 参观校园时，「防泼水的」布料挡住了落在长裤上的细雨。

words.enDefinition: made so that water cannot get through it

examples.en: Get a waterproof phone pouch for the kayak trip next weekend.
examples.zh: 下周末去划皮划艇，买个「防水」手机袋。

examples.en: These boots claim to be waterproof, yet my socks got soaked anyway.
examples.zh: 这靴子号称「防水」，结果袜子照样湿透。

words.enDefinition: much more than is acceptable

examples.en: The lecture hall is way too cold, bring a hoodie tomorrow.
examples.zh: 梯教室里「实在太」冷了，明天带件连帽衫。

examples.en: That assignment took way too long for only ten percent of the grade.
examples.zh: 那份作业只占总成绩百分之十，花的时间却「实在」太长。

words.enDefinition: A sign that helps people find a place

examples.en: A wayfinding sign near the lift showed which direction led to the meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 电梯旁的「导向指示牌」标出了会议室在哪个方向。

examples.en: I followed a wayfinding sign to the courtyard instead of asking at the desk.
examples.zh: 我跟着「导向指示牌」走到了院子，不用去前台问。

words.enDefinition: low network bars that make calls and texts unreliable

examples.en: The weak signal in the elevator means my texts will not send.
examples.zh: 电梯里「信号弱」，短信都发不出去。

examples.en: There is a weak signal near the back stairs, so calls cut off there.
examples.zh: 后楼梯附近「信号弱」，电话打到那儿就会断。

words.enDefinition: move in and out around people or obstacles while walking

examples.en: Weave through the book carts between the shelves to save time.
examples.zh: 从书架间书车的空隙「穿行绕过」，能省不少时间。

examples.en: She weaved through the Friday market crowd with two full bags.
examples.zh: 周五集市人潮里，她拎着两大袋东西「左穿右绕」。

words.enDefinition: a small built-in camera on a laptop for video calls

examples.en: My webcam light turns on by itself, which honestly freaks me out.
examples.zh: 我的「摄像头」灯会自己亮起来，说实话有点吓人。

examples.en: Tape over your webcam when you are not in an online class.
examples.zh: 没在上网课的时候，用胶带把「摄像头」贴住。

words.enDefinition: force something firmly into a narrow gap

examples.en: Wedge the door open with your shoe while we carry the couch.
examples.zh: 我们搬沙发的时候，用你的鞋把门「抵」住别关上。

examples.en: The delivery box got wedged between the dorm door and the wall.
examples.zh: 快递箱「卡」在了宿舍门和墙中间。

collocations: wedge a box under the bed

words.enDefinition: any day of the working week from Monday to Friday

examples.en: On weekdays the campus gym stays quiet until five in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 「工作日」的校内健身房下午五点前人很少。

examples.en: Weekday mornings are hectic, so I prepare breakfast the night before.
examples.zh: 「工作日」早上很赶，所以我前一晚就备好早餐。

words.enDefinition: wearing neat, attractive, suitable clothes

examples.en: The well-dressed recruiter somehow remembered every candidate's name at the crowded booth.
examples.zh: 那位「衣着得体」的招聘官竟记住了展位上每位候选人的名字。

examples.en: He arrived well-dressed for the video interview even though only his top half showed.
examples.zh: 视频面试只拍上半身，他还是「穿着讲究」地出了镜。

words.enDefinition: having enough light to see and work comfortably

examples.en: Choose a well-lit bus stop at night so drivers can see you.
examples.zh: 晚上等车要选「光线好」的站台，司机才看得见你。

examples.en: I study in the well-lit reading room because my eyes get tired downstairs.
examples.zh: 我在「光线明亮」的阅览室学习，在楼下待久了眼睛累。

words.enDefinition: written clearly, skillfully, and effectively

examples.en: Her well-written personal statement stood out among hundreds of scholarship applications.
examples.zh: 她那份「写得漂亮」的个人陈述在几百份奖学金申请中脱颖而出。

examples.en: The textbook is well-written, with worked examples that actually make sense to beginners.
examples.zh: 这本教材「写得很好」，例题讲解让初学者真能看懂。

words.enDefinition: A sign warning that the floor is wet

examples.en: I noticed the wet floor sign before stepping into the lobby with my books.
examples.zh: 我抱着书走进门厅前，注意到了「小心地滑警示牌」。

examples.en: The volunteer put a wet floor sign beside the entrance after the rain started.
examples.zh: 开始下雨后，志愿者在入口旁放了一块「小心地滑警示牌」。

collocations: put out a wet floor sign
walk past a wet floor sign

words.enDefinition: asks which dishes will be served for the evening meal

examples.en: Every day at five my roommate texts me asking what's for dinner.
examples.zh: 我室友每天下午五点都会发消息问我：「晚饭吃什么？」

examples.en: What's for dinner? I can smell something amazing from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 「晚饭吃什么？」我从厨房闻到一股特别香的味道。

words.enDefinition: quickly prepare a simple meal with little effort

examples.en: I can whip up some fried rice in ten minutes flat.
examples.zh: 十分钟内我就能「做好」一份炒饭。

examples.en: She whipped up a quick pasta after her late class ended.
examples.zh: 晚课结束后，她飞快地「做好」了一份意面。

words.enDefinition: A page displayed before internet access is granted

examples.en: I opened the Wi-Fi sign-in page when the network did not connect automatically.
examples.zh: 网络没自动连上时，我打开了「无线网登录页面」。

examples.en: The Wi-Fi sign-in page appeared after I selected the community hall's guest network.
examples.zh: 我选了社区活动大厅的访客网络后，「无线网登录页面」就弹出来了。

collocations: instructions on the Wi-Fi sign-in page

words.enDefinition: fully awake, with no feeling of sleepiness left

examples.en: A cold shower got me wide awake before my eight a.m. lecture.
examples.zh: 早八上课前，一次冷水澡让我「完全清醒」了。

examples.en: I was wide awake at midnight after drinking that bubble tea.
examples.zh: 喝了那杯奶茶之后，我半夜十二点还「清醒得很」。

words.enDefinition: a comb with teeth spaced far apart

examples.en: I used a wide-tooth comb after swimming because my hair had tangled during practice.
examples.zh: 游泳训练时头发打了结，我游完用了一把「宽齿梳」。

examples.en: She took a wide-tooth comb from her bag while we waited for the bus.
examples.zh: 我们等公交时，她从包里拿出了一把「宽齿梳」。

words.enDefinition: the wireless network that connects devices to the internet

examples.en: The dorm wifi drops every evening when everyone streams shows at once.
examples.zh: 每晚大家同时看剧，宿舍的「无线网络」就会掉线。

examples.en: Ask at the counter for the wifi name and password before you order.
examples.zh: 点单前先到柜台问一下「无线网络」的名称和密码。

words.enDefinition: the code you need to join a wireless network

examples.en: Could you text me the wifi password before I come over to study?
examples.zh: 我过去自习之前，能先把「WiFi密码」发我一下吗？

examples.en: The cafe posts its wifi password on a little chalkboard by the counter.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把「WiFi密码」写在柜台边的小黑板上。

words.enDefinition: slowly relax after a busy day before sleeping

examples.en: I wind down with ten minutes of stretching before I sleep.
examples.zh: 睡前我会做十分钟拉伸来「放松」。

examples.en: She winds down by journaling instead of scrolling her phone in bed.
examples.zh: 她靠写日记「放松」，而不是躺在床上刷手机。

collocations: wind down after a long day

words.enDefinition: a lightweight jacket designed to keep the wind out

examples.en: I took a windbreaker for the walk across the bridge because it gets windy there.
examples.zh: 过桥那段路风大，我带了件「防风夹克」。

examples.en: The windbreaker folds small enough to fit beside my lunch box in my bag.
examples.zh: 「防风夹克」折起来挺小，能在包里塞到饭盒旁边。

words.enDefinition: with a lot of wind blowing outside

examples.en: It's too windy for the rooftop picnic; everything keeps blowing away.
examples.zh: 今天外面「风很大」，天台野餐的东西老被吹跑。

examples.en: Hold your umbrella right; the lakeside path gets really windy at dusk.
examples.zh: 伞要抓稳，傍晚的湖边小路「风」特别大。

words.enDefinition: A distinct section extending from a building's main part

examples.en: An entire wing of the building was closed while the volunteers set up the exhibition.
examples.zh: 志愿者布展时，这栋楼有「整个侧翼」暂不开放。

examples.en: I went into the wrong wing of the building and had to cross the courtyard again.
examples.zh: 我进了「这栋楼的另一翼」，只好再穿过院子走回去。

collocations: a new wing of a building
close one wing of the building
a room in the east wing of the building

words.enDefinition: to remove something by moving a cloth, tissue or hand over it

examples.en: I used my sleeve to wipe away the mist on the bus window.
examples.zh: 我用袖子「擦掉」公交车玻璃上的雾气。

examples.en: I stopped to wipe away the spilled tea before opening my notebook.
examples.zh: 打开笔记本之前，我先「擦掉」洒出来的茶。

words.enDefinition: clean a surface thoroughly with a damp cloth

examples.en: Could you wipe down the counter after you cook tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚做完饭后你能把操作台「擦干净」吗？

examples.en: I wiped down the desk with a damp cloth before studying.
examples.zh: 学习前我用湿布把书桌「擦干净」了。

words.enDefinition: connecting or working without any wires or cables

examples.en: A wireless keyboard frees up half of my tiny dorm desk.
examples.zh: 「无线」键盘能省出我那张小书桌的一半地方。

examples.en: Our wireless earbuds keep disconnecting on the bus route home.
examples.zh: 回家那路公交上，我们的「无线」耳机老是断连。

words.enDefinition: clever and funny with words

examples.en: His witty replies keep our group chat lively at midnight.
examples.zh: 他「风趣的」回复让我们的群聊在午夜依然热闹。

examples.en: The witty host made every campus tour feel like a comedy show.
examples.zh: 那位「风趣的」讲解员让每次校园导览都像看脱口秀。

words.enDefinition: move or shake unsteadily from side to side

examples.en: Old dorm tables wobble every time you set a mug down.
examples.zh: 宿舍那张旧桌子，一放杯子就「晃」。

examples.en: My stacked library books wobbled dangerously as I climbed the stairs.
examples.zh: 我抱着摞起来的图书馆的书爬楼梯，书堆一路「晃晃悠悠」。

words.enDefinition: to eat food very quickly and greedily

examples.en: I wolfed down a sandwich before sprinting to my afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 我「狼吞虎咽」地塞了个三明治，就冲去上下午的研讨课。

examples.en: Don't wolf down your lunch; the study group meets in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 别「狼吞虎咽」，学习小组二十分钟后就开始了。

words.enDefinition: damaged or thin from being used a long time

examples.en: These running shoes are so worn out that my knees started hurting.
examples.zh: 这双跑鞋「磨」得太旧，我的膝盖都开始疼了。

examples.en: The couch came with the flat and is completely worn out.
examples.zh: 沙发是房东留下的，已经「旧」得不成样子。

words.enDefinition: unhappy because you keep thinking about a possible problem

examples.en: My mom gets worried whenever I don't reply to her messages.
examples.zh: 只要我不回消息，我妈就会很「担心」。

examples.en: Honestly, I'm a little worried about my grades this semester.
examples.zh: 说实话，我有点「担心」这学期的成绩。

words.enDefinition: good enough to justify the cost or effort

examples.en: The 6 a.m. wake-up hurt, but the sunrise hike was worth it.
examples.zh: 早上六点起床确实痛苦，但那次日出徒步「值了」。

examples.en: Rent near campus is high, but being ten minutes from everything is worth it.
examples.zh: 校外房租是贵，但去哪儿都只要十分钟，「值了」。

words.enDefinition: important enough to bring up briefly

examples.en: One detail worth mentioning: the shared dorm kitchens close for cleaning every Sunday night.
examples.zh: 有个细节「值得一提」：宿舍公用厨房每周日晚封闭打扫。

examples.en: It's worth mentioning that the professor accepts late submissions once per term.
examples.zh: 还「值得一提」的是，教授每学期允许迟交一次作业。

words.enDefinition: deserving the time or effort you put in

examples.en: The volunteer program was worthwhile because I made friends and improved my English.
examples.zh: 这个志愿项目很「值得」，我既交了朋友又练了英语。

examples.en: Flying home for one weekend is expensive, but for my sister's wedding it felt worthwhile.
examples.zh: 为一个周末飞回家不便宜，但赶上姐姐的婚礼就觉得「值」。

words.enDefinition: finish the last part of an activity or meeting

examples.en: Let's wrap up the group call—it's almost the dorm's quiet hours.
examples.zh: 小组通话就到这里「收尾」吧，快到宿舍安静时段了。

examples.en: The presenter wrapped up five minutes early and left time for questions.
examples.zh: 汇报人提前五分钟「收尾」，留出了提问时间。

words.enDefinition: twist wet cloth tightly to squeeze out water

examples.en: Wring out the mop before you lean it against the wall.
examples.zh: 拖把先「拧干」了，再靠到墙边。

examples.en: She wrung out her soaked socks over the bathtub after the rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴雨过后，她在浴缸上方「拧干」湿透的袜子。

collocations: wring it out over the sink

words.enDefinition: made to stay smooth without easily forming creases

examples.en: I packed a wrinkle-resistant shirt for the conference because it had to fit in my backpack.
examples.zh: 出席会议的衣服得塞进背包，所以我带了一件「不易起皱的」衬衫。

examples.en: Her wrinkle-resistant trousers still looked neat after the long train ride back to campus.
examples.zh: 坐了很久火车回学校，她那条「不易起皱的」长裤看起来还是挺整齐。

words.enDefinition: covered in lines and folds that need ironing

examples.en: My interview shirt came out of the suitcase completely wrinkled.
examples.zh: 面试的衬衫从行李箱里拿出来，已经「皱」得不成样子。

examples.en: She irons everything she owns, so nothing in her closet is wrinkled.
examples.zh: 她的衣服件件都熨，衣柜里找不出一件「起皱」的。

words.enDefinition: record information on paper so you remember it

examples.en: Write down the wifi password before you forget it again.
examples.zh: 趁还没忘，把无线网密码「写下来」。

examples.en: I wrote down the meeting spot that she suggested yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我把她建议的碰头地点「记了下来」。

words.enDefinition: pull something suddenly and with a lot of force

examples.en: Don't yank the charger out by the cable; pull the plug instead.
examples.zh: 拔充电器别「猛拽」线，要捏住插头拔。

examples.en: He yanked the suitcase off the carousel before anyone else could reach it.
examples.zh: 他抢先从行李传送带上「猛拽」出箱子，别人都没来得及伸手。

words.enDefinition: continuing through every season of the year

examples.en: The campus swimming pool stays open year-round, even during winter break.
examples.zh: 校游泳馆「全年」开放，寒假也不例外。

examples.en: This farmer's market runs year-round with covered stalls for snowy days.
examples.zh: 这个农夫市场「全年」营业，下雪天还有带顶棚的摊位。

words.enDefinition: shout angrily at someone because you are upset

examples.en: The coach yelled at us for jogging through the warm-up drills.
examples.zh: 教练因为我们热身敷衍而「冲我们大吼」。

examples.en: My mom used to yell at me for leaving lights on everywhere.
examples.zh: 我妈以前总因为我到处不关灯「吼我」。

collocations: get yelled at by the coach

words.enDefinition: A map label marking the viewer's current location

examples.en: I looked for the “You are here” dot before trying to locate our meeting room.
examples.zh: 我先找地图上的「您在此处」标记，再找我们要去的会议室。

examples.en: The map's “You are here” marker showed that we were in the east wing.
examples.zh: 地图上的「您在此处」标记显示我们在东翼。

words.enDefinition: a pocket that closes with a zipper

examples.en: I put my bike key in a zip pocket before setting out for the library.
examples.zh: 出发去图书馆前，我把自行车钥匙放进了「拉链口袋」。

examples.en: The zip pocket was the only part of my jacket where the coins stayed put.
examples.zh: 我这件夹克只有「拉链口袋」能让硬币好好待在里面。

collocations: keep keys in a zip pocket

words.enDefinition: close a jacket or bag using its zipper

examples.en: Zip up your hoodie, the wind is getting stronger outside.
examples.zh: 「拉上」卫衣拉链，外面的风越来越大了。

examples.en: She zipped up her backpack and hurried off to class.
examples.zh: 她「拉好」背包拉链，匆匆赶去上课。

words.enDefinition: the small tab you hold to move a zipper

examples.en: The zipper pull on my jacket was hard to grip with my mittens on.
examples.zh: 戴着连指手套时，我很难捏住夹克的「拉链拉片」。

examples.en: I tied a short ribbon to the zipper pull so I could find it easily.
examples.zh: 我在「拉链拉片」上系了根短丝带，这样就容易找到它了。

words.enDefinition: stop paying attention because you are bored or tired

examples.en: I zoned out halfway through the statistics lecture and missed the deadline announcement.
examples.zh: 统计学课听到一半我就「走神」了，错过了截止日期的通知。

examples.en: Sorry, I zoned out for a second—could you repeat the room number?
examples.zh: 抱歉，我刚才「走神」了，能再说一遍房间号吗？

words.enDefinition: make part of a screen image look bigger

examples.en: Zoom in on the timetable—my eyes can't read the tiny print.
examples.zh: 把课表「放大」，这字太小，我眼睛看不清。

examples.en: I zoomed in on the map until I could see the dorm entrance.
examples.zh: 我把地图「放大」，直到看清宿舍入口。

words.enDefinition: move past very fast with a low buzzing sound

examples.en: Delivery scooters zoom past this crosswalk all through lunch hour.
examples.zh: 午饭时间外卖电动车在这条人行横道「飞驰而过」。

examples.en: The campus shuttle zoomed past us because the stop was full.
examples.zh: 因为站点已满，校车从我们身边「呼啸而过」没停。
